job.title: Blast Line Operator
job.description:
Blast Line Operator

Location: Youngstown, OH
Job Type: Full-Time
Shift: 2nd, 3rd shift
$16/hr
Industry: Steel Manufacturing / Metal Fabrication

Job Summary

Local manufacturer is seeking a dependable Blast Line Operator to join their manufacturing team in Youngstown, OH. The Blast Line Operator is responsible for operating and monitoring equipment used to clean, prepare, and finish steel components prior to additional processing, painting, or fabrication.

This position is ideal for someone who enjoys hands-on industrial work, is comfortable working around large steel products and machinery, and takes pride in maintaining a safe and productive work environment.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Operate and monitor blast line equipment used to clean and prepare steel products.
  • Load and unload steel components onto and from the blast line.
  • Inspect materials before and after processing to ensure they meet quality standards.
  • Remove rust, scale, dirt, paint, and other surface contaminants from steel.
  • Monitor equipment operation and make basic adjustments as needed.
  • Maintain proper flow of material through the blast line to meet production requirements.
  • Identify equipment issues, abnormal noises, or operating conditions and report them to the supervisor.
  • Perform routine cleaning and housekeeping around the blast line and work area.
  • Follow all safety procedures, PPE requirements, and company policies.
  • Use hand tools and basic equipment as required.
  • Work closely with other production employees to maintain workflow and production goals.
  • Complete production and quality documentation as required.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Previous manufacturing, steel, production, or industrial experience preferred.
  • Ability to work in a physically demanding manufacturing environment.
  • Ability to stand, walk, bend, stoop, and lift throughout the shift.
  • Ability to safely handle and work around large steel components.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Ability to follow written and verbal instructions.
  • Dependable attendance and punctuality.
  • Ability to work effectively as part of a team.
  • Willingness to follow all safety procedures and wear required PPE.

Preferred:

  • Previous blast line, shot blast, abrasive blasting, or steel processing experience.
  • Experience operating industrial machinery.
  • Experience working with steel plate or fabricated steel products.
  • Forklift or overhead crane experience.
  • Experience using measuring tools and basic hand tools.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods.
  • Frequent bending, reaching, lifting, and handling of materials.
  • Ability to lift and move materials weighing up to approximately 50 pounds.
  • Ability to work in a manufacturing environment with exposure to dust, noise, vibration, and varying temperatures.
  • Must be comfortable working around heavy machinery and large steel products.
  • Must be able to wear required personal protective equipment, including safety glasses, hearing protection, gloves, and other PPE as required.

Work Environment

This is a heavy industrial manufacturing environment . Employees will work around steel products, production machinery, overhead material-handling equipment, noise, dust, and industrial temperatures. Safety is a priority, and all employees are expected to follow established safety procedures at all times.

job.title: Analog Circuit Design Engineer - Secret Clearance (Remote)
job.description:
Description:
We are seeking a highly experienced Analog Circuit Design Engineer with deep subject matter expertise in complex linear regulator design for space and nuclear environments. This engineer will support the redesign and improvement of highly complex analog circuits used in critical strategic hardware, where reliability, performance, and radiation tolerance are paramount.

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience designing, analyzing, troubleshooting, and redesigning precision linear regulator circuits using MIL SPEC, radiation hardened discrete semiconductor components. This individual must be capable of quickly integrating into an established engineering team, independently evaluating existing designs, and immediately contributing technical expertise to challenging circuit redesign efforts.

Key Responsibilities
• Lead the analysis, redesign, and optimization of complex linear regulator circuits for mission critical space and nuclear applications.

• Serve as the technical subject matter expert for analog circuit design, with particular emphasis on discrete component linear regulators, precision voltage regulation, stability, transient response, and protection circuitry.

• Perform detailed circuit analysis and design evaluations using radiation hardened, MIL SPEC discrete semiconductors and other high reliability electronic components.

• Evaluate existing circuit designs, identify technical limitations and performance risks, and develop robust redesign solutions that meet stringent electrical, environmental, reliability, and radiation requirements.

• Support worst case circuit analysis (WCCA), tolerance analysis, stability analysis, and other detailed electrical performance assessments as needed.

• Collaborate with electrical engineers and multidisciplinary engineering teams to resolve difficult technical challenges and ensure design solutions meet program requirements.

• Provide technical leadership and design recommendations for complex analog circuitry operating in demanding radiation, temperature, and reliability environments.

• Rapidly assess existing designs, establish technical priorities, and begin producing meaningful engineering results with minimal onboarding.

Required Qualifications
• Extensive professional experience in analog circuit design, with demonstrated expertise in complex linear regulator design.

• Proven experience designing or redesigning high reliability analog circuits using discrete semiconductor components.

• Direct experience with radiation hardened components and MIL SPEC parts for space, nuclear, aerospace, or similarly demanding applications.

• Strong understanding of linear regulator architectures, feedback and control loops, loop stability, compensation, transient response, precision references, and protection circuits.

• Demonstrated ability to analyze complex legacy circuit designs, identify root causes of technical issues, and develop practical, defensible redesign solutions.

• Ability to work independently, make sound engineering decisions, and contribute immediately to complex technical efforts.

• Strong technical communication skills, including the ability to document design rationale, explain tradeoffs, and communicate recommendations to engineering leadership and technical teams.

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with radiation effects and component selection for radiation hardened electronics, including applicable total ionizing dose and single event effects considerations.

• Experience supporting spaceflight, strategic defense, nuclear hardened, or other mission critical electronic hardware programs.

• Experience performing detailed worst case circuit analysis, tolerance analysis, and design verification for high reliability analog electronics.

• Familiarity with applicable military and aerospace component specifications, qualification requirements, and environmental design constraints.

Immediate Support Need

This position supports a critical engineering effort involving the redesign of highly complex analog circuits for strategic hardware. We require an established technical expert who can engage quickly, evaluate existing designs, and begin contributing practical design solutions immediately. Candidates whose experience is primarily theoretical or limited to general analog circuit design, without substantial hands on experience in complex linear regulator design and high reliability discrete component implementations, are unlikely to meet the needs of this effort.

job.title: Maintenance Mechanic I
job.description:
SW Title: Maintenance

Top Skills
Strong Mechanical Troubleshooting
Ability to diagnose equipment failures, identify root causes, and perform repairs with minimal supervision.
Strong mechanical reasoning and problem-solving skills are essential.
Hydraulic & Pneumatic Systems Experience
Experience troubleshooting and repairing hydraulic and pneumatic components, including pumps, valves, cylinders, and related systems.
Understanding of industrial fluid power systems and maintenance practices.
Powertrain, Conveyor & Fabrication Skills
Knowledge of chains, gears, bearings, conveyors, and power transmission equipment.
Ability to fabricate, modify, or repair parts and tools when needed to keep equipment running.

Highly Preferred: Previous corrugated manufacturing, paper mill, or industrial production maintenance experience.

Bonus Skills: Boiler experience, forklift operation, and rigging experience.

Position Summary
We are seeking an experienced Mechanic Technician to join a maintenance team supporting a large corrugated manufacturing operation. This role is responsible for troubleshooting, repairing, and maintaining corrugator equipment and supporting systems to ensure safe and efficient production.
The ideal candidate will have strong mechanical troubleshooting skills, experience working with industrial equipment, and the ability to support a variety of machinery rather than specializing in a single area. Candidates from paper mills, corrugated facilities, manufacturing plants, or other industrial maintenance environments are highly encouraged to apply.
Key Responsibilities
Troubleshoot and repair production equipment and support systems
Perform preventive maintenance (PMs) and corrective maintenance activities
Maintain and repair hydraulic and pneumatic systems
Diagnose and repair conveyor, chain, gear, bearing, and power transmission equipment
Fabricate or modify tools, machine parts, and components as needed
Support equipment reliability and minimize production downtime
Operate forklifts and assist with occasional rigging activities
Perform maintenance across multiple machine types and production systems
Follow all safety, quality, and maintenance procedures
Top Skills & Qualifications
Required Skills
Strong mechanical troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities
Experience with hydraulic and pneumatic systems
Knowledge of conveyors, chains, gears, bearings, and power transmission systems
Mechanical reasoning and root-cause analysis skills
Ability to read equipment issues and implement effective repairs
Preferred Experience
Corrugated manufacturing experience
Paper mill experience
Industrial manufacturing maintenance experience
Experience working on older or legacy equipment
Preventive maintenance experience
Bonus Qualifications
Boiler experience
Forklift experience
Rigging experience
Fabrication and welding experience
Equipment & Work Environment
The facility operates a large corrugator system and various supporting equipment, including:
Corrugator line
Roll stands and splicers
Conveyor systems
Banders
Shredder
Baler
Fanfold equipment
Hydraulic shears and slitters
Starch kitchen systems
Many machines are older and require hands-on troubleshooting, creativity, and fabrication skills to keep equipment operating efficiently.
Compensation
Compensation is based on skills, experience, and testing results under the United Steelworkers union pay structure.
Mechanic Technician: Starting at ***/hour
Mechanic Technician 2: Up to ***/hour
Final pay rate will be determined through an onsite skills assessment and evaluation of experience. This assessment will be completed during the interview.
Interview & Testing Process
One onsite interview with facility tour
Maintenance skills assessment conducted during or shortly after the interview
Testing results will determine placement and compensation level
Additional interview round only if necessary
Schedule
Shift Options
1st Shift: 5:45 AM - 2:00 PM
2nd Shift: 1:45 PM - 10:00 PM
3rd Shift: 9:45 PM - 6:00 AM
All shifts include a 15-minute paid overlap for shift handoff.
Current Hiring Need
The primary need is on 2nd and 3rd shifts, with the current opening focused on 3rd shift. Shift assignment may vary based on business needs and staffing requirements.
Training & Onboarding
All new hires will begin training on 1st shift alongside experienced technicians.
2nd Shift Assignments: Typically 1-2 weeks of training on days
3rd Shift Assignments: Typically up to 1 month of training on days
Training duration may vary based on the employee's experience and readiness to work independently.
What Makes a Strong Candidate?
Successful candidates will be:
Strong troubleshooters who can diagnose equipment issues independently
Comfortable working on a wide range of equipment
Experienced with hydraulic and pneumatic systems
Mechanically inclined and resourceful
Committed to preventive maintenance and equipment reliability
Adaptable in a fast-paced manufacturing environment
Willing to learn specialized corrugated manufacturing equipment

job.description:

Hours: 7:30AM – 4pm Monday Through Friday.
1st Shift

Shipping & Receiving Specialist

Position Summary
Seeking an experienced Shipping & Receiving Specialist to support a dynamic, high-volume logistics operation. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing domestic and international shipments, maintaining inventory accuracy, resolving complex receiving and shipping discrepancies, and collaborating across multiple departments to ensure operational excellence. This role requires strong SAP proficiency, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to prioritize competing demands in a fast-paced environment.
Key Responsibilities
Process and coordinate high-volume domestic and international inbound and outbound shipments while ensuring compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements.
Prepare and review all shipping and receiving documentation, including packing lists, bills of lading, manifests, certificates of origin, import/export documentation, letters of credit, declarations, and related records.
Utilize SAP and carrier systems to process transactions, maintain accurate inventory records, and support order fulfillment activities.
Investigate and resolve complex shipping and receiving issues, including shortages, damages, inventory discrepancies, delayed shipments, and documentation errors.
Coordinate with carriers, freight forwarders, customs brokers, suppliers, customers, and internal stakeholders to ensure timely movement of materials.
Partner closely with Customer Service, Project Management, Finance, Procurement, and Operations teams to meet customer commitments and critical delivery schedules.
Manage return material authorizations (RMA) and returned goods processes while ensuring proper communication and documentation.
Maintain inventory integrity through accurate receiving practices, transaction processing, cycle count support, and inventory reconciliation activities.
Generate, analyze, and maintain shipping, receiving, inventory, and performance reports.
Prioritize and expedite critical shipments to support customer requirements and operational needs.
Identify process improvements that enhance efficiency, accuracy, and throughput within shipping and receiving operations.
Maintain compliance with all safety, quality, trade compliance, and company procedures.
Required Qualifications
High School Diploma or GED.
Minimum 3-5 years of experience in shipping, receiving, warehouse operations, logistics, or supply chain environments.
Demonstrated experience handling high-volume domestic and international shipments.
Strong SAP experience with inventory and shipping transactions.
Intermediate to advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
Proven ability to troubleshoot and resolve shipping, receiving, and inventory discrepancies.
Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Excellent communication and customer service skills.
Display good teamwork, flexibility, and initiative.
Interface with different departments, vendors, and customers in a professional manner.
Time management skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience within manufacturing, distribution, aerospace, or industrial environments.
Knowledge of customs documentation, import/export regulations, and freight forwarding processes.
Experience with inventory control, cycle counting, and root cause analysis.
Lean, Continuous Improvement, or Six Sigma experience.
Forklift certification and warehouse equipment experience.
Required Competencies
High attention to detail and commitment to inventory accuracy.
Strong sense of urgency and accountability.
Ability to effectively manage competing priorities and deadlines.
Professional communication with vendors, customers, carriers, and internal stakeholders.
Team-oriented mindset with the flexibility to adapt to changing business needs.
Proven ability to perform under pressure in a demanding operational environment.
Working Conditions
Work is performed in both office and warehouse/shipping-receiving environments.
Frequent standing, walking, and occasional lifting of packages and materials.
Exposure to seasonal temperature variations within warehouse areas.
Overtime and occasional weekend work may be required to support operational demands and critical customer commitments.


Experience:
Warehouse Shipping and Receiving Clerk or Specialist. Logistics experience is a PLUS.

job.title: Engineering Development Site Coordinator
job.description:
The Engineering Development Site Coordinator will provide coordination services supporting the transition, startup, operational readiness, and ongoing technical operations support activities associated with the Southlake Engineering Development Center. During the initial phase of the assignment, services provided will focus on equipment relocation, equipment installation, facility readiness projects, infrastructure implementation efforts, inventory establishment, material handling activities, and coordination of contractors, equipment suppliers, and service providers supporting the transition to Southlake.

As the Southlake facility becomes operational, the scope of the assignment will transition toward ongoing technical operations support activities that enable engineering development, prototyping, equipment evaluation, and capability-building efforts conducted within the facility. These services will include coordination of equipment logistics, inventory and asset tracking, material receiving and movement, facility organization and housekeeping activities, equipment documentation support, and support of safety and environmental compliance activities.

The role will facilitate coordination among engineering teams, facilities personnel, contractors, equipment suppliers, and service providers to support the execution of planned projects, installations, and operational activities. The assignment may also provide technical documentation support, including maintenance of engineering drawing packages, document retention activities, and support of records maintained within AutoCAD, Autodesk Inventor, Vault, or similar engineering documentation systems. The ideal candidate will possess a strong technical operations background and be comfortable working within industrial, manufacturing, pilot, engineering development, or research environments while supporting multiple concurrent projects and initiatives.

This assignment will support transition, relocation, readiness, startup, and ongoing technical operations activities associated with the Southlake Engineering Development Center. Services provided through this assignment include coordination of equipment relocation and installation activities, facility readiness efforts, infrastructure implementation support, material handling, inventory and asset tracking, contractor coordination, engineering documentation support, and safety and environmental compliance support activities. The assignment is expected to evolve from an initial focus on facility transition and readiness efforts toward ongoing support of day-to-day engineering development center operations and capability-building activities.

• Minimum 7 years of experience supporting manufacturing, technical operations, facilities, maintenance, engineering support, industrial project implementation, equipment installation, facility startup, contractor coordination, or industrial infrastructure projects. (Required)

• Experience operating industrial material handling equipment and willingness to obtain required forklift and scissor-lift certifications immediately upon assignment if not currently certified; familiarity with inventory management systems, material logistics, and asset tracking. (Required)

• Working knowledge of industrial safety practices, environmental compliance requirements, waste management processes, and Microsoft Office applications in industrial or technical environments. (Required)

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Engineering Technology, Industrial Technology, Facilities Management, Operations Management, or related technical discipline and experience with AutoCAD, Autodesk Inventor, Vault, or similar engineering drawing and document management systems. (Preferred)

Note:
Preference will be given to an Food and Beverage family of companies retiree with an engineering, manufacturing/production operations, maintenance, or facilities background who brings practical industry knowledge and general understanding of the organizational ways of working.

Top 3 Skills:
1) Industrial equipment & facility coordination (equipment moves/installs, facility readiness, infrastructure implementation)
2) Technical operations & material handling (forklift/scissor-lift operation, material receiving & movement, general parts/inventory management & upkeep, assurance and records management for safety & environment requirements)
3) Project coordination & technical documentation (coordination with other contractors/vendors for site efforts, technical project execution for equipment changes)

job.title: Manufacturing Training Specialist
job.description:
Manufacturing Training Specialist

Location: Fairport, NY
Schedule: Monday – Friday, 7:00 AM – 4:00 PM
Shift: First Shift
Work Environment: Manufacturing / Plant Operations
Travel: Less than 5%

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Manufacturing Training Specialist to support the development, delivery, administration, and continuous improvement of a manufacturing plant's training program.

This position will play a key role in implementing standardized training methodologies, administering learning management systems, coordinating employee onboarding, and developing effective training content for production and operational employees.

The ideal candidate will have experience in manufacturing training, instructional design, Training Within Industry (TWI), Learning Management Systems (LMS), and eLearning development, along with strong communication, project management, and organizational skills.

Key Responsibilities

Manufacturing Training & Program Development

  • Serve as the plant's primary Training Within Industry (TWI) trainer and auditor.

  • Deliver TWI Job Instruction training to manufacturing and operational employees.

  • Coach employees, trainers, and department leaders on the consistent application of TWI training methodologies.

  • Evaluate training effectiveness and audit adherence to standardized training practices.

  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve plant training programs.

  • Support the standardization of training processes across departments.

  • Provide coaching, resources, and training support to Process Training and Qualification Leads.

  • Partner with subject matter experts, production teams, and department leadership to identify training needs and opportunities for improvement.

Learning Management System Administration

  • Administer the Dozuki training and knowledge management platform, including:

    • Training content organization and structure

    • User access and system support

    • Training deployment

    • Platform utilization and effectiveness

  • Administer TrueBlue Learning activities supporting plant operations, including:

    • Employee training assignments

    • Curriculum management

    • Training records and documentation

    • Training reporting and tracking

    • User assistance and troubleshooting

  • Maintain accurate training records and qualification documentation.

  • Monitor employee training completion and identify training gaps.

  • Generate reports to evaluate training progress, compliance, and program effectiveness.

  • Support effective use of learning technologies across the organization.

Employee Onboarding & Training Coordination

  • Coordinate and lead new employee onboarding activities.

  • Organize and facilitate training sessions for newly hired manufacturing employees.

  • Collaborate with production supervisors, department leaders, and training resources to ensure employees receive appropriate training.

  • Support employee qualification and job-specific training requirements.

  • Track onboarding progress and training completion.

  • Ensure training activities align with plant operational needs and established procedures.

Instructional Design & eLearning Development

  • Design, develop, update, and deploy engaging eLearning content.

  • Apply adult learning principles and instructional design methodologies to create effective training materials.

  • Develop training content using appropriate instructional methods and multimedia resources.

  • Translate complex technical and operational information into clear, practical training materials.

  • Evaluate existing training content and recommend improvements.

  • Support the development of classroom, hands-on, and digital training programs.

  • Ensure training materials remain accurate, relevant, and aligned with operational requirements.

Training Technology & Continuous Improvement

  • Evaluate, develop, and implement training technologies that improve learning delivery and administration.

  • Identify opportunities to improve training accessibility, effectiveness, and efficiency.

  • Support or lead plant training projects and cross-functional improvement initiatives.

  • Collaborate with department stakeholders to implement new training processes, tools, and systems.

  • Support training automation, reporting improvements, and technology integrations.

  • Utilize training data and reporting to identify performance gaps and recommend improvements.

  • Promote continuous improvement and standardized training practices throughout the manufacturing facility.

Required Education & Experience

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Education, Instructional Design, Engineering, or a related field.

Experience

  • Experience developing, delivering, or administering training programs in a manufacturing, technical, or operational environment.

  • Experience facilitating classroom and hands-on training for employees with varying levels of experience.

  • Experience administering learning systems and maintaining training records.

  • Experience developing instructional materials and eLearning content.

  • Experience supporting training projects and continuous improvement initiatives.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Strong knowledge of adult learning principles and structured on-the-job training methodologies.

  • Ability to facilitate effective classroom and hands-on training sessions.

  • Experience administering Learning Management Systems (LMS) and tracking employee training progress.

  • Ability to develop clear, engaging, and effective training materials using various instructional methods.

  • Strong project management, organizational, and follow-through skills.

  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking abilities.

  • Ability to translate complex technical requirements into practical training solutions.

  • Strong written, verbal, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Microsoft 365 applications, including:

    • Excel

    • Word

    • PowerPoint

    • Outlook

    • SharePoint

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with production employees, subject matter experts, department leaders, and senior management.

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Training Within Industry (TWI) Job Instruction certification or demonstrated proficiency with TWI methodologies.

  • Experience conducting training audits and evaluating compliance with standardized training practices.

  • Experience administering a SCORM-compliant Learning Management System.

  • Experience with Dozuki or similar manufacturing training and knowledge management platforms.

  • Experience with eLearning authoring tools and instructional design practices.

  • Experience developing or implementing training technologies, including:

    • Training automation

    • Reporting and analytics

    • Microsoft Power Platform solutions

    • System integrations

  • Knowledge of manufacturing operations and production processes.

  • Familiarity with process standardization, employee qualification systems, and continuous improvement methodologies.

  • Experience supporting manufacturing training initiatives across multiple departments.

Work Schedule & Travel Requirements

  • Schedule: Monday – Friday

  • Hours: 7:00 AM – 4:00 PM

  • Shift: First Shift

  • Additional or off-shift hours may be required to support employee onboarding, training delivery, special projects, and operational needs.

  • Travel: Less than 5%, primarily for training, networking, and benchmarking activities.

What You Will Be Doing

-The engineer will work on complex technical problems and provide solutions that are innovative and ingenious.
-The engineer will act independently to uncover and resolve issues associated with the implementation of operational products.

•Experience with hands on hardware
•Experience with the use of RF microwave test equipment and microwave simulation tools is required.
•Excellent communication and presentation skills are required.

•Expertise with RF subsystems and hardware including antennas, transmitters, receivers, microwave components, low noise amplifiers, high power amplifiers, advanced electronic modules, amplifiers, mixers, switches, frequency generation circuits, and frequency conversion circuits is desired.

•Strong communication skills.
•Experience with customer interface including technical presentations.

Position Overview

The Production Assembly and Packaging Associate builds finished goods from prepared components, hardware, and partially completed assemblies. This position also inspects, packages, and identifies completed units according to production documentation, customer requirements, and internal procedures.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review job travelers, production instructions, bills of materials, and related documentation before beginning work.

  • Notify the appropriate production leader or quality representative when documentation conflicts, missing components, assembly concerns, or packaging issues are identified.

  • Test and visually inspect completed units for correct operation, cleanliness, workmanship, and possible defects.

  • Make ongoing quality decisions to ensure only acceptable products are approved for shipment.

  • Complete the final quality review before finished units are packed and released to the customer.

  • Help orient and train newly assigned employees on relevant processes and expectations.

  • Participate in hand and body stretching or warm-up activities at the beginning of the shift and following meal and rest breaks to reduce the risk of repetitive-motion injuries.

  • Communicate and work effectively with supervisors, quality personnel, and other team members.

  • Perform additional production-related responsibilities as assigned.

  • Ability to communicate clearly and work cooperatively with others.

  • Ability to safely operate common hand tools and selected powered equipment, which may include cutting equipment and a stationary drill.

Electronic Control Units (ECUs)
Aerospace engine control systems
Auxiliary Power Unit (APU) controls
Cabin pressure control systems
Sensors, actuators, and electromechanical devices

Engineering change management and product lifecycle support

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical Systems Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
Due to U.S. export control regulations, applicants must be a U.S. Citizen, U.S. Permanent Resident, or otherwise have authorization to work on export-controlled projects.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Position Overview
We are seeking an experienced Senior PCB Designer with strong RF layout expertise to join our engineering team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience designing complex, high-speed, multi-layer PCBs for mission-critical applications, preferably within the defense or aerospace industry. This role requires deep technical knowledge of RF design principles, signal integrity, and industry compliance standards, along with proficiency in Altium Designer, Siemens Xpedition (Mentor), and Cadence Allegro.

Key Responsibilities
• Design and develop complex, multi-layer PCBs (including rigid, flex, and rigid-flex) for RF and high-speed digital applications
• Perform RF layout for controlled impedance structures, transmission lines, antennas, filters, LNAs, Client, and mixed-signal designs
• Implement best practices for signal integrity (SI), power integrity (PI), EMI/EMC mitigation, and thermal management
• Collaborate closely with RF, hardware, mechanical, and manufacturing engineers throughout the product lifecycle
• Create and maintain PCB libraries, stack-ups, and design rules
• Generate fabrication and assembly documentation packages
• Support prototype bring-up, testing, and debugging activities

Required Qualifications
• 8+ years of professional PCB design experience
• Extensive RF layout experience (GHz-range designs preferred)
• Strong proficiency in:
o Altium Designer
o Siemens Xpedition (Mentor Graphics)
o Cadence Allegro PCB Designer
• Experience with high-layer-count boards (10+ layers preferred)
• Deep understanding of:
o Controlled impedance routing
o Differential pair routing
o Crosstalk mitigation
o Return path management
o Grounding and shielding strategies
• Experience working with high-speed interfaces (e.g., SERDES, DDR, PCIe, Ethernet, etc.)
• Familiarity with stack-up design and material selection for RF performance
• Working knowledge of SI/PI analysis tools

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience in the defense, aerospace, or military electronics industry

• Experience designing for harsh environments (temperature, vibration, shock)

Soft Skills
• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills

• Detail-oriented with strong documentation discipline
• Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced, regulated environment
• Leadership mindset with mentoring capability

Education
• Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Technology, or related field (or equivalent experience)

Why Join Us
• Work on cutting-edge RF and mission-critical defense technologies
• Collaborative engineering culture
• Competitive compensation and benefits
• Opportunity to make a direct impact on national security programs

job.title: Shipping
job.description:
OVERALL SUMMARY

This position is responsible for all aspects of shipping material goods from the warehouse while providing customer service to both internal and external customers.  Monday - Friday, 7a - 4p  $20-23/hr DOE

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

  • Prepare and pack orders for shipment.
  • Assembles orders, while checking against shipping or customer order; reports shortages and incomplete orders.
  • Select appropriate shipping containers and packing material. Operates standard manual and automatic equipment.
  • Stack shipments on skids and transfer shipments to shipping dock.

job.title: Technical Publications Multimedia Writer - Hybrid
job.description:
Description:
Writes, rewrites and/or edits technical documents such as technical procedure manuals, user manuals, programming manuals, service manuals, operational specifications, and related technical publications to communicate clearly and effectively technical specifications and instructions to a wide range of audiences. Acquires subject knowledge by interviewing product developers, observing performance of production methods, referring to technical specifications, blueprints, engineering illustrations, and trade journals. Oversees preparation of illustrative materials, selecting drawings, sketches, diagrams and charts. Conducts quality review of materials.

Specific Job Description:
Candidate will perform as a Technical Publications Multimedia Engineer supporting the Precision Fires line of business including MLRS, HIMARS, GMLRS, ATACMS, and PrSM programs. Position requires preparation of Interactive Electronic Technical Manuals, other technical publications, Depot Maintenance Work Requirements (DMWRs), Repair Parts and Special Tools Lists (RPSTL) and graphics in accordance with applicable military standard and commercial requirements. Position will also coordinate and support technical meetings with the customer and team members to ensure compliance is met during exchange of documentation between associate and sub-contractors to ensure materials are developed in accordance with all applicable military and commercial requirements. Candidate will also assist with development and populating technical data in the Logistics Management Information (LMI) system compliant with GEIA-STD-0007.

Required Experience:
- Candidate must have at least 3-5 years experience with Extensible Markup Language (XML) and Standard Generalized Markup Language (SGML)
- Candidate must have at least 3-5 years experience with Arbortext and UltraEdit or similar tools
- Candidate must have at least 3-5 years experience as a technical writer
-Candidate must have at least 3-5 years experience with MIL-STD-40051, MIL-STD-2361, MIL-PRF-63002 for Modification Work Orders, and MIL-PRF-63033 for Demilitarization
- Candidate must have at least 3-5 years experience with Microsoft Office products (Word, Excel, Project, PowerPoint, SharePoint) and Adobe Acrobat (Standard/Professional).
- Candidate must have at least 3-5 years experience using clear and concise language that adheres to customer-established standards and conventions.
- Candidate must have at least 3-5 years experience with researching and writing technical content for maintenance technical manuals including installation, test, repair, and troubleshooting procedures
- Candidate must have at least 3-5 years experience acquiring and verifying subject matter content by consulting with other disciplines engaged in developing products, observing production methods, referring to engineering drawings, notes, manuals, and similar publications.
-Candidate must have at least 3-5 years experience with Interactive Electronic Technical Manual (IETM) development experience
- Candidate must have at least 3-5 years experience with Graphics illustration experience and skills using graphics tools such as ISOdraw or similar graphics tools
- Strong interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills
- Strong technical background
- Ability to quickly learn new software tools and processes
- Must be able to work well in a team environment and work well with various levels of management
- Strong organizational skills, attention to detail and must be able to work with minimal supervision
- Ability to obtain a U.S. Government Security Clearance
- Candidate must be willing to work overtime and travel as needed to support program requirements

Desired Skills
- Experience leading or supporting Technical Publication Validation and Verification events 3-5 years experience
- Proficiency using Interactive Authoring and Display System (IADS) 4.0 software 3-5 years experience
- Experience working with stylesheets including Extensible Stylesheet Language Formatting Objects (XSL-FO), Extensible Stylesheet Language Transformation (XSLT) and scripting 3-5 years experience
- Working knowledge of Content Management Systems such as WindChill or S1000D Common Source Database 3-5 years experience
- Proficiency with Logistics Management Information (LMI) systems compliant with GEIA-STD-0007 3-5 years experience
- Proficiency with SLIC Wave LMI system 3-5 years experience
- Proficiency with Power Log J LMI system 3-5 years experience
- Experience leading or supporting Logistics Demonstration events 3-5 years experience
- Past military experience
- Past experience as MLRS or HIMARS Launcher Operator and/or MLRS Maintenance Technician
- Proficiency with Pro-E Creo or similar Computer Aided Drafting tools in a 3D environment. 3-5 years experience

The ideal candidate will be comfortable working in a fast-paced warehouse environment and will play an important role in ensuring inventory accuracy, maintaining safety standards, and delivering excellent customer service. job.title: Warehouse Associate - 1st Shift
job.description:
Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–4:30 PM

Position Summary

We are seeking a dependable Warehouse Associate to support daily warehouse and material-handling operations. This position is responsible for receiving, picking, packing, staging, replenishing, and shipping materials while maintaining accurate inventory records and following established safety and quality procedures.

The ideal candidate is safety-focused, comfortable working in a fast-paced manufacturing environment, and able to perform physically demanding warehouse duties.

Key Responsibilities

  • Receive and unload incoming materials and goods.

  • Enter receiving information into the appropriate system and accurately label and store materials.

  • Pick, verify, separate, and stage customer orders for shipment.

  • Pack and repack materials according to customer specifications.

  • Prepare boxes, labels, and other shipping materials as needed.

  • Ensure products and materials are properly identified and labeled.

  • Complete system transactions related to receiving, inventory, and shipping.

  • Participate in cycle counts, verify inventory information, research discrepancies, and make necessary adjustments.

  • Perform required forklift inspections and review preventative maintenance checklists to ensure equipment is in safe working condition.

  • Operate forklifts and other material-moving equipment as required.

  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area.

  • Follow all company safety policies, procedures, and work rules.

  • Complete required paperwork accurately and on time.

  • May handle, transport, or assist with the disposal of hazardous waste. Required training will be provided when applicable to ensure compliance with RCRA waste-management requirements.

  • Perform additional warehouse and material-handling duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or GED required.

  • Previous warehouse, manufacturing, or material-handling experience preferred.

  • Forklift experience and/or forklift operator certification/license preferred or required based on assignment.

  • Ability to read, understand, and follow written instructions and safety procedures.

  • Basic math and quantitative skills.

  • Good manual dexterity and attention to detail.

job.title: CNC Lathe Machinist
job.description:
CNC Lathe Machinist

Phoenix, AZ · On-site · Full-time

Join a leading aerospace manufacturer in Phoenix where precision matters and your skills help produce mission-critical components. We're hiring experienced CNC Lathe Machinists who can independently set up, run, and prove out parts on modern Fanuc-controlled turning centers. Multiple shifts available.

Pay Range: $25–$35/hr
Shift: 2nd Shift (Mon–Thurs) (+8% Shift Differential)

What You'll Do

  • Set up and operate CNC lathes and turning centers utilizing Fanuc controls
  • Perform complete machine setups, tooling changes, offsets, and program prove-outs

  • Read and interpret complex blueprints and GD&T requirements
  • Perform first-piece, in-process, and final inspections using precision measuring instruments
  • Troubleshoot machining issues including tool wear, chatter, surface finish concerns, and tolerance drift
  • Maintain production efficiency while ensuring compliance with quality standards

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of CNC lathe machining experience in aerospace or precision manufacturing environments
  • Proven ability to perform independent setups and program prove-outs
  • Strong experience with Fanuc controls
  • Experience machining tight-tolerance components (±0.001" or better)
  • Strong blueprint reading and GD&T interpretation skills
  • Experience using calipers, micrometers, bore gauges, indicators, and other precision measuring equipment
  • Familiarity with live tooling, multi-axis lathes, or twin-spindle machines is a plus
  • Reliable, safety-minded, and detail-oriented

Position Summary
We are seeking an experienced, highly organized, and detail-oriented AP/AR General Accounting Associate to join our accounting team. This direct-hire opportunity is ideal for a dependable accounting professional with strong accounts payable and accounts receivable experience, excellent problem-solving skills, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
The successful candidate will be responsible for supporting daily accounts payable and accounts receivable activities, maintaining accurate financial records, resolving account discrepancies, and assisting with month-end accounting processes.

  • SAP accounting software experience is strongly preferred.

job.title: Director of Maintenance & Plant Engineering
job.description:
Nesco Resource is hiring for Director of Maintenance and Plant Engineering in the Manchester, TN Area.

  • Salary Range: $140,000-$160,000 annually
  • Classification: Salary-Exempt (does not receive OT)
  • Work schedule: Monday – Friday 8a-5p (must be willing to work outside core hours if/when needed)
  • EXCELLENT BENEFITS - 20% bonus, Car wash, Onsite Chiropractor, Onsite Hair Salon, Onsite Gym, 401K, Insurances, and etc.

Job Summary

This role provides strategic and operational leadership for plant engineering, facilities, maintenance, utilities, and capital-project execution. The position is accountable for safe, reliable, and cost-effective equipment and infrastructure; improved plant uptime and manufacturing capability; development of engineering and skilled-trades personnel; and delivery of capital projects that support the company's safety, quality, delivery, cost, customer, and growth objectives.

Essential Functions

  • Provide leadership for plant engineering, facilities, maintenance, utilities, equipment reliability, and technical support activities.
  • Establish and execute maintenance and reliability strategies that improve safety, equipment availability, plant uptime, and lifecycle cost.
  • Set targets and review performance for preventive and predictive maintenance compliance, downtime, mean time between failures, mean time to repair, overall equipment effectiveness, maintenance cost, and schedule attainment.
  • Ensure recurring equipment failures are addressed through disciplined root-cause analysis, corrective action, and verification of effectiveness.
  • Develop and maintain critical-equipment, spare-parts, obsolescence, and business-continuity plans that reduce operational risk.
  • Lead annual capital-expenditure planning, project prioritization, budget development, forecasting, and approval recommendations aligned with business objectives.
  • Direct equipment specifications, supplier technical evaluations, procurement support, installation, commissioning, capability validation, and final acceptance of capital equipment.
  • Manage capital-project scope, schedule, cost, risk, and return-on-investment commitments; communicate status and corrective actions to executive leadership.
  • Ensure facilities, utilities, equipment, and engineering activities comply with applicable safety, environmental, regulatory, customer, and company requirements.
  • Partner with Production, Quality, Safety, Purchasing, Finance, Information Technology, Human Resources, customers, and suppliers to support launches, capacity needs, operational readiness, and continuous improvement.
  • Build organizational capability through workforce planning, succession planning, technical training, performance management, and development of engineering and skilled-trades personnel.
  • Allocate personnel, contractors, and technical resources to meet plant priorities, customer requirements, planned shutdowns, and emergency-response needs.
  • Standardize engineering and maintenance systems, documentation, project controls, and work practices to improve execution and knowledge retention.
  • Promote lean manufacturing, data-based decision-making, energy efficiency, automation, and cost-reduction initiatives that improve operational performance.

Leadership Competencies

  • Strategic planning and disciplined execution.
  • Sound financial judgment and capital stewardship.
  • Team development, coaching, succession planning, and accountability.
  • Cross-functional leadership and effective customer and supplier communication.
  • Urgency, structured problem-solving, and fact-based decision-making.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities independently and through teams.
  • Performs other duties as required.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical field required; equivalent combinations of education and progressively responsible technical leadership experience may be considered.
  • Eight (8) to ten (10) years of progressive plant engineering, maintenance, reliability, facilities, or capital-project experience in a manufacturing environment, including leadership of managers, engineers, or skilled-trades teams.
  • Automotive manufacturing experience strongly preferred, with working knowledge of IATF 16949, ISO 14001, customer-specific requirements, launch readiness, and disciplined problem-solving.
  • Demonstrated experience with preventive, predictive, and condition-based maintenance; root-cause analysis; equipment reliability; spare-parts strategy; and maintenance performance metrics.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing capital plans and managing equipment projects from business case and specification through installation, commissioning, validation, and acceptance.
  • Working knowledge of relevant manufacturing processes, automation, controls, robotics, tooling, utilities, and facility systems; experience with the company's core manufacturing processes preferred.
  • Proficiency with computerized maintenance management systems, project-management software, Microsoft Excel, data analysis, and reporting tools; CAD familiarity preferred.
  • Knowledge of lean manufacturing, continuous improvement, risk assessment, contractor management, and applicable safety and environmental requirements.
  • Demonstrated written, presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with executives, employees, customers, and suppliers.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, respond to urgent plant needs, and work outside normal business hours when operational support requires it.
COM101

job.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
job.description:
Our client is a leading electronics manufacturer who is currently enduring an exciting growth phase due to a recent acquisition. This has led to multiple career opportunities on their Engineering team. Great time to jump on board with a thriving and growing organization with an excellent benefits package!

Job Purpose

The Senior Electrical Engineer provides technical leadership in the design, development, testing, and support of electronic products for defense applications. This role requires deep expertise in power electronics, battery protection systems, embedded controls, and compliance with military standards, and plays a key role in guiding engineering efforts to deliver reliable energy solutions for mission-critical defense operations.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

• Play lead role in the architecture and development of electrical circuits for electronic products.
• Create detailed electrical schematics and specifications for electronic products.
• Design and integrate monitoring and protection systems to ensure safe and reliable operation.
• Perform system analysis related to electrical performance, thermal management, electromagnetic
interference, and system reliability.
• Use engineering tools for simulation, modeling, and analysis of electrical designs.
• Support environmental and electrical qualification testing in accordance with military and defense
standards.
• Work closely with mechanical, software, systems, and manufacturing teams throughout the
development cycle.
• Participate in technical reviews and risk assessments for new products.
• Provide technical support to Sales and Marketing for bids and proposals.
• Prepare clear documentation for testing, production, and customer requirements
• Mentor junior engineers and support team development.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, A Master's degree is preferred.
• 10+ years of experience in electrical design, power systems, or defense-related products.
• Strong knowledge of lithium-ion and similar battery technologies, including system safety and
protection designs.
• Experience working with high-voltage battery systems and energy storage designs, including low EMI
circuit design.
• Proficiency with electrical design software tools.
• Experience integrating electronics with microcontrollers and communication networks such as
Controller Area Network (CAN) or serial communications.
• Hands-on experience with testing, troubleshooting, and qualifying electronic systems.
• Detail-oriented with a strong commitment to product quality and reliability.
• Creative and adaptable approach to engineering challenges.

You'll be responsible for setting up and operating metal fabrication equipment, accurately forming and cutting sheet metal, reading blueprints and cut lists, and inspecting finished work for quality.   • Ability to read and interpret blueprints and technical drawings
  • Strong understanding of shop math, measurements, and dimensions
  • Experience using measuring tools such as calipers, micrometers, and other precision instruments
  • Ability to accurately set up machinery and tooling
  • Familiarity with hand tools, machining tools, and assembly processes
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality
  • Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced manufacturing environment
  • Ability to follow safety procedures and maintain a clean work area

Why Join Us?

This is a Temp-to-Hire opportunity with the potential to become a permanent member of the team. If you have sheet metal or press brake experience and are looking for a stable manufacturing opportunity in the Corning area, we'd like to hear from you.

job.title: Service Life Analysis Engineer - Secret Clearance
job.description:
Description:
Aeronautics is seeking a Service Life Analysis Engineer in Fort Worth, Texas. A successful candidate will apply their understanding of Durability and Damage Tolerance (DaDT) analysis using fracture mechanics to develop innovative and ingenious solutions to highly complex technical problems. Responsibilities for this position may include:
- DaDT and Fatigue analysis, detail part sizing, and strength assessment of aircraft primary and secondary structure and systems
- Using crack initiation and crack growth analysis tools to perform design sizing, Material Review Board (MRB), drawing review, and preparing analysis reports
- Development of force management source data to actively manage airframe to ensure safe operation
- Development and implementation of Force Structural Maintenance Plans (FSMPs) and Individual Aircraft Tracking (IAT) to support force management activities

Must be a US Citizen; this position will require a government security clearance.

job.description:

Perform electrical assembly requirements, which include panel layout and drilling, conduit and wire way installation and assembly, wire pulling and termination. Daily interaction with both test technicians and engineers. Communication and Teamwork skills are extremely important.

• Prior Military (USAF, USN) service a plus.

job.title: Shipping and Receiving Clerk
job.description:
Shipping & Receiving Associate
Pay: Starting at $18.00 per hour
Schedule: Monday–Thursday, 6:00 AM–4:30 PM
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Overview
We are looking for a dependable, detail-oriented Shipping & Receiving Associate to join the team. This position is responsible for preparing orders for shipment, receiving and inspecting incoming products, maintaining accurate shipping documentation, and ensuring orders are pulled and packaged correctly.
The ideal candidate has at least 3 years of shipping and receiving experience, is comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, and takes pride in accuracy, safety, and customer service. Forklift certification is preferred but not required for candidates willing to complete certification training.
Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare customer orders for shipment, including picking, packing, labeling, pallet wrapping, and completing shipping paperwork.
  • Select the most economical shipping method based on company requirements or customer instructions.
  • Prepare shipments using UPS systems and documentation, including Bills of Lading (BOLs) for truckload (TL) and less-than-truckload (LTL) shipments.
  • Receive incoming deliveries and inspect products for correct quantities, quality, damage, and discrepancies.
  • Verify purchase orders, packing slips, product labels, and product descriptions to ensure order accuracy.
  • Double-check picked orders with a teammate and verify teammates' orders before shipment.
  • Pull products for outside contractors, prepare materials for assembly, and inspect completed assemblies with the Quality Control team to ensure they match purchase order specifications.
  • Assist walk-in customers in a friendly, professional manner.
  • Rotate inventory to ensure older product ships first.
  • Assist with weekly and monthly inventory counts.
  • Package products and perform light assembly work when needed.
  • Operate forklifts and packaging equipment safely.
  • Maintain a clean, organized work area and follow all company safety procedures.
  • Report damaged products, shortages, shipping discrepancies, and other issues to management promptly.
  • Assist with daily work coordination when needed.
Required Qualifications
  • At least 3 years of shipping and receiving experience.
  • Experience preparing shipments and handling shipping documentation.
  • Knowledge of UPS shipping systems or manifest procedures.
  • Experience with TL/LTL shipments and preparing Bills of Lading (BOLs).
  • Basic computer skills.
  • Ability to read, write, perform basic math, and follow written and verbal instructions.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to order accuracy.
  • Ability to communicate professionally with customers and coworkers.
  • Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment and handle periods of increased workload.
  • Commitment to workplace safety and proper use of required personal protective equipment (PPE).
Preferred Qualifications
  • Current forklift certification.
  • Previous experience operating a forklift and packaging equipment.
  • Ability to help coordinate daily work activities when needed.
  • Bilingual communication skills are a plus but are not required.
Forklift certification is not required to apply. Training can be arranged for the right candidate.
Physical & Work Requirements
  • Ability to safely handle, package, and move products throughout the workday.
  • Ability to lift and move materials as required, using dollies, team assistance, and other approved lifting methods when appropriate.
  • Ability to wear required safety equipment, including safety glasses, gloves, masks, and other protective gear as applicable.
  • Ability to maintain a clean, safe, and organized work environment.

If you have solid shipping and receiving experience, understand the importance of accuracy, and enjoy being part of a team, we'd like to hear from you!

job.title: Lead Quality Inspector
job.description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented Quality Inspector to join our client's manufacturing team. This role is responsible for inspecting electrical and mechanical assemblies, ensuring compliance with quality standards, and resolving production quality issues in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform in-process, final, and pre-shipment inspections of electrical and mechanical assemblies.

  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced production environment.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to stand, walk, bend, reach, and perform hands-on inspections.
  • Ability to occasionally lift up to 25 pounds.

job.title: Inside Sales / Estimator
job.description:
Inside Sales / Estimator Job in Danbury, CT:

Salary Range: $60-65,000

We are seeking an Inside Sales / Estimator for a well-established, technologically advanced electronics manufacturer. This is a detail-oriented role combining administrative expertise, analytical thinking, and strong math skills to review technical documentation, communicate with customers and suppliers, and manage the quoting process from start to finish. The right candidate will be comfortable working with bills of materials and Excel, and will also help guide team members and keep quoting procedures on track.
Responsibilities of the Inside Sales / Estimator Job in Danbury, CT:

  • Review, organize, and evaluate incoming RFQs, bills of materials (BOMs), assembly drawings, and technical files.
  • Assist with the preparation and processing of accurate, competitive customer quotes.
  • Convert customer BOMs into standardized Excel and quoting formats.
  • Prepare and submit RFQs to suppliers and track responses.
  • Serve as the main point of contact for quote-related questions from customers and suppliers.
  • Help prioritize and distribute quoting work to meet deadlines and customer expectations.
  • Guide team members on established procedures and review quotes for accuracy and quality.
  • Enter and maintain information in internal databases, ERP systems, and Excel.
  • Maintain tracking reports and prepare quote letters, status updates, and related documentation.
Requirements of the Inside Sales / Estimator in Danbury, CT:
  • Associate degree in Business or a related field required; Bachelor's degree preferred. Equivalent education and hands-on experience may be considered.
  • Experience reviewing and interpreting contracts, RFQs, and customer requirements.
  • Electronics or manufacturing industry experience strongly preferred.
  • Familiarity with blueprints, material specifications, and/or DFARS is highly desirable.
  • Strong math, analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet tight deadlines, and work independently.
  • Intermediate Microsoft Excel skills, including data manipulation and conversion, plus proficiency with Microsoft Office.
  • Familiarity with ERP systems and quoting software.
  • This position requires access to information subject to ITAR and/or EAR. Candidates must meet applicable eligibility requirements for access to export-restricted information.

Schedule: 2-2-3 rotation (12 hour shifts)

Pay Rate: $19/hr

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Film Production & Batch Operator for a manufacturing facility in Statesville, NC. This is not an entry-level machine operator position. The operator will prepare and mix material batches, operate film-production equipment, and monitor the manufacturing process to ensure the finished film meets quality specifications.

  • Ability to follow formulas, measurements, written instructions, and production specifications.

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to product quality.

Candidates with experience in plastics manufacturing, blown or cast film, extrusion, resin mixing, masterbatch preparation, textile manufacturing, chemical batching, or other formula-based production environments are strongly encouraged to apply.

job.title: Product Engineer
job.description:
Nesco Resource is hiring for a Product Engineer for the Manchester, TN area.

JOB SUMMARY:
The Product Engineer designs, develops, and improves new or existing products while coordinating prototype production and testing. This role ensures projects align with customer specifications, schedules, and budget limitations while collaborating with internal teams, contractors, and vendors. The Product Engineer plays a key role in optimizing manufacturing processes, developing tooling, and maintaining accurate CAD models.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Develop and refine designs for new products and tooling to meet customer requirements and industry standards.
  • Preparing technical drawings, sketches, and procedures essential for product development.
  • Ensure proper CAD data transfer, manage drawing and tooling control systems.
  • Create and maintain part numbers and BOMs for product development.
  • Research and recommend raw materials, components, and innovative manufacturing processes.
  • Assist Process Engineers with production trials to improve manufacturing efficiency.
  • Oversee prototype development to validate product performance.
  • Support production teams by optimizing tooling to enhance efficiency.
  • Interface directly with customer engineers and designers to ensure product designs meet their specifications.
  • Participate in vehicle fit-ups, process reviews, and design evaluations to resolve product or production challenges.
  • Ensure proper documentation, including engineering specifications and design process records.


ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES:
  • Collaborate with QA and TQC teams by providing engineering drawings and specifications.
  • Support manufacturing during new product launches and contribute to operations standards.
  • Assist in CAD transfers and technical coordination with customers and suppliers.
  • Provide technical guidance for prototype builds, testing, and product validation.
  • Work independently or as a functional participant in a development team.
  • Perform other duties as required, including supporting other North American locations.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:
  • Associates degree in Engineering or related field required.
  • Bachelor's degree (B.S.) in Engineering required.
  • Strong knowledge of engineering principles, design criteria, GD&T, and basic drafting techniques.
  • Experience with AutoCAD and CATIA (preferred but not required).
  • Familiarity with lean manufacturing principles, material selection, and product testing.
  • Hands-on experience in prototype development and manufacturing process optimization.
  • Proficiency with analytical tools and mechanical/technical skills.
  • Strong computer skills, including MS Excel, Word, and Project.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to multitask and work effectively within a team environment.

QUALIFICATIONS:
  • Work may involve standing, bending, lifting, and cutting for extended periods.
  • Must be able to lift 40 pounds overhead.

job.title: CNC Swiss Process Specialist: Direct Hire | Gilbert, AZ | $70,000 – $95,000 per year
job.description:
CNC Process Specialist: Direct Hire | Gilbert, AZ | $70,000 – $95,000 per year

  • Direct hire with a stable employer
  • $70,000 – $95,000 per year, depending on experience
  • Great benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), and EAP
  • A role with real influence on how the shop runs, without the headaches of managing people
  • Room to grow in a precision manufacturing environment
 

Nesco Resource is hiring a CNC Process Specialist for our client, a precision machining company in Gilbert, AZ. This is a direct hire position with great benefits and long-term growth. If you're a machinist who loves making parts run faster, cleaner, and more profitably, this role is for you.

About the Role

This is a hands-on, process-focused position. You'll work alongside the machinists who program, set up, and run multi-axis Swiss screw machines and CNC lathes, and your focus is making their processes better. You'll dig into cycle times, tooling, and setups, and you'll help lead continuous improvement on the shop floor. You'll mentor and support the team, but this is not a formal supervisory role.

What You'll Do

  • Provide technical guidance and process support for machinists running multi-axis Swiss screw machines (Citizen, Tsugami, Tornos Deco, Escomatic) and multi-axis CNC lathes (DMG Mori Seki NLX2500)
  • Determine the best tooling, feeds, and speeds for complex parts, cutting cycle times while holding tight tolerances
  • Specify and manage cutting tools, collets, and guide bushings, and monitor tool wear and wear offsets to prevent defects
  • Troubleshoot G-code, chatter, tool wear, and dimensional drift during live runs
  • Interpret engineering drawings, CAD models, and GD&T to develop and refine machining processes
  • Lead or support Kaizen events and projects that reduce cycle times and setup times
  • Apply Lean principles (5S, standard work, SMED) to machine cells and eliminate shop-floor waste
  • Write and update SOPs and setup sheets so work is repeatable across shifts
  • Work with engineering and quality to improve fixtures, toolpaths, and cutting parameters
  • Help quote custom parts by estimating machining time and cost
  • Perform preventative maintenance and diagnose and repair machine tool problems
  • Train and informally mentor machinists and operators on best-practice setups and process controls

What We're Looking For

  • Machining experience on Swiss screw machines and/or multi-axis CNC lathes
  • Strong G-code, tooling, and blueprint/GD&T skills
  • A process mindset, with a track record of reducing cycle times, setup times, or scrap
  • Lean manufacturing knowledge (5S, SMED, Kaizen)
  • Comfort mentoring and training others without needing a supervisor title
  • Good communication with engineering, quality, and production teams

What We Offer

  • Direct hire with a stable employer
  • $70,000 – $95,000 per year, depending on experience
  • Great benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), and EAP
  • A role with real influence on how the shop runs, without the headaches of managing people
  • Room to grow in a precision manufacturing environment

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 3:00 PM–11:30 PM
Job Type: Full-Time
Location: Manufacturing facility

Are you an experienced Set-Up Technician looking for your next opportunity?

We are seeking a dependable, mechanically inclined Set-Up Technician to join a manufacturing team on 2nd shift. This role is ideal for someone with at least two years of injection molding or setup technician experience who takes pride in quality work, communicates well with others, and can keep up in a fast-paced production environment.

  • Good computer skills and the ability to manage work orders, documentation, and frequent changes accurately.

job.title: Administrative Assistant
job.description:
Administrative Assistant – Training & Operations Support

Position Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented and highly organized Administrative Assistant to provide intermediate-level administrative, technical, and operational support to various departments.

This position plays an important role in coordinating employee onboarding, training activities, Learning Management System (LMS) administration, document control, scheduling, and departmental reporting.

The ideal candidate will have strong administrative and organizational skills, proficiency in Microsoft Office and Microsoft 365, and experience supporting training programs, employee records, and departmental operations.

Key Responsibilities

Administrative & Office Support

  • Perform daily administrative duties, including answering phones, filing, copying, scanning, typing, processing mail, and data entry.

  • Coordinate and schedule meetings using Microsoft Outlook, including managing invitations and participant availability.

  • Provide administrative support to department managers, supervisors, and employees.

  • Prepare, organize, and maintain departmental files, reports, spreadsheets, invoices, and records.

  • Greet visitors and coordinate services with vendors, consultants, and other business partners.

  • Order and distribute office supplies, meals, refreshments, badges, and meeting materials.

  • Maintain office supply inventory and coordinate replenishment as needed.

  • Assist with meeting logistics, conference room setup, and departmental events.

  • Coordinate travel arrangements and provide receptionist coverage as needed.

  • Maintain the organization and cleanliness of conference rooms, reception areas, and other assigned spaces.

Training Coordination & Employee Onboarding

  • Coordinate new employee onboarding activities, training schedules, and qualification requirements.

  • Schedule qualification walkthrough testing and other training activities with supervisors and employees.

  • Update and maintain onboarding materials, PowerPoint presentations, and training documentation.

  • Distribute job progression pre-training sign-off sheets, track completion, and follow up on outstanding requirements.

  • Assist with employee scheduling and training coordination.

  • Maintain accurate employee training and qualification records.

  • Support training compliance initiatives and departmental reporting requirements.

Learning Management System (LMS) Administration

  • Create and maintain training tests, curricula, employee assignments, qualification records, and training reports within the SABA Learning Management System (LMS).

  • Update LMS prescriptive rules to ensure employees receive appropriate training assignments based on job responsibilities.

  • Monitor training completion and maintain accurate training records.

  • Generate and distribute LMS reports to supervisors and departmental stakeholders.

  • Assist with maintaining employee training documentation and supporting audit requirements.

Document Control & Records Management

  • Maintain and update operating procedures, training documentation, and other controlled documents.

  • Perform document formatting, revisions, and document-control updates.

  • Scan, index, organize, and maintain electronic training records, qualification records, and supporting documentation.

  • Maintain departmental files, records, and documentation in accordance with established procedures.

  • Assist with document control activities and compliance-related audits.

  • Coordinate and maintain records associated with departmental, training, and compliance processes.

Microsoft 365, SharePoint & Reporting

  • Create, update, and maintain Excel spreadsheets used to track training activities, operating procedures, and departmental metrics.

  • Prepare and distribute reports to managers, supervisors, and other stakeholders.

  • Update and maintain SharePoint sites, document libraries, intranet pages, workflows, and supporting documentation.

  • Utilize Microsoft Office and Microsoft 365 applications, including:

    • Outlook

    • Excel

    • Word

    • PowerPoint

    • Teams

    • SharePoint

  • Utilize Microsoft Copilot and other productivity tools to improve administrative efficiency and workflow effectiveness.

  • Perform basic analysis and review of assigned transactions and departmental data.

Safety, Compliance & Additional Responsibilities

  • Follow established workplace safety and environmental policies and procedures.

  • Participate in required safety meetings, training, emergency drills, and hazard recognition programs.

  • Report unsafe working conditions, accidents, injuries, and near misses.

  • Support departmental compliance activities and maintain required documentation.

  • Perform additional administrative and operational assignments as needed.

Qualifications

Education

- High school diploma or equivalent required.

Experience

  • 2–5 years of administrative support experience preferred.

  • Experience in one or more of the following areas is highly desirable:

    • Training coordination

    • Employee onboarding

    • Learning Management System administration

    • Records management

    • Document control

    • Office administration

    • Departmental reporting

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office and Microsoft 365 applications, including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and SharePoint.

  • Strong administrative, clerical, and data entry skills.

  • Excellent organizational and time management abilities.

  • Ability to prioritize assignments and manage multiple responsibilities simultaneously.

  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively with employees at all organizational levels.

  • Strong problem-solving, listening, and interpersonal skills.

  • Ability to follow established procedures and guidelines.

  • Basic mathematical and analytical skills.

  • Ability to maintain professional working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

  • Dependable, punctual, flexible, and capable of working effectively under pressure.

  • Ability to learn new software applications and administrative systems.

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Experience with SABA Learning Management System (LMS), including:

    • Training assignments
