job.title: Process/Metrology Engineer
job.description:
As part of the Division Quality - Metrology group, to lead metrology tech transfer from R&D to production lines, and provide leadership in problem solving and technical expertise in metrology area.

Lead metrology projects from concept through implementation to support R&D-to-manufacturing transfer and production readiness, including metrology planning, gauge development, system qualification, deployment, and production release.
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including QA, engineering, manufacturing, software and controls teams to implement robust measurement solutions.
Develop metrology strategies in terms of gauges capability, capacity, lead time, and cost evaluation, etc.
Survey, develop, deploy and qualify new capable gauges, and measurement systems to meet the new test requirements relating to critical product characteristics including glass defects, glass size, weight, reliability, optical performance, mechanical characteristics, and other critical product attributes.

Design, improve, and validate new test methods using existing metrology systems. Support the design and development of fixtures and tools used in metrology systems.
Develop measurement data reporting, traceability, usability, data analysis applications when deploying new gauges or new test methods and continue improvement afterwards. Partner with controls and software engineers to develop operator interfaces, data collection systems, and databases that support effective use of measurement systems.
Documentations on gauges' engineering or operational work instructions; summarize measurement systems development and qualification reports.
Train users and provide technical support for deployed metrology systems.
Provide metrology technical leadership in 2nd-level troubleshooting metrology issues, performing root cause analysis, and implementing sustainable corrective actions for plant gauges.
Metrology governance - Lead and drive gauge alignment, and metrology standardization including MSA across internal plants, contract manufacturers, and customer sites as needed.
Evaluate current gauge capability and capacity, and drive continuous improvement, governance, and long-term metrology capability development

Education Required:
BS or Higher; Master is preferred. majors in Metrology, Precise Instruments, Optics, Machine Vision, Physics, Materials and Science, Automation and Mechanical Engineering, related

Required skills:
Knowledge of metrology – calibration traceability, data uncertainty, gauge qualification types, etc.
Knowledge of MSA
Familiar with MS office tools
Familiar with Minitab/Origin
Familiar with Matlab/Python
Basic statistics and reporting capability
Good communication skills
Familiar with Machine Vision is a plus

Working experience in a test lab or glass defects inspection system development is a plus
5% Domestic travel depending on projects stage and schedule to ***, NY
40 hrs/week, expected to work hours required to successfully deliver project and support requirements.

job.title: Electrician - 2nd shift
job.description:
JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:
Perform a variety of maintenance, repairs, continuous improvement, and new installation functions on plant equipment and machinery with limited direction and guidance. Support manufacturing operations in a spirit of teamwork and cooperation. Troubleshoot and resolve issues in a timely fashion. Safely, professionally and efficiently, complete wiring projects and new installations per electrical line-up and documentation. Competencies:

  • Knowledge of industrial, mechanical and electrical codes, techniques and standards. Familiarity with government regulations for industry, and safe work practices dealing with high voltage circuits.
  • Must have strong background in electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, robotic arms, and overall machine troubleshooting skills.
  • Skilled understanding and experience with electrical schematics and ladder diagrams. Expertise with meters and diagnostic instruments used to evaluate electrical systems, both low and high voltage and AC/DC circuits.
  • Ability to read electrical schematics, specify and gather material and complete wiring installation or repairs with minimal supervision.
  • Familiarity with complex machinery, electrical circuits and plant operating equipment. Should maintain a sense of urgency, self-motivation and overall good work ethic while performing tasks in a safe manner.
  • Skilled in interpersonal relations and written and oral communications.


Key Responsibilities/Deliverables:
1. Troubleshoot and repair machinery and equipment with minimal supervision using safe electrical techniques, schematics and diagnostic instruments. Perform mechanical functions and incidental work as needed to achieve assigned task. Verify equipment as functional and leave the area clean and safe.
2. Operate in response to requests by maintenance supervisor or support personnel, and set priorities as required to maximize equipment uptime.
3. Gather and maintain a complete set of required tools, including electrical meters and diagnostic devices. Utilize diagnostic tools and electrical schematics to define problem areas and assist with resolution. Develop PLC skills to troubleshoot controls related issues.
4. Participate in preventive and predictive maintenance programs to improve operational uptime and equipment life. Recommend improvements and/or changes to PM systems/tasks when applicable.
5. Follow designated work instructions as outlined for specific functions. These include, but are not limited to; PM work orders, continuous improvement tasks, new installation line-ups and repair/refurbish assignments.
6. Update drawings/prints, suggest spare parts and suitable replacements, run conduit/wire-way and power drops. Build, label and wire panels/boxes in a professional manner per line-up and schematics.
7. Follow standard practices and governmental regulations and laws relating to powered equipment.
8. Perform other related duties as assigned by immediate supervisor and management.

Education Required/Preferred: High School Diploma or equivalent. Electrical Journeyman's card or equivalent work experience. Ability to pass an Electrician aptitude test.

job.title: Machine Operator with Forklift Experience
job.description:
Nesco Resource is currently seeking dependable and detail-oriented Thermoforming Machine Operators for a manufacturing opportunity in the Upstate South Carolina area.

The ideal candidate will have experience in manufacturing, machine operation, or plastic production. This position involves setting up, operating, and monitoring thermoforming equipment to ensure products meet quality standards and production goals. Candidates should be comfortable working in a fast-paced manufacturing environment, performing equipment changeovers, and maintaining a safe and organized work area.

Key Responsibilities

  • Set up, operate, and monitor thermoforming machinery to meet daily production requirements.

  • Install and remove molds, fixtures, and tooling during production changeovers.

  • Adjust machine settings and monitor equipment performance to maintain consistent product quality.

  • Inspect finished products for defects and ensure they meet company quality standards.

  • Record machine operating conditions, production output, and equipment performance.

  • Identify and report equipment malfunctions, quality concerns, and production delays to supervisors.

  • Prepare, stack, wrap, and organize finished products for shipment.

  • Handle raw materials, finished products, and scrap materials according to company procedures.

job.title: Senior Financial Analyst - NJ
job.description:
The Financial Analyst - Distribution role serves as a strategic business partner to the distribution and logistics teams. This role drives operational excellence by delivering financial analysis, forecasting, and insights that improve efficiency, reduce costs, and support decision-making across the supply chain. The analyst will play a pivotal role in translating data into actionable recommendations, developing KPI dashboards, and collaborating with cross-functional partners to optimize performance.

Hybrid - (4-in, 1-remote)

Key Responsibilities

Financial Analysis & Reporting

  • Prepare and deliver accurate, timely financial reports for supply chain functions (distribution, logistics, and inventory).
  • Conduct variance and trend analyses to identify cost drivers, risks, and opportunities for efficiency/profitability improvements.
  • Conduct variance analyses for freight and duty actuals vs standard
  • Support month-end and quarter-end close processes, including accruals, reconciliations, and variance commentary.
  • Develop Monthly Inventory reporting to capture inventory and SKU data by division by aging bucket including SKU productivity metrics.
  • Develop financial models to evaluate warehouse performance, capital investments, and operational initiatives.

Budgeting & Forecasting

  • Lead annual budgeting and ongoing forecasting for supply chain operations, including operating expenses, capital expenditures, and unit flows by division by order type.
  • Review and update distribution forecasts based on changing supply and demand conditions-unit flows
  • Monitor performance against forecasts, identify variances, and recommend corrective actions.
  • Support long-range financial planning and scenario modeling to assess operational strategies.
  • Assist with warehouse labor planning (permanent and temporary

KPI & Dashboard Development

  • Design, build, and maintain dashboards to track KPIs for distribution, logistics, and inventory functions.
  • Partner with IT and operations teams to extract and structure data from multiple sources, ensuring integrity and consistency.
  • Train stakeholders on dashboard use and interpretation to strengthen data-driven decision-making.

Business Partnership & Collaboration

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to Distribution Center management, logistics leaders, and division finance/sales teams.
  • Implement recurring monthly/quarterly cross functional meetings to review financial performance and KPI's to discuss trends and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Translate financial data into insights for non-financial stakeholders, supporting cost savings and operational improvements.
  • Participate in strategic projects, supplier negotiations, and inventory optimization initiatives.

Process Improvement & Operational Support

  • Evaluate and enhance financial reporting and planning processes for efficiency and automation.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce costs, improve service levels, and optimize distribution and operations network.
  • Support compliance, internal controls, and best practices in financial management

Qualifications & Experience

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Supply Chain, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 3–5+ years of experience in financial or operational analysis supporting distribution center operations.
  • Hands-on experience analyzing distribution center KPIs, including cost per unit (CPU), unit flow, throughput, labor productivity, and capacity utilization.
  • Proven ability to analyze and forecast inbound and outbound unit flows across freight and distribution operations.
  • Experience performing SKU-level analysis to evaluate productivity, shipment trends, and operational efficiency.
  • Advanced Excel skills (complex formulas, large data sets, dashboard creation) and experience with Power BI or similar BI tools to build operational dashboards and reporting.
  • Strong understanding of distribution, logistics, and inventory flow, including the operational drivers behind cost and efficiency in a DC environment.
  • Experience supporting labor tracking and distribution center optimization initiatives, including monitoring labor productivity and cost per unit metrics.
  • Ability to translate operational data into actionable insights and communicate findings clearly to cross-functional partners.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working closely with distribution, logistics, inventory planning, and operations teams.
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and organizational skills with a proactive, continuous improvement mindset.

job.title: Technical Account Manager
job.description:
Nesco Data Center & Infrastructure is seeking a (TAM) Technical Account Manager in the Greater Maryland-Delaware Area who is interested in joining a premiere IT Solution Provider.

Technical Account Manager

The Technical Account Manager (TAM) serves as a trusted technology advisor and primary point of contact for assigned clients. This position is responsible for managing the overall client relationship from a technology and service perspective, understanding business objectives, monitoring service performance, and helping clients develop and execute practical technology strategies.

The Technical Account Manager works closely with client stakeholders and internal technical teams to assess existing environments, identify risks and opportunities, develop technology roadmaps, and ensure services align with business requirements. The role requires a strong combination of technical knowledge, business understanding, communication skills, and relationship management.

The TAM will regularly lead or participate in Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), strategic planning sessions, service reviews, technology roadmap discussions, and executive-level client meetings. This individual must be comfortable translating complex technical information into clear business recommendations and coordinating internal resources to deliver measurable value to the client.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary technology contact and trusted advisor for assigned client accounts.

  • Develop and maintain strong, long-term relationships with technical, operational, and executive-level client stakeholders.

  • Conduct technology assessments, baseline reviews, discovery activities, maturity assessments, and technology alignment exercises.

  • Evaluate client environments to identify technology risks, operational gaps, inefficiencies, lifecycle concerns, and opportunities for improvement.

  • Facilitate Quarterly Business Reviews, strategic planning meetings, service reviews, roadmap discussions, and other recurring client engagements.

  • Develop and maintain technology roadmaps that align client technology investments with business priorities and long-term objectives.

  • Assist clients with technology budgeting, lifecycle planning, prioritization, and strategic investment decisions.

  • Monitor service performance, technology initiatives, and account activities to proactively identify potential issues or areas requiring attention.

  • Coordinate resources across engineering, project management, solution architecture, cybersecurity, service delivery, sales, and other internal teams.

  • Advocate for client requirements internally and ensure appropriate resources are engaged to address customer needs.

  • Prepare executive-level presentations, technology assessments, gap analyses, strategic recommendations, roadmap presentations, and other client-facing deliverables.

  • Maintain accurate account documentation, technology roadmaps, governance materials, decision logs, service review documentation, action-item registers, risk trackers, and issue logs.

  • Document client meetings, decisions, recommendations, risks, and follow-up activities.

  • Follow established delivery methodologies, templates, playbooks, and quality standards to ensure consistent and professional client engagements.

  • Identify documentation deficiencies, service delivery issues, process inefficiencies, and opportunities to improve the overall client experience.

  • Work collaboratively with internal teams to develop repeatable processes, best practices, knowledge resources, and other delivery improvements.

  • Participate in strategic technology discussions and customer-success initiatives designed to increase client value and strengthen relationships.

  • Identify opportunities for additional technology services or solutions that address legitimate client requirements and provide measurable business value.

  • Ensure recommendations and technology initiatives are appropriately aligned with client business objectives, operational requirements, risk tolerance, and financial considerations.

Required Qualifications

Professional Experience

  • 3–7 years of experience in Technical Account Management, IT consulting, customer success, technology services, account management, or a related technology leadership role.

  • Experience working within an MSP, technology services organization, consulting environment, systems integrator, or enterprise IT organization preferred.

  • Demonstrated experience managing client relationships and leading technology-focused discussions with both technical and business stakeholders.

  • Experience working directly with customers on technology strategy, service delivery, infrastructure planning, or technology improvement initiatives.

Communication & Relationship Management

  • Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.

  • Ability to clearly explain complex technical concepts to both technical professionals and non-technical business executives.

  • Strong relationship-building skills with the ability to establish credibility and trust with clients.

  • Ability to influence stakeholders, facilitate productive discussions, and drive decisions without relying solely on direct authority.

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple clients, priorities, deliverables, and deadlines simultaneously.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking abilities.

Business Acumen

  • Understanding of business operations, strategic planning, technology investment planning, risk management, and operational efficiency.

  • Ability to translate technology recommendations into measurable business outcomes, cost considerations, risk reduction, and potential ROI.

  • Comfortable participating in executive-level conversations involving technology strategy, budgets, priorities, service performance, and business objectives.

  • Ability to understand a client's broader business goals and translate those goals into practical technology initiatives.

Technical Knowledge

  • Working knowledge of enterprise IT infrastructure, networking, cloud technologies, cybersecurity fundamentals, and IT service management.

  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 environments preferred.

  • Understanding of technology lifecycle management, infrastructure modernization, governance, security best practices, and managed services delivery.

  • Ability to understand and discuss enterprise technology architectures, infrastructure dependencies, service-level metrics, operational performance, and technology roadmaps.

  • Ability to work effectively with engineers, architects, cybersecurity professionals, project managers, service delivery teams, and other technical specialists without necessarily serving as the hands-on technical resource.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a technically knowledgeable, business-minded professional who can operate comfortably between the client, executive leadership, and technical delivery teams. This individual should be capable of understanding complex technology environments while maintaining a strong focus on customer relationships, business outcomes, service quality, and long-term technology strategy.

The successful Technical Account Manager will be proactive rather than reactive, able to recognize emerging risks and opportunities, communicate recommendations clearly, and coordinate the appropriate internal resources to help clients achieve their technology and business objectives.

job.title: Coordinator, Administrative Services
job.description:
Project Administrator / Project Coordinator

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive Project Administrator / Project Coordinator to provide administrative, financial, procurement, and project coordination support throughout the project lifecycle.

This position is responsible for maintaining project records, tracking budgets and expenditures, supporting procurement activities, coordinating project documentation, and ensuring accurate reporting across project management and financial systems.

The ideal candidate will have experience in project administration, project coordination, procurement, finance, or a related field, along with strong Microsoft Excel skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities independently.

The role also involves independently coordinating equipment-only capital projects, including procurement, scheduling, budget tracking, stakeholder communication, and project closeout.

Key Responsibilities

Project Administration & Coordination

  • Create, update, and maintain project records within project management and financial systems.

  • Support project setup activities, including funding requests and authorization documentation.

  • Maintain project forecasts, expenditure reports, and spending status trackers.

  • Assist project teams with monthly forecasting, budgeting, and financial updates.

  • Coordinate and maintain project documentation throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Support project closeout activities, including documentation, financial reconciliation support, and records retention.

  • Ensure project information is accurate, organized, and accessible to relevant stakeholders.

Financial Management & Cost Tracking

  • Track project expenditures and maintain financial forecasting spreadsheets.

  • Download, compile, review, and distribute project spending reports.

  • Update financial reports using current expenditure data and forecast information.

  • Process cost transfers and other project-related financial transactions.

  • Monitor project funding approvals, expenditures, and budget status.

  • Identify discrepancies and coordinate with appropriate teams to resolve financial reporting issues.

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date project financial documentation.

Procurement & Supplier Coordination

  • Create, submit, and track purchase requisitions.

  • Coordinate Service Entry Sheets (SES) and Goods Receipts (GR).

  • Assist with invoice processing, supplier payment inquiries, and purchasing documentation.

  • Partner with Procurement and Finance teams to resolve purchasing and payment issues.

  • Follow up with buyers regarding purchase orders, requisitions, and procurement status.

  • Monitor purchasing approval workflows and help expedite approvals when necessary.

  • Maintain accurate procurement records and ensure timely follow-up on outstanding items.

Systems Administration & Reporting

  • Maintain project data and documentation within SAP, EcoSys, SharePoint, and other project management systems.

  • Create, organize, and maintain project SharePoint sites, folders, and documentation repositories.

  • Generate project status reports, financial reports, and administrative tracking documents.

  • Ensure data consistency and accuracy across project controls, procurement, and financial systems.

  • Support project teams with reporting, document management, and system-related administrative tasks.

Equipment & Capital Project Coordination

  • Independently coordinate equipment-only capital projects from initial purchasing through project closeout.

  • Track project schedules, budgets, procurement activities, and supporting documentation.

  • Communicate project progress, updates, and outstanding action items to stakeholders.

  • Coordinate with Project Management, Procurement, Finance, Operations, and suppliers to support successful project execution.

  • Identify potential project risks, delays, or issues and proactively coordinate resolution.

  • Ensure assigned projects remain organized, properly documented, and aligned with established timelines and requirements.

Required Qualifications

Education

- High school diploma or GED equivalent.

Professional Experience

- Minimum of 2 years of experience in one or more of the following areas:

  • Project coordination or project administration

  • Procurement or purchasing support

  • Finance or financial administration

  • Construction administration

  • Facilities management

  • Related administrative or project support functions

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Outlook, Word, and SharePoint.

  • Experience maintaining spreadsheets, tracking financial information, and preparing reports.

  • Ability to accurately manage project records, financial data, and supporting documentation.

  • Strong computer skills and ability to navigate multiple business systems.

job.title: Electrician - 3rd shift
job.description:
JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:
Perform a variety of maintenance, repairs, continuous improvement, and new installation functions on plant equipment and machinery with limited direction and guidance. Support manufacturing operations in a spirit of teamwork and cooperation. Troubleshoot and resolve issues in a timely fashion. Safely, professionally and efficiently, complete wiring projects and new installations per electrical line-up and documentation. Competencies:

  • Knowledge of industrial, mechanical and electrical codes, techniques and standards. Familiarity with government regulations for industry, and safe work practices dealing with high voltage circuits.
  • Must have strong background in electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, robotic arms, and overall machine troubleshooting skills.
  • Skilled understanding and experience with electrical schematics and ladder diagrams. Expertise with meters and diagnostic instruments used to evaluate electrical systems, both low and high voltage and AC/DC circuits.
  • Ability to read electrical schematics, specify and gather material and complete wiring installation or repairs with minimal supervision.
  • Familiarity with complex machinery, electrical circuits and plant operating equipment. Should maintain a sense of urgency, self-motivation and overall good work ethic while performing tasks in a safe manner.
  • Skilled in interpersonal relations and written and oral communications.


Key Responsibilities/Deliverables:
1. Troubleshoot and repair machinery and equipment with minimal supervision using safe electrical techniques, schematics and diagnostic instruments. Perform mechanical functions and incidental work as needed to achieve assigned task. Verify equipment as functional and leave the area clean and safe.
2. Operate in response to requests by maintenance supervisor or support personnel, and set priorities as required to maximize equipment uptime.
3. Gather and maintain a complete set of required tools, including electrical meters and diagnostic devices. Utilize diagnostic tools and electrical schematics to define problem areas and assist with resolution. Develop PLC skills to troubleshoot controls related issues.
4. Participate in preventive and predictive maintenance programs to improve operational uptime and equipment life. Recommend improvements and/or changes to PM systems/tasks when applicable.
5. Follow designated work instructions as outlined for specific functions. These include, but are not limited to; PM work orders, continuous improvement tasks, new installation line-ups and repair/refurbish assignments.
6. Update drawings/prints, suggest spare parts and suitable replacements, run conduit/wire-way and power drops. Build, label and wire panels/boxes in a professional manner per line-up and schematics.
7. Follow standard practices and governmental regulations and laws relating to powered equipment.
8. Perform other related duties as assigned by immediate supervisor and management.

Education Required/Preferred: High School Diploma or equivalent. Electrical Journeyman's card or equivalent work experience. Ability to pass an Electrician aptitude test.

Pay & Benefits

About the Role

Ready to lead from the field? We're looking for a hands-on Electrical Construction Foreman to direct crews working on traffic signal systems, roadway lighting, and related transportation infrastructure.

You'll oversee daily jobsite activities, coordinate crews and equipment, maintain safety and quality standards, and keep projects moving forward. This role is a strong fit for an experienced field professional who can lead by example, solve problems on-site, and hold a crew accountable for getting the job done right.

Key Responsibilities

Field Leadership & Crew Direction
Lead daily field operations, assign work, and provide hands-on guidance to crews installing and maintaining roadway electrical systems.

Project Execution & Scheduling
Coordinate labor, materials, tools, and equipment to support project schedules and maintain productivity.

Electrical Construction Oversight
Oversee installation and maintenance activities involving traffic signals, roadway lighting, and related infrastructure.

Plans, Specifications & Inspections
Read and interpret construction drawings and project specifications while ensuring work meets applicable standards and inspection requirements.

Safety & Quality Control
Enforce safe work practices, maintain jobsite accountability, and ensure work is completed to quality expectations.

Field & Project Coordination
Communicate with project managers, inspectors, and other field personnel to address challenges and keep work progressing.

Qualifications

Relevant Electrical Construction Experience
Experience with traffic signals, roadway lighting, electrical infrastructure, or a closely related construction field. Five or more years of experience is preferred, but not required.

Crew Leadership Experience
Previous experience leading or supervising construction crews is strongly preferred.

Technical Knowledge
Ability to interpret construction plans, electrical drawings, and project specifications, with working knowledge of ODOT standards and requirements for roadway electrical projects.

Required License
Valid Class A CDL is required.

Safety & Jobsite Readiness
Knowledge of electrical construction safety, equipment operation, and field procedures. Must be able to work outdoors in varying weather conditions and perform physically demanding tasks.

Travel & Pre-Employment Requirements
Must be willing to travel as project assignments require and successfully complete a criminal background check and drug screening.

Work Environment

This is a hands-on, field-based leadership role supporting active roadway and transportation infrastructure projects. Work takes place outdoors in changing weather conditions and may involve active construction zones, traffic exposure, and physically demanding activities. Travel is required based on project needs.

job.description:

Degree in microbiology, chemistry, or similar scientific discipline.

Position Description:
This role will support manufacturing operations and will be primarily responsible for the review of completed production batch documents.
This role will be responsible for batch record review.
Multiple departments of batch records will be in scope for this role.
This team member will provide documentation guidance from a quality compliance perspective having knowledge of local and global Animal Health standards, USDA regulations, and cGMP generally.
Document reviews will be tracked and prioritized based on target release dates and will assist the IPT in tracking and prioritizing their reviews to meet target dates.

This position is expected to become a back-up for various QA functions within the team as well as assist with quality systems tasks such as, deviations and change controls.
The ideal candidate will seek opportunities to develop competency in the multiple Quality Assurance functions and systems and assist in various projects and responsiblies within the QA and manufacturing team.

A successful candidate will be able to navigate the various perspectives of Planning, QA and Production utilizing Leadership Behaviors and principals of Inclusion, while holding Safety and Quality as primary values.

Key participant in Quality Compliance Inspections from regulatory agencies and off-site entities
Other tasks as assigned by QA Manager and Quality Director

job.title: Software Quality Engineer
job.description:
Description:
The selected candidate will be the Software Quality Engineer Staff - Test Engineering Hardware (HW) SME for the Software Quality Engineering team. Our team is responsible for developing and maintaining SSQE common processes aligned with AS9100, CMMI, and customer requirements.

Why Join Us
The ideal candidate is a collaborative problem solver who thrives in a fast paced, mission focused environment. This role offers the chance to shape critical quality initiatives that directly impact program success, while working with cutting edge technology and a supportive team.
We strive to support your work life balance and overall well being, offering flexible scheduling options

What You Will Be Doing
As the Software Quality Engineer Staff, you will be responsible for driving software quality across test equipment and hardware in the loop systems.

Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:
•Support Test Equipment throughout the life cyber of a test stations from requirements to certification.
•Support of test set hardware – including reading drawings/schematics, performing hardware inspections including cable inspections, executing calibration/metrology reviews and approvals, data integrity checks, logbook creation, safety checks, etc.
•Test documentation reviews, program non-conformance burndown,
•Witness verification and validation of test equipment, including hardware in the loop systems.
•Define and executing audit strategies to ensure compliance with software and system processes.

Basic REQUIRED Qualifications:
•Ability to travel to *** sites, supplier locations, and test facilities as needed
•Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related STEM discipline
•Ability to obtain and maintain a Secret security clearance
•Experience in requirements analysis, design reviews, product integration, and verification/validation (including certification) of hardware software test systems
•Demonstrated experience with test equipment and test set hardware – including reading schematics, performing hardware inspections, and executing calibration reviews
•Ability to read, interpret, and troubleshoot LabVIEW/TestStand and C/C++ test code to verify that software implementations satisfy system requirements
•Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access) for test documentation and reporting

Desired Skills:
•Certified Software Quality Engineer (ASQ CSQE)
•Knowledge of industry recognized quality models (CMMI, ISO, AS, FAA regulations)
•Green or Black Belt certification in Lean/Six Sigma (LSS)
•Experience collaborating with software suppliers with test equipment and Government/DoD customers
•In depth expertise with National Instruments (NI) LabVIEW and TestStand environments (beyond basic code interpretation)

job.title: Hose Former, 2nd/3rd shift
job.description:
GENERAL SUMMARY
Responsible for the efficient manufacture and quality forming of production parts within the assigned department.
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES (Duties required for successful job performance):
  1. Check specifications as to job and perform numbers.
  2. Retrieve proper pre-form and guide onto mandrel using lubricant as necessary.
  3. Position loaded mandrels in curing rack for curing. Move curing rack into autoclave when full.
  4. Remove curing rack from autoclave to proper work area.
  5. Position mandrel bars for unloading. Remove formed hose from mandrel, place into proper container.
  6. Position full baskets with proper job and employee clock numbers.
  7. Identify parts baskets with proper job and employee clock numbers.
  8. Set up curing racks per production and supervisor guidance.
  9. Replenish lubricant in trough as needed.
  10. Perform all operations according to standard practice or as directed by supervisor to produce quality parts.
  11. Fill out required paperwork as necessary.
  12. Record cure charts as required.
  13. Perform other miscellaneous duties required but not listed above.





REQUIRED EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE (These are the traditional minimum, or required, bona-fide occupational qualifications and other requirements of most people in this job).
  1. High School Diploma or GED required. Previous manufacturing experience preferred (particularly in a team environment).
  2. NCRC certified preferred.
REQUIRED SKILLS AND ABILITIES (Those needed to perform the essential functions of the job).
  1. Interpersonal Skills Must be able to read and write at a medium level for the purpose of understanding and applying quality documentation and standard operating procedures, along with completion of job / time reporting.
  2. Problem-solving May be asked to participate in continuous improvement activities and perform basic mathematics.
  3. Physical / Mental / Visual abilities Duties of job require periods of standing, use of hands (pushing and pulling > 50 lbs.) and fingers, bending and reaching, lifting (> 50lbs.) and movement of materials frequently. Must be able to visually interpret work instructions.
REQUIRED DECISION-MAKING AND ORGANIZATION IMPACT (Describe the typical types of decisions made by employees in this job and the likely impact of those decisions on the Company).
  1. The position will decide on a daily basis the acceptable level of quality for finished product to be shipped to the customer.
  2. This determination will be based upon interpretation of the customer specifications and past experience.
  3. Customer rejections of finished product could incur additional costs and may jeopardize the sourcing of business to the company.
REPORTING RELATIONSHIPS (Indicate job titles for this job's supervisor and direct reports).
  1. Directly Reports To: Group Leader / Shift Supervisor
  2. Indirectly Reports To: Business Unit Manager- II
WORKING CONDITIONS (Describe the environment within which the work is performed).
  1. Work time will be spent in general factory floor environments.
  2. Temperature and noise may vary depending on external environmental conditions.
  3. Lack of attention and carelessness may result in personal injury to self or others.

job.title: Pipe Welder - Stainless and Carbon
job.description:
Welder — Pipe (Stainless and Carbon)
Phoenix, AZ 85041

The role
This is a production pipe-welding job. You will weld stainless and carbon pipe to shop drawings and a welding procedure. Day and night shifts are open. All new welders train on first shift, then move to the assigned shift.

What you'll do

  • Weld stainless pipe with flux-core to AWS D1.6 and full TIG (GTAW), including 3/8-inch open-root joints
  • Weld carbon pipe in the 6G position: TIG root through cap, or TIG root with flux-core or MIG (SuperArc) fill and cap
  • Pass a carbon Super Coupon test on 2-inch extra-heavy wall pipe. This one coupon covers small-diameter and thick-wall qualification
  • Fit, tack, and weld your own joints from shop drawings, isometrics, and a WPS
  • Hold weld quality, joint prep, and shop safety standards

What we're looking for

  • Pipe welding experience on stainless and carbon. Three or more years preferred
  • Able to pass weld test before placement:
    • Stainless: flux-core, AWS D1.6, and full TIG, including 3/8-inch open root
    • Carbon: 6G open-root pipe
    • Carbon Super Coupon, 2-inch extra-heavy wall
  • Able to read prints, weld symbols, and a WPS
  • Reliable attendance for shift work after first-shift training

job.title: Specialist/Analyst, Payroll Operations
job.description:
Payroll Operations Specialist

Location: Phoenix, AZ Work Schedule: Monday–Friday | 100% On-site (5 days per week) Department: Finance – Payroll Operations

Position Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Payroll Operations Specialist to support a high-volume, multi-state payroll operation within a large corporate environment.

This position is responsible for the timely and accurate processing of employee payroll, including collecting, reviewing, entering, auditing, and verifying payroll data. The ideal candidate will have experience processing payroll for a large organization, strong Microsoft Excel skills, and an understanding of payroll regulations, collective bargaining agreements (CBAs), and union payroll requirements.

The Payroll Operations Specialist will also support payroll reporting, audit compliance, employee inquiries, process improvements, and special projects while ensuring accuracy, confidentiality, and adherence to established payroll procedures.

Key Responsibilities

Payroll Processing & Administration

  • Process high-volume, multi-state payroll accurately and within established deadlines.

  • Collect, review, enter, edit, and verify employee payroll data.

  • Ensure payroll transactions comply with company policies, applicable labor agreements, and federal, state, and local regulations.

  • Maintain the confidentiality and security of employee payroll information.

  • Review payroll audit reports, identify discrepancies, and coordinate necessary corrections.

  • Organize and maintain accurate payroll records to minimize errors and incorrect employee payments.

  • Apply payroll processing requirements specific to unionized employee groups and collective bargaining agreements (CBAs).

  • Support accurate and timely payroll processing for a large, diverse workforce.

Payroll Auditing & Compliance

  • Review payroll transactions and audit reports to ensure accuracy and compliance.

  • Follow established Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) processing controls, procedures, and documentation requirements.

  • Identify payroll discrepancies, investigate root causes, and recommend corrective actions.

  • Ensure payroll processing activities align with internal controls and applicable regulatory requirements.

  • Maintain accurate payroll documentation and supporting records for audit purposes.

Employee Support & Issue Resolution

  • Research and respond to employee payroll inquiries in a timely and professional manner.

  • Investigate payroll discrepancies, payment concerns, and processing issues.

  • Explain complex payroll information, policies, and procedures to employees at all organizational levels.

  • Collaborate with internal departments to resolve payroll-related issues.

  • Provide a high level of customer service while maintaining confidentiality and professionalism.

Reporting, Data Analysis & Process Improvement

  • Analyze large volumes of payroll data using Microsoft Excel and related tools.

  • Utilize Excel formulas, macros, and reporting functions to review and validate payroll information.

  • Identify trends, errors, and opportunities to improve payroll accuracy and operational efficiency.

  • Evaluate existing payroll processes and recommend improvements while maintaining SOX compliance.

  • Document, maintain, and update payroll procedures and process workflows.

  • Assist with payroll system testing, special projects, and other assigned responsibilities.

Required Qualifications

Education

- High school diploma, GED, or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.

Professional Experience

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in payroll processing, accounting, or human resources, preferably within a high-volume, multi-state payroll environment.

  • Experience processing payroll in a large corporate organization.

  • Strong understanding of payroll processing procedures, payroll data validation, and employee payment accuracy.

  • Knowledge of collective bargaining agreements (CBAs), union payroll requirements, or labor agreement provisions.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including working with large datasets.

  • Experience researching payroll discrepancies and resolving employee inquiries.

  • Ability to maintain accurate payroll records and follow established compliance procedures.

Required Skills & Competencies

  • Strong payroll processing and administration skills.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including data analysis and reporting.

  • Experience working with high-volume payroll data.

  • Understanding of multi-state payroll operations.

  • Familiarity with union payroll and collective bargaining agreements.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

  • Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.

  • Strong organizational and time management skills.

  • Ability to meet strict payroll processing deadlines.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to explain complex payroll information clearly and professionally.

  • Strong customer service and interpersonal skills.

  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel and Word.

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team.

  • Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and protecting sensitive employee information.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Human Resources, or a related field.

  • Experience with SAP payroll systems.

  • Experience working in a large enterprise or corporate payroll department.

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including macros and large-scale data analysis.

  • Familiarity with Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance requirements and payroll internal controls.

  • Experience supporting payroll system testing and process improvement initiatives.

Work Environment & Expectations

  • Work Location: Phoenix, AZ

  • Work Arrangement: 100% on-site, five days per week.

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced payroll operations environment with strict processing deadlines.

  • Must demonstrate accuracy, confidentiality, and professionalism when handling sensitive payroll information.

  • Additional duties and special projects may be assigned based on business needs.

Location: South

Job Description: Responsible for the incoming quality inspection of electronic, electro mechanical, microprocessor based systems, radio communication equipment, cables, harnesses, and mechanical components used in mining safety products. Ensures that all incoming materials meet quality, safety, and regulatory requirements before being released to production, recognizing the safety critical nature of mining applications.

  • Perform incoming, in-process, and final inspections of PCBAs, cable assemblies, subassemblies, finished products, aluminum housings, casted housings, machined components, plastic parts, and other purchased materials.
  • Verify product compliance with engineering drawings, specifications, work instructions, quality standards, and customer requirements.
  • Conduct visual inspections of electronic assemblies in accordance with IPC-A-610 workmanship standards.
  • Perform dimensional inspections using precision measuring equipment including calipers, micrometers, height gauges, thread gauges, pin gauges, and other inspection tools.
  • Verify cosmetic appearance, dimensional accuracy, labeling, markings, surface finishes, and overall product workmanship.
  • Identify, document, and segregate nonconforming materials following established quality procedures.
  • Complete inspection reports, First Article Inspection (FAI) documentation, inspection records, and nonconformance reports accurately and on time.
  • Support Material Review Board (MRB) activities by providing inspection results and objective evidence.
  • Verify product traceability and ensure proper identification throughout the inspection process.
  • Ensure compliance with Quality Management System (QMS) requirements, company procedures, and applicable industry standards.
  • Assist Manufacturing, Engineering, and Supplier Quality teams in investigating product quality issues and implementing corrective actions.
  • Maintain inspection equipment in good condition and ensure only calibrated equipment is used.
  • Follow ESD, safety, and housekeeping requirements while handling electronic components and assemblies.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying recurring quality issues and recommending process improvements.

Minimum Qualifications:
  • High School Diploma or equivalent. (pre-requisite)
  • Driver license
  • Experience in QC Inspection of electro-mechanical assemblies or cable fabrication (favorable)
  • Current or past IPC-A-610 certification (favorable)

job.title: Senior Financial Analyst - Distribution
job.description:
The Financial Analyst - Distribution role serves as a strategic business partner to the distribution and logistics teams. This role drives operational excellence by delivering financial analysis, forecasting, and insights that improve efficiency, reduce costs, and support decision-making across the supply chain. The analyst will play a pivotal role in translating data into actionable recommendations, developing KPI dashboards, and collaborating with cross-functional partners to optimize performance.

Hybrid - (4-in, 1-remote)
Base pay up to $135K based on experience

Key Responsibilities

Financial Analysis & Reporting

  • Prepare and deliver accurate, timely financial reports for supply chain functions (distribution, logistics, and inventory).
  • Conduct variance and trend analyses to identify cost drivers, risks, and opportunities for efficiency/profitability improvements.
  • Conduct variance analyses for freight and duty actuals vs standard
  • Support month-end and quarter-end close processes, including accruals, reconciliations, and variance commentary.
  • Develop Monthly Inventory reporting to capture inventory and SKU data by division by aging bucket including SKU productivity metrics.
  • Develop financial models to evaluate warehouse performance, capital investments, and operational initiatives.

Budgeting & Forecasting

  • Lead annual budgeting and ongoing forecasting for supply chain operations, including operating expenses, capital expenditures, and unit flows by division by order type.
  • Review and update distribution forecasts based on changing supply and demand conditions-unit flows
  • Monitor performance against forecasts, identify variances, and recommend corrective actions.
  • Support long-range financial planning and scenario modeling to assess operational strategies.
  • Assist with warehouse labor planning (permanent and temporary

KPI & Dashboard Development

  • Design, build, and maintain dashboards to track KPIs for distribution, logistics, and inventory functions.
  • Partner with IT and operations teams to extract and structure data from multiple sources, ensuring integrity and consistency.
  • Train stakeholders on dashboard use and interpretation to strengthen data-driven decision-making.

Business Partnership & Collaboration

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to Distribution Center management, logistics leaders, and division finance/sales teams.
  • Implement recurring monthly/quarterly cross functional meetings to review financial performance and KPI's to discuss trends and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Translate financial data into insights for non-financial stakeholders, supporting cost savings and operational improvements.
  • Participate in strategic projects, supplier negotiations, and inventory optimization initiatives.

Process Improvement & Operational Support

  • Evaluate and enhance financial reporting and planning processes for efficiency and automation.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce costs, improve service levels, and optimize distribution and operations network.
  • Support compliance, internal controls, and best practices in financial management

Qualifications & Experience

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Supply Chain, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 3–5+ years of experience in financial or operational analysis supporting distribution center operations.
  • Hands-on experience analyzing distribution center KPIs, including cost per unit (CPU), unit flow, throughput, labor productivity, and capacity utilization.
  • Proven ability to analyze and forecast inbound and outbound unit flows across freight and distribution operations.
  • Experience performing SKU-level analysis to evaluate productivity, shipment trends, and operational efficiency.
  • Advanced Excel skills (complex formulas, large data sets, dashboard creation) and experience with Power BI or similar BI tools to build operational dashboards and reporting.
  • Strong understanding of distribution, logistics, and inventory flow, including the operational drivers behind cost and efficiency in a DC environment.
  • Experience supporting labor tracking and distribution center optimization initiatives, including monitoring labor productivity and cost per unit metrics.
  • Ability to translate operational data into actionable insights and communicate findings clearly to cross-functional partners.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working closely with distribution, logistics, inventory planning, and operations teams.
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and organizational skills with a proactive, continuous improvement mindset.

The Automated Machine Designer is responsible for researching, planning, and designing stations and machines using calculations, mechanical principals, and proven practices to create semi/fully automated assembly and test systems.

job.title: Cost Accountant- Manufacturing
job.description:
Cost Accountant – Manufacturing

Tulsa, OK | Full-Time | Monday–Friday, 7:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m. | On-Site

Pay & Benefits

Compensation: $75,000–$90,000, depending on experience
Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance
Retirement Planning: 401(k) with company match
Time Away: Paid time off, holidays, and personal days
Additional Support: Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Bonus Incentive Program
Coverage: Life and disability insurance
Work Environment: Established manufacturing company with a stable weekday schedule and a collaborative team environment

About the Role

We’re looking for a Cost Accountant with manufacturing experience to help track, analyze, and improve the financial performance of a production operation.

This role is focused on manufacturing costs, inventory, standard costing, and variance analysis. You’ll work closely with Finance, Production, Procurement, and Project Management to understand where costs are coming from, identify discrepancies, and provide information that helps the business make better decisions.

This is a strong opportunity for an accountant who enjoys going beyond basic general ledger work and wants to understand how products are made, what they cost, and where the company can improve profitability.

Key Responsibilities

Manufacturing Cost Analysis:

  • Analyze material, labor, production, and overhead costs to help identify trends and areas for improvement

  • Prepare cost accounting reports and provide analysis to support operational and financial decisions

  • Review production costs and identify opportunities for improved efficiency and cost reduction

Standard Costing & Variance Analysis:

  • Calculate and maintain standard costs for products and manufacturing activities

  • Analyze cost variances and investigate the underlying causes

  • Work with operational teams to understand significant changes in material, labor, and overhead costs

Inventory Accounting & Reconciliation:

  • Monitor inventory transactions and ensure costs are accurately captured

  • Perform inventory reconciliations and research discrepancies

  • Support accurate inventory valuation and related financial reporting

Financial Analysis & Profitability:

  • Perform profitability and cost-benefit analysis on products, projects, and operational activities

  • Provide financial insight to help management evaluate costs and potential savings

  • Identify trends and communicate findings clearly to Finance and operational leadership

Month-End Close & Accounting:

  • Support month-end and year-end closing activities related to inventory and manufacturing costs

job.title: Vulnerability and Patch Management
job.description:
A major client of ours has a need for a Vulnerability and Patch Management Analyst. This role is a hybrid contract with 3 days a week in the office in Midtown Manhattan, NY.

Vulnerability Patch Management Analyst

The duties of the analyst include analyzing all relevant cyber security event data and other data sources for attack indicators and potential security breaches; produce reports, assist in coordination during incidents; and coordinate with defense teams to ensure all security monitoring systems on-line, up to date and operational.

The duty of the analyst includes managing and optimizing our vulnerability and patch management process. Your mandate will include the proactive identification and efficient monitoring and remediation of security vulnerabilities across our entire IT landscape.

Responsibilities:

  • Drive the full vulnerability patch management lifecycle: identification, prioritization, and remediation for all infrastructure, systems, applications, and SDLC.

  • Deliver consistent, high-quality VPM reporting to leadership and relevant teams.

  • Collaborate extensively with IT stakeholders across the Americas, Head Office, and international platforms.

  • Assess vulnerability impact and risk levels to inform strategic remediation.

  • Prioritize patch deployments and manage SLA breaches, developing and executing follow-up plans.

  • Design and enhance VPM procedures and processes.

  • Participate in vulnerability assessments and track software/system updates.

  • Strengthen compliance and adherence to security best practices and approved tools.

  • Liaise with Second Line of Defense and auditors.

  • Coordinate the development and maintenance of a comprehensive patch management strategy.

  • Assist IT teams with timely vendor patch acquisition and deployment.

  • Monitor and report on patch management effectiveness, implementing improvements.

  • Stay current on industry best practices and emerging threats.

  • Provide backup support for cybersecurity projects, incidents, and audit remediation.

  • Be available for off-hours support as needed to address emergent threats

  •  
Skills:
  • Proven experience in vulnerability management, patch management, or related security roles with oversight of Plans of Action and Milestones (POAM).

  • Ai initiatives – ability to use Ai to automate manual processes and tasks.

  • Strong understanding of common security vulnerabilities and the ability to assess their impact on systems and infrastructure.

  • Experience with vulnerability management and SIEM tools.

    • SIEM experienced with creating dashboard and report

    • Vulnerability Tool experience in conducting scan, treatment, and remediation
  • Familiarity with security, IT Audit frameworks and standards (NIST. FFIEC handbooks etc.)

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills for management presentation materials and ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

  • Experience on reporting and analysis tools is required - PowerBl, Advanced Excel/PowerQuery.

  • Data sets, pivot tables etc.

  • Script experience

  • Enhancement of existing documentations including procedures, playbooks, and runbooks

  • Deep understanding of network devices and architecture, TCP/IP, network protocols, server operating systems, and vulnerability scanning.

  • Strong understanding of internal control concepts and policies with focus on improving process/procedure manuals and documentation.

  • Strong knowledge of cyber-security frameworks (such as ISO 27001, NIST CSF, CIS, etc.)

  • Knowledge of Windows, Linux/Unix, VMware, IDS/IP, forensic discovery.

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills and the ability to work effectively with a wide range of constituencies in a diverse community.

  • 5-9 years of experience

job.title: Hydro Blaster Trainee- Days
job.description:
Hydro Blaster Trainee

Claremore, OK | Full-Time | Contract-to-Hire | $20.50/hour | Day Shift

Get your foot in the door of a skilled industrial career.

A Claremore industrial team is looking for a dependable, hands-on individual to join their crew and learn specialized equipment cleaning and maintenance processes. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys working with their hands, being outdoors or in industrial environments, and learning a skilled trade.

You'll work alongside experienced technicians and receive hands-on training in high-pressure water cleaning, industrial equipment maintenance, and job-site safety.

Previous experience in hydro blasting is not required. We're looking for someone with a strong work ethic, good attendance, mechanical common sense, and a willingness to learn.

Pay & Schedule

  • $20.50/hour

  • Monday–Friday

  • 6:00 AM–4:30 PM

  • Overtime as needed

  • Full-Time | Contract-to-Hire

  • Claremore, OK

  • Weekly pay

What You'll Do

  • Assist experienced technicians with setup and operation of specialized industrial cleaning equipment

  • Help connect and move hoses, pumps, nozzles, and other equipment

  • Support cleaning and maintenance work on industrial equipment, tanks, and piping

  • Help prepare tools and materials for each job and safely load/unload equipment

  • Monitor work areas and help maintain a safe environment for the crew

  • Keep equipment and work areas clean and organized

  • Participate in daily safety meetings and hands-on training

  • Learn additional responsibilities as you develop your skills

No Experience? That's Okay.

You don't need to come in knowing how to hydro blast.

This could be a strong fit if you've worked in:

  • Industrial or manufacturing environments

  • Construction or skilled trades

  • Maintenance or mechanical work

  • Oil & gas

  • Welding or fabrication

  • Equipment operation

  • Warehouse or other physically demanding jobs

You may also be a fit if you're new to the industry but are mechanically inclined, dependable, and ready to learn a trade.

What We're Looking For

  • Reliable attendance and a strong work ethic

  • Comfortable working with your hands and using basic hand tools

  • Willingness to learn specialized equipment and procedures

  • Strong commitment to safety and following instructions

  • Ability to work effectively as part of a team

  • Comfortable working in industrial environments and around heavy equipment

  • Willingness to work overtime and occasional weekends when needed

  • High school diploma or GED preferred

This Is a Physical Job

This is hands-on industrial work, not a desk position.

You should be comfortable:

  • Lifting and carrying 50+ pounds

  • Standing, walking, bending, kneeling, climbing, and working for extended periods

  • Working outdoors and in unconditioned industrial environments

  • Working around water, machinery, hoses, and industrial equipment

  • Working in confined or elevated areas when required and properly trained

Build a Skilled Career

If you're tired of jobs where you do the same thing every day with no opportunity to learn, this position gives you a chance to build specialized skills and work toward a skilled technician career.

You'll start by supporting experienced technicians and progressively learn more about the equipment, processes, and safety procedures involved in industrial cleaning and maintenance.

This is a Contract-to-Hire opportunity with the goal of permanent placement for employees who demonstrate strong attendance, safety, performance, and reliability.

Ready to Learn Something New?

If you're dependable, physically capable, and looking for an opportunity to learn a skilled trade and build a long-term career, apply today!

Position Summary: We are seeking an experienced Manual Machinist with exceptional technical skills, precision, and craftsmanship. The ideal candidate will have extensive hands-on experience operating manual machine tools, produce high-precision components, and working independently with minimal supervision while maintaining strict quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Set up and operate manual vertical and horizontal mills, engine and turret lathes, and surface grinders.

  • Read and interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, and technical specifications.

  • 15+ years of manual machining experience Preferred.

  • Ability to consistently machine components to extremely tight tolerances.
  • Proficiency in blueprint reading, technical drawings, and precision measurement techniques.

job.title: Electrical Engineer
job.description:
Description:
The applicant will be focused on electrical wiring and harness assembly design and development. Duties include creating wiring diagrams and schematics, resolving wiring/integration related issues between the various avionics/electrical systems, performing technical checks to ensure wiring document correctness, and providing engineering sign-off for all F-16 change notices developed at Hill AFB. A B.S. in Electrical Engineering or similar 4 year degree, previous experience interpreting and drafting wiring diagrams and schematics, and experience utilizing CAD drafting software (Catia or similar) is required. Previous experience designing on aerospace platforms ( F-16, F-35, F-22, etc.) and experience with *** Aeronautics proprietary tools (ADMS/CSPL, Parts Warehouse, EDMS, etc.) is desirable.

job.title: Technical Customer Service Representative
job.description:
Title: Technical Customer Service Representative
Location: Cleveland, OH 44135
Pay: $19.00–$20.00 per hour
Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM with a 1-hour lunch

Put Your Mechanical Skills to Work!

Nesco Resource is hiring a Technical Service Representative in Cleveland for a temp-to-hire opportunity with a well-established company. If you have strong mechanical aptitude, enjoy solving problems, and like helping people, this could be a great opportunity to put your skills to work.

This is not your typical call center position. You will be part of a technical service team where you'll use your mechanical knowledge, troubleshooting skills, and customer service abilities to help customers with pellet stoves, wood stoves, and other heating products.

You'll work directly with customers to understand their concerns, diagnose problems, research solutions, and guide them through the steps needed to resolve technical issues. You'll also have opportunities to build your product knowledge through training and hands-on learning.

What You'll Do:

Provide friendly, professional, and knowledgeable technical support to customers.
Respond to customer questions through inbound and outbound phone calls, email, web chat, and other communication channels.
Troubleshoot and diagnose issues with pellet stoves, wood stoves, installed heaters, and related products.
Ask questions and gather information to identify the source of technical problems.
Guide customers through maintenance, troubleshooting, and corrective steps.
Explain technical information clearly and in an easy-to-understand manner.
Research technical questions using service manuals, schematic diagrams, and product information.
Recommend solutions, replacement parts, accessories, and related products when appropriate.
Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, technical issues, warranty concerns, and quality trends.
Enter customer orders and RMAs into the company's operating system.
Process customer credit card orders through web-based systems.
Maintain up-to-date product knowledge and stay informed about industry and product trends.
Communicate recurring quality issues, warranty trends, and potential product concerns to the Technical Service team.
Work with parts specialists to help support service-parts availability.
Represent the company professionally during occasional customer site visits, training events, and trade shows.
Participate in technical training programs and continue developing product knowledge.
Assist with occasional marketing, website, warehouse, and offseason technical projects.

What We're Looking For:

We're looking for someone who is mechanically minded, dependable, curious, and enjoys figuring out how things work.

The ideal candidate will have:

1–2 years of customer service or technical service experience.
Strong mechanical aptitude and an interest in troubleshooting equipment.
The ability to read and understand service manuals and schematic diagrams.
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
The ability to explain technical information clearly and professionally.
Intermediate to advanced Microsoft Office skills, including Word, Outlook, and Excel.
The ability to work independently while also being a strong team player.
A professional, patient, and customer-focused attitude.
The ability to make product and accessory recommendations when appropriate.
An Associate's degree or technical training is preferred.
Spanish/English bilingual skills are a plus.

Why You'll Enjoy This Opportunity:

If you're looking for something beyond a traditional customer service or call center job, this role offers the opportunity to develop valuable technical knowledge while helping people solve real problems.

You won't simply be reading from a script. You'll listen to customers, ask questions, troubleshoot issues, research solutions, and help determine the best way to resolve their concerns.

You'll also have opportunities for technical training, product education, customer site visits, and trade shows, giving you the chance to continue learning and growing in the role.

Ready to Put Your Skills to Work?

If you're mechanically inclined, enjoy solving problems, and like helping people, we'd love to hear from you!

job.description:
Monday - Thursday 5am – 3:30pm

Temp to Perm

JOB SUMMARY:The Production Operator is either responsible for the set up and operation of equipment which blends, mixes, packages and/or transports liquid or dry chemicals that comprise ***'s customer products or the operation of ***'s packaging lines. The Production Operator ensures the highest quality product at the lowest possible costs while meeting customer
specifications and delivery requirements in accordance with *** Corporation policies and procedures.


Essential Functions as a Mixing Operator
• Sets up, starts, and runs all machinery while checking all controls for adherence to operation, safety procedures, and ISO standards.
• Weighs materials to meet product recipe specifications; inserts raw and pre-blended materials into machinery; ensures the correct materials are delivered to the work area.
• Monitors production processes and equipment to ensure safe and efficient operation; troubleshoots equipment and processing issues.
• Operates machinery to mix, extrude, discharge, or process materials according to operating procedures.
• Examine materials visually and/or physically to ensure conformance with established standards.
• Take samples of materials to lab for evaluation and instructions on batch adjustments, as needed.
• Refers issues to Production Lead or Production Supervisor for disposition.
• Performs all required machine cleaning.
• Completes and maintains all required system inputs and transactions. Responsible for data integrity.
• Documents work completed as required, including production logs, data reports, procedures, etc.
• Participate in training, retraining and continual improvement processes and methods.
• Follows and complies with all safety rules, work rules, and regulations.
• Maintains departmental housekeeping standards.
• Other duties as assigned

Essential Functions as a Packaging Operator
• Operates small press machine, checking all controls for adherence to operating/safety procedures and ISO standards.
• Operates the Automated Packaging Line (APL)
• Ensure containers are accurately labeled, counted, palletized, and transferred to designated holding area with pallet jack.
• Follows product recipe to accurately weigh materials using walkie lift
• Mix material in small vessels
• Examines materials visually and/or physically to ensure conformity with established standards.
• Refers issues to Production Lead or Production Supervisor for disposition.
• Performs all required machine cleaning.
• Completes and maintains all required system inputs and transactions; responsible for data integrity.
• Documents work completed as required, including logs, data reports, and procedures into computer system (SAP).
• Participates in training, retraining, and continual improvement processes and methods.
• Follows and complies with all safety rules, work rules, and regulations.
• Maintains departmental housekeeping standards.
• Other duties as assigned

QUALIFICATIONS:
Education and Experience
• High School Diploma or GED
•
2 years of manufacturing experience
•
1 year of machine operation experience

Physical Demands The typical work week is Monday through Thursday with occasional overtime. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, stoop, kneel, crouch and/or crawl; use hands to finger, handle and/or feel objects, tools, and/or controls; talk and/or hear. Occasionally required to sit. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 55 pounds and occasionally handle up to 250 pounds. Specific vision abilities may require close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. Requires the use of safety equipment as dictated by the work area such as safety glasses, safety shoes, dust mask, hard hat, respirator, face shield, hearing protection, chemical suit, gloves, aprons, etc. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate except for high noise areas. Proper personal safety equipment must be used while performing the duties of this job. All needed safety equipment is determined by plant safety guidelines.
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently exposed to hot or cold temperatures, wet and/or humid conditions, dust, fumes, airborne particles, chemical dust, risk of electric shock, vibration, non-hazardous chemical agents, and outside weather conditions. Employees are regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts, fumes and/or airborne particles.

job.title: Remote Sr. Systems Administrator
job.description:
SUMMARY

The IT Corporate System Administrator role assists in developing, implementing and maintaining corporate Infrastructure Operations standards, technologies, processes and procedures. As a key member of the IT Infrastructure Operations team, this role works collaboratively to support and rapidly respond to needs of the business. This is in addition to business integration initiatives to consolidate disparate systems to improve service and experience levels. This position will assist in the development of the Infrastructure & Operations strategy to guide efforts in conjunction with the overall IT strategy.

The Collaboration Systems Administrator III position will be responsible for maintenance and reliable operation of the Microsoft 365 toolset (Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Exchange, Office 365, etc.) and other Collaboration software tools (Zoom, Adobe, Lucid, NinjaOne, etc). The position also includes leading project improvement efforts for existing tools and implementing new tools to support the organization's evolving technical needs. The role also provides administration and governance for the Microsoft Power Platform, supports the secure administration and engineering of agentic AI solutions and AI agents, and applies Microsoft 365 eDiscovery knowledge and experience to support legal, compliance, investigation, and information governance requirements.

 

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Responsible for System Administration and process development/improvement of Email Services (Exchange Online) and Office Applications (Office 365), Teams, OneDrive and SharePoint
  • Responsible for administration, governance, security, environment management, and operational support of the Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Pages, Dataverse, and the Power Platform Center of Excellence toolkit
  • Administer and support agentic AI platforms and AI agents, including identity and access, environment controls, connectors, data permissions, lifecycle management, monitoring, security, governance, and solution engineering
  • Administer and support Microsoft Purview eDiscovery capabilities, including case management, preservation, search, collection, review, export, permissions, auditability, and coordination with Legal, Compliance, Privacy, and Security stakeholders
  • Develop enhanced security and reliability of all team owned products including all Microsoft 365 products, Lucid, and Smartsheet
  • Responsible for implementing and administering email security utilizing Proofpoint solutions
  • Provide basic networking and active directory functionality as it relates to existing tools and customer needs
  • Collaborates with cross-functional teams to support and troubleshoot level 2 and level 3 problems
  • Leads and supports project efforts focusing on improvement and enhancement of solutions and implementing new solutions
  • Supports system monitoring environment to ensure a reliable and proactive system environment
  • Account administration for new users and existing users requiring license additions
  • Provide high level training and education for end users on Office 365 and other collaboration tools
  • Manage incidents and requests to meet or exceed identified SLA targets
  • Perform other duties as needed or required

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

None; Willing to teach and coach other professionals within the department

 

QUALIFICATIONS:

Education and/or Experience

  • Associates degree in Information Systems, Computer Science or Computer Technology or, equivalent years of relevant work experience is required
  • A minimum of 5 years of related work experience is commonly required to meet the expectation of the position

Certificates, License & Registrations

  • Microsoft certifications a plus

 

Competencies (Skills & Abilities)

  • Experience with advanced administration of Microsoft Office 365, including Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, Azure AD and related technologies
  • Experience administering and governing the Microsoft Power Platform, including environment strategy, Dataverse, connectors, data loss prevention policies, tenant settings, capacity, security roles, managed environments, and application lifecycle management
