job.description:
Material Handler

Schedule:
1st Shift: Monday through Friday 5:00 AM to 3:30 PM
OR
2nd Shift: Monday through Friday 3:30 PM to 2:00 AM

Description:

Join our team as a Material Handler, a full-time production role equivalent to a Rigger classification. In this role, you'll begin with a compulsory Training Period, setting you up for success in our fast-paced environment. After completing training, you'll be assigned to a production shift and may be required to work overtime.

Essential Functions/Tasks:

As a Material Handler, you'll be essential to our production process. Your tasks will vary depending on your shift, production requirements, and supervisor instructions, including:

  • Operate Overhead Crane Systems: Handle steel beams, plates, and assemblies safely and efficiently.
  • Manage Steel and Equipment: Move and position small pieces of steel and shop equipment weighing between 10 to 50 pounds.
  • Assist with Steel Preparation: Help with cleaning and painting steel, handling paint and solvents.
  • Drive Forklifts and Tractors: Use forklifts and tractors to move materials around the shop floor.
  • Load and Unload: Efficiently load and unload trucks and rail cars using the appropriate equipment and systems.
  • Maintain Cleanliness: Perform yard and building cleaning tasks, contributing to the overall maintenance of our facilities and equipment.

Physical Requirements:

You'll need adequate strength, mobility, dexterity, vision, hearing, and stamina to perform these tasks with minimal assistance.

Other Qualifications:

  • Education: A high school education is preferred.
  • Independence: Ability to follow instructions well and work without constant supervision.
  • Team Player: Willingness to collaborate and contribute to a positive work environment.

Why Join Us?

In this role, you'll find a supportive team environment where your skills and dedication are valued. You will work with advanced equipment and contribute to our production processes. With opportunities for overtime and growth, this position is both rewarding and fulfilling.

Join us and be part of a company that values hard work, precision, and teamwork. Apply now to start your journey as a Material Handler with us!

Nesco Resource has an exciting new career opportunity for you! Nesco Resource is currently hiring dependable and motivated Loader Machine Operators to join our client's team in Williamsport, PA. Pay: $19.00 per hour

 Job Summary

The Loader Machine Operator is responsible for monitoring and operating an automated robotic system that feeds eggs into the grading machine. This position ensures smooth production by monitoring equipment performance, responding to alarms, performing basic troubleshooting, and working closely with maintenance and production teams to minimize downtime and maintain efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Follow all food safety, quality, and sanitation requirements, including HACCP, FDA, and SQF standards.

  • Follow required safety procedures, PPE requirements, and lockout/tagout practices.

  • Basic math skills and the ability to accurately complete production documentation.

  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.

  • Ability to work safely and effectively in a fast-paced production environment.

  • Reliable attendance and punctuality.

  • Flexibility to work overtime, weekends, and holidays as business needs require.

Physical & Work Environment

We are currently seeking an experienced Supervisor/Team Lead to join our team in the Toledo area. This position is responsible for overseeing multiple sorting, inspection, and rework operations within an automotive manufacturing environment.

The ideal candidate will have previous supervisory or team lead experience, strong leadership skills, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced manufacturing environment. Forklift certification or several years of forklift operating experience is a plus.

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensure all end-of-shift responsibilities are completed, including auditing paperwork and time sheets.

  • Provide on-the-job training and communicate new or updated work instructions to employees.
  • Maintain accountability for all personnel assigned to specific jobs.
  • Provide feedback to Supervisors or Managers regarding employee performance.
  • Report policy, safety, or procedural violations to the appropriate Supervisor or Manager.

job.title: Windows Systems Support Specialist
job.description:
Windows Systems Support Specialist

Oklahoma City, OK | $49,920–$52,000 Annual Salary

Work Authorization Requirement: Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. and must NOT require current or future visa sponsorship of any kind, including Student Visas.

Ready to Take Your IT Skills to the Next Level?

If you enjoy figuring out how technology works, solving technical problems, and keeping systems running securely, this could be your next move.

Nesco Resource is seeking a Windows Systems Support Specialist to help keep Windows environments secure, updated, and performing as they should. You'll work with Microsoft patching, system upgrades, vulnerability remediation, and technical testing — gaining valuable hands-on experience in the systems and security side of IT.

You don't need a decade of experience to get started. If you have at least one year of relevant experience, understand the basics of Windows systems and Microsoft patching, and are ready to keep learning, we want to hear from you.
The Details
  • Pay: $49,920–$52,000 annually
  • Location: Oklahoma City, OK
  • Work Arrangement: 100% on-site
  • Schedule: Monday–Friday
  • Employment Type: Contract-to-hire with a long-term opportunity and potential for permanent placement based on performance
  • Experience: At least 1 year of relevant hands-on experience
Important: You must live within reasonable driving distance of Oklahoma City and be able to commute to the worksite daily.

What You'll Be Working On

  • Keep Windows systems up to date: Support Windows upgrades, Microsoft patching, and scheduled updates across Windows 10/11 environments.
  • Help strengthen system security: Assist with vulnerability remediation, antivirus technologies, and keeping systems aligned with security policies.
  • Test before deployment: Help validate updates, troubleshoot issues, and make sure changes are ready before they go live.
  • Work with Microsoft infrastructure: Support Active Directory and related Windows systems and services.
  • Solve problems and improve processes: Identify issues, document results, and help make patching and maintenance processes more efficient.
  • Put your technical skills to work: Use Microsoft Office tools, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Visio, to document findings and communicate solutions.

What We're Looking For

  • An associate degree, relevant technical certifications, or equivalent related work experience.
  • At least 1 year of hands-on Microsoft patching experience or closely related Windows systems support experience.
  • Familiarity with Windows 10/11, Microsoft patching schedules, and deployment methods.
  • A basic understanding of WSUS (Windows Server Update Services).
  • Experience with Microsoft Active Directory and familiarity with Windows Server environments.
  • Knowledge of antivirus technologies and basic security practices.
  • Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Visio.
  • A valid driver's license and clean driving record.
  • Ability to work on-site in Oklahoma City every workday.

Extra Skills That Will Make You Stand Out

You don't need to check every box below, but experience with any of these is a plus:
  • Group Policy Administration
  • Basic SQL Server queries
  • Linux fundamentals
  • SharePoint, IIS, or other Microsoft infrastructure tools
  • IT asset management
  • A bachelor's degree in an IT-related field

Why This Could Be Your Next Move

  • Build valuable systems and security experience beyond basic desktop troubleshooting.
  • Get hands-on exposure to Windows patching, upgrades, and vulnerability remediation.
  • Put your existing skills to work while continuing to learn and grow.
  • Pursue a long-term opportunity with the potential to become a permanent employee based on performance.

Interested? Let's Talk.

You don't have to know everything on day one. If you have a solid foundation in Windows systems support, real experience with Microsoft patching, and the motivation to grow your IT career, this could be the opportunity you've been looking for.

Apply today!

job.title: Automation Engineering Technician Lead
job.description:
Automation Engineering Technician Lead $36-$49/hr
Rochester Area

Scope: This role is essential for maintaining the site's manufacturing operations, ensuring equipment reliability, and leading maintenance efforts to improve productivity and minimize operational disruptions.

Job Summary: Primary focus on sustaining site manufacturing processes and leading shift maintenance team members in execution of equipment return to standard and preventive maintenance activities. Is the escalation path for maintenance individuals within the working shift. Conducts smaller scale process improvement projects supporting various site initiatives.

Essential Functions & Accountabilities:

  • Continuous Improvement Initiatives / Activities
    • Understands site Key Business Metrics to drive focused improvements. Applies statistical problem-solving tools to implement robust solutions that are verified and/or validated.
    • Define, Plan, & Execute improvement initiatives within the site and within SOP guidelines. Adherence to verification/validation (IQ, OQ, PQ) protocols is required.
    • Design & dimension component details in support of automated equipment improvements.
    • Works frequently with external vendors, site Engineers & other CooperVision sites to improve site manufacturing processes.
    • Effectively able to understand, and describe, automated process flows to facilitates improvements to automated logic control systems.
  • Troubleshoot, Repair, and Maintenance for all production equipment.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex Electrical, Mechanical, & Controls issues on various automated manufacturing cells.
  • Significant knowledge of various Programmable Logic Controllers (PLC's), with ability to interpret logic in resolving complex equipment and process issues.
  • Interpret and apply written specifications, schematic drawings, parts lists, prints and sketches, to installation, maintenance, and repair of equipment.
  • Effectively communicates, both verbal and written, with shift team, management and other support groups.
  • Minimize lost time incidents through escalation to various support groups, both internal & external.
  • Provides on-shift leadership support to manufacturing maintenance personnel to include, but not limited to, training, employee relations, performance reviews, and discipline. Will provide feedback to Senior Engineering Manager in relation to hiring and termination decisions.
  • Identifies and addresses developmental needs for individuals and provides training and coaching as appropriate. Partners with Human Resources as needed.
  • Direct focus coaching and developing maintenance team members in return to standard and preventive maintenance of automated equipment/processes. Secondary focus on coaching manufacturing technicians in the flow of various automated processes.
  • Ensures shift team members effectively complete preventative maintenance events prior to due dates, supporting all site manufacturing equipment. All related documentation is completed accurately and legibly in accordance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOP).
  • Provides documentation updates for electrical and mechanical drawings as needed to sustain accurate prints, in support of various manufacturing cells, including electrical, pneumatic, hydraulic, and mechanical details.
  • Completes periodic review and/or approval of equipment maintenance SOP procedures, and work instruction. Coaches shift maintenance team individuals in the update and development of SOP procedure.
  • Able to provide leadership support, as needed, for facility related issues, during normal working hours, to sustain, or return flow to key manufacturing processes. (ex. Power Outage, Water leaks, Weather, other...)
  • As business needs dictate, works extended hours to complete daily department goals or tasks to include mandatory overtime.
  • Perform other duties as directed by department manager or shift supervisor.

Travel:
This position does not require travel.

Qualifications
Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:
  • Notable PLC controls experience required, skilled in accessing PLC content to efficiently resolve process/equipment issues. (Allen Bradley preferred)
  • Demonstrated electrical problem-solving abilities. (control up to 480 VAC)
  • MS Office Experience required.
  • Industrial Robots, Vision &/or Laser marking experience preferred.
  • Experience adhering to Standard Operating Procedures and Regulatory requirements in the manufacturing of medical devices is preferred.
  • Machining & Fabrication experience desired.
  • Previous leadership responsibilities desired.
  • Exhibits excellent communication skills – verbal, written, and comprehension of the English language.

Work Environment:
  • Primary environments include clean manufacturing area supporting medical device manufacturing, with secondary office type environment.
  • Exposure to various chemicals or solvents commonly used in sustaining automated equipment.
  • Physical Requirements:
  • Standing, Walking - 50-75%
  • Sitting, Climbing, Bending, Stooping, Kneeling, Crouching, Twisting, Reading overhead
  • Finger/wrist dexterity, Hand/eye coordination, Grasping/pinching
  • Lifting up to 50 lbs.

Experience:
  • 7 - 10 years of experience in resolving and maintain automated equipment processes, including PLC (controls), electrical, mechanical &/or related competencies.

Education: Associate degree or equivalent technical certification (completion of an apprenticeship program, military program or trade school) with 7 years of experience is preferred.

job.title: Civil Designer / Civil 3D Designer
job.description:
We are seeking a Civil Designer or Civil 3D Designer to support industrial engineering and design projects in Houston, TX.

The ideal candidate will have experience with grading, drainage, site layouts, and three-dimensional modeling using AutoCAD Civil 3D. Candidates with a piping design background using CADWorx or AVEVA E3D will also be considered, particularly if they have experience interpreting engineering drawings and modeling piping systems at specified slopes and elevations.

This position is well suited for an early-career to mid-level designer who is technically capable, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with multidisciplinary engineering teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and modify civil design drawings and 3D models for industrial facilities.

  • Assist with site grading, drainage, and underground utility layouts.

  • Use AutoCAD Civil 3D to develop and revise grading and drainage models.

  • Interpret engineering plans, drawings, elevations, and design specifications.

  • Model piping and underground utility systems at appropriate slopes and elevations.

  • Coordinate with Civil, Piping, Structural, and other engineering disciplines.

  • Review drawings and models for accuracy, consistency, and potential interferences.

  • Incorporate engineering markups and design revisions.

  • Prepare drawings and design deliverables in accordance with project standards.

  • Support senior engineers and designers throughout project development.

Required Qualifications

  • 2–6 years of relevant civil design, piping design, or industrial CAD experience preferred.

  • Ability to read and interpret engineering plans, drawings, and elevation information.

  • Demonstrated ability to accurately model piping or utility systems on a slope.

  • Working experience with at least one relevant 3D design platform, such as Civil 3D, CADWorx, or AVEVA E3D.

  • Understanding of grading, drainage, underground utilities, or piping layout concepts.

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to work with multidisciplinary engineering teams.

  • Ability to follow design standards and incorporate engineering revisions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with AutoCAD Civil 3D for grading and drainage design.

  • Experience with CADWorx or AVEVA E3D for piping and utility modeling.

  • Previous experience supporting industrial, oil and gas, chemical, or EPC projects.

  • Familiarity with underground piping, drainage systems, and site development.

  • Associate degree in Drafting, CAD Technology, Civil Engineering Technology, or a related discipline.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a practical, hands-on designer who can accurately interpret drawings, understand elevations and slopes, and produce reliable 3D models.

Candidates do not need to be senior-level engineers. We are particularly interested in individuals who have strong CAD skills, can work independently on assigned design tasks, and are comfortable supporting civil or piping-related deliverables.

job.title: Welder/Fabricator
job.description:
Location: Waukesha, WI
Schedule: Monday–Friday | 6:00 AM–2:30 PM
Pay: $27–$32 per hour, with some flexibility for the right candidate

Job Requirements and Primary Responsibilities:

  • Fabrication experience.
  • MIG and Flux-Core welding experience
  • Understand how to read and interpret engineering drawings and blueprints.
  • Study engineering drawings and blueprints to determine materials requirements and task sequences.
  • Plan the sequence of steps to perform duties.
  • Understand how to use measuring devices to cut and prepare raw materials to required specifications.
  • Lay out and examine metal stock or workpieces to be processed to ensure that specifications are met.
  • Set up and operate fabricating machines such as brakes, rolls, shears, flame cutters, grinders, and drill presses to bend, cut, form, punch, drill or otherwise form and assemble metal components.
  • Position, align, fit, and weld parts to form complete units or subunits, following blueprints, engineering drawings and layout specifications using jigs, welding torches, and hand tools.
  • Operate various welding, soldering, or brazing equipment to assemble equipment.
  • Align and fit parts according to specifications, using jacks, turnbuckles, wedges, drift pins, pry bars, and hammers.
  • Position or tighten braces, jacks, clamps, ropes or bolt straps, or bolt parts in position for welding or riveting.
  • Move, assemble, and install equipment.
  • Install generators, fabricate the vehicles to accommodate customer specifications for exhaust and fuel line hook ups.
  • Perform all duties following all 5S/LEAN manufacturing requirements and according to all safety and health policies.

Required Skills:

  • Able to read and interpret documents such as layouts, blueprints, sketches, engineering drawings and manufacturing instructions.
  • Able to calculate figures and amounts such as proportions, percentages, area and circumference.
  • Ability to apply concepts of basic algebra and geometry and general math skills.
  • Solve problems with a deal of variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists.
  • Must be able to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram or schedule form.

Required Experience and Education:

  • Requires the ability to operate various equipment: to include welding equipment, forklift, hoists and various hand and power tools.
  • Requires a broad knowledge of mechanics, metal properties, welding techniques and general metalwork procedures and practices.

job.title: Maintenance Manager
job.description:
Maintenance Manager

Location: Fayetteville, TN
Pay: $100,000–$105,000 per year
Schedule: 1st Shift
Employment Type: Direct Hire

Lead Maintenance. Drive Reliability. Make an Impact.

We are seeking an experienced Maintenance Manager to lead the maintenance function for a manufacturing operation in Fayetteville, TN. This is a key leadership position responsible for the overall direction of plant maintenance, equipment reliability, preventive maintenance, projects, budgets, and maintenance personnel.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on, results-driven maintenance leader with experience in an automotive or manufacturing environment who understands how to reduce downtime, improve equipment reliability, develop maintenance teams, and support a culture of safety, quality, and continuous improvement.

What You'll Do

  • Lead and oversee all plant maintenance activities, ensuring equipment and facilities operate safely, efficiently, and reliably.

  • Direct, coordinate, and prioritize daily maintenance activities, projects, and staffing requirements.

  • Develop and manage Preventive Maintenance (PM) and asset-care programs to improve equipment reliability and minimize unplanned downtime.

  • Analyze equipment downtime, recurring failures, and maintenance issues to identify root causes and implement effective countermeasures.

  • Partner with Operations and other departments to improve equipment performance, production efficiency, and overall plant results.

  • Lead, mentor, train, and develop maintenance supervisors and technicians while establishing clear expectations and accountability.

  • Manage maintenance staffing, schedules, workload, performance evaluations, and departmental objectives.

  • Develop project plans, obtain bids, review proposals, and oversee outside contractors and service providers.

  • Manage the maintenance department budget, approve expenses, monitor costs, and identify opportunities for cost reduction.

  • Manage spare-parts inventory, purchasing, and equipment/supply needs.

  • Support equipment installations, modifications, improvement projects, and troubleshooting efforts.

  • Read and interpret mechanical/electrical blueprints, specifications, and technical documentation.

  • Support robotics and automated production equipment, including training maintenance personnel on robot operation and improvement activities.

  • Utilize or work with CAD/CAM and 2D/3D design systems as needed.

  • Support welding process improvements and maintain appropriate welding conditions to promote quality and consistency.

  • Ensure compliance with company policies and applicable safety, quality, and environmental standards.

  • Maintain accurate maintenance, safety, project, expense, and equipment records.

  • Support 5S, Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, Quality, Cost, Delivery, and Safety initiatives.

  • Provide technical guidance, review work instructions and progress, and recommend improvements when needed.

  • Support administrative and IT-related activities associated with plant operations.

  • Identify opportunities to improve maintenance processes, equipment performance, and overall departmental efficiency.

Leadership Responsibilities

This position provides overall direction, coordination, and leadership for the maintenance organization, including subordinate supervisors and maintenance personnel.

Responsibilities include:

  • Interviewing, hiring, onboarding, and training maintenance personnel

  • Planning and assigning work

  • Establishing performance expectations

  • Coaching, mentoring, and developing employees

  • Conducting performance evaluations

  • Addressing employee concerns and resolving problems

  • Promoting accountability and teamwork

  • Ensuring the maintenance team supports plant goals for Safety, Quality, Cost, and Delivery

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Engineering, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience will be considered.

  • 5+ years of supervisory or leadership experience in an automotive or manufacturing environment preferred.

  • Strong background in industrial/manufacturing maintenance leadership.

  • Demonstrated experience with preventive maintenance, equipment reliability, downtime reduction, and root-cause analysis.

  • Experience leading and developing maintenance teams.

  • Strong project management, budgeting, and cost-control skills.

  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints, technical drawings, specifications, and equipment documentation.

  • Experience working with automated manufacturing equipment, robotics, and/or welding processes is highly desirable.

  • Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, 5S, Kaizen, and continuous improvement principles.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills.

  • Ability to work effectively with plant leadership, production, quality, engineering, and maintenance teams.

Technology & Systems

Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Teams, along with experience using ERP and/or maintenance management systems.

Why Consider This Opportunity?

This is an opportunity to take ownership of the maintenance function within a manufacturing environment and have a direct impact on equipment reliability, downtime, team performance, cost, and plant productivity.

If you are an experienced maintenance leader ready to take the next step in your career, we'd like to hear from you.

job.title: Process Engineer
job.description:
PROCESS ENGINEER $75k-$115k Onsite
Rochester Area

Scope: Provides technical support for a variety of manufacturing processes to help achieve the targeted performance levels for the overall site and wider business objectives.

Job Summary: Provides manufacturing process and project engineering support including process development and continuous improvement activities. Supports the wider business in the introduction of new products and automated processes into manufacturing.

Essential Functions & Accountabilities:

  • Supports the installation, development, and validation of manufacturing processes from concept to implementation.
  • Provides on-going support and monitoring to the manufacturing organization in achieving objectives in respect of process performance, yield, cost, and product quality.
  • Identifies process problems to gain root cause, evaluating data from a variety of sources, formulates alternative solutions, selects, and implements the best solution.
  • Undertakes troubleshooting activities where issues arise across various manufacturing disciplines providing corrective action to resolve disruptions.
  • Seeks to identify areas for Improvement in process yield, cost, and product quality. Undertakes improvement activity and the implementation of improvements across manufacturing operations as appropriate.
  • Helps develop and maintain production related documentation, ensuring documents are accurate, up to date and reflect current GMP (cGMP).
  • Supports process and product validation activities including the construction and delivery of validation protocols and reports. Ensures that the validation process and procedures are fit for purpose and compliant with current regulatory requirements.
  • Assists in the receiving of new products and processes into manufacture to ensure the most efficient transfer.
  • Supports manufacturing improvement events driving Lean initiatives to improving processes utilizing various toolbox items. (6S, VSM, Kaizen, Visual Mgmt, Poka-yoke, 3P, ...)
  • Conduct analysis for space optimization and maintains equipment / manufacturing layouts.
  • Always considers the potential business impact of specific actions and decisions for the company, and consistently directs efforts to preserve and enhance its business position.
  • Travel Requirements : Minimal travel may be required but not likely, estimated at 1-2 weeks per year.

Qualifications
Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:
High volume Manufacturing process engineering and optimization experience.
Experienced in defining and optimization of manufacturing processes, including creation of appropriate documentation, with demonstrated results in the following areas:
o Lean manufacturing
o Continuous improvement
o OEE
o Risk management
o DMAIC
Experienced in the installation and transfer of automated manufacturing equipment into production according to medical device regulations.
Validation experience including FAT, SAT, IQ-OQ-PQ, process characterization, producing detailed reports.
Knowledge of Quality Assurance and Quality Control systems, ideally from medical device/pharmaceutical industry, GAMP and appropriate regulatory requirements.
Health and Safety awareness in respect of safe working practice, use of equipment/guarding, mechanical handling, NFPA/OSHA or CE marking.

job.title: Machine Operator
job.description:
Nesco Resource is hiring for a Machine Operator in Newberry, SC. Apply today!

Position Description

Responsible for the wire-drawing process to ensure requirements of the work order and production schedules are met.

Essential Functions

  • Performs start-up and shut-down processes.
  • Inspects wire at the beginning of the process and cuts wire at appropriate points to finish work orders and/or when a bobbin is full.
  • Measures wire periodically using a micrometer to ensure consistent tolerance.
  • Visually inspects the process continually to spot and correct/report problems.
  • Uses portable welding equipment and other processes to connect ends of coils.
  • Performs routine maintenance of equipment within area of knowledge or refers problem to maintenance.
  • Operates overhead crane to position bobbin at the front/end of the process.
  • Performs daily housekeeping duties to keep area clean and free of safety hazards.
  • Performs other duties as required.
  • Reasonable accommodation may be provided to enable individuals with disabilities to perform all the essential functions of this job.

Scope of Responsibility

Responsible for the wire-drawing process as an operator to ensure that production schedules are met. Responsible for following all safety and quality control procedures. Refers to new and unusual situations to the area lead person or supervisor. Follow all policies and instructions.

Job Specifications

Education: High School or GED

Experience: Prefer some previous experience of one year in manufacturing

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Must have interpersonal skills necessary to foster cooperation and to effectively communicate with others.
  • Must be able to use instruments such as micrometers and scan gun.
  • Must be able to speak, read and understand English.

Working Environment

Physical Demands: Must be able to push, pull, and lift up to 50 lbs. routinely. Must be able to work up to 12 hours. Must be able to be on feet all shift.

Visual, Hearing and Dexterity Demands: Must have normal hearing. Must have normal visual acuity with the ability to distinguish colors and depth perception.

Working Conditions: Noisy and dusty environment. Can be subject to variations in heat normal for a non-air-conditioned manufacturing environment.

job.title: CAD Designer
job.description:
Job Summary
The CAD Designer is responsible for the conceptual design, layout, and development of Firefighter Air Replenishment Systems (FARS) for commercial, industrial, institutional, and high-rise building applications. This role creates comprehensive mechanical and electrical system layouts that support system functionality, code compliance, installation efficiency, and customer requirements.

Using AutoCAD, the designer will develop detailed 2D and 3D building layouts that integrate air piping distribution networks, fill stations, monitoring equipment, control devices, power requirements, and communication interfaces. The successful candidate must possess advanced AutoCAD skills, strong technical aptitude, and the ability to manage multiple projects while working under demanding deadlines.
This position collaborates closely with Technical Services, Engineering, Sales, Product Management, Architects, Consultants, Contractors, and End Users to develop practical and effective system designs for complex building environments.

Primary Responsibilities
Develop conceptual and detailed layouts for Firefighter Air Replenishment Systems (FARS) within commercial, industrial, institutional, healthcare, data center, and high-rise building applications.
Create complete mechanical system layouts including piping distribution networks, risers, fill stations, air monitoring equipment, and associated system components.
Develop electrical layouts for system monitoring, annunciation devices, control panels, communication interfaces, and supporting infrastructure.
Produce detailed 2D and 3D AutoCAD drawings including floor plans, riser diagrams, equipment layouts, isometric drawings, installation details, and system schematics.
Coordinate mechanical and electrical system designs with the project management team.
Evaluate building conditions, space limitations, accessibility requirements, and installation considerations to ensure practical and efficient system implementation.
Generate bills of material, equipment schedules, device lists, riser schedules, and supporting technical documentation.
Manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting aggressive deadlines and changing business priorities.
Ensure all drawings and documentation comply with company standards, applicable codes, regulations, and industry practices.
Recommend improvements to design standards, documentation methods, and department processes.
Provide technical guidance on AutoCAD standards and system layout best practices.

Qualifications

Education
Associate Degree in Drafting and Design Technology, Engineering Technology, Architectural Technology, or a related technical discipline required.

Experience
5+ years of CAD design experience preferred.
Experience developing mechanical and electrical system layouts for commercial or industrial building applications.
Experience reading and coordinating architectural, mechanical, and electrical construction drawings.
Experience supporting projects with multiple stakeholders and demanding schedules.
Fire protection, life safety, building systems, telecommunications, controls, security, or industrial systems design experience preferred.

Technical Competencies
Advanced proficiency in AutoCAD (2D and 3D required).
Ability to independently develop complete building system layouts from conceptual requirements.
Strong understanding of mechanical piping layouts and electrical device integration within building environments.
Proficiency developing floor plans, riser diagrams, equipment layouts, installation details, and schematic drawings.
Strong spatial visualization and building coordination skills.
Ability to interpret construction drawings, specifications, and technical requirements.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.

Professional Competencies
Proven ability to manage multiple assignments and consistently meet tight deadlines.
Exceptional attention to detail and drawing accuracy.
Strong planning, organizational, and project management skills.
Excellent written, verbal, and visual communication skills.
Effective problem-solving and analytical abilities.
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
Customer-focused mindset with strong technical consultation skills.
Continuous improvement mindset and willingness to learn new technologies.
Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and results orientation.

This role combines general facility maintenance with hands-on industrial troubleshooting to ensure building systems, utilities, and production support equipment operate safely and efficiently while minimizing downtime.

The ideal candidate will have experience maintaining and repairing industrial facilities, troubleshooting mechanical and electrical issues, and supporting equipment and utility systems in a manufacturing environment. Experience with electrical troubleshooting, PLCs, and industrial controls is a strong plus. This position is well suited for a hands-on problem solver who can identify issues, take initiative, and support both facility-related needs and industrial maintenance requirements.   • Maintain and repair building infrastructure, including doors, loading docks, floors, walls, roofing, and other facility components

Requirements:

  • High School Diploma or GED required

  • Minimum of 2 years of facility maintenance or industrial maintenance experience in a manufacturing or industrial setting
  • Working knowledge of mechanical systems, electrical systems, plumbing, and HVAC

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience troubleshooting industrial electrical systems

  • Background supporting both facility maintenance and industrial production equipment
  • Experience working in a fast-paced manufacturing environment

Physical Requirements:

Working Conditions:

job.title: Senior Electrical Engineer – Industrial / EPC Projects
job.description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Electrical Engineer to support complex industrial engineering, design, and construction projects in Houston, TX.

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in electrical engineering for large-scale industrial facilities, including oil and gas, refining, petrochemical, chemical processing, or similar heavy industrial environments.

This individual will be responsible for developing electrical engineering deliverables, coordinating with multidisciplinary engineering teams, and ensuring electrical systems meet applicable codes, project specifications, and industry standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead electrical engineering design activities for industrial and process facility projects.

  • Develop and review electrical one-line diagrams, three-line diagrams, electrical schematics, and equipment specifications.

  • Perform electrical load calculations, short-circuit studies, protective device coordination, and arc-flash analysis.

  • Design and specify low- and medium-voltage electrical distribution systems.

  • Prepare electrical equipment specifications and technical evaluations for transformers, switchgear, motor control centers (MCCs), motors, and variable frequency drives (VFDs).

  • Develop electrical layouts, cable schedules, cable tray routing, grounding, and lighting designs.

  • Review vendor drawings, equipment submittals, and technical documentation.

  • Coordinate electrical engineering activities with Process, Mechanical, Piping, Structural, and Instrumentation & Controls teams.

  • Support electrical equipment procurement, construction, commissioning, and startup activities as needed.

  • Participate in design reviews, technical meetings, and project coordination activities.

  • Ensure compliance with NEC, NFPA, IEEE, and applicable industry standards.

  • Provide technical guidance to junior engineers and electrical designers.

  • Maintain project deliverable quality while meeting established schedules and budgets.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering from an accredited institution.

  • 10+ years of electrical engineering experience, preferably in an EPC or engineering consulting environment.

  • Significant experience supporting industrial, refining, petrochemical, oil and gas, or chemical processing projects.

  • Strong knowledge of low- and medium-voltage power distribution systems.

  • Experience developing electrical engineering calculations, equipment specifications, and construction deliverables.

  • Familiarity with NEC, NFPA 70E, IEEE, and relevant electrical design standards.

  • Experience coordinating with multidisciplinary engineering and design teams.

  • Strong technical communication, problem-solving, and organizational skills.

  • Ability to manage multiple engineering deliverables and meet project deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Professional Engineer (PE) license.

  • Experience with ETAP or SKM PowerTools for electrical system studies.

  • Experience with AutoCAD, AutoCAD Electrical, or similar electrical design software.

  • Experience with 3D plant design environments and multidisciplinary model coordination.

  • Previous experience with large-scale EPC projects or brownfield facility modifications.

  • Experience supporting electrical equipment procurement and vendor technical evaluations.

  • Familiarity with hazardous area classification and electrical equipment requirements in industrial facilities.

  • Experience mentoring junior engineers or providing technical oversight to electrical designers.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The successful candidate will be a technically strong, hands-on Senior Electrical Engineer with extensive industrial EPC experience. They should be comfortable independently managing electrical engineering deliverables, collaborating across disciplines, and supporting complex projects from detailed design through construction.

Candidates with recent experience in refining, petrochemical, oil and gas, or large industrial processing facilities are strongly preferred.

job.title: UX/UI Designer – Web & Digital Experiences
job.description:
Position Overview

We're looking for an experienced UX/UI Designer to help create engaging, intuitive, and accessible digital experiences across websites, landing pages, and other online platforms.

This is a hands-on design position for someone who enjoys taking an idea from early concepts through finished designs and working closely with developers to bring those designs to life.

You'll use Figma to develop wireframes, interactive prototypes, high-fidelity mockups, and reusable design components. You'll also contribute to an established design system, helping create consistent experiences across different websites and digital initiatives. The primary focus is website UX/UI design, with occasional opportunities to support email marketing, digital campaigns, and other online creative projects.

What You'll Be Doing:
  • Design user-friendly, responsive experiences for websites, landing pages, online forms, and other digital platforms.
  • Turn business goals, user needs, and project requirements into wireframes, interactive prototypes, and polished visual designs.
  • Develop clear page layouts, navigation structures, content organization, and calls to action that make websites easier to use.
  • Create designs that work consistently across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
  • Apply accessibility standards and inclusive design principles to improve the experience for users with different needs.
  • Build, update, and maintain reusable UI components, templates, and design patterns within an established design system.
  • Document component variations, interaction behaviors, responsive layouts, content considerations, and accessibility requirements.
  • Partner with developers to ensure designs can be implemented efficiently using reusable, scalable components.
  • Prepare organized Figma files, design specifications, assets, and supporting documentation for development.
  • Review completed website implementations to ensure they match approved designs and meet usability, responsiveness, and accessibility expectations.
  • Collaborate with marketing, content, technical, and business stakeholders to translate feedback into practical design improvements.
  • Use available analytics, usability findings, and stakeholder input to refine existing digital experiences.
  • Occasionally develop supporting creative assets for email marketing, digital advertisements, campaign banners, and other online initiatives.
What We're Looking For:
  • Strong professional experience designing websites, landing pages, and interactive digital experiences.
  • Advanced proficiency with Figma, including component libraries, design systems, prototyping, and developer handoff workflows.
  • Experience creating user flows, wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity UI designs.
  • Hands-on experience working with design systems, reusable components, interface patterns, and supporting documentation.
  • Solid understanding of UX principles, information architecture, navigation, content hierarchy, and interaction design.
  • Experience designing responsive interfaces that provide a consistent user experience across different screen sizes.
  • Knowledge of accessibility standards and best practices for creating inclusive digital experiences.
  • Experience collaborating directly with developers and preparing detailed design specifications for implementation.
  • Ability to work across multiple projects, brands, or digital properties while maintaining consistent design standards.
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to explain design decisions and incorporate constructive feedback.

job.title: CNC Programmer - 1st Shift
job.description:
CNC Programmer
Hours: Monday - Friday, 830am - 5pm with flexibility to start early or stay late by 1 hour

Job Overview
Seeking an experienced CNC Programmer to support CNC programming, setup, and machining operations within our additive manufacturing operation. The ideal candidate will have strong experience with CNC programming, setup, tooling, and machining processes, along with the ability to collaborate with Operations and Engineering teams to produce high-quality prototype and production parts.

This is a hands-on role supporting a mix of prototype and production work in a growing manufacturing environment. The CNC Programmer will contribute to machining process development, fixture implementation, quality inspection, documentation, and day-to-day shop activities.

A Day In The Life
  • Create, modify, and optimize CNC programs for prototype and production components.
  • Perform machine setup and operation of CNC Okuma Milling equipment.
  • Select tooling, workholding, and machining parameters to achieve required quality and productivity targets.
  • Support fixture design, fabrication, and implementation for new and existing products.
  • Collaborate with Engineering to review part designs, tolerances, materials, and manufacturability considerations.
  • Troubleshoot machining, tooling, fixturing, and quality issues and support corrective actions.
  • Create and maintain setup sheets, work instructions, tooling documentation, and process records.
  • Inspect parts using calipers, micrometers, gauge pins, optical measurement equipment, 3D scanners, and other metrology tools.
  • Support first-piece inspections and ongoing process verification activities.
  • Assist with continuous improvement initiatives focused on safety, quality, delivery, and efficiency.
  • Maintain tooling, consumables, and material inventory for machining operations.
  • Support general manufacturing activities including assembly, shipping/receiving, scheduling support, and material flow as needed.
  • Maintain a safe, clean, and organized work environment.

What will help you thrive in this role?
  • High school diploma or vocational/technical training in machining, manufacturing, or related discipline.
  • 5+ years of CNC machining experience, including CNC programming, setup, and operation.
  • Experience with 3-, 4-, or 5-axis milling environments.
  • Proficiency with CAM software such as Mastercam.
  • Working knowledge of CAD software such as Fusion 360, Autodesk Inventor, or SOLIDWORKS.
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, dimensions, tolerances, and GD&T.
  • Strong understanding of tooling selection, work-holding, machining practices, and process optimization.
  • Experience in machinery of a variety of metals and engineering materials.
  • Experience with Okuma equipment and OSP controls preferred.
  • Familiarity with inspection equipment and quality-control procedures preferred.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
  • Comfortable balancing multiple priorities while maintaining accurate documentation and process discipline.

job.title: Director of Information Technology
job.description:
DIRECTOR OF INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY

SCOPE:
The Director of IT is responsible for the strategic direction, leadership, and day-to-day management of the company's information technology environment across all corporate and manufacturing facilities. This role partners closely with business leaders, operations, finance, supply chain, manufacturing, and IT teams to ensure systems and data solutions support business goals, improve decision-making, and drive operational efficiency.

The ideal candidate is a hand-on technology leader who can operate strategically while appreciating the operational complexities of the manufacturing facilities.


RESPONSIBILITIES:

IT Strategy & Leadership

  • Develop and execute a company-wide IT strategy aligned with business and manufacturing objectives.
  • Lead, coach, and develop IT team members including setting objectives, providing coaching and establishing/managing performance.
  • Establish technology priorities, roadmaps, budgets and IT standards to support current operations and future growth.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and identify opportunities to leverage technology to improve productivity, efficiency, quality and profitability.
  • Lead major technology initiatives from strategy and planning through implementation and stabilization.
  • Provide IT leadership for due diligence support for acquisitions, integrations, new facilities and other strategic business initiatives.
  • Manage 3 rd party consultants, vendors and other contractor performance through close monitoring and supervision.

Business Systems & Applications
  • Oversee core business applications, including ERP, MES, reporting, and departmental systems.
  • Partner with functional leaders to identify business requirements, improve processes, and prioritize system enhancements.
  • Develop application roadmaps to ensure systems remain scalable, integrated and aligned with business needs.
  • Lead evaluation and selection of technology solutions and software partners.

Infrastructure & Network
  • Provide strategic and operational oversight of the company's technology infrastructure across all corporate and manufacturing locations.
  • Oversee Wi-Fi, VPN, firewalls, switches, routers, servers, cloud infrastructure, telecommunications, storage, and related technologies.
  • Ensure high availability, reliability, performance, and scalability of critical IT infrastructure.
  • Establish infrastructure standards, technology architecture, and lifecycle management strategies.
  • Lead infrastructure planning associated with business growth, new facilities, acquisitions, manufacturing modernization and/or plant expansions.
  • Ensure appropriate redundancy, monitoring, capacity planning, and disaster recovery capabilities.

Cybersecurity & Risk Management
  • Establish and maintain a comprehensive cybersecurity strategy. Oversee cybersecurity controls, including endpoint protection, identity and access management, network security, vulnerability management, email security, and threat monitoring.
  • Establish appropriate access controls, authentication standards, and data protection practices.
  • Lead the response to significant cybersecurity incidents and coordinate remediation efforts.
  • Maintain IT security policies and employee cybersecurity awareness programs.
  • Oversee security assessments, vulnerability assessments, penetration testing, and related initiatives.
  • Partner with executive leadership, HR, Legal, and other stakeholders on cybersecurity, privacy, and data protection matters.

Required Qualifications
  • 10+ years of progressive IT experience including significant leadership responsibility. Experience in paper manufacturing or packaging.
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.
  • Demonstrated experience leading both IT infrastructure/network operations and business systems/applications.
  • Proven experience developing and executing IT strategy and managing IT operations and capital budgets.
  • Strong project management, problem-solving, communication, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

job.title: File Clerk
job.description:
File & Records Support Specialist

Position Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented and highly organized File & Records Support Specialist to assist with physical and digital records management, file organization, document retention, and data tracking.

This position will primarily involve locating, organizing, documenting, boxing, and preparing account files for retention or destruction in accordance with established records management procedures.

The ideal candidate will be comfortable performing repetitive, detail-focused tasks, working with physical filing systems, and accurately maintaining tracking information in Microsoft Excel.

Position Details

  • Job Title: File & Records Support Specialist

  • Work Arrangement: 100% Onsite

  • Schedule: Monday – Friday, 5 days per week

Key Responsibilities

File & Records Management

  • Search for and retrieve physical files from shelving based on closed-account filing lists.

  • Review and organize closed account files according to established retention requirements.

  • Identify and shred files that have exceeded their required closed-account retention period.

  • Package closed account files that must be retained into boxes organized by the year the accounts were closed.

  • Ensure files are accurately sorted, categorized, and stored.

File Organization & Documentation

  • Label storage boxes with required information, including:

    • Account numbers

    • Account closure dates

    • Scheduled destruction dates

  • Maintain accurate records of boxed files and corresponding labels using Microsoft Excel spreadsheets.

  • Organize and track files to ensure proper documentation and retrieval.

  • Verify file information for accuracy and completeness.

  • Follow established procedures for document retention and records organization.

Physical File Reorganization

  • Remove all files from shelving unit 2 to allow facilities maintenance to be completed.

  • Condense and reorganize remaining open-account files on shelving units.

  • Arrange open-account files in numerical order by account number.

  • Maintain an orderly and accessible filing system.

  • Assist with reorganizing storage areas to improve efficiency and accessibility.

Offsite Records Retention

  • Prepare file boxes for shipment to offsite records retention facilities, as needed.

  • Follow established offsite storage instructions and packaging requirements.

  • Use designated materials to properly package and label file boxes.

  • Ensure files are accurately documented and prepared for transfer.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience working with physical filing systems, document organization, or records management.

  • Familiarity with digital filing systems and electronic recordkeeping.

  • Basic proficiency with Microsoft Excel, including entering, organizing, and maintaining spreadsheet data.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

  • Ability to accurately sort and organize files by account number and closure date.

  • Ability to follow established records retention and document handling procedures.

  • Comfortable performing repetitive, detail-oriented tasks for extended periods.

  • Ability to work independently and maintain productivity with minimal supervision.

  • Strong time management skills and ability to complete assigned tasks efficiently.

  • Ability to lift and move file boxes weighing approximately 10–15 pounds.

  • Willingness and ability to work onsite five days per week.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience in records management, document control, administrative support, or filing.

  • Experience maintaining physical and electronic records in an office environment.

  • Familiarity with document retention, archiving, and secure document destruction procedures.

  • Previous experience working in banking, financial services, or other document-intensive environments.

  • Experience tracking files, inventory, or records using Microsoft Excel.

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Physical and Digital Filing

  • Records Management

  • Document Retention & Archiving

  • Microsoft Excel

  • Data Entry & Spreadsheet Tracking

  • File Organization & Labeling

  • Document Shredding & Disposal

  • Records Inventory Management

  • Attention to Detail

  • Organization & Time Management

  • Independent Work & Task Completion

  • Accuracy & Quality Control

Required Candidate Prescreening Questions

Important: The following questions must be answered by each candidate and included with their resume at the time of submission.

  1. What experience do you have with physical and digital filing systems?

  2. Are you comfortable using Microsoft Excel spreadsheets? Please describe your experience.

  3. Are you able to lift and move file boxes weighing approximately 10–15 pounds?

  4. How do you keep yourself focused and motivated when performing repetitive tasks?

  5. How would you describe your organizational skills? This position requires pulling files from shelves, organizing them into boxes by account closure year, labeling the boxes, and accurately logging the information in a spreadsheet. Are you comfortable performing these responsibilities?

Warehouse Team Lead – Bilingual English/Spanish

We are seeking a dependable, hands-on, and detail-oriented Bilingual Warehouse Team Lead to support daily shipping, receiving, and inventory operations. This position will help coordinate workflow, support warehouse employees, ensure incoming and outgoing shipments are processed accurately, and communicate with manufacturing teams, internal departments, and transportation carriers.

The ideal candidate will have previous warehouse and shipping/receiving experience, leadership skills, and the ability to communicate effectively in both English and Spanish.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and support daily warehouse shipping and receiving activities.

  • Help coordinate daily workflow, priorities, and assignments for warehouse team members.

  • Communicate instructions, expectations, and updates to employees in both English and Spanish.

  • Verify and maintain accurate records of incoming and outgoing shipments.

  • Prepare products and materials for shipment using proper packaging methods, including crating, shrink-wrapping, and protective packaging.

  • Compare shipment information against bills of lading, invoices, purchase orders, and other records.

  • Count, weigh, or measure incoming and outgoing materials to verify accuracy.

  • Receive, unpack, inspect, and document incoming shipments.

  • Identify and report damaged materials, shortages, or shipment discrepancies.

  • Ensure orders and shipments are completed accurately and on schedule.

  • Maintain accurate inventory of shipping materials and warehouse supplies.

  • Communicate effectively with manufacturing teams, internal support departments, and outside transportation carriers.

  • Assist with training, coaching, and supporting warehouse employees as needed.

  • Promote a safe, organized, productive, and team-oriented work environment.

  • Perform additional warehouse and shipping/receiving duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Bilingual English/Spanish required.

  • Must be able to effectively communicate with employees in both English and Spanish.

  • Previous shipping, receiving, warehouse, or inventory control experience required.

  • Previous Team Lead, Lead Warehouse Associate, or warehouse leadership experience preferred.

  • Knowledge of shipping, receiving, and inventory control procedures.

  • Basic computer proficiency, including Microsoft Word.

  • Ability to learn and effectively use computerized inventory and warehouse management systems.

  • Ability to read and verify shipping documentation, including bills of lading, invoices, and purchase orders.

  • Strong organizational and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Dependable and team-oriented with the ability to take initiative.

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced warehouse environment and help keep the team organized and on task.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a hands-on bilingual leader who isn't afraid to jump in and work alongside the team. The ideal candidate can communicate effectively in English and Spanish, keep employees focused on daily priorities, and ensure shipping, receiving, and inventory activities are completed safely, accurately, and efficiently.

job.title: Facilities Technician
job.description:
Work for a well-regarded aerospace company in Hauppauge, NY as a Facilities Technician. This position is full time/permanent with excellent benefits!
What you need to know:

  • Starting Pay: $28-$34/hour
  • 100% Onsite role
  • This is an entry-to-junior-level, hands-on role for a technician with prior maintenance experience who is looking to develop their skills under the guidance of the Facilities Supervisor and senior technicians
  • . The Facilities Technician I performs routine maintenance, repairs, preventive maintenance, vendor coordination, and general facility upkeep, including daily cleaning duties. Responsibilities also include maintaining and servicing industrial equipment, compressors, generators, and hydraulic and pneumatic test systems.
Responsibilities of the Facilities Technician
  • Perform routine maintenance and repairs on building systems, including HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and lighting.
  • Complete scheduled preventive maintenance (PM) tasks on facility equipment, test stands, compressors, and generators, documenting all work in maintenance logs.
  • Perform general maintenance on diesel-powered compressors and generators, including checking and replenishing oil, coolant, and fuel; replacing oil and air filters; servicing water separators; and completing startup and shutdown procedures.
  • Maintain hydraulic and fuel test stands, including replacing leaking hoses, fittings, and other components as needed.
  • Perform scheduled maintenance on pneumatic test stands and processed air systems, including inspecting valves, sensors, piping, and related components.
  • Troubleshoot equipment issues and perform basic repairs, including replacing defective gaskets, valves, sensors, hoses, fittings, and other components.
  • Assist with maintenance and repairs involving hydraulic, pneumatic, and electromechanical equipment.
  • Coordinate with third-party vendors for major equipment repairs and specialized maintenance.
  • Perform basic plumbing and electrical repairs, painting, carpentry, groundskeeping, and snow removal.
  • Respond to routine maintenance requests and escalate complex issues to the Facilities Supervisor or senior technicians.
  • Clean common areas, maintain facility cleanliness, and perform minor property repairs.
  • Visually inspect fire and safety systems and promptly report any issues.
  • Maintain accurate records of maintenance activities, equipment servicing, and completed work.
  • Operate company vehicles to transport tools, equipment, and supplies between facilities and job sites, and run occasional errands for parts and materials.
  • Follow all safety regulations, maintenance procedures, and company vehicle policies.
Experience and Skills of the Facilities Technician
  • 1–2 years of experience in building maintenance, facilities support, industrial maintenance, or a related hands-on trade.
  • Basic working knowledge of HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and mechanical systems.
  • Familiarity with diesel engines, compressors, generators, hydraulic systems, pneumatic systems, or industrial test equipment is a plus.
  • Basic troubleshooting and repair skills involving mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic, or electromechanical components are preferred.
  • Ability to use hand and power tools safely.
  • Mechanical aptitude and willingness to learn from senior technicians.
  • Ability to follow instructions, maintain accurate records, and work effectively as part of a team.
  • Good communication and customer service skills.
  • Ability to pass pre-employment and random drug and alcohol screenings, as well as a basic background check.
Physical Requirements
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds.
  • Ability to climb stairs and work in confined spaces, outdoor environments, and varying temperatures.
  • Manual dexterity to handle components and operate tools safely.
  • Ability to stand or sit for extended periods.
  • Frequent use of hand tools and basic repair equipment.
Education, Licenses, and Certifications
  • High school diploma or GED required.
  • Trade schooling or related coursework is a plus but not required.
  • Valid state driver's license with a clean driving record required.
Compensation and Benefits
  • Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance options.
  • 401(k) with 100% match on the first 4%.
  • Paid holidays, vacation, and sick/personal leave accrued from date of hire.

job.description:
Industrialer Paint / Powder Coater

Location: Canton, Ohio
Shift: 1st Shift | Monday–Friday, 7:00 AM–3:30 PM
Pay: $20.00–$26.00 per hour, based on experience and skill level

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Industrial Paint / Powder Coater to apply wet paint and powder coatings to precision sheet metal fabrications. The ideal candidate will have prior experience with both wet painting and powder coating processes and a strong understanding of coating application, surface preparation, and quality inspection.

Responsibilities

  • Set up and operate industrial washing equipment to clean metal parts before coating.

  • Load and unload parts on the conveyor system.
  • Prepare and mix liquid coatings to achieve the required color and consistency.
  • Load powder coating material into the application hopper as needed.
  • Operate spray equipment to apply wet paint and powder coatings to metal surfaces.
  • Set and monitor oven temperatures to ensure proper curing of coatings.
  • Inspect finished parts for coating quality and proper thickness using a mil thickness gauge.
  • Remove parts from the conveyor and remove masking materials as required.
  • Follow established safety procedures and maintain a clean, organized work area.

Qualifications

  • Previous experience in both wet painting and powder coating of precision sheet metal fabrications is required.
  • Knowledge of industrial coating application methods and surface preparation.
  • Ability to read and follow engineering drawings and specifications.
  • Experience using coating thickness gauges is preferred.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing quality work.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds.
  • Ability to stand, walk, reach, and bend throughout the work shift.

JOB DESCRIPTION:
Create and modify electrical design for machine control hardware and electromechanical machine assemblies. Utilize CAD software as primary software package for hardware design. Use dedicated controls software such as Rockwell RSlogix, Siemens Symantic for control software design. Ideal candidate has knowledge of industrial machinery systems and expertise in electro-mechanical control systems. Experience with servo-based motion control a plus.

JOB DUTIES:
  • Analyze and coordinate the intended design change on all effected documentation to identify the full impact of the design change based upon form, fit, and/or function and relationships of parts as well as design for manufacturability.
  • Work in cross-functional project teams to create, modify, and detail machine components, bills-of-materials, and assemblies.
  • Collaborate with input from operations and engineering team members as well as contributing design concepts and ideas.
  • Process ECR's/ECN's for pre-release and converting engineering support to ensure current documentation of all design changes and maintaining the highest quality of configuration management. This is accomplished by creating and modifying detailed assemblies, bills-of-materials, specification sheets, and updating/engineering product data management system. This accountability will also include the checking of the ECN's and drawings to support the change process.
  • Resolve machinery problems involving functional and reliability issues to initiate process, quality and safety improvements.
  • Perform product line support as a resource for addressing and resolving problems on existing products when necessary. Safe Commissioning of machinery and subcomponents. This may include process engineering work.
  • Establish and maintain standard AutoCAD Electrical design configuration and part libraries to provide a universal-working environment for all CAD users, which provides efficiency and reduces error when documentation is released.

QUALIFICATIONS
Bachelor's degree in a technology field and 1-2 years of direct experience. Associate
degree in a technology field and several years of direct experience with demonstrated
ability to design parts, subassemblies for mechanical systems.
Proficiency level in CAD system preferably AutoCAD Electrical.

job.title: Construction Coordinator
job.description:
Construction / Equipment Installation Coordinator

Primary Purpose:
Provide field coordination and installation support for major equipment installation projects. This person will coordinate hourly installation resources and contractors, serve as the connection between field personnel and engineering, and ensure equipment installations are completed safely, correctly, and according to project schedules and engineered documentation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide construction coordination for equipment installation projects, including Project North Pole Import/Export equipment installations.
  • Oversee and coordinate hourly field resources performing primary processing equipment installations.
  • Provide weekend and occasional off-shift installation support as required by the project schedule.
  • Serve as the liaison between field installation personnel and Primary Processing Engineering.
  • Coordinate with engineering to resolve field questions, drawing discrepancies, installation issues, and technical concerns.
  • Coordinate contractors and subcontractors to ensure required installation work is completed according to project requirements.
  • Develop, organize, and maintain job plans, work packages, installation documentation, and other project materials.
  • Support the organization and execution of project objectives, milestones, and timelines.
  • Review and interpret engineered drawings, equipment layouts, specifications, and technical documents.
  • Communicate installation requirements and technical information to hourly personnel and contractors.
  • Monitor installation progress and help ensure work stays aligned with the project schedule.
  • Identify field issues and coordinate appropriate resolution with Engineering, Construction, and project stakeholders.
  • Provide hands-on field support when necessary to keep equipment installation activities moving.

What the Hiring Manager Is Really Looking For

The strongest candidates will likely have experience as a:

  • Construction Coordinator
  • Construction Supervisor
  • Equipment Installation Coordinator
  • Installation Supervisor
  • Field Engineer
  • Field Construction Engineer
  • Mechanical Construction Supervisor
  • Mechanical Installation Supervisor
  • Project Coordinator – Construction
  • Construction Manager
  • Equipment Engineer with strong field experience
  • Maintenance/Engineering Supervisor with equipment installation experience

Must-Have Experience

Look for candidates who have:

  1. Equipment installation experience
  2. Construction/field coordination experience

job.title: Bilingual Payroll Coordinator
job.description:
Bilingual Payroll & Benefits Coordinator

  Tulsa, OK       $60,000 – $70,000 / year       Full-Time

  About the Role

A growing industrial manufacturer is seeking a detail-oriented BILINGUAL (English/Spanish) professional to run payroll and benefits for our production workforce, with payroll accuracy and timeliness as the heart of the role. You'll be the first point of contact for employees with pay and benefits questions, while keeping our records accurate, compliant, and confidential. You'll work closely with the HRIS & Payroll Manager to make sure employees are paid correctly and on time and have the support they need to use their benefits. Must be well organized, discreet with confidential information, service minded and easy to talk to.

  What You'll Do

  Payroll (Primary Focus)

  • Run payroll each week or every other week for both hourly and salaried team members
  • Check time and attendance data for errors, confirming that regular hours, overtime, PTO, and leave are coded correctly
  • Catch and fix discrepancies before each payroll is finalized
  • Handle pay changes, raises, deductions, bonus payouts, and back-pay corrections
  • Keep payroll files and supporting documents organized and current
  • Reconcile payroll records, journal entries, and tax liabilities in QuickBooks
  • Help with payroll tax filings, garnishments, wage assignments, and direct deposit setup
  • Answer employee pay questions quickly and resolve issues
  • Assist with year-end tasks, including preparing and distributing W-2s

Benefits

  • Manage employee benefit offerings, including medical, dental, vision, life, disability, retirement, and wellness programs
  • Process new enrollments, life-event changes, terminations, and beneficiary updates
  • Explain plan options and answer benefits questions in clear, approachable language
  • Lead benefits orientation sessions for new hires
  • Help plan and carry out annual open enrollment, from communications to final processing
  • Work with insurance carriers and third-party administrators to resolve employee issues
  • Verify that benefit deductions on paychecks are correct
  • Keep enrollment records current and process changes promptly

Compliance & Recordkeeping

  • Follow applicable payroll and benefits laws, company policy, and reporting deadlines
  • Protect sensitive employee information
  • Support ACA reporting and compliance work
  • Help prepare documentation for internal and external audits
  • Maintain organized digital and paper files

Additional Duties

  • Enter and update employee records in the HRIS
  • Process hires, promotions, transfers, pay changes, and separations
  • Run regular data audits for accuracy and completeness
  • Build payroll, benefits, and workforce reports on request
  • Contribute to system testing, upgrades, and process improvements

  Qualifications

Required

  • Fluency in both English and Spanish, spoken and written
  • At least 3 years of hands-on payroll and benefits administration
  • Experience with payroll in a manufacturing or multi-shift setting
  • Familiarity with HRIS, payroll, and timekeeping platforms
  • Experience supporting open enrollment and benefits administration
  • Working knowledge of payroll practices, wage-and-hour rules, and benefits administration
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and QuickBooks
  • Associate's degree in HR, Business Administration, Accounting, Finance, or a related field (relevant experience in place of a degree will be considered)

job.title: Lead EHS Specialist
job.description:
Position Summary
The Lead EHS Specialist is responsible for implementing and completing EHS initiatives for manufacturing and lab operations. This role requires a high level of understanding of OSHA Guidelines regulations and general safety requirements. Teamwork and communication skills are essential skills for this role as it requires close interaction with the operations and engineering teams to ensure any issues get communicated and resolved in a timely manner. This position will report to the EVP, Global Manufacturing. The ideal candidate should be self-motivated, able to handle multiple project assignments and willing to learn and adapt within a fast-paced organization. Occasional travel is required; 10-15%. The position is located at the Lafayette, IN, facility; remote work is generally not available.

Core Duties and Responsibilities

  • Help to implement and monitor EHS activities with the operations team
  • Complete routine safety inspections (fire extinguishers, cranes, emergency eye wash stations/showers, forklift, etc.), including required electronic checklists, tracking audit findings, responses and audit close-outs; maintains records.
  • Deliver training to employees including EHS new hire orientation.
  • Coordinate training and licenses for cranes and forklifts.
  • Completes JSAs for new equipment and processes.
  • Collaborate with supervisors to document PPE assessments
  • Participate in incident investigations and ensure incident management system is current
  • Track investigations and run trend reports.
  • Maintain chemical inventory database that cross-references GHS Safety Data Sheets. Responsible for ensuring that each SDS is current and approved within the system and accessible to all employees.
  • Where applicable, help establish a Chemical Hygiene Plan for safe operation in laboratory spaces.
  • Participate in daily operation meetings and Gemba walks as assigned.
  • Communicate consistently and effectively to all cross-functional team members to ensure EHS improvements and changes are understood, and questions are answered to move projects forward.
  • Build and maintain knowledge of Client technology.
  • Possess a detailed understanding of global and EHS legal requirements (i.e.: Regulations, Codes, Standards, Directives, and Administrative Policies) and provide regulatory knowledge, technical expertise, EHS engineering knowledge, best practices and EHS management systems
  • Work well with limited supervision while being responsible for project management, compliance assurance and program rollout
  • Prioritize and manage multiple technically complex assignments concurrently
  • Represent Client in a professional manner at all times and in all interactions
  • Perform all other duties as assigned

Position Summary:
The Storeroom Attendant is an individual contributor positioned within a customer's location to fulfil daily receiving, stocking, issuing, and cycle counting of customer and/or company inventory. They are responsible for maintaining a professional, clean and organized work environment.

Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities:
•Unloads, receives and puts away incoming product, goods, tools and/or equipment; unpacks bales, crates, and other containers; checks for damage and for discrepancies between goods and invoices.

•Enters data into a database or other computerized system to maintain up-to-date stock records; retrieves stored information to respond to inquiries (e.g., inventory levels or delivery schedules.); documents discrepancies on an error log and seeks management advice on appropriate corrective action.

•Inspects and measures tools/equipment for defects, wear and tear and reports damage or wear to supervisors.
