job.title: Senior Accountant
job.description:
Nesco Resource is seeking a Sr Accountant in the Fairfax VA area.

Senior Accountant

Position Summary

The Senior Accountant is responsible for managing day-to-day accounting operations, with primary responsibility for Accounts Payable (AP), general ledger accounting, account reconciliations, financial close activities, and financial reporting support. This position also oversees Accounts Receivable (AR) and billing activities while supporting inventory accounting, audits, internal controls, and continuous accounting process improvements.

The Senior Accountant maintains accurate, complete, and compliant financial records in accordance with U.S. Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) and all applicable legal, regulatory, contractual, and organizational accounting requirements.

Position Risk Designation

Selected Risk Designation: Public Trust (High) / Low Risk

This position may involve responsibilities that could substantially affect public trust and may require a background investigation submitted using Standard Form 85P (SF-85P), subject to applicable government requirements.

Other risk classifications, if applicable, will be determined by the requirements of the assigned position and government contract.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

The essential functions include, but are not limited to, the following:

1. Accounting Operations, General Ledger, and Financial Close

  • Perform and oversee daily accounting activities, including Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), billing, and general ledger (GL) functions.

  • Ensure accurate and timely monthly, quarterly, and year-end financial close activities in accordance with GAAP.

  • Prepare and post journal entries, reconcile balance sheet accounts, research discrepancies, resolve reconciling items and variances, and prepare account analyses.

  • Assist with the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and related financial reports for assigned business entities.

2. Unanet ERP and Contract Accounting

  • Administer and review accounting-related organizational setups and updates within Unanet, including customer and vendor records, contracts, and associated system configurations.

  • Manage contract setup and modifications within Unanet to support accurate job cost accounting, compliant billing, and reliable financial reporting.

  • Review accounting data and system configurations to identify and resolve discrepancies affecting contract accounting and financial records.

3. Accounts Payable and Vendor Management

  • Maintain vendor profiles and records and review, code, post, and process vendor invoices and employee business and travel expense reports.

  • Process vendor payments and ensure required documentation, including IRS Form W-9, is collected, maintained, and properly documented.

  • Respond to vendor inquiries concerning accounting records, invoice status, and payment information, as appropriate.

4. Accounts Receivable and Billing Support

  • Maintain customer profiles and prepare, review, and process customer invoices.

  • Submit invoices through applicable government billing portals and other designated billing systems.

  • Monitor accounts receivable and collection activity and investigate outstanding balances or billing discrepancies.

  • Respond to customer inquiries concerning invoices, billing documentation, and account status, as appropriate.

5. Inventory Accounting

  • Maintain inventory accounting records and tracking documentation.

  • Perform periodic inventory reconciliations, variance analyses, and physical inventory counts to ensure inventory balances are complete and accurate.

  • Investigate and resolve inventory discrepancies and related accounting variances.

6. Tax and Regulatory Compliance

  • Prepare and support required tax reporting and documentation, including IRS Form 1099.

  • Review applicable monthly, quarterly, and annual sales tax reporting for accuracy and completeness.

  • Ensure accounting activities comply with applicable legal, regulatory, contractual, and organizational requirements.

7. Audits and Internal Controls

  • Support external financial statement audits, internal control reviews, government contract audits, and other required audits or assessments.

  • Assist with the design, documentation, implementation, and execution of accounting controls, policies, and procedures.

  • Maintain appropriate supporting documentation to facilitate audit readiness and demonstrate compliance with applicable requirements.

8. Process Improvement and Organizational Support

  • Identify and implement opportunities to improve accounting processes, automation, internal controls, efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.

  • Maintain the confidentiality and security of financial, operational, customer, vendor, and organizational information.

  • Support organizational objectives through special projects, process improvements, and other assigned responsibilities.

  • Perform other related accounting duties as needed.

Minimum Qualifications: Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

1. Education and Professional Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

  • Three (3) to five (5) years of progressive accounting experience, including a strong understanding of GAAP, general ledger accounting, and full-cycle accounting processes.

  • At least one (1) year of supervisory or team-lead experience, including responsibility for reviewing the work of others.

2. Accounting Knowledge and Experience

  • Demonstrated experience supporting month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities, including journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations, account analyses, variance resolution, and financial reporting.

  • Hands-on experience with inventory accounting and management, including inventory tracking, reconciliations, variance analysis, and discrepancy resolution.

  • Experience with job cost accounting and enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems.

  • Ability to navigate accounting systems, extract financial data, and perform detailed analyses to support accurate reporting and decision-making.

3. Systems and Technical Skills

  • Experience with Unanet ERP is strongly preferred.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including experience with reconciliations, large datasets, lookup functions, PivotTables, and financial analysis.

4. Professional Competencies

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to independently investigate and resolve accounting discrepancies, reconciliation issues, and financial variances.

  • Effective verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally with internal teams, customers, vendors, auditors, and other stakeholders.

  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, including the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

  • High levels of accuracy, attention to detail, accountability, and discretion when handling confidential financial and operational information.

5. Government Customer and Security Requirements

  • This position supports U.S. Government customers and may involve access to government systems and Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI).

  • Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States and able to satisfy applicable government-mandated personnel security, suitability, credentialing, background investigation, and system-access requirements.

  • Depending on the applicable contract and assignment, requirements may include obtaining and maintaining a federal security clearance, Public Trust determination, and/or Personal Identity Verification (PIV) credential.

  • Employment and system access are contingent upon satisfying the applicable requirements for the assigned position.

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • Directly supervise one Staff Accountant, providing day-to-day guidance, reviewing assigned work, and supporting training and professional development.

  • Review work prepared by the Staff Accountant and provide timely feedback to ensure accuracy, completeness, and adherence to deadlines.

  • Coordinate assignments and daily workflow, helping prioritize responsibilities during monthly, quarterly, and year-end close periods.

  • Provide constructive performance feedback and participate in performance evaluations.

  • Assist with onboarding, training, and professional development of assigned accounting personnel, as applicable.

job.title: Cabinet Maker
job.description:
Cabinet Maker
Winter Park/Orlando
$19+
6am to 4:30pm

Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Cabinetry Maker to join our team. This position focuses on the hands-on fabrication, assembly, and installation of custom wood cabinets and cabinet components using engineering drawings, measuring tools, and a variety of power and pneumatic tools. The ideal candidate has experience working with wood, assembling cabinets, cutting and fitting components, and ensuring finished products meet quality standards.

Cabinet Makers will be responsible for taking cabinet components from the fabrication stage through final assembly, finishing, quality inspection, and installation while maintaining a safe and organized work environment.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Fabricate and assemble wood cabinets according to engineering drawings, blueprints, measurements, and production specifications.

  • Measure, cut, fit, and join wood panels, cabinet frames, doors, drawers, shelves, and other cabinet components.

  • Install cabinet hardware, hinges, handles, brackets, and other necessary fittings.

  • Operate woodworking machinery, power tools, and pneumatic tools to cut, shape, drill, fasten, and assemble cabinet parts.

  • Read and interpret engineering drawings and layouts to ensure accurate cabinet dimensions, alignment, and fit.

  • Laminate cabinets and panels as needed, ensuring a clean, consistent, and professional finish.

  • Perform sanding, surface preparation, and prep/paint work as required.

  • Inspect completed cabinets and components for accuracy, workmanship, functionality, and overall quality.

  • Identify and correct assembly issues, measurement discrepancies, and defects before products move to the next stage of production.

  • Assist with cabinet installation and fitting when required.

  • Maintain production schedules by organizing tasks, meeting deadlines, and completing assigned work efficiently.

  • Work independently with minimal supervision while maintaining consistent quality and productivity.

  • Assist with training other Cabinet Makers and sharing proper assembly techniques when needed.

  • Maintain a clean, organized workspace in accordance with company safety and 5S standards.

  • Follow company policies, attendance requirements, and all applicable safety procedures.

  • Properly manage hazardous waste containers, keeping them closed unless adding or removing waste.

  • Understand hazardous waste communication procedures, spill response protocols, and designated evacuation routes.

  • Follow applicable OSHA and EPA requirements and complete required hazardous materials handling training.

  • Perform additional duties as assigned.

Qualifications and Requirements

  • Previous experience in cabinet making, woodworking, cabinet assembly, furniture fabrication, or a related manufacturing environment is preferred.

  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, cabinet layouts, and written work instructions in English.

  • Experience measuring, cutting, fitting, and assembling wood components with attention to accuracy and detail.

  • Ability to read and use tape measures, rulers, and other linear measuring instruments.

  • Familiarity with woodworking tools and equipment, including drills, screw guns, table saws, band saws, routers, and other power or pneumatic tools.

  • Ability to install cabinet hardware and assemble components according to specifications.

  • Experience laminating cabinets and panels is a plus.

  • Basic mathematical skills, including measurements, fractions, and calculations.

  • Ability to follow verbal and written instructions in English.

  • Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and meet production deadlines.

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing high-quality finished products.

  • Ability to communicate effectively and maintain cooperative working relationships with team members.

  • General knowledge of workplace safety standards, including applicable OSHA and EPA requirements.

  • Willingness to complete required hazardous materials handling training and annual refresher courses.

job.title: L2 Systems Integration Tech
job.description:
Nesco Data Center is seeking an L2 Systems Integration Technician.

Job Title: Level 2 IT / Systems Integration Technician


Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8 hours per day
Work Hours: Flexible start and end times between 6:00 AM and 5:00 PM, with a typical schedule of approximately 7:00 AM–3:30 PM.

This is a 6 Month Opportunity, maybe extending.

Position Overview

We are seeking a hands-on Level 2 IT / Systems Integration Technician to support an onsite IT team in a fast-paced manufacturing and facility construction environment. This individual will assist with the installation, integration, configuration, testing, troubleshooting, and deployment of IT hardware, industrial computing systems, and supporting infrastructure as new operations and facilities come online.

The ideal candidate is a technically capable, self-motivated problem solver with strong PC and hardware troubleshooting skills, practical systems integration experience, and the ability to work independently. The technician will receive training on site-specific equipment, applications, and procedures; however, the ability to learn quickly, follow technical direction, research unfamiliar issues, and take initiative without constant supervision will be critical to success.

This role will support a variety of hands-on initiatives, including human-machine interface (HMI) refreshes, camera system deployments, PC and peripheral installations, equipment staging, system racking, and general IT infrastructure integration.

Key Responsibilities

  • Hardware Installation and Integration: Install, connect, configure, and test desktop computers, industrial PCs, monitors, scanners, printers, dashboards, peripherals, and related equipment.

  • HMI Refresh Project: Support the replacement, installation, configuration, and validation of approximately 14 human-machine interface (HMI) units and associated equipment within a chemical laboratory environment.

  • Camera System Deployments: Assist with the installation, connection, configuration, and testing of camera systems, including associated computing hardware, peripherals, and supporting infrastructure.

  • Equipment Staging and Preparation: Unbox, inventory, label, organize, stage, and prepare hardware for deployment, ensuring equipment is properly configured and ready for installation.

  • System Racking and Infrastructure: Assist with equipment mounting, rack installation, hardware placement, cable organization, connectivity, and physical infrastructure integration.

  • Level 2 Technical Support: Diagnose and troubleshoot PC hardware, operating systems, peripheral devices, connectivity issues, configuration problems, and system integration challenges.

  • Testing and Validation: Verify that installed equipment, applications, displays, scanners, printers, and connected systems function as intended before operational handoff.

  • Field Troubleshooting: Investigate hardware and connectivity problems in the field, identify root causes where possible, implement appropriate fixes, and escalate more complex issues when necessary.

  • Construction and Startup Support: Work alongside IT personnel, engineering teams, contractors, and other stakeholders as new manufacturing spaces, laboratory systems, and operational infrastructure are completed and commissioned.

  • Documentation and Turnover: Maintain accurate installation records, equipment inventories, configuration notes, test results, and issue documentation to support project completion and ongoing operations.

  • Project Execution: Manage assigned tasks efficiently, prioritize competing demands, communicate progress, and complete installation and integration activities within established project timelines.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Hands-on experience in an IT support, desktop support, field service, hardware deployment, systems integration, or Level 2 technician role.

  • Strong practical knowledge of PC hardware, Windows-based systems, operating system configuration, drivers, peripherals, and common hardware and software issues.

  • Experience installing, connecting, configuring, and testing computers, monitors, printers, scanners, and other IT equipment.

  • Ability to troubleshoot technical issues methodically, isolate potential causes, and work toward solutions independently.

  • Familiarity with physical infrastructure tasks, including cable management, equipment mounting, rack-and-stack activities, and hardware staging.

  • Comfort working in manufacturing, industrial, laboratory, construction, or other active operational environments.

  • Ability to follow technical instructions, standard operating procedures, wiring diagrams, installation documentation, and equipment specifications.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail when handling equipment, documenting installations, and validating completed work.

  • Ability to manage multiple assignments in a fast-paced environment while maintaining quality, safety, and schedule expectations.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate with an established onsite IT team, engineers, contractors, and operational personnel.

  • A self-directed work style, sound judgment, resourcefulness, and a willingness to learn unfamiliar technologies and processes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting manufacturing IT, industrial computing, laboratory systems, or operational technology (OT) environments.

  • Exposure to human-machine interfaces (HMIs), industrial PCs, operator workstations, dashboards, and production-related computing equipment.

  • Experience deploying IP-based camera systems or working with video surveillance hardware and associated network connectivity.

  • Familiarity with basic networking concepts, including Ethernet cabling, IP addressing, switches, network connectivity, and connectivity troubleshooting.

  • Experience with hardware refreshes, technology rollouts, equipment migrations, new facility deployments, or system commissioning.

  • Exposure to equipment racks, patch panels, structured cabling, cable labeling, and physical infrastructure organization.

  • Familiarity with ticketing systems, asset management, inventory tracking, and technical documentation.

  • Experience coordinating installations and resolving issues in environments where production schedules or project milestones are important.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The successful candidate is a strong, hands-on technician who enjoys working directly with equipment and solving real-world technical problems. They do not need to be an expert in every application or system before starting, but they must possess a solid technical foundation, a proactive attitude, and the confidence to investigate unfamiliar issues and learn new processes quickly.

This individual should be comfortable moving between equipment staging, physical installations, PC troubleshooting, system testing, and field support as project priorities evolve. They must be dependable, adaptable, safety-conscious, and capable of becoming a productive extension of the onsite IT team with minimal day-to-day supervision.

Contract Duration and Schedule

This is a six-month contract assignment supporting active infrastructure deployment, equipment refresh, and manufacturing technology integration initiatives. The technician will work eight hours per day, Monday through Friday, with a flexible start and end time between 6:00 AM and 5:00 PM. The typical team schedule is approximately 7:00 AM–3:30 PM, depending on the lunch break.

The position is primarily hands-on and onsite, with success measured by the ability to learn the environment, execute assigned technical work, troubleshoot effectively, and help bring equipment and systems online accurately and on schedule.

job.description:
Position Summary

We are seeking a dependable and quality-focused Manufacturing Production Operator to join an automotive component manufacturing team. Under the direction of the Shift Supervisor, this position works closely with the Line Leader to maintain consistent production, ensure product quality, meet production goals, and assist with training new employees.

The ideal candidate is mechanically inclined, has strong troubleshooting skills, and is willing to learn proper production techniques and equipment operation. Candidates must be comfortable working in a team environment while maintaining a strong commitment to safety, quality, and productivity.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support production line operations to ensure consistent output and product quality.
  • Set up and operate string line and recoiler equipment.
  • Perform hourly quality and production checks.
  • Complete size changeovers as required.
  • Perform splicing and crimping operations.
  • Utilize the Q Plant system to record or access production information.
  • Scan and print finished goods labels.
  • Conduct cross-section analysis to verify product quality.
  • Use micrometers to measure and verify product specifications.
  • Assist with troubleshooting production and equipment issues.
  • Help train new employees on proper procedures and production techniques.

Qualifications and Skills

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Forklift (Hi-Lo) license and crane operator qualifications required.
  • Previous manufacturing or production experience is preferred.
  • Knowledge of manufacturing equipment and quality inspection procedures is an asset.
  • Ability to read micrometers or willingness to learn.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively with coworkers and supervisors.
  • Good troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities.
  • Self-motivated, dependable, and responsible.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team of 2–3 employees.

Physical Requirements

Candidates must be able to perform the physical demands of a manufacturing environment, including:

  • Standing and walking for extended periods.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for a reliable team player who takes pride in producing high-quality products, follows established procedures, and is willing to learn and grow in a manufacturing environment.

Interested in this opportunity? Apply today to be considered for this manufacturing production position.

job.title: Machinist Senior
job.description:
Senior Machinist

Shift: 1st Shift | 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM
 

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Machinist to set up and operate a variety of conventional and numerically controlled machining equipment to produce precision and complex components. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with tight-tolerance machining, precision inspection equipment, machine setups, and blueprint reading.

This position works with limited guidance in a team environment and requires the ability to follow established manufacturing processes while making appropriate machine adjustments to consistently produce quality parts.

Key Requirement – Tight-Tolerance Experience

The hiring manager is specifically looking for candidates who have experience machining and inspecting parts to tight tolerances of .003" or better, with the position requiring precision inspection capabilities involving tolerances of less than .0005".

Candidates should be prepared to provide the tightest tolerance they have personally machined and consistently held.

Key Responsibilities

  • Set up and operate multiple production machines, including conventional and CNC equipment.

  • Perform machining operations such as cutting, shaping, drilling, grinding, forming, and deburring.

  • Perform rework operations as required to bring components into specification.

  • Set up and secure work using standard fixtures and established work-holding methods.

  • Install and adjust cutting tools based on material type, machine requirements, and established processes.

  • Determine and adjust feeds, spindle speeds, and depth of cut to produce quality parts.

  • Work from engineering blueprints, sketches, planning sheets, route sheets, specifications, and verbal instructions.

  • Read and interpret machining drawings and manufacturing documentation.

  • Operate and work with equipment such as:

    • OD, ID, profile, and surface grinders

    • CNC lathes

    • Wire EDMs

    • Broaches

    • Manual machining equipment

  • Work with fixtures, arbors, vises, chucks, carriers, collets, and other work-holding/clamping systems.

  • Deburr precision and complex machined components and features.

  • Inspect finished and in-process components for dimensional and visual conformance.

  • Use precision inspection equipment including:

    • Micrometers

    • Calipers

    • Height gauges

    • Indicators

    • Bore gauges

    • Surface finish comparators

    • Other precision measurement equipment

  • Use magnification equipment, including microscopes when required, to identify surface damage or defects.

  • Perform visual inspections for burrs, damaged surfaces, and other machining defects.

  • Accurately complete required shop documentation, job travelers, inspection records, time reporting, and electronic manufacturing records.

  • Perform statistical process control (SPC) activities as required.

  • Routinely maintain machining equipment to support cleanliness, accuracy, and reliability.

  • Handle raw materials, semi-finished components, and finished parts using appropriate carts, hoists, lifts, or other material-handling equipment.

  • Participate in Lean manufacturing initiatives and identify opportunities to improve productivity, quality, and cost.

  • Follow all company safety, quality, and manufacturing procedures and maintain a clean and organized work area.

  • Perform other related responsibilities as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 3 years of related machining experience.

  • Demonstrated ability to perform machine setups with limited guidance.

  • Experience operating conventional and/or CNC machining equipment.

  • Strong ability to read and interpret blueprints, specifications, route sheets, and manufacturing instructions.

  • Experience machining to tight/close tolerances.

  • Ability to use precision inspection equipment such as micrometers, calipers, indicators, gauges, and comparators.

  • Working knowledge of machine-shop mathematics, including basic trigonometry.

  • Understanding of feeds, speeds, depth of cut, tooling, and work-holding.

  • Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a team environment.

  • Ability to accurately complete production, inspection, and electronic manufacturing documentation.

  • Ability to apply Lean manufacturing concepts and identify process improvements.

  • Strong verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.

  • Ability to use job-specific software and employee self-service systems.

Preferred / Strongly Desired Experience

Candidates will be especially competitive if they have experience with:

  • Precision or aerospace machining

  • Tight-tolerance components

  • CNC setup and operation

  • OD/ID/profile/surface grinding

  • Wire EDM

  • Broaching

  • Manual machining

  • Complex mechanical components

  • Precision inspection and dimensional verification

  • SPC

  • Lean manufacturing

  • Engineering drawings and close-tolerance specifications

Candidate Screening Notes

For each candidate submitted, please include:

1. Tightest tolerance:
Document the tightest tolerance the candidate has personally machined and held.

2. Machines operated:
List the specific CNC, grinders, EDMs, broaches, and/or manual equipment they have used.

3. Inspection equipment:
Identify experience with micrometers, calipers, height gauges, indicators, bore gauges, comparators, microscopes, etc.

4. Setup experience:
Confirm whether the candidate independently performs machine setups.

5. Reason for leaving each recent position:
Provide a clear explanation for each job transition, as this information will help determine interview suitability.

Schedule & Compensation

Shift: 1st Shift
Hours: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM
 

Eligibility: This position is subject to applicable U.S. export compliance and/or U.S. Government contracting citizenship eligibility requirements.

job.title: 1st Shift Production Operator
job.description:
A Production Operator operating on-site or just-in-sequence near the Greer/Greenville plant is responsible for assembling, inspecting, and sequencing panoramic sunroof and roof modules before they are installed onto the vehicle line.

Work is fast-paced and directly tied to plants build schedule.

1st Shift
7 am - 7 pm M-F, OT mandatory on weekends

Core Assembly & Mechanical Work

  • Mechanical Sub-Assembly: Assemble sunroof cassettes, roller blinds/sunshades, drainage channels, mounting brackets, drive cables, and electric drive motors using torque-controlled screwdrivers and pneumatic tools.
  • Sealing & Priming: Apply weatherstripping, specialized seals, and urethane primers or adhesives along glass and frame edges.
  • Electrical Routing: Clip and secure wiring harnesses and connect sensors/actuators to ensure power and switch signals integrate smoothly bus network.
Testing, Alignment & Quality Control
  • Cycle & Function Testing: Place assembled roofs into automated test fixtures to cycle glass open/tilt/close motions, verify limit switches, and check motor amp draw for binding or noise.
  • Gap & Flushness Verification: Check that glass panels seat flush within tight automotive tolerances using feeler gauges, calipers, or optical laser gauges.
  • Leak & Cosmetic Inspection: Verify continuous seal placement to prevent water intrusion and inspect panoramic glass for scratches, delamination, or debris.
Sequencing & Material Handling
  • JIS Rack Loading: Load finished roof modules into specialized sequence racks or automated delivery carts, ensuring units precisely match the broadcast schedule of BMW's assembly line (VIN-to-VIN matching).
  • Material Management: Keep track of sub-components, scan barcodes into the production system (MES), and escalate part defects or non-conformities before delivery.
Work Environment & Expectations
  • Physical Requirements: Standing for 8- to 12-hour shifts, repetitive lifting (often 30–50 lbs assisted by overhead zero-gravity lifters/manipulators), and high-reach handling.
  • Standards: Strict adherence to Standard Process Instructions (SPIs), 5S workplace organization, and zero-defect automotive escalation protocols.

job.title: Quality Assurance Inspector - (Aerospace)
job.description:
Senior Aerospace Inspector – MRO / Final Inspection

Shift: 1st Shift, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM

We are seeking an experienced Senior Inspector to perform final visual, dimensional, functional, and documentation inspections of aerospace lubrication and scavenge pumps and related mechanical components. This position is responsible for verifying that repaired, overhauled, assembled, and tested aerospace articles conform to approved technical data, customer requirements, company quality standards, and applicable FAA Part 145 requirements.

Responsibilities

  • Perform final inspection of repaired, overhauled, assembled, and tested aerospace components.
  • Inspect mechanical parts and assemblies for wear, damage, corrosion, contamination, configuration, identification, workmanship, and proper assembly.
  • Interpret and apply component maintenance manuals, engineering drawings, blueprints, service bulletins, repair specifications, Airworthiness Directives, inspection plans, and work instructions.
  • Perform dimensional inspections using calipers, micrometers, depth gauges, indicators, thread gauges, and other precision measurement equipment.
  • Review test results, travelers, routers, inspection records, and repair station documentation for accuracy and completeness.
  • Verify component, material, and serialized-part traceability.
  • Confirm inspection equipment is appropriate and within current calibration.
  • Identify, document, and communicate nonconforming conditions and documentation discrepancies.
  • Support return-to-service activities by verifying required inspection and compliance documentation.
  • Maintain complete, accurate, and traceable inspection records.
  • Work closely with technicians, Quality, Engineering, repair station leadership, customers, and regulatory representatives.
  • Follow applicable Parker, FAA, customer, safety, quality, and repair station procedures.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Experience in aerospace inspection, MRO inspection, mechanical inspection, or a related quality role.
  • Working knowledge of FAA Part 145 or another regulated environment.
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, maintenance manuals, specifications, service bulletins, and work instructions.
  • Experience with dimensional inspection and precision measuring tools.
  • Working knowledge of GD&T and mechanical inspection methods.
  • Ability to review test results and determine compliance with acceptance criteria.
  • Strong attention to detail and documentation skills.
  • Basic Microsoft Office/computer skills.
  • Ability to read, write, and understand regulatory English.
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • A&P license
  • Previous final inspection experience in an FAA Part 145 repair station
  • Aerospace pump experience, particularly lubrication, scavenge, fuel, or hydraulic pumps
  • Experience with return-to-service documentation and FAA Form 8130-3
  • AS9100, AS9110, ISO 9001, or similar quality-system experience
  • Inspection stamp authority or eligibility
  • Experience with electronic QMS, ERP/MRP, or document-control systems
Senior Aerospace Quality Inspector with 5–15 years of aerospace/MRO experience, currently or previously working in an FAA Part 145 repair station, performing final inspection of mechanical/engine components. Experienced reading CMMs, drawings, service bulletins and repair specifications; performing dimensional inspection using micrometers/calipers/indicators; reviewing test data and repair documentation; maintaining traceability; handling NCRs; and supporting return-to-service documentation. A&P, AS9110, 8130-3, and inspection stamp authority would be major pluses.

job.title: Document Control Administrator
job.description:
Document Control Specialist / Administrative Assistant

Position Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented and highly organized Document Control Specialist / Administrative Assistant to support document management, data entry, supplier transparency, and general administrative operations.

This position will be responsible for maintaining accurate physical and electronic filing systems, organizing and archiving documents, updating supplier information, and ensuring documentation complies with established company standards.

The ideal candidate will possess strong Microsoft Word and Excel skills, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple administrative responsibilities efficiently. This individual should be comfortable learning new software applications, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and supporting continuous improvements in document control processes.

Key Responsibilities

Document Control & Records Management

  • Organize, maintain, file, and archive physical and electronic documents in accordance with established procedures.

  • Maintain structured filing systems to ensure documents are easily accessible and retrievable.

  • Develop and maintain consistent document naming conventions, categorization, and filing practices.

  • Conduct routine document audits to verify accuracy, completeness, and compliance with company standards.

  • Ensure records are current, properly organized, and maintained in designated document management systems.

  • Support document retention, archival, and retrieval activities.

Data Entry & Supplier Documentation

  • Accurately enter, update, and maintain information across multiple databases and software applications.

  • Maintain accurate supplier records, documentation, and communication history to support supplier transparency initiatives.

  • Review data entries for completeness, consistency, and accuracy.

  • Identify and resolve discrepancies in documentation and data records.

  • Support administrative reporting and documentation tracking activities.

  • Ensure supplier-related information is properly documented and organized.

Microsoft Office & Administrative Support

    • Pivot tables

  • Assist with resolving document-related questions, data discrepancies, and administrative issues.

Required Qualifications

Experience

Core Competencies

job.title: Data Validation & Analytics Expert
job.description:
Overview
Client is transforming its global ERP landscape by consolidating multiple ERP platforms into a common SAP S/4HANA Private environment. The Data Validation & Analytics Expert supports this initiative by validating Req to Pay (RTP) data transfers during ERP deployments and improving how deployment data is analyzed, interpreted, and reported.
This role partners with ERP transformation teams, business leads, and stakeholders to ensure data accuracy, completeness, and alignment across deployment activities. The position combines hands-on data validation, profiling, cleansing, and analysis with dashboard development, reporting, and AI-enabled approaches to support deployment readiness and business decision-making.

Core Responsibilities
• Validate that RTP data is accurately transferred during ERP deployment activities.
• Partner with ERP transformation data teams, business leads, and users to define data requirements, validation criteria, priorities, and status updates.
• Collect data from primary and secondary sources and maintain databases, files, and data systems that support validation and analysis activities.
• Develop and implement data collection processes, validation methods, and strategies that improve data quality, consistency, and efficiency.
• Filter, cleanse, and review data through reports, reconciliations, and performance indicators to identify issues and improve reliability.
• Perform data profiling to identify, investigate, and understand anomalies, gaps, inconsistencies, and data transfer risks.
• Mine and analyze large datasets to support deployment activities and business decision-making.
• Use statistical and analytical tools to identify trends, patterns, and insights that support diagnostic and predictive analytics efforts.
• Develop dashboards, visualizations, exception reporting, and reconciliation tools that enable more effective data analysis.
• Apply AI-enabled approaches to support faster issue identification, pattern detection, and insight generation across validation activities.
• Translate validation and analytical findings into clear recommendations, status updates, and reporting for management and stakeholders.
• Proactively identify trends, risks, and business improvement opportunities and provide recommendations to stakeholders.
• Support stronger data quality, lower deployment risk, and more reliable RTP process outcomes across the ERP transformation.

job.title: Software Engineer
job.description:
Description

The Software & Controls Engineer II designs, develops, supports, and enhances software and control systems used to manufacture and test thin-film materials and related products at DSI. This position supports automated and electro-mechanical manufacturing equipment through software development, PLC programming, controls troubleshooting, system documentation, and equipment upgrades. The engineer works closely with Engineering, Maintenance, Production, and other technical teams to improve equipment reliability, resolve technical issues, and support the modernization of manufacturing systems.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, modify, test, and support software and control systems used in automated manufacturing and test equipment.
  • Develop and troubleshoot PLC logic, control software, operator interfaces, instrumentation, sensors, actuators, and equipment communications.
  • Support Maintenance and Engineering teams with equipment troubleshooting root cause investigations, corrective actions, and reliability improvements.
  • Document control systems by updating wiring diagrams, mapping I/O, documenting signal flow, and creating as-built technical documentation.
  • Support equipment upgrades and legacy system modernization, including hardware replacement, software migration, testing, commissioning, and production release.

Required Skills

  • 1-2 years of experience with one or more of the following PLC programming tools (Siemens TIA Portal, Allen Bradley RSLogix, Client Fanuc LogicMaster), PLC troubleshooting, industrial automation, or control-system support.
  • 1-2 years of experience troubleshooting electrical controls, instrumentation, sensors, actuators, motor controls, or electro-mechanical equipment.
  • 1-2 years of experience reading and interpreting electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, I/O lists, control drawings, or mechanical drawings.
  • 1-2 years of experience developing, modifying, testing, or debugging software used to control automated equipment or manufacturing systems.
  • 1-2 years of experience creating or maintaining technical documentation, wiring diagrams, equipment configuration records, software revisions, or change-control documentation.

Desired Skills

  • PLC programming experience with Siemens TIA Portal, Allen-Bradley RSLogix, Studio 5000, Client Fanuc LogicMaster, or similar PLC platforms.
  • LabVIEW programming experience using National Instruments development tools.
  • Experience with industrial wiring, control panels, field devices, instrumentation, equipment communications, or conductor termination.
  • Experience reverse engineering legacy control systems, mapping I/O points, documenting signal flow, or creating as-built electrical drawings.
  • Experience with equipment upgrades, hardware obsolescence planning, software migration, manufacturing data systems, relational databases, document control, or formal change management.

job.description:
Experienced Film Production & Batch Operator

Schedule: 2-2-3 rotation (12 hour shifts)
Day Shift: 7:45 am - 8:00 pm
Pay Rate: $17/

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Film Production & Batch Operator for a manufacturing facility in Statesville, NC. This is not an entry-level machine operator position. The operator will prepare and mix material batches, operate film-production equipment, and monitor the manufacturing process to ensure the finished film meets quality specifications.

Candidates should have previous experience with industrial batching, mixing, compounding, plastics manufacturing, film production, extrusion, or similar process-driven equipment.

Responsibilities

  • Measure, weigh, mix, and prepare raw materials according to production formulas and work orders.

  • Load prepared material into the production equipment.

  • Set up, operate, and monitor film-production machinery.

  • Adjust machine settings as needed to maintain product quality and production requirements.

  • Monitor material flow, temperatures, speeds, and other operating conditions.

  • Inspect finished film for thickness, consistency, appearance, defects, and overall quality.

  • Complete required batch records and production paperwork accurately.

  • Perform product changeovers and assist with equipment setup.

  • Identify equipment or quality issues and make basic operating adjustments.

  • Communicate mechanical problems to maintenance or production leadership.

  • Maintain a clean and organized work area.

  • Follow all safety, quality, and production procedures.

Qualifications

  • Previous experience in industrial mixing, batching, compounding, plastics, film production, extrusion, or a related manufacturing process is required.

  • Experience operating process-based production machinery.

  • Ability to follow formulas, measurements, written instructions, and production specifications.

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to product quality.

  • Basic mechanical aptitude and troubleshooting ability.

  • Comfortable working around raw materials and manufacturing equipment.

  • Ability to stand for the majority of the shift and perform the physical requirements of the position.

  • Dependable attendance and the ability to work a 12-hour schedule.

  • High school diploma or GED preferred.

Ideal Experience

Candidates with experience in plastics manufacturing, blown or cast film, extrusion, resin mixing, masterbatch preparation, textile manufacturing, chemical batching, or other formula-based production environments are strongly encouraged to apply.

job.title: IT Project Manager - (Oil/Gas)
job.description:
Overview
The IT Project Manager III is responsible for leading medium- to high-complexity IT PMO projects from initiation through completion. This role works within a matrix organization and partners with cross-functional teams, stakeholders, vendors, and leadership to deliver technology initiatives while adhering to Client project management standards and governance processes.
The position supports software, hardware, ERP, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and related technology projects. Responsibilities include project planning, financial oversight, risk management, stakeholder communication, status reporting, and coordination across internal teams and external vendors to ensure successful project delivery.

Core Responsibilities
• Lead assigned IT PMO projects with minimal supervision, managing project scope, schedule, budget, risks, and deliverables from beginning to end.
• Partner with cybersecurity management, business stakeholders, and project leadership to uphold project objectives and ensure successful outcomes.
• Develop and maintain detailed project plans and schedules, tracking progress and managing changes to scope, cost, and timelines.
• Facilitate project governance through status meetings, stand-ups, review sessions, executive presentations, and weekly project reporting.
• Monitor project risks, issues, actions, decisions, financial viability, and opportunities for continuous improvement, implementing solutions as needed.
• Coordinate with cross-functional teams, system integrators, vendors, and third parties to ensure alignment with project deliverables, statements of work, invoicing requirements, and timelines.
• Collaborate with financial analysts and project leadership to support budgeting, forecasting, accruals, reclassifications, and financial reporting.
• Manage stakeholder relationships and communications, ensuring project milestones, status updates, escalations, and change control processes are properly communicated and executed.
• Lead strategic project meetings, organize workshops and training sessions, document outcomes, and maintain project records and documentation.
• Promote and enforce project management best practices while supporting strong collaboration, accountability, and communication across project teams.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies
• Bachelor’s degree.
• Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
• 5–7 years of experience managing multiple software, hardware, and/or ERP projects.
• Experience managing multi-disciplinary teams across functional workstreams.
• Proven experience managing implementation projects with responsibilities shared across multiple system integrators.
• Proven experience leading software releases, ERP implementation projects, and/or security projects.
• Strong understanding of project management methodologies, including management of scope, cost, and schedule.
• Experience with project budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, accruals, and variance management.
• Ability to identify, document, and manage project risks, issues, and problems.
• Understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC).
• Intermediate to advanced proficiency with Microsoft Project.
• Excellent organization, time management, written communication, and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to work effectively within a matrix environment and coordinate cross-functional project teams.
• Detail-oriented, self-motivated, collaborative, and able to perform effectively in dynamic and complex environments.

Preferred Skills or Experience
• Energy industry experience.
• Experience working in an Information Technology environment.
• Experience working with or managing projects for Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, and/or GRC teams.
• Master’s degree.

Work Details
• On-site 3–4 days per week.
• Location: Dallas corporate office.
• Minimal travel required, less than 5% annually.
• Work is primarily office-based but may include time in warehouse, plant, refinery, industrial, or pipeline environments.
• May require outdoor work and exposure to varying weather conditions.

job.description:
Position: Contract HR Coordinator About the Role:
Nesco is looking for a hands-on Contract HR Coordinator to provide temporary support to the Human Resources Director during a period of increased hiring and business activity. Recruiting and onboarding will be a primary focus, but this role will also assist with HR administration, employee activities, special projects, and other department needs as they arise. This is a great fit for someone who enjoys variety, is comfortable jumping in where needed, and can quickly shift priorities in a fast-paced HR environment.
What You'll Be Doing: Learn the Manufacturing Plant and Distribution Center operations, positions, and work environments to effectively recruit and communicate job expectations to candidates. Conduct phone screens and help identify qualified candidates for open manufacturing and distribution positions. Coordinate interviews, including scheduling candidates, sending interview agendas, and sending calendar invitations to interview teams. Greet candidates and help create a welcoming candidate experience. Follow up with candidates throughout the recruiting process and communicate next steps. Learn the clients benefit offerings and confidently provide candidates with an overview of available benefits. Extend job offers and communicate pre-employment and onboarding requirements. Complete new-hire onboarding through Paylocity, including electronic I-9 completion and E-Verify. Conduct new-hire orientation and help prepare employees for their first day. Organize, file, and maintain employee records as needed. Assist with planning and coordinating the company Holiday Party and other employee activities as needed. Provide general administrative support to Human Resources and assist with other projects and duties as needed. What We're Looking For: Previous recruiting, human resources, staffing, or related experience preferred. Comfortable communicating with candidates by phone and in person and representing the client in a professional, welcoming manner. Strong organization, attention to detail, and follow-through. Ability to manage multiple candidates, interviews, and priorities in a fast-paced hiring environment. Comfortable learning manufacturing and distribution jobs and spending time in both work environments. Experience with an HRIS or applicant tracking system preferred; Paylocity experience is a plus. Working knowledge of Microsoft Office and calendar scheduling. Ability to handle confidential employee and candidate information with discretion. Dependable, self-motivated, flexible, and willing to jump in wherever HR support is needed.

job.title: Purchasing Agent
job.description:
Our client is seeking a detail-oriented Purchasing Agent to support production operations through the timely and cost-effective procurement of materials, components, and supplies.

This individual will oversee purchasing activities from requisition review through order placement and supplier follow-up, ensuring that materials meet technical requirements, quality expectations, and production schedules. The role involves close collaboration with engineering, manufacturing, and other internal teams, along with ongoing communication with vendors to maintain dependable supply relationships.

The Purchasing Agent will manage a significant portfolio of material purchases, requiring strong organizational skills, sound decision-making, attention to detail, and an understanding of purchasing practices within a manufacturing environment.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Approximately 3–5 years of purchasing or procurement experience, preferably in a manufacturing or production-oriented environment.

  • Ability to review and understand technical documentation, engineering drawings, blueprints, and material specifications preferred.

  • Familiarity with Bills of Materials, purchase requisitions, purchase orders, and manufacturing workflows.

  • Strong organizational, analytical, communication, and supplier coordination skills.

  • Demonstrated attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple purchasing priorities effectively.

job.title: Electrical Hardware Engineer
job.description:
Location: North Austin, TX Area
Employment Type: Full-Time, Direct Hire
Work Arrangement: Primarily On-Site (4–5 Days/Week)

About the Opportunity

We are partnering with an established technology-driven organization seeking an Electrical Hardware Engineer to join its product development team in the North Austin area. This is a hands-on engineering opportunity for someone who enjoys designing electronic hardware, troubleshooting circuit boards, and helping bring new products from concept through production.

You'll work with a collaborative team of electrical, mechanical, firmware, and manufacturing professionals to develop and improve electronic systems used in connected devices and embedded applications. While some embedded firmware development is part of the job, the primary focus is electrical hardware design, PCB development, testing, and troubleshooting.

We're looking for someone with a strong electrical engineering foundation who is comfortable working directly with physical hardware and enjoys figuring out how things work.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design, develop, and improve electronic circuits and hardware assemblies used in microcontroller-based products.
  • Create electrical schematics, develop PCB layouts, and maintain component libraries using tools such as Altium Designer.
  • Perform hands-on testing and troubleshooting of circuit boards, electronic components, and embedded systems.
  • Use oscilloscopes, multimeters, power supplies, and other laboratory equipment to diagnose electrical issues and verify performance.
  • Collaborate with engineers across hardware, firmware, mechanical design, and manufacturing to resolve technical challenges.
  • Support hardware bring-up activities, investigate circuit behavior, and troubleshoot interactions between electronics and embedded software.
  • Write, modify, and troubleshoot embedded firmware in C or C++ for microcontroller-based devices.
  • Participate in product validation, reliability testing, and performance evaluations before release.
  • Investigate product issues discovered during development, manufacturing, or field use and recommend corrective actions.
  • Assist with regulatory testing and certification efforts, including UL and FCC requirements.
  • Support new product introductions, production readiness, component substitutions, and ongoing product improvements.
  • Maintain engineering documentation, including schematics, test procedures, design revisions, and troubleshooting findings.

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a closely related technical field.
  • At least 1 year of professional or equivalent hands-on experience developing analog and digital electronic hardware.
  • Practical experience designing or modifying printed circuit boards, including schematic capture and PCB layout.
  • Familiarity with Altium Designer or comparable electronic design automation (EDA) software.
  • Understanding of embedded systems involving microcontrollers, sensors, and analog/digital electronic components.
  • Experience working with common hardware communication interfaces, including I2C, SPI, Ethernet, RS232, and RS485.
  • Ability to troubleshoot electronic assemblies using oscilloscopes, multimeters, bench power supplies, and related diagnostic tools.
  • Working knowledge of embedded C or C++ programming and the relationship between firmware and physical hardware.
  • Familiarity with firmware programming, debugging, and testing tools.
  • Experience using Git or similar version control systems.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to work through technical challenges independently.
  • Comfortable communicating and collaborating with engineers from different technical disciplines.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Bluetooth or other wireless communication technologies.
  • Exposure to connected devices, IoT hardware, or similar embedded electronic products.
  • Familiarity with hardware certification processes, including UL or FCC compliance.
  • Experience supporting products through manufacturing, production testing, or field deployment.
  • Personal electronics projects involving microcontrollers, circuit design, PCB development, or embedded programming.
  • Experience collaborating with engineering teams across multiple locations.

job.description:
Description:
2nd Shift: 2p – 1130p Mon-Fri

Must be a US Citizen

Customer service skills needed.

Must wear pants with belt loops and a t-shirt or polo.
Site is climate controlled.

Position Summary:
***'s Storeroom Attendant is an individual contributor positioned within a customer's location to fulfil daily receiving, stocking, issuing, and cycle counting of customer and/or *** inventory. They are responsible for maintaining a professional, clean and organized work environment.

Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities:
Unloads, receives and puts away incoming product, goods, tools and/or equipment; unpacks bales, crates, and other containers; checks for damage and for discrepancies between goods and invoices.
Accurately sorts, labels, moves and stores items; places material or items on racks, shelves, or in bins according to predetermined sequence such as size, style, or product codes; arranges storage to optimize crib space.
Issues product, goods, tools and/or equipment to site employees; documents and maintains accurate records for issued and returned items.
Enters data into a database or other computerized system to maintain up-to-date stock records; retrieves stored information to respond to inquiries (e.g., inventory levels or delivery schedules.); documents discrepancies on an error log and seeks management advice on appropriate corrective action.
Requests requisitions to replenish inventory.
Assists with inventory level maintenance; performs cycle counts and prepares report results.
Inspects and measures tools/equipment for defects, wear and tear and reports damage or wear to supervisors.
Prepares periodic inventory or maintains perpetual inventory of supplies and equipment.
Delivers tools or equipment to associate work locations.
Investigates and locates lost or misplaced equipment or safety supplies.
May repair, service and lubricate tools and equipment as required.
Performs other related duties as requested.

Job Qualifications:
3+ months relevant experience and/or training. High school diploma or equivalent preferred (not required).
Relevant experience and/or aptitude should include:
Loading, unloading, picking, packing or moving goods in a warehouse environment.
Demonstrated ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, work orders, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals.
Basic computer knowledge and proficiency and/or a demonstrated technical aptitude to learn; preferred technical skills to include but not limited to MS-Office products, Vista, Control, SX.e, Prophet 21.
Demonstration of basic mathematical skills (add, subtract, multiply and divide in all units to measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals); ability to compute rate*** ratio, and percent preferred.
Strong communication and customer service skills.
Ability to work in a team environment and be self-motivated to accomplish assigned tasks and goals.
Demonstration of attention to detail and is safety minded.

Work Environment & Physical Demands:
May be required to wear various forms of protective equipment (shoes, gloves, protective eyewear, etc.)
Assigned work shifts may vary and/or rotate.
Overtime may be required; extended day, evening and weekend work may be required as job duties demand and may include little to no advanced notice.
Must be able to handle and work physical inventory; required to lift up to 25 lbs or greater with assistance following standard operating and safety procedures. Other physical requirements including, regularly being required to stand, walk, kneel, bend, crouch, crawl, climb and balance.
Close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus are required.

job.description:
Customer Service Representative – Inside Sales

Position Overview

We are seeking a customer-focused and detail-oriented Customer Service Representative (Inside Sales) to provide exceptional customer service, technical product support, and sales assistance within an industrial distribution environment.

This position is responsible for responding to customer inquiries, preparing quotes, processing orders, sourcing products, and coordinating with customers and suppliers to ensure timely and accurate order fulfillment.

The ideal candidate will have strong communication, customer service, and organizational skills, along with experience in sales, order processing, and industrial products or supply chain operations.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Service & Sales Support

  • Respond to customer inquiries and provide accurate product information, pricing, and availability.

  • Prepare customer quotes and process incoming sales orders.

  • Deliver professional and responsive customer service to ensure customer satisfaction.

  • Proactively generate sales opportunities and promote company products and services.

  • Negotiate sales and purchase prices with customers and suppliers.

  • Build and maintain positive relationships with customers and business partners.

  • Troubleshoot customer concerns and provide timely, effective solutions.

Order Processing & Product Sourcing

  • Assist with customer returns and related order adjustments.

  • Support the preparation of products and materials for shipment.

  • Coordinate with warehouse and inventory personnel to ensure timely order fulfillment.

  • Support shipping and distribution activities as needed.

Administrative & Operational Support

  • Maintain accurate customer, product, and order information.

  • Communicate with customers, suppliers, and internal departments through email and other communication channels.

  • Utilize Microsoft Office applications to support daily sales and customer service activities.

  • Manage multiple customer requests, orders, and priorities simultaneously.

  • Maintain organized records and ensure timely follow-up on outstanding items.

Required Qualifications

Education

  • High school diploma or GED required.

Experience & Skills

  • Strong customer service and communication skills.

  • Previous industry or sales experience.

  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize competing deadlines.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

  • Reliable, focused, and able to work independently.

  • Moderate computer proficiency, including professional email communication.

  • Experience using Microsoft Office applications, particularly Microsoft Excel.

  • Ability to interact professionally with customers, suppliers, and internal teams.

  • Strong time management and problem-solving abilities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous inside sales or industrial distribution experience.

  • Knowledge of industrial products and related applications.

  • Familiarity with supply chain systems and processes.

  • Experience with product sourcing, order entry, and order fulfillment.

  • Experience preparing quotes, negotiating pricing, and managing customer orders.

  • Understanding of inventory management, shipping, and returns processes.

Technical Skills

  • Microsoft Excel

  • Order processing and tracking

Core Competencies

  • Customer service orientation

  • Sales and persuasion skills

  • Achievement orientation

  • Initiative and accountability

  • Time management

  • Sound judgment and decision-making

  • Multitasking and prioritization

  • Problem-solving and follow-through

job.title: Mechanical Techinician - (Equipment Installations)
job.description:
Position Summary
The Mechanical Technician IV supports engineering projects related to manufacturing capacity additions, line installations, equipment debug, and mechanical readiness for operations receivership. This role supports manufacturing engineering projects during development and execution to ensure timely, error-free mechanical support for multi-line equipment installations. The role also works closely with cross-functional internal and external teams, vendors and suppliers on a daily basis to resolve technical issues and protect project scope, timing, cost, and overall installation goals by providing and applying mechanical expertise.

Applicants must have strong technical knowledge in mechanical engineering, troubleshooting and design processes to proactively identify root causes, resolve technical issues, and implement robust, industrialized solutions that improve equipment and manufacturing performance.
 

Key Responsibilities

  • Maintain safe work practices, inform others of hazardous conditions or personal practices as expressed on project team
  • Manage installation and debugging activities to meet milestone & timeline objectives for successful capacity additions
  • Design & implement mechanical solutions and process changes to improve capability of manufacturing equipment.
  • Solve mechanical and process issues through data analysis, experience, and collaboration with subject matter experts
  • Manage spare part identification and storeroom entry as recommended by suppliers or peer engineers; noting available spares within (2)-plant footprint
  • Develop and update engineering and operations documentation
  • Support training for operations workforce regarding equipment or operations changes
  • Perform advanced troubleshooting, diagnosis, and repair of mechanical systems, equipment, and machinery (e.g., motors, pneumatics, etc.)
  • Align, test, and calibrate mechanical systems after installation
  • Diagnose complex mechanical failures and recommend effective solutions
  • Interpret blueprints, schematics, and technical manuals to support troubleshooting and repair activities
  • Identify opportunities to improve equipment reliability, efficiency, and safety
  • Collaborate with other departments to implement process improvements


Required Qualifications

  • Education:
    • Associates degree in relevant field (mechanical, technical, engineering)
  • Years/ Area of Experience:
    • At least 2+ years' experience in new equipment installations in a manufacturing environment; start-up experience a plus

Additional Certifications

  • Relevant mechanical or industrial certifications (e.g., millwright, or welding) are a plus

 Required Skills

  • Strong technical fundamentals and mechanical engineering/troubleshooting skills
  • Expertise in mechanical systems such as pneumatics, motors, and gear systems
  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, blueprints, and schematics
  • Ability to learn new technology and processes quickly
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, and critical-thinking skills
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize work on an independent basis in a fast-paced project install manufacturing environment
  • Proficiency with PC software, including Microsoft Office Suite
  • Proficiency in using hand tools, power tools, and diagnostic equipment
  • Knowledge of safety regulations and practices in an industrial setting

 Soft Skills

  • Ability to work and effectively collaborate within a team
  • Ability to allocate/supervise resources to accomplish aggressive project milestones and timeline within specification
  • Able to shift tasks quickly
  • Able to prioritize and multitask
  • Strong communication skills, both verbal and written
  • Detail oriented and able to perform with limited supervision

 Desired Skills

  • Project leadership/management experience
  • Experience in vendor/supplier management on-site/off-site
  • Experience with CAD

 Travel Requirements:

  • Project locations will range multiple locations within a small locale from Newton to Hickory, North Carolina.

 Hours of work/work schedule/flex-time

  • 40 hrs (overtime periodically expected). Due to the project timing; overtime and off-hours coverage may be necessary to successfully complete workload and keep in-line with project goals.

job.title: Head of Customer Success - Commercial Lending
job.description:
We're working with an established software company in the FinTech space that's looking for an experienced commercial banking professional to lead its Customer Success function, strengthen existing customer relationships, and drive long-term revenue growth. This is an opportunity for someone who understands how banks operate, knows how to build relationships with senior banking executives, and enjoys developing teams and processes that produce measurable business results.

The ideal candidate brings hands-on commercial lending experience along with strong commercial instincts and the ability to help financial institutions get more value from their technology investments.

This position reports directly to executive leadership and will play a meaningful role in shaping the company's customer engagement strategy.

What You'll Be Responsible For

Customer Retention & Revenue Growth

  • Lead efforts to retain existing customers, improve renewal performance, and increase recurring revenue.
  • Develop proactive account renewal strategies that identify potential risks well before contracts expire.
  • Create structured success plans and relationship strategies for important customer accounts.
  • Establish customer health measurements to recognize accounts needing attention and uncover opportunities for growth.
  • Strengthen relationships with senior banking decision-makers to support customer satisfaction and long-term retention.
  • Collaborate with operational and commercial teams to identify additional products or services that benefit existing customers.

Strategic Account Management

  • Serve as a senior relationship leader for key financial institution customers.
  • Establish trusted partnerships with commercial lending executives, credit administrators, banking operations leaders, and other senior stakeholders.
  • Conduct Executive Business Reviews (EBRs) that highlight customer results, technology adoption, business priorities, and future opportunities.
  • Build detailed account strategies that outline decision-makers, upcoming renewals, business challenges, competitive considerations, and opportunities for expansion.
  • Develop strong customer advocates who are willing to provide references and support long-term partnerships.

Customer Success Operations

  • Design and improve the processes, structure, and operating standards of the Customer Success organization.
  • Organize customer accounts into appropriate service levels based on their needs, size, and growth potential.
  • Define performance indicators, reporting dashboards, and management routines that create visibility into customer relationships.
  • Introduce consistent approaches to account reviews, customer communication, contract renewals, and relationship planning.
  • Improve forecasting for renewals, account growth, and customer retention.
  • Provide executive leadership with reliable insight into customer performance, risks, and future revenue opportunities.
  • Establish clear procedures for handling customer escalations and coordinating internal responses.

Customer Onboarding, Adoption & Long-Term Value

  • Partner with software implementation and delivery teams to support successful customer launches.
  • Help customers understand and effectively use the software to improve their banking operations.
  • Develop ways to track platform usage, engagement, business results, and readiness for additional solutions.
  • Coordinate with implementation, technical support, and account management teams to create a consistent customer experience throughout the relationship.

Customer Feedback & Product Collaboration

  • Maintain an understanding of customer challenges, evolving banking needs, and industry developments.
  • Work closely with Product and Engineering teams to communicate feedback from financial institution customers.
  • Advocate for product improvements that simplify commercial lending processes and improve customer outcomes.
  • Help guide software priorities using insights gathered through customer relationships and market demand.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Build, mentor, and lead Customer Success and Account Management professionals as the organization grows.
  • Establish measurable expectations and development plans that support individual and team performance.
  • Create scalable processes and team structures that can accommodate additional customers without sacrificing service quality.
  • Encourage strong collaboration and a customer-focused mindset across the business.


What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of professional experience in commercial banking or lending, including direct experience in positions such as Commercial Lender, Relationship Manager, Credit Officer, Portfolio Manager, Chief Lending Officer, Credit Administrator, or similar commercial banking roles.
  • Strong knowledge of the commercial lending lifecycle, including loan origination, underwriting, credit analysis, approval processes, portfolio oversight, covenant monitoring, and servicing.
  • Experience establishing relationships with senior financial institution stakeholders, including commercial banking executives, credit leaders, and C-suite decision-makers.
  • Proven ability to manage important customer relationships, retain business, and identify opportunities for account growth.
  • Demonstrated experience leading teams, implementing performance measurements, and building consistent operating processes.
  • Strong understanding of how customer relationships contribute to recurring revenue, profitability, and business growth.
  • Excellent communication and relationship management skills, including confidence presenting and advising at the executive level.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with a financial technology company, commercial lending software provider, banking technology organization, or consulting firm serving financial institutions.
  • Leadership experience in Customer Success, Strategic Account Management, Relationship Management, or Client Services.
  • Experience managing customer renewals, revenue retention, expansion opportunities, or subscription-based business relationships.
  • Familiarity with Gross Revenue Retention (GRR), Net Revenue Retention (NRR), and Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR).
  • Experience developing customer engagement programs, account review processes, renewal forecasts, or customer health scoring.
  • Understanding of Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) business models and subscription revenue structures.
  • Previous responsibility for strategic executive customer relationships and business review programs.

job.description:
Basic Function

Discuss inspection results with those responsible for products, discard or reject products not meeting specifications, inspect, test assembled parts or products for defects and deviations from internal or customer specifications. A keen attention to detail is central to the job. Ability to communicate clearly and effectively when reporting issues and defects is a must. Position requires knowledge of good manufacturing practices, precision measurement instruments, basic PC skills, literacy, and general mathematical skills.

Essential Duties

  1. Accurately perform visual inspection on all product assemblies for workmanship, cosmetic acceptability, cleanliness, etc.
  2. Train on other operations within area as necessary.
  3. Read and comprehend documentation relating to phases of production area: customer supplied blueprints, parts lists, and rework instructions.
  4. Record all inspection results onto an inspection report as required. Keep accurate and detailed records.
  5. Understand all production processes which relate to inspection; can use quick judgment and discretion in determining acceptable standards.
  6. Report any errors or major discrepancies to the Team Leader immediately so immediate corrective action may be taken.
  7. Accept responsibility for quality aspects of the job and actively participating in quality efforts.
  8. Responsible for compliance to Fulton's Quality Management System and other regulatory and statutory requirements as required by the customer.
  9. High level of attention to detail, focus, and accuracy while under tight deadlines.
  10. Good communication and team player skills to interface with various internal groups.
  11. Train other Microscope Inspectors as necessary.
  12. Maintain accurate documentation as required.

  14. Must understand, and abide by all plant rules and safety rules and regulations.
  15. Actively participate in continuous improvement activities and the total quality management process.
  16. Successfully pass all required job specific training per the departmental training matrix.
  17. Support all company goals and objectives.
  18. Other duties as assigned.

Tools / Equipment Used

  1. Precision measuring instruments as required
  2. PC
  3. Hand tools and calipers
  4. Microscope majority of shift

Education Required

High School Diploma or GED

Experience Required
