job.title: Industrial Maintenance Technician
job.description:
Maintenance Technician

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Maintenance Technician to support the ongoing operation and reliability of manufacturing equipment, facility systems, and utilities within a pharmaceutical manufacturing environment. This position will be responsible for performing preventative and corrective maintenance, troubleshooting equipment issues, and supporting equipment installations and facility improvement projects.

The ideal candidate is mechanically strong, comfortable troubleshooting independently, and able to work safely within a highly regulated cGMP manufacturing environment. This role requires someone who can identify the root cause of equipment problems, make effective repairs, and clearly document maintenance activities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform preventative, predictive, and corrective maintenance on production, facility, and utility equipment.
  • Troubleshoot mechanical and electromechanical equipment to identify the cause of equipment failures and determine appropriate repairs.
  • Maintain manufacturing equipment used in the production of pharmaceutical products, including pumps, agitators, mechanical seals, gaskets, compression equipment, encapsulation machinery, compactors, coating equipment, and related systems.
  • Maintain and troubleshoot facility and utility systems, including HVAC, compressed air, dust collection, refrigeration, boilers, electrical systems, purified water/RO systems, and other supporting utilities.
  • Read and interpret equipment manuals, mechanical drawings, layouts, specifications, and electrical/wiring diagrams.
  • Use precision measuring equipment such as calipers, micrometers, levels, and other diagnostic tools to evaluate equipment and components.
  • Make equipment adjustments, alignments, repairs, and component replacements using appropriate hand and power tools.
  • Fabricate or modify replacement components when necessary using machine shop equipment.
  • Assist with the installation, startup, modification, and maintenance of new equipment and facility systems.
  • Maintain accurate records of maintenance activities, equipment conditions, repairs, and follow-up requirements.
  • Provide technical information to assist with identifying and ordering replacement parts and maintaining appropriate spare-parts inventory.
  • Communicate equipment issues, maintenance needs, and ongoing work clearly with team members and other departments.
  • Respond promptly to maintenance requests while maintaining a strong focus on production needs and internal customer service.
  • Follow established SOPs, manufacturer recommendations, maintenance procedures, and cGMP requirements.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.
  • Follow all site safety policies and procedures, including proper lockout/tagout practices.
  • Perform confined-space work when required and in accordance with applicable safety procedures.
  • Complete assigned maintenance work safely, accurately, and efficiently with minimal supervision.

Qualifications

  • Previous maintenance experience in a pharmaceutical, biotech, food, chemical, or other highly regulated manufacturing environment preferred.
  • Strong mechanical troubleshooting and repair skills.
  • Experience maintaining pumps, seals, gaskets, agitators, production machinery, and other industrial equipment.
  • Working knowledge of facility and utility systems such as HVAC, compressed air, dust collection, boilers, refrigeration, and water purification systems.
  • Ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings, equipment layouts, wiring diagrams, and technical specifications.
  • Experience using precision measuring tools and common maintenance equipment.
  • Familiarity with Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures.
  • Confined-space training or experience is preferred.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize maintenance needs, and resolve equipment problems with limited supervision.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to accurately document work performed and communicate equipment conditions and outstanding issues.
  • Commitment to following safety procedures, quality standards, and established maintenance practices.

What We're Looking For

The successful candidate will be a hands-on maintenance professional who enjoys troubleshooting problems and keeping equipment operating reliably. You should be comfortable working independently, but also able to communicate effectively with production, engineering, and other maintenance team members.

Experience in a regulated manufacturing environment is highly valued, particularly for candidates who understand the importance of documentation, safety, preventive maintenance, and cGMP compliance.

COM067

job.title: Logistics Support Coordinator
job.description:
Logistics:
Shipping and pulling jobs primarily but may be needed to do some cycle counting as well.

Stock Room:
-Team members have a scanner, a laptop and a cart. There is a board that shows all of the jobs to be picked. The grab the info for the job that needs to be picked, print the paperwork (Pick List) and then go and pull all of the components for the job and place them on a cart. A Pick List can have anywhere from 50 components to 150 components.

Receiving:
-Team Members here sign for deliveries, boxes received are placed on carts. The person here logs the receipts into our system, enters the location they will go into the stock room (via computer) and then goes and places the parts in the appropriate location on the shelves in the stock room.

Shipping:
-Team members are responsible for packing product via customer requirements then use FedEX, UPS, etc to create labels to ship. Some of our customers have portals that authorizations need to be approved. Someone who has shipping internationally (export compliance) would be a plus. We are not looking for someone who has only called freight carriers to pick up pallets (freight) – this is very different from that.

Split Shift Hours: 11:30 am – 8:00 pm
Position requires High School Diploma or GED.
$1,000 Signing Bonus paid as follows: $250 at 30 days, $750 at 6 months

Position Summary
With guidance in a team environment, responsible for Stock Room functions including maintaining a cycle-counting program that validates our inventory counts for accounting and production purposes. Position is also required to perform a variety of product support duties of basic and/or moderate scope while following and assisting in the development of procedures and processes in one or more of the following functions per B00284 (Logistics
– Receiving, Stockroom and Shipping): stockroom, raw stock, parts identification, shipping, receiving, stockroom, clean operations, etc. Initial primary focus is the Stockroom with support in Shipping. Eventually cross training will occur to cover all Logistics positions.
Shipping
· Prepare parts and/or materials to assure safe handling for shipment including the completion of the necessary paperwork and shipping records.
· Prepare packaging per specifications for shipment including computer input for necessary labels, forms and shipping records.
· Interpret shipping instructions as referenced on company documents or customer specifications or standards related to preservation and packing.
· Prepare stencils and mark shipments in a legible manner.
· Prepare air bills, bills of lading and sales order forms for the carrier and company records.
· Contact carriers for dispatching shipments, establishing rates or tracing follow-up information.
Stockroom and Cycle Counting
· Maintain a cycle counting program by counting inventory
· Reconciling inventory counts within our electronic system
· Identify and resolve all inventory issues
· Receive material, check and identify parts by type or part number
· Prepare parts for storage and place stock in proper location as directed.
· Select parts from stock to fill orders according to parts lists.
· Perform cycle inventory count.
· Maintain, update and access necessary records utilizing a computer.
· Responsible for releasing requisitions, editing requisitions, filling shortages and deleting requisitions.
Receiving
· Receive shipments at receiving dock and forward materials to the appropriate team.
· Weigh or count incoming/outbound parts or materials.
· Perform data input to update system records and verify all documents for completeness and accuracy.
Raw Stock
· Receive incoming raw stock and verify material against documentation for identification and accuracy of quantity.
· Load and unload trucks and move raw material to the proper location.
· Identify and code raw materials and operate saw to cut stock to dimensional specifications.
· Perform minor repair of equipment.
· Report critical shortages and/or problems to appropriate organizations.
· Issue jobs per schedule and update shop floor, MRP and other systems.
Parts Identification

· Client out exact dimensions and locations on the parts for identification markings.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Must possess a High School Diploma or equivalent
  • Minimum of one year related product support experience and demonstrated ability to perform described position responsibilities.

  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include the ability to favorably pass a visual acuity exam (which includes far vision, near vision and color perception)
  • May require forklift operator certificate.
  • Good level of knowledge and experience with computers including software packages and mainframe systems.
  • Must demonstrate manual dexterity.
  • Ability to perform basic mathematical calculations.
  • Ability to read and understand related forms and specifications.
  • May be required to lift up to 50 lbs.
  • Must demonstrate effective verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with others and be a participative team player.

AMI Operator – 2nd Shift

Nesco Resource is currently hiring an AMI Operator for our client in New Baltimore, MI. This is a 2nd shift, contract-to-hire opportunity with the potential for long-term employment.

Position Details

  • Shift: Monday–Friday, 3:00 PM–11:00 PM
  • Pay Rate: $18.00/hour + $0.75/hour shift premium
  • Overtime: Available based on production needs
  • Location: New Baltimore, MI
  • Job Type: Contract-to-Hire

Key Responsibilities

  • Load and unload hoppers as needed.
  • Sort rejected parts and perform retesting.
  • Weigh and seal boxes for shipment.
  • Handle materials and pull material for machine changeovers.
  • Perform final audits and initiate work instructions.
  • Ensure changeovers are completed accurately and efficiently.
  • Complete dock audit sign-offs.
  • Enter and maintain work orders.
  • Verify test parts and inspect poke-yokes.
  • Follow the production build schedule provided by the Materials department.
  • Perform minor repairs and machine adjustments as needed.
  • Maintain process books, log sheets, and One Point Lessons.
  • Enter production and quality data into the computer system throughout the shift.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Reliable and predictable attendance.
  • Strong professional and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to communicate respectfully and professionally with coworkers, customers, vendors, and visitors.
  • Ability to work independently while effectively managing multiple tasks.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Basic to proficient computer skills; experience with Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Excel, and PowerPoint, is preferred.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to read and follow work instructions and production schedules.

Education & Experience

  • High school diploma or equivalent experience preferred.
  • Ability to use basic measuring devices.
  • Previous manufacturing or automotive experience is a plus.
  • Computer literacy preferred.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods.
  • Frequent bending, reaching, and repetitive movements.
  • Ability to lift and carry up to 40 pounds.
  • Frequent use of hands, wrists, fingers, and legs.
  • Ability to perform repetitive manual tasks requiring hand-eye coordination.
  • Clear verbal communication.
  • Ability to distinguish basic colors and demonstrate depth perception.

Working Environment

  • Work is performed indoors in an automotive components manufacturing environment.
  • May be exposed to varying temperatures, fumes, chemicals, grease, and oils.
  • Exposure to machinery with moving parts.
  • Noise levels may consistently exceed 85 dB and may include vibration.
  • May occasionally work with hands in water or work independently.
  • Overtime may be required based on production demands.

Required PPE

  • Safety glasses/eye protection
  • Hearing protection
  • Safety shoes
  • Gloves and hard hat as required

job.title: CNC Machinist
job.description:
CNC Machinist

Brodhead, KY | Right-to-Hire | Full-Time

Precision. Skill. Opportunity.

Are you mechanically inclined and enjoy working with precision equipment? Do you take pride in producing quality parts and working with tight tolerances? If you're looking for a company where you can showcase your skills and earn a permanent position, this could be the opportunity you've been waiting for!

We're seeking a CNC Machinist to join a growing manufacturing team in Brodhead, KY. This is a Right-to-Hire position, offering the chance to prove your skills and become a permanent member of the team.

What You'll Do:

Set up and operate CNC machinery to cut, shape, and form metal components to precise specifications.

Perform machine shop operations using mills, lathes, grinders, jig borers, shapers, and other machining equipment.

Install and secure tooling, fixtures, cutting tools, and workpieces.

Adjust machine controls, speeds, feeds, coolant flow, and cutting depths.

Read and interpret blueprints and engineering drawings.

Inspect finished parts using micrometers, calipers, gauges, and other precision measuring equipment.

Document inspection results and ensure products meet quality standards.

Identify and report material defects or machine concerns.

Maintain a clean, organized, and safety-focused work environment.

What We're Looking For:

Mechanical aptitude and a willingness to learn

Experience using micrometers, calipers, and other precision measuring tools

Ability to read and understand blueprints

Strong math and problem-solving skills

Excellent attention to detail and commitment to quality

Dependable attendance and a positive attitude

Why You'll Love This Opportunity:

Right-to-Hire position with long-term career potential

Opportunity to grow your CNC machining skills

Clean, team-oriented manufacturing environment

Work with precision equipment and modern machining technology

Join a company that values quality, safety, and continuous improvement

Ready to Build Your Future?

If you're looking for more than just a job and want the opportunity to grow into a long-term career with a respected manufacturer, we want to hear from you!

Apply today and take the next step in your machining career!

job.title: Environmental Health & Safety Specialist
job.description:
Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) Specialist

Position Summary

Nesco Resource is seeking an Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) Specialist to support manufacturing operations by promoting a safe workplace, minimizing operational risks, and ensuring compliance with environmental and safety regulations. This individual will partner with site leadership, operations teams, and EHS professionals to strengthen safety practices, investigate incidents, and implement continuous improvement initiatives.

The EHS Specialist will provide technical guidance, support the development and implementation of safety programs, and help ensure compliance with applicable local, state, and federal regulations, as well as company policies and standards. Success in this role requires strong communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to collaborate with employees and leaders across multiple locations and departments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with operations leadership and other stakeholders to identify workplace hazards, evaluate risks, and implement effective risk-reduction strategies.
  • Assist managers with incident investigations, root cause analysis, and the development and follow-up of corrective and preventive actions.
  • Analyze workplace incidents, accidents, and operational failures to identify trends, determine contributing factors, and recommend solutions.
  • Ensure incidents and reportable events are documented and submitted to the appropriate regulatory agencies in accordance with applicable requirements.
  • Conduct and coordinate EHS inspections at manufacturing facilities, document findings, and work with responsible parties to resolve identified concerns.
  • Support the use and maintenance of the company's incident management system, including VelocityEHS.
  • Review EHS data and performance trends to help leadership make informed decisions regarding workplace safety and operational practices.
  • Assist with workers' compensation claims, return-to-work planning, and restricted-duty arrangements in collaboration with appropriate internal stakeholders.
  • Support site Safety Committees and encourage employee engagement in workplace safety initiatives.
  • Participate in new employee orientation, safety training, qualification tracking, and related onboarding activities.
  • Work with Production, Maintenance, and EHS personnel to ensure environmental reporting is completed accurately and on schedule.
  • Coordinate with internal teams and external agencies on environmental compliance reporting, permitting, and related requirements.
  • Maintain Safety Data Sheets (SDS), review new chemicals before they are introduced into the workplace, and coordinate appropriate employee communication and protective measures.
  • Prepare routine EHS reports and maintain accurate records and documentation.
  • Perform additional related duties as assigned.
  • Travel between regional company locations as needed to support business and compliance requirements.

Qualifications and Experience

  • At least three years of experience in an Environmental, Health & Safety role, or an equivalent combination of education, training, experience, and certifications.
  • Experience with environmental compliance reporting and regulatory requirements.
  • Knowledge of incident investigation and root cause analysis methods, such as 5 Whys, Fishbone diagrams, TapRooT, FMEA, or Fault Tree Analysis.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with employees, management, contractors, and external organizations.
  • Ability to coach and mentor leaders and employees, encourage thorough incident investigations, and promote accountability and continuous improvement.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, including the ability to manage multiple priorities and maintain accurate documentation.
  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to completing work accurately and on time.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
  • Ability to handle confidential employee and medical-related information with professionalism and discretion.
  • Ability to influence decisions and encourage compliance without relying on direct supervisory authority.
  • Familiarity with OSHA recordkeeping requirements and basic medical terminology is preferred.

Education and Certifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Occupational Health and Safety, Environmental Science, or a related discipline preferred.
  • Relevant professional certifications, such as Certified Safety Professional (CSP), Construction Health and Safety Technician (CHST), or other recognized EHS credentials, are preferred.

Additional Requirements

  • Willingness to participate in company-sponsored continuing education as needed.
  • Ability to travel approximately 25–50% between regional company locations, depending on business needs.

COM067

job.title: Litigation Paralegal - Hybrid Work Schedule
job.description:
Litigation Paralegal – Jacksonville, FL

Direct Hire | Hybrid Schedule – 3 Days in Office / 2 Days Remote

Nesco Resource is recruiting an experienced Litigation Paralegal for one of our established law firm clients in Jacksonville, FL. This is a direct hire opportunity offering a hybrid work schedule, with three days in the office and two days working from home.

Our client is seeking a proactive, highly organized Litigation Paralegal to support attorneys across a variety of litigation matters. The ideal candidate will have a strong background working in a litigation law firm, excellent organizational and calendaring skills, and the ability to manage a large caseload in a fast-paced environment.

Candidates should have a working knowledge of federal and state court rules, procedures, and electronic filing systems, along with experience conducting legal research using LexisNexis and/or Westlaw.

Key Responsibilities

  • Draft routine court documents, including Notices of Appearance, Pro Hac Vice Motions, Notices of Motion, Subpoenas, Stipulations, and other legal filings.

  • Prepare and compile legal documents, discovery responses, affidavits, and supporting materials for attorney review.

  • Request, subpoena, and coordinate with record vendors to obtain medical treatment and educational records.

  • Prepare exhibits and demonstrative evidence for hearings, depositions, and trials.

  • Conduct legal research using LexisNexis, Westlaw, and public access websites to support litigation defense strategies.

  • Organize, analyze, summarize, and index medical records, educational records, and other case-related documents.

  • Assist attorneys with witness preparation for depositions and trials.

  • Review documents for relevance and privilege in preparation for disclosure.

  • Analyze and categorize reports, discovery responses, and other case materials.

  • Maintain accurate case files, deadlines, scheduling, and court calendars.

  • Capture and record billable time in accordance with firm policies and procedures.

Qualifications

  • 4+ years of relevant litigation paralegal experience, preferably within a law firm.

  • Strong organizational, communication, scheduling, and follow-up skills.

  • Experience managing multiple attorneys, competing deadlines, and document-intensive cases.

  • Knowledge of federal and state court procedures and electronic filing systems.

  • Proficiency in LexisNexis and/or Westlaw, Microsoft Word, Excel, and KOFAX Professional.

  • Experience preparing medical chronologies and billing indexes preferred.

  • Bachelor's degree and/or Paralegal Certificate.

  • Ability to work independently while maintaining a collaborative, team-oriented approach.

  • Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and professionalism.

Schedule & Work Arrangement

  • Employment Type: Direct Hire

  • Location: Jacksonville, FL

  • Hybrid Schedule: 3 days in office / 2 days remote

  • Hours: Monday–Friday, 8:30 AM–5:30 PM, including a one-hour lunch

  • Overtime: Flexibility to work additional hours when needed

About the Opportunity

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Litigation Paralegal who enjoys working on a variety of cases, supporting multiple attorneys, and taking ownership of their work. Our client values individuals who are dependable, detail-oriented, quick learners, and committed to producing high-quality work.

Interested candidates are encouraged to apply through Nesco Resource to learn more about this opportunity.

job.title: Software QA Automation Engineer - (Aerospace)
job.description:
Overview
Client is seeking a motivated Software Quality Assurance Engineer to support all phases of the software quality assurance process. This role is responsible for designing, executing, and documenting testing activities while helping ensure the delivery of high-quality, reliable custom applications for internal and external partners.
Working in a collaborative environment, you will partner with developers, systems engineers, and stakeholders to validate software functionality, develop automated testing solutions, troubleshoot issues, and continuously improve testing processes and product quality.

Core Responsibilities
• Design, execute, and document functional, integration, regression, system, and performance testing activities.
• Define and maintain test strategies, test plans, test cases, and automation frameworks aligned with program requirements and industry standards.
• Develop, maintain, and support automated test suites, testing tools, and CI/CD pipelines.
• Write and validate user story acceptance criteria and verify delivered features meet business and functional requirements prior to sign-off.
• Document test results, defect investigations, root cause analyses, and testing metrics with clear, traceable reporting.
• Debug and troubleshoot software issues, reproduce defects in test environments, and collaborate with developers to resolve problems.
• Identify gaps in test coverage and process inefficiencies, recommending and implementing continuous improvement initiatives.
• Collaborate with developers, hardware engineers, mission planners, and stakeholders during design reviews, sprint ceremonies, risk assessments, and other project activities.
• Assist with onboarding and mentoring junior QA team members.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies
• Experience performing functional, integration, regression, system, and performance testing.
• Experience developing and maintaining automated testing tools, frameworks, and test suites.
• Ability to write, validate, and verify user story acceptance criteria.
• Experience documenting test cases, execution results, defects, investigations, and quality metrics.
• Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and defect analysis skills.
• Experience working collaboratively with cross-functional technical teams and stakeholders.
• Ability to support continuous improvement efforts related to testing processes, tooling, and software quality.

Work Details
• Opportunity for full-time employment conversion.
• Work schedule: 5/40, 1st Shift.
• Worksite classification: Worker will telework less than 50% of the time.
• Security clearance: Ability to obtain clearance required.
• Role requires access to ECI information.
• Overtime status: Exempt.

job.description:
Inside Sales Manager

Location: Schenectady, NY
Salary: $100,000–$110,000, plus bonus potential
Schedule: Monday–Friday | Primarily onsite
Employment Type: Direct Hire

Are you a hands-on leader who enjoys developing people, improving processes, and finding better ways to serve customers? We’re partnering with an established global manufacturing organization to identify an Inside Sales Manager to lead a local team and help drive the next stage of its operational growth.

This is an opportunity for someone who can balance customer service and daily operations with team development and continuous improvement. You’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on how the team works, collaborates across departments, and supports customers.

  • Oversee daily customer service and inside sales operations, ensuring timely and effective resolution of customer needs.

  • Demonstrated ability to coach employees, establish accountability, and address performance challenges.
  • A proactive, hands-on approach to problem-solving and continuous improvement.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • The ability to balance a supportive leadership style with the confidence to challenge existing processes and drive change.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
  • Experience with SAP, ERP systems, or system implementation projects is a plus.
  • A bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, or a related field is preferred.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive base salary of $100,000–$110,000.

job.title: Assembler 2nd Shift
job.description:
Shift Details

2nd Shift, 2:15pm - 12:45am, Monday to Thursday (10-hour shifts). Possible overtime on Saturdays from 2:15pm to 12:45am. The candidate will train on 1st Shift from 6:00am to 2:30pm.

Requirements

  • Electrical wiring background.
  • Able to lift up to 35 lbs. continuously.

Job Responsibilities

  • Obtain work order from your lead person.
  • Check the bill of material for description, quantity, and parts needed to build the product.
  • Read the routing carefully and report labor against the proper sequence.
  • Review the work order for any special instructions. If unclear, ask your lead person or supervisor for clarification.
  • Request a production assembly drawing from your lead person, supervisor, or inspector when required.
  • Inspect all parts as they are being used.
  • Inspect flanges (the joint between the body and cover) 100% with a .0015 feeler gauge. The gauge can go no deeper than 1/8 max.
  • Check for porosity, torn threads, bad paint, missing features, etc., per instructions from your routings, drawings, lead person, or supervisor.
  • Lubricate all indicated threaded areas.
  • Remove nonconforming or questionable material to designated areas until a determination can be made.
  • Communicate any problems with the assembly (e.g., bad parts, equipment, fixtures, tools, drawings, or unclear work instructions) to your lead person, supervisor, or inspector for corrective action.
  • Clear your work area and put all consumable parts in their place after completing each work order.
  • Return special tools, equipment, and drawings to where they belong.
  • Use downtime constructively: fill your bins with consumable parts, clean your area, and be prepared for your next work order or instructions.

job.title: Facilities Technician
job.description:
Facilities Technician / Industrial Maintenance Technician

Compensation: $54,000–$66,500 annually, based on experience + 5% bonus
Schedule: Typically 7:00 AM–3:00 PM or 8:00 AM–4:00 PM; overtime as needed
Environment: Manufacturing / aerospace / MRO production environment

What They Will Do

The Facilities Technician will maintain, troubleshoot, repair, and improve production machinery, plant utilities, and facility equipment. This is a highly hands-on position requiring strong experience across mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic, electrical, and electronic systems.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Perform preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance on manufacturing equipment.
  • Troubleshoot and repair mills, lathes, compressors, hydraulic systems, pumps, motors, sensors, control panels, and electrical/electronic equipment.
  • Read and interpret electrical schematics, advanced wiring diagrams, P&IDs, blueprints, and mechanical drawings.
  • Use diagnostic equipment including:
    • Multimeters
    • Oscilloscopes
    • Ammeters
    • Handheld voltage meters
  • Diagnose electrical problems such as blown fuses, faulty safety switches, voltage drops, sensors, and control issues.
  • Install, troubleshoot, repair, and maintain hydraulic and pneumatic systems.
  • Work on hydraulic pumps, motors, valves, cylinders, and related components.
  • Troubleshoot electronic proportional valves and motion-control systems.
  • Maintain plant utilities including air compressors, air dryers, HVAC, plumbing, water, vacuum, gas, and alarm systems.
  • Establish PM requirements for new equipment and maintain accurate maintenance records.
  • Train production operators on basic autonomous maintenance, cleaning, inspections, fluid checks, and daily equipment care.
  • Participate in 5S, continuous improvement, and high-performance team initiatives.
  • Follow OSHA and plant safety requirements, including identifying and reporting unsafe conditions.
  • Document repairs, PMs, work orders, labor, parts, and equipment issues.
  • Support cross-functional maintenance and improvement projects.

Ideal Candidate

Look for someone with:

  • 5+ years of industrial/manufacturing maintenance experience
  • Strong mechanical + electrical + hydraulic troubleshooting
  • Experience maintaining heavy manufacturing equipment
  • Ability to read electrical schematics and P&IDs
  • Experience using a multimeter
  • Ideally hands-on experience with oscilloscopes and ammeters
  • Hydraulic pump/motor repair experience
  • Pneumatic systems experience
  • Experience with PLC/sensors/electronic controls is a plus
  • Preventive/predictive maintenance experience
  • OSHA/safety knowledge
  • Technical school, vocational degree, or equivalent experience

Good Target Titles

I would search for candidates with titles such as:

  • Industrial Maintenance Technician
  • Maintenance Technician
  • Maintenance Mechanic
  • Industrial Maintenance Mechanic
  • Manufacturing Maintenance Technician
  • Electrical Maintenance Technician
  • Mechanical Maintenance Technician
  • Electro-Mechanical Technician
  • Maintenance Engineer Technician
  • Facilities Maintenance Technician
  • Equipment Maintenance Technician
  • Machinery Maintenance Technician
  • Millwright
  • Maintenance Specialist
  • Industrial Maintenance Specialist

Important: Don't over-index on the word Facilities. A candidate with a strong industrial maintenance background may be a much better fit than someone who primarily maintains buildings/HVAC.

Competitive Compensation
Participation in Annual Incentive Program

Parker offers competitive benefit programs, including:
  • Comprehensive coverage for medical, prescription drugs, dental, vision, voluntary optional life, accident insurance, hospital indemnity insurance and critical illness insurance with competitive premium cost
  • 401(k) Plan with company matching contributions at 100% of the first 5% of pay
  • Company provided defined-contribution retirement plan with annual contribution equal to 3% of pay

    Career development and tuition reimbursement
  • Other benefits including paid parental leave, short and long-term disability programs, adoption assistance, a Care.com membership and financial planning assistance are provided at no cost to you.
  • Supplemental benefit programs including identity protection, legal protection, and pet wellness are available at competitive rates.
  • Paid Time Off and 13 Company-Paid Holidays

job.title: Network Administrator
job.description:
Overview
Client is seeking a Network Administrator to support and maintain enterprise network infrastructure in wired and wireless environments. This role is responsible for configuring, administering, troubleshooting, and optimizing network resources, connectivity services, and supporting technologies across the organization.
The Network Administrator will work with network switches, routers, firewalls, VPN technologies, wireless systems, servers, and VoIP environments while providing technical support, maintaining documentation, and ensuring reliable network operations.

Core Responsibilities
• Maintain network resources including network switches, access points, server hardware, PBX/VoIP systems, operating systems, applications, and services in wired and wireless environments.
• Configure, maintain, and support network components including routers, switches, connectivity services, and access services.
• Perform advanced and custom configuration of network devices, including firewalls and VPN concentrators.
• Reconfigure network equipment as necessary to accommodate environmental and operational changes.
• Troubleshoot and diagnose complex network issues, implement corrective actions, and escalate broader network concerns when appropriate.
• Maintain wireless authentication tools and serve as a primary support contact for campus network users.
• Administer servers in both physical and virtual environments.
• Utilize monitoring tools to analyze network traffic, maintain uptime, identify trends, address outages, and generate operational reporting.
• Create and maintain network documentation, system diagrams, and asset records.
• Support Cisco and VoIP telecommunications environments, including adds, moves, changes, and platform maintenance.
• Provide technical support to network users and help desk personnel, including user setup, access, and network environment configuration.
• Install and test software and hardware in accordance with established standards and change management processes.
• Provide support and access coordination for network replacement vendors as needed.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies
• Associate's degree or equivalent from a technical school, Bachelors Degree preferred, Higher Education background and knowledge with 4-7 years of related experience and/or training.
Strong experience configuring and troubleshooting Cisco IOS networking devices, including switching and related network infrastructure.
• Experience configuring and supporting Fortigate firewalls in a collapsed core network design.
• Demonstrated experience with Aruba ClearPass environments and Aruba wireless controllers.
• Working knowledge of Microsoft Server operating systems, Microsoft Active Directory Domain Services, DNS, and DHCP.
• Experience with network administration including security, backup, recovery, and capacity planning.
• Broad-based, hands-on experience implementing and supporting network switches and routers.
• Practical experience administering Cisco phone systems and VoIP environments.
• Working knowledge of Linux and Windows Server operating systems.
• Familiarity with network monitoring platforms such as SolarWinds.
• Excellent time management, planning, organizational, interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
• Ability to work effectively with end users, identify technical and operational requirements, and develop practical technical solutions.
• Ability to manage scope and customer expectations on assigned work.
• Ability to define problems, gather data, analyze information, and develop valid conclusions.
• Ability to interpret technical documentation, diagrams, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
• Willingness to work collaboratively with systems, operations, and administrative teams.
• Must participate in an on-call rotation.

Preferred Skills or Experience
• Cisco IOS (CCNA) certification.
• Additional relevant professional certifications.

Work Details
• May occasionally work outside normal business hours for emergency support or installation activities.
• Offsetting time and overtime opportunities are available.

job.title: NDT Technician II
job.description:
RPO Direct Hire

Full-time day shift in an hourly position - 7am - 4:00pm
Must be UT and FPI certified.

Position Summary
The Level II Nondestructive Testing (NDT) Technician is responsible for performing and interpreting Fluorescent Penetrant Inspection (FPI) and Ultrasonic Testing (UT) on aerospace components and assemblies in accordance with applicable customer, industry, and company specifications. The technician will independently conduct inspections, evaluate results, document findings, and ensure product compliance while maintaining a safe and efficient work environment.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities
Perform Level II Fluorescent Penetrant Inspection (FPI) on aerospace components and hardware in accordance with approved procedures and specifications.
Perform Level II Ultrasonic Testing (UT) inspections, including setup, calibration, testing, and evaluation of inspection results.
Interpret and evaluate inspection indications in accordance with acceptance and rejection criteria.
Prepare and maintain inspection reports, records, certifications, and related documentation.
Verify equipment calibration and perform daily system performance checks.
Ensure compliance with NAS410, customer specifications, and company procedures.
Review work instructions, blueprints, engineering drawings, and technical specifications.
Identify and segregate nonconforming material and initiate required documentation.
Support internal, customer, and regulatory audits as required.
Assist with the training and mentoring of Level I technicians and trainees.
Maintain cleanliness and organization of NDT equipment and work areas.
Follow all safety, environmental, and quality requirements.

Required Qualifications
Current or previously certified Level II in FPI and UT in accordance with NAS410, SNT-TC-1A, or equivalent employer-based certification program.
High school diploma or GED required.
Minimum of 3 years of NDT inspection experience, preferably in aerospace manufacturing.
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and process instructions.
Working knowledge of NDT standards, procedures, and quality system requirements.
Strong attention to detail and documentation accuracy.
Basic computer skills, including Microsoft Office and inspection reporting systems.

Preferred Qualifications
Aerospace manufacturing experience.
Additional NDT certifications (MT, ET, RT, VT, etc.).
Experience with customer specifications from major aerospace OEMs.
Familiarity with NADCAP requirements and audits.
Physical Requirements
Ability to stand, walk, bend, and lift up to 35 pounds throughout the shift.
Ability to distinguish colors and contrast as required for FPI evaluations.
Visual acuity sufficient to perform inspections and interpret indications.
Ability to work in manufacturing and laboratory environments.
Ability to wear required personal protective equipment (PPE).

Work Environment
Manufacturing and inspection laboratory setting.
Exposure to chemicals used in penetrant inspection processes.
Frequent interaction with production, engineering, and quality personnel.
Overtime and weekend work may be required based on business needs.
Key Competencies
Attention to Detail
Technical Aptitude
Problem Solving
Quality Focus
Communication Skills
Teamwork
Safety Awareness
Integrity and Professionalism

Location: Newton, NC
Schedule: Full-time, Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.
Work Arrangement: On-site

Position Summary
The Contract Process Engineer II supports manufacturing process qualification, optimization, capacity expansion, and capital projects. This role develops process solutions, analyzes performance data, resolves technical issues, and supports project execution from design through commissioning and closeout.
Working with production, maintenance, quality, R&D, EHS, automation, project management, vendors, and contractors, the engineer improves safety, quality, yield, capacity, reliability, and cost performance.

Key Responsibilities
  • Support equipment upgrades, process development/modifications, and continuous-improvement initiatives from design through startup and performance verification.
  • Qualify, evaluate, troubleshoot, and optimize manufacturing processes, equipment, workflows, and operating conditions.
  • Prepare and maintain engineering documentation, process descriptions, equipment specifications, calculations, reports, and operating procedures.
  • Conduct process calculations, equipment-sizing evaluations, capacity studies, process simulations, and statistical data analysis.
  • Support process recipe creation, testing, validation, and process integration.
  • Partner with project managers to define scope, manage technical risks, track progress, and support schedules, estimates, and corrective actions.
  • Participate in design, process-safety, risk, and management-of-change reviews.
  • Develop and execute commissioning plans, startup procedures, test protocols, and acceptance criteria.
  • Investigate process issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement corrective actions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure processes and designs are safe, compliant, operable, and maintainable.
  • Identify and implement improvements using Lean, Six Sigma, DMAIC, DOE, 8D, FMEA, and related methodologies.
  • Prepare trial summaries and present to upper-level managers and stakeholders.

Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Chemical, Mechanical, Process, Electrical, Aerospace Engineering, or a related discipline.
2+ years of process, manufacturing, or project engineering experience in an industrial or manufacturing environment.
Experience with process improvement, equipment upgrades, process development, or manufacturing operations.
Ability to develop and review process documentation, including PFDs, P&IDs, calculations, and equipment specifications.
Experience supporting construction, commissioning, startup, production troubleshooting, or field activities.
Strong data analytical, problem-solving, organizational, communication, and technical writing skills.
Ability to present statistical data to cross functional teams by using software and appropriate tools
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently in a fast-paced project environment.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office and statistical-analysis software, such as JMP.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience with process-design or project-management tools, such as Aspen Plus, HYSYS, AutoCAD Plant 3D, MATLAB, Microsoft Project, or Primavera.
Knowledge of process equipment, instrumentation, automation, PLC, SCADA, DCS, and control systems.
Familiarity with process-safety methods, including HAZOP, What-If, PHA, LOPA, FMEA, and Management of Change.
Knowledge of applicable standards and regulations, including OSHA, NFPA, ASME, API, ISA, EPA, GMP, FDA, or ISO.
Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt, PE, or EIT certification.

Work Environment
Primarily on-site in office, manufacturing, and construction environments.
Periodic travel to nearby *** sites (10 - 12 min drive) and occasional off-hours support may be required for project activities, shutdowns, commissioning, or startup.

job.title: Enterprise Search Engineer/Technical Lead (REMOTE)
job.description:
Candidates must be located in or able to work within the East Coast time zone. REMOTE OPPORTUNITY

Overview
Client is seeking a Search Engineer / Technical Lead to lead the design, implementation, optimization, and operation of the enterprise search layer supporting digital customer experiences. This role will deliver secure, grounded, and supportable conversational search capabilities using Lucidworks Fusion, with a strong preference for candidates who have hands-on Fusion expertise.
The position combines technical leadership with hands-on engineering, focusing on search relevance, retrieval optimization, conversational AI, and enterprise search integrations across web, content, commerce, and AI platforms. The initial focus will be on single-turn answer experiences, expanding into multi-turn conversational search capabilities.

Core Responsibilities
• Design and implement collections, schemas, connectors, indexing and query pipelines, query profiles, and REST API integrations within Lucidworks Fusion or a comparable enterprise search platform.
• Build and optimize lexical, semantic, vector, and hybrid retrieval solutions, including embeddings, relevance tuning, boosting, filtering, synonyms, facets, and fallback strategies.
• Leverage behavioral signals and analytics to improve relevance, recommendations, personalization, and search effectiveness.
• Develop relevance benchmarks, regression testing frameworks, grounding and citation validation, latency objectives, and search quality measurements.
• Troubleshoot ingestion pipelines, indexing processes, Solr environments, Kubernetes and AWS deployments, APIs, model endpoints, and front-end integrations.
• Engineer conversational search experiences with intent detection, entity extraction, query rewriting, clarification workflows, and session context management.
• Implement grounded RAG architectures that retrieve approved content, provide citations, and apply confidence-based fallback behavior.
• Integrate enterprise LLM services and AI gateway technologies while managing prompt controls, model configuration, rate limiting, error handling, latency targets, and cost governance.
• Partner with AEM and front-end teams to deliver accessible search experiences, conversational answers, facets, and follow-up recommendations.
• Produce architecture documentation, deployment guides, runbooks, operational standards, and knowledge-transfer materials while collaborating with security, legal, privacy, architecture, product, and business stakeholders.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
• 5+ years of experience in search engineering, information retrieval, or enterprise application development.
• Strong hands-on experience with Lucidworks Fusion. Comparable experience with platforms such as Solr/Lucene, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, Algolia, Vespa, or Azure AI Search will be considered, though Lucidworks Fusion experience is strongly preferred.
• Experience with schemas, analyzers, tokenization, synonyms, faceting, boosting, filtering, relevance scoring, query debugging, connectors, signals, custom pipeline stages, and REST APIs.
• Practical expertise in semantic search, embeddings, approximate nearest-neighbor retrieval, neural hybrid ranking, relevance evaluation, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), grounding strategies, prompt design, citations, guardrails, and fallback patterns.
• Experience designing multi-turn conversational experiences, including session management, intent classification, and entity extraction.
• Experience deploying and supporting search workloads in AWS and Kubernetes environments, including observability and production troubleshooting.
• Proficiency with Java and/or Python, JSON, HTTP APIs, Git, automated testing, and CI/CD practices.
• Ability to translate business requirements and customer journeys into technical designs, acceptance criteria, measurable outcomes, and delivery plans.
• Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and the ability to work independently in ambiguous environments.

Preferred Skills or Experience
• Lucidworks Fusion 5.x implementation, administration, upgrade, or self-hosted deployment experience.
• Experience with Fusion AI, RAY, Learning-to-Rank, Relevance Workbench, Analytics Studio, Commerce Studio, A/B testing, or similar search optimization capabilities.
• Integration experience with AEM as a Cloud Service, commerce platforms, product catalogs, digital assets, or document and certificate services.
• Knowledge of Redis or similar session-store technologies.
• Experience with multilingual search, part-number and SKU search optimization, permissions-aware retrieval, and blending structured and unstructured content.
• Experience operating within compliance-sensitive or document-intensive environments.
• Familiarity with accessibility, privacy, secure AI development, responsible AI practices, and production monitoring.
• Relevant search, cloud, or AI certifications.

Work Details

• Limited travel as needed.

job.title: Capital Project Scheduler - (Refinery)
job.description:
Position Summary

Capital Project Scheduler

We are seeking an experienced Capital Project Scheduler to support large-scale midstream, refining, and industrial capital projects. The Scheduler will be responsible for developing, maintaining, analyzing, and reporting integrated project schedules throughout the full project lifecycle, including engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and startup.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience with Primavera P6, Critical Path Methodology (CPM), schedule forecasting, risk analysis, contractor schedule review, and capital project execution. This individual will work closely with project management, engineering, procurement, construction, contractors, and project controls teams to ensure projects remain aligned with approved schedules, milestones, and execution plans.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain detailed resource-loaded project schedules using Primavera P6.
  • Build and maintain integrated Level 1 through Level 4 schedules.
  • Establish project baselines and maintain schedule integrity throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Develop schedules covering engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and startup activities.
  • Establish schedule coding structures, calendars, activity attributes, and logic relationships.
  • Facilitate schedule development and planning workshops with project stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and operations teams to identify milestones, constraints, and execution requirements.
  • Validate schedule logic, critical path activities, float, and overall schedule health.
  • Collect, validate, and update project progress during established reporting cycles.
  • Analyze schedule performance and forecast project completion dates.
  • Identify schedule trends, productivity impacts, delays, and emerging risks.
  • Perform critical path and near-critical path analysis.
  • Develop recovery schedules and mitigation plans for schedule variances.
  • Review contractor schedules and validate reported progress.
  • Generate weekly and monthly schedule reports for project leadership.
  • Develop dashboards, KPIs, milestone reports, look-ahead schedules, S-curves, and executive summaries.
  • Support earned value management reporting where applicable.
  • Monitor schedule performance indicators including SPI, milestone achievement, float consumption, and schedule health.
  • Participate in schedule risk assessments and support probabilistic schedule analysis and Monte Carlo simulations.
  • Evaluate schedule impacts related to scope changes, delays, contractor performance, change orders, and unforeseen events.
  • Support claims analysis and schedule impact evaluations.
  • Review contractor schedules for compliance with project requirements and execution plans.
  • Ensure schedule integration across multiple contractors, vendors, and project teams.
  • Participate in planning meetings, constructability reviews, project reviews, and turnaround planning activities.
  • Communicate schedule status, risks, impacts, recovery strategies, and forecast dates to project leadership.

Required Qualifications

  • 5–10+ years of project scheduling experience supporting major capital projects.
  • Minimum 5 years of hands-on Primavera P6 experience.
  • Experience supporting capital projects in one or more of the following industries:
    • Refining
    • Midstream
    • Oil & Gas
    • Pipelines
    • Terminals
    • Storage facilities
    • Petrochemical or heavy industrial
  • Experience working with EPC contractors and/or owner organizations.
  • Advanced proficiency with Primavera P6 Professional.
  • Strong understanding of Critical Path Methodology (CPM).
  • Experience with resource loading and cost loading.
  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills.
  • Experience with Power BI preferred.
  • Knowledge of engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and startup processes.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with project leadership, contractors, vendors, engineering, procurement, and field construction teams.

Preferred Skills

  • Schedule risk analysis
  • Monte Carlo simulation
  • Schedule recovery planning
  • Delay and impact analysis
  • Contractor schedule review
  • Change management
  • Construction sequencing
  • Forecasting and trend analysis
  • Executive reporting and presentations
  • Earned Value Management (EVM)
  • S-Curve and KPI development

Work Environment

This is a 100% onsite position in Dallas, TX. Candidates must be able to work onsite.

job.title: Accounts Receivable Specialist
job.description:
Accounts Receivable Specialist

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Accounts Receivable Specialist to support accounts receivable, collections, cash application, customer account reconciliation, and reporting activities.

This position is responsible for monitoring outstanding receivables, collecting past-due balances, researching payment and invoice discrepancies, maintaining accurate collection documentation, and partnering with internal teams to resolve customer account issues. The role also supports month-end activities, including dock walk audits, monitoring non-invoiced shipments, and other accounting and reporting responsibilities.

The ideal candidate has at least two years of accounts receivable or accounting experience, strong Microsoft Excel skills, experience with ERP or billing systems, and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines within a fast-paced environment.

Work Schedule

  • Shift: 1st Shift

  • Must be available to work two Saturdays per month.

  • Must be available during month-end close, including at minimum the first three business days of each month.

  • Overtime may be required based on business needs, deadlines, and reporting requirements.

  • Must be able to adjust schedule as needed to support month-end and other time-sensitive accounting activities.

Key Responsibilities

Accounts Receivable & Collections

  • Support Accounts Receivable collection activities by working with customers, contract administrators, and the A/R team to ensure timely and effective collection efforts.

  • Contact customers via email and phone regarding:

    • Past-due balances

    • Payment status

    • Account balances

    • Invoice discrepancies

    • Disputes

    • Other accounts receivable matters

  • Review A/R aging reports on a daily and weekly basis and take appropriate action on delinquent accounts.

  • Prioritize collection activities based on aging, payment risk, customer history, and business impact.

  • Monitor promises to pay and follow up to ensure customer commitments are met.

  • Maintain accurate notes documenting collection attempts, customer communications, payment commitments, and follow-up activities.

  • Assist with credit hold and release reviews and provide escalation recommendations for high-risk or past-due accounts.

  • Provide management with updates regarding collection efforts, high-risk accounts, dispute status, and expected cash receipts.

Cash Application & Account Reconciliation

  • Support cash application and customer account maintenance activities.

  • Research and resolve:

    • Short payments

    • Deductions

    • Chargebacks

    • Unapplied payments

    • Invoice discrepancies

    • Customer disputes

  • Assist with account reconciliation and payment discrepancy research.

  • Support credit memo and additional billing creation as needed.

  • Ensure transactions and account activity are processed accurately and in accordance with established accounting procedures and internal controls.

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Partner with internal teams including:

    • Sales

    • Customer Service

    • Contracts

    • Operations

    • Shipping

    • Planning

    • Production Support

    • Key Account Managers

  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders to resolve billing, shipping, documentation, and payment issues in a timely manner.

  • Gather and provide customers with supporting documentation as needed, including:

    • Invoices

    • Statements

    • Proof of delivery

    • Shipping documentation

    • Other customer account support

Month-End & Dock Walk Audits

  • Perform monthly dock walk audits on the last business day of each month.

  • Verify shipping boxes and corresponding shipping documentation against the non-invoiced shipper list.

  • Follow up with the Shipping Department regarding boxes or shipments not properly reflected on the list.

  • Verify shipments that have been shipped but not invoiced within the same month.

  • Monitor outstanding non-invoiced shipments and perform necessary follow-up.

  • Support month-end close activities and related accounting deadlines.

Reporting & Accounting Support

  • Prepare and maintain required daily, weekly, and monthly reports.

  • Track non-invoiced work orders and shipments on a weekly basis.

  • Support ad-hoc accounting and reporting projects as required.

  • May assist with additional accounting responsibilities as proficiency is demonstrated, including:

    • Journal entries

    • Account reconciliations

    • Financial and operational reports

    • Other accounting support activities

  • Assist with maintaining compliance with established accounting policies, procedures, and internal controls.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of 2 years of relevant Accounts Receivable or accounting experience.

  • Bachelor's degree preferred, ideally in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

  • Strong knowledge of accounts receivable and collection processes.

  • Experience with ERP or billing systems and order-to-cash processes.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, including:

    • Pivot Tables

    • VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP

    • INDEX/MATCH

    • Basic formulas

  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy in data entry and reconciliation.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Comfortable communicating with external customers and internal Operations, Shipping, Sales, and other business teams.

  • Ability to prioritize workload and manage multiple responsibilities simultaneously.

  • Ability to meet strict deadlines within a fast-paced environment.

  • Strong problem-solving and issue-resolution skills.

  • Ability to follow established procedures and appropriately escalate issues.

  • Reliable and punctual with the ability to work overtime as business needs require.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Microsoft Power BI or similar reporting tools.

  • Previous experience within a manufacturing, distribution, or government contracting environment.

  • Experience supporting month-end accounting activities.

  • Experience with cash application, collections, account reconciliation, and order-to-cash processes.

We are seeking a detail-oriented Banking Operations Specialist to support a broad range of operational and administrative activities within a banking environment. This position is responsible for processing and maintaining documentation, reviewing transactions and records for accuracy, completing reporting and analysis, resolving operational issues, and supporting various banking products and processes.

The ideal candidate will have previous banking or financial operations experience, strong attention to detail, proficiency with 10-key and Microsoft Office, and the ability to accurately manage high transaction volumes while meeting established production goals and deadlines.

Work Location

Key Responsibilities

Banking & Operational Support

  • Perform moderately complex operational and administrative activities within established procedures and guidelines.

  • Process, file, record, service, and organize documentation associated with banking products and operational processes.

  • Review transactions and documentation to ensure proper procedures and requirements are followed.

  • Handle a broad range of responsibilities across areas that may include:

    • Retail banking

    • Credit cards

    • Small business banking

    • Consumer lending

    • Mortgage banking

    • Collections and recovery

    • Loan origination

  • Ability to accurately process high transaction volumes.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.

  • Strong analytical, research, and problem-resolution skills.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

  • Strong interpersonal and customer service skills.

  • Ability to work under pressure and meet established deadlines.

  • Ability to meet production and performance goals.

  • Ability to work independently with limited supervision.

  • Ability to adapt to new processes and ideas in a changing environment.

  • Ability to effectively resolve customer inquiries and challenging situations.

What is an example of a situation or job that required a high level of attention to detail?

job.title: Solderer
job.description:
Nesco Resource is looking for Solderers for our long-time client in Rochester Hills, MI. This shift operates Monday through Friday from 7 AM until 3:30 PM. Pay is based on experience, must have an updated resume. The associate will perform all soldering, bonding, wiring, routing, assembly, disassembly, touch-up, rework, cleaning, and minor modifications, assemblies and sub-assemblies within the facility using electronic parts and components and a variety of hand tools.

Payrate is 20 to 25 an hour depending on experience

The associate will work from approved visual aids, change notices (CN's), deviations and routes and/or any engineer-approved changes that apply to them. Solderers will also move the completed product to the next production operation. You will also use various measuring instruments and equipment to perform a visual and dimensional inspection of printed circuit boards, harnesses, sub-assemblies, and assemblies. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
 
  • Perform manual and automated soldering of electronic components onto printed circuit boards
  • Read and interpret technical drawings, schematics, and work instructions
  • Set up and operate soldering equipment, including wave soldering machines and reflow ovens

  • Clean and maintain soldering equipment and work area
REQUIREMENTS
  • Previous experience in electronic soldering, preferably in a manufacturing environment Ability to follow verbal and written instructions in English
  • Proficiency in various soldering techniques, including through-hole and surface mount technology Ability to identify electronic components
  • Ability to frequently lift/carry products weighing up to 50 lbs.
  • Ability to read and understand technical documents and schematics
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality
  • Good hand-eye coordination and manual dexterity
  • Good time management and organizational skills
OTHER SKILLS AND ABILITIES
  • Must complete soldering training course and pass soldering proficiency test
  • Ability to maintain hourly run rates in a fast-paced environment
  • Basic Math Electrostatic Discharge (ESD) training Electronic component identification training

job.description:

Plans, implements, tests, documents, and maintains solutions for the integration and testing of in-house developed and COTS/GOTS components, elements, subsystems and/or systems. Synthesizes customer contractual needs and requirements into system test solutions that acknowledge technical, schedule and cost constraints. Establishes functional and technical specifications and standards, solves hardware/software interface problems, defines input/output parameters, and ensures integration of the entire system or subsystem. Coordinates subsystem and/or system testing activities with programs and other organizations. Writes discrepancy reports and performs integration regression testing to verify/validate incorporated fixes to software, components, subsystems and systems.

Looking for someone capable of building dashboards/reports from scratch, interpreting performance data and translating it into recommendations. Not simply reviewing reports someone else created.

We're looking for someone who genuinely enjoys doing the work. You should be comfortable moving between website updates, SEO analysis, paid campaigns, reporting, and digital projects without needing an outside agency to handle the execution.
You'll be successful if you're self-directed, analytical, detail-oriented, comfortable juggling multiple priorities, and able to identify an issue, recommend a solution, and then help implement it.

job.title: Cloud Engineer
job.description:
Overview
The Cloud Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining secure, scalable, and reliable cloud-based solutions. This role supports business objectives by optimizing cloud infrastructure, automating deployments, and ensuring compliance with security and performance standards.
The position works across enterprise and research application environments, helping Client build, operate, and continuously improve cloud platforms that are secure, resilient, cost-effective, and aligned with operational and compliance requirements.

Core Responsibilities
• Design and deploy cloud architectures across AWS and/or Azure that meet performance, security, availability, and cost-efficiency requirements.
• Architect and implement cloud networking, compute, storage, and identity services using least-privilege access, network segmentation, encryption, and defense-in-depth security principles.
• Evaluate and recommend cloud services, architectural patterns, and infrastructure approaches, balancing engineering capability, operational cost, and long-term platform sustainability.
• Implement and maintain infrastructure-as-code (IaC) solutions using Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, or equivalent technologies.
• Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for cloud infrastructure and application deployments, including automated testing, validation, deployment, and rollback capabilities.
• Automate operational processes including patching, scaling, monitoring, alerting, and cost optimization to improve reliability and reduce manual effort.
• Ensure cloud environments comply with security standards, regulatory requirements, and data governance policies through controls for identity management, secrets management, audit logging, and encryption.
• Monitor cloud security posture, identify and remediate misconfigurations and policy violations, and integrate CSPM tooling into operational workflows.
• Partner with cybersecurity teams to align cloud security with enterprise threat models and regulatory frameworks, including GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, HIPAA, and SOX where applicable.
• Monitor cloud environments for performance, availability, and cost efficiency, applying FinOps practices and resource optimization strategies.
• Contribute to platform engineering standards, reference architectures, and guardrails that enable consistent and secure cloud adoption.
• Troubleshoot cloud infrastructure issues, participate in post-incident analysis, and implement preventive improvements to reduce recurrence.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
• 3+ years of hands-on cloud engineering experience in a production enterprise environment with AWS and/or Azure.

job.title: Senior Recruiter
job.description:
Senior Recruiter

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Contract Recruiter to manage a high-volume portfolio of entry-level sales requisitions and deliver full-cycle recruiting support from initial intake through offer and pre-onboarding.

This position will partner closely with hiring managers, Talent Acquisition Coordinators, and a Managed Service Provider (MSP) Talent Acquisition vendor to ensure efficient requisition management, candidate processing, interview coordination, and onboarding activities.

The ideal candidate has strong high-volume recruiting experience, can effectively manage multiple requisitions and priorities simultaneously, and is skilled at building talent pipelines while delivering an excellent candidate and hiring manager experience.

Key Responsibilities

Full-Cycle & High-Volume Recruiting

  • Manage a high volume of open requisitions for entry-level sales positions.

  • Deliver full-cycle recruiting support, including:

    • Recruiting and hiring strategy

    • Candidate sourcing

    • Resume review and screening

    • Interview coordination

    • Candidate selection

    • Offer recommendations and negotiations

    • Pre-onboarding activities

  • Maintain consistent candidate communication throughout the recruiting process.

  • Ensure a positive candidate and hiring manager experience from intake through offer.

Hiring Manager Partnership

  • Lead structured recruiting intake and strategy sessions with hiring managers.

  • Partner with hiring managers to establish:

    • Target candidate profiles

    • Sourcing strategies and channels

    • Interview processes

    • Selection criteria

    • Hiring and decision timelines

  • Provide regular updates regarding candidate pipelines, recruiting activity, and requisition status.

Talent Sourcing & Pipeline Development

  • Develop and maintain talent pipelines for current and anticipated hiring needs.

  • Source candidates through multiple channels, including:

    • Job boards

    • Social media campaigns

    • Talent communities

    • Employee and candidate referrals

    • Networking events

    • Universities and community colleges

    • Workforce development programs

  • Identify opportunities to improve sourcing strategies and overall recruiting effectiveness.

MSP & Recruiting Operations Partnership

  • Partner closely with the Managed Service Provider (MSP) Talent Acquisition vendor to support efficient requisition management and candidate processing.

  • Collaborate with Talent Acquisition Coordinators on:

    • Job postings

    • Candidate status and progress updates

    • Interview scheduling

    • Pre-onboarding and onboarding coordination

  • Maintain accurate candidate and requisition information within the Applicant Tracking System.

  • Ensure recruiting and onboarding activities follow established processes and compliance requirements.

Recruiting Metrics & Process Improvement

  • Track and report recruiting activity and key performance metrics, including:

    • Time-to-fill

    • Offer acceptance rates

    • Talent pipeline activity

  • Identify opportunities to improve recruiting processes, candidate flow, and hiring efficiency.

  • Maintain accurate documentation and handle confidential candidate and employee information appropriately.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of 5 years of recruiting experience with demonstrated expertise in full-cycle recruiting.

  • Experience managing multiple requisitions and high-volume hiring activity.

  • Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to independently prioritize competing responsibilities.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office.

  • Experience working with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS).

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to appropriately handle confidential information.

  • Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills.

  • Strong customer-service orientation when working with candidates and hiring managers.

  • Ability to identify and implement recruiting process improvements.

  • Knowledge of recruiting and onboarding compliance requirements.

job.description:
The Industrial Engineer will play a critical role in the design, implementation, and management of complex systems and test equipment solutions. You will work within and lead cross-functional teams on cutting-edge projects that transform the way businesses operate. Your technical expertise in systems engineering, project management, and technical leadership will be instrumental in shaping the future of technology and industry solutions.

As an Industrial Engineer within the Factory Test Equipment team, you will be looked to as the subject matter expert and be focused on the design and architectural aspects of complex systems, which may involve hardware, software, network components, and will include PLC systems. You will ensure that the system design aligns with ***'s quality standards and industry's best practices. You will be responsible for maintaining in-depth knowledge of relevant technologies, providing knowledge and technical assistance to other team members, and potentially take on mentorship opportunities.
If you are looking to expand your career with a global leader in technology and have a direct impact on improving the quality of life for people around the world, this is an ideal opportunity for growth and development. Join us and be a part of a dynamic workplace where we consistently are shaping the future.

You will report directly to our Engineering Manager, and you'll work out of our Minneapolis, MN location.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Provide technical skills and abilities to engineering teams, ensuring the successful execution of projects
  • Become an expert in PLC integration and troubleshooting for a complex automated system.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to capture and manage system requirements, ensuring they are well-defined, complete, and traceable throughout the project lifecycle
  • Develop and execute test plans, analyze test results, and drive corrective actions
  • Supervise a small team of 2 to 3 and manage project schedules, budgets, and resources to ensure successful project completion

YOU MUST HAVE
  • Experience in systems or industrial engineering
  • Experience with PLCs
  • Mastery of knowledge in equipment integration, implementation, and troubleshooting
  • Ability to work under minimal supervision

WE VALUE
  • Bachelor's degree in engineering (Electrical, Mechanical, Aerospace, or related field)
  • Associates or technical degree in automation (Industrial Controls, Robotics, or related field)
  • Experience with Allen Bradley CompactLogix PLC.

  • Knowledge of industry best practices and emerging technologies
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Passion for innovation and continuous learning
  • Attention to detail
  • Excellent problem-solving capability
