job.description:
SUMMARY:
Precision Metal Works, a Bartell Global Company, manufactures metal stamped parts and components for the appliance and automotive industries. We have approximately 250 team members and two manufacturing facilities in Louisville, KY. Our facilities boast 36 stamping presses, a state-of-the-art powder coating line , robotic welding, cosmetic stainless-steel finishing and numerous assembly operations.

Precision Metal Works has an immediate opening for a Production Technician. The Production Technician operates production machinery consistent with established standards.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Perform manufacturing processes to complete assemblies using machines or presses
  • Report defective materials or questionable conditions to the department Lead
  • Complete tasks as directed by manufacturing schedules with minimal supervision
  • Maintain the work area and equipment in a clean and orderly condition
  • Must understand and perform to the Fundamentals of Manufacturing
  • Work efficiently in a team environment
  • Must adhere to all safety and operational processes and company policy
  • Must operate using job specific PPE
  • Safe use of various equipment, follow process specifications, and meet production standards to manufacture products.
  • Perform various operations to supply products to meet customer requirements.
  • Use visual inspection, gauges and other measurement devices to ensure accurate output and quality of products.
  • Understand and utilize all guarding / protection.
  • Adhere to procedures relating to the proper use and care of equipment and materials.
  • Change machine setups and/or make minor adjustments to machines to produce product, which meets the designated product specifications for that particular workstation.
  • Communicate effectively in both oral and written formats
  • Other duties may be assigned

job.title: Biologist (3-5 years)
job.description:
Come join the Cardiometabolic Research (CMR) team at ***! We are focused on the discovery and early phase clinical development of biologic, small molecule, oligonucleotide, and cell therapies for treatment of diabetes, obesity, cardiovascular disease, and associated metabolic disorders. The Data Science team within CMR is seeking someone with wide-ranging experience in next-generation sequencing library preparation to help achieve our research goals. The successful candidate will be responsible for RNA-seq, scRNA-seq, snRNA-seq, and other types of -seq library preparations for all CMR groups. Job Requirements
B.S. and/or M.S. in biological or biochemical sciences (or a related field) with 3-5 years of laboratory research experience.
Molecular biology mastery of nucleic acid extraction and purification, quantification, NGS library preparation/QC, and qPCR.
Strong background in NGS technologies and their applications, including quantification, sequencing, and data QC (preferably Illumina). Direct experience with RNA-seq (bulk) and amplicon-seq.
Direct experience with single-cell and single-nucleus RNA-seq library preparation is required. Candidates must be familiar with multiple scRNA-seq/snRNA-seq platforms (e.g., 10X Genomics Chromium, Illumina PIP-seq, ScaleBio, or Parse Biosciences).

Familiarity with CRISPR-based gene editing and high-throughput screening is a plus.
Experience with automation is a plus (Mantis, Integra systems, Liquid Handlers, SPTLabtech Firefly, Tecan, etc).
Strong organizational, time management, and communication skills.
Experience with documentation in electronic notebook software.

  • Responsible for the planning, coordination and implementation of assigned
  • Develop and track capital investment budgets for assigned projects.

job.title: Ansible Automation Engineer - (Active Secret Clearance Required)
job.description:
Overview
Client is seeking an Ansible Engineer to support infrastructure automation, configuration management, and operational consistency across Linux, Windows, containerized, and cloud-based environments. This role focuses on working on F-35 Pilot training devices, developing reusable automation solutions, integrating infrastructure tooling, and supporting secure, scalable deployment practices.
The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Ansible, infrastructure-as-code concepts, systems administration, and automation testing, with experience integrating automation into modern CI/CD and observability platforms.

Core Responsibilities
• Design, develop, and maintain idempotent Ansible playbooks and reusable roles while managing role dependencies and automation standards.
• Create and manage static and dynamic inventories, host variables, and integrations with external inventory sources.
• Automate Linux and Windows system administration tasks, including package management, system configuration, PowerShell-based remediation, and Active Directory integration.
• Support infrastructure provisioning and post-provisioning configuration using Ansible in conjunction with tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.
• Implement automation for containerized and Kubernetes environments, including cluster bootstrapping, deployment management, and runtime configuration.
• Integrate Ansible workflows into Git-based development processes, pull-request reviews, and CI/CD pipelines.
• Develop testing and validation frameworks using tools such as Molecule, TestInfra, and policy or schema validation solutions.
• Implement and maintain secure secrets management solutions using Ansible Vault, HashiCorp Vault, or cloud-based key management services.
• Support compliance initiatives by maintaining audit trails, generating compliance reporting, and ensuring automation aligns with organizational security standards.
• Integrate automation workflows with monitoring and observability platforms to improve operational visibility and detect configuration drift.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies
• Strong experience developing Ansible playbooks and roles, including idempotent automation design, dependency management, and reusable role structures.
• Deep understanding of YAML and Jinja2, including templating, filters, conditionals, and dynamic configuration generation.
• Experience with inventory management, including host grouping, host variables, static inventories, dynamic inventories, and external inventory integrations.
• Strong Linux administration experience across distributions such as RHEL, Ubuntu, Debian, and Alpine.
• Experience supporting Windows environments using Ansible Windows modules, PowerShell, and Active Directory integrations.
• Knowledge of infrastructure automation and configuration management practices using Ansible and infrastructure-as-code tools.
• Experience with Kubernetes, container platforms, and automation of deployment and cluster management tasks.
• Proficiency with Git workflows, repository management, branching strategies, and pull-request-based review processes.
• Experience integrating automation into GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or Azure Pipelines, including automated testing and linting.
• Hands-on experience with Molecule, TestInfra, and automation testing methodologies.
• Experience implementing secrets management solutions using HashiCorp Vault, Ansible Vault, or cloud key management services.
• Understanding of compliance, auditing, and security-focused automation practices.
• Knowledge of networking fundamentals, including DNS, DHCP, VPCs, subnets, load balancers, firewalls, and IP address management.
• Scripting experience using Python or Bash for automation, custom modules, and tool integration.

Preferred Skills or Experience
• Familiarity with Terraform, Pulumi, or CloudFormation in hybrid or multi-cloud infrastructure environments.
• Experience integrating automation telemetry and operational data into Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or Splunk environments.

Work Details
• Security Clearance Required: Secret.
• Work arrangement: Worker will telework less than 50% of the time.
• Schedule: 4/10, 1st Shift.
• Opportunity for full-time hire.
• Program supports F-35 pilot training devices under Prime Contract #N00019-19-C-0010.
• Access to ECI information is required.

job.title: Contracts Specialist, Discovery Sciences(Fully Remote)
job.description:
Contracts Specialist – Discovery Science / Life Sciences

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Contracts Specialist for a 6–12 month, full-time temporary assignment supporting discovery science and research contracting activities.

This individual contributor will be responsible for drafting, negotiating, and processing procurement-facing agreements supporting outsourced discovery science and research services. The Contracts Specialist will work from assignments provided by the contracting lead and will execute agreements accurately, efficiently, and within established templates, playbooks, approval frameworks, and systems.

The ideal candidate will have previous contracts experience within a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, CRO, or life sciences procurement environment and be comfortable managing a high volume of agreements while negotiating directly with external suppliers.

Scope of Work

Contract Drafting & Negotiation

  • Draft, review, negotiate, and finalize assigned agreements for outsourced discovery science services.

  • Manage agreements including:

    • Confidentiality Agreements (CDAs)

    • Work Orders

    • Amendments

    • Software and SaaS Agreements

  • Negotiate directly with third-party suppliers to advance and close assigned agreements.

  • Apply established contract templates, fallback positions, playbooks, and approval frameworks throughout the negotiation process.

  • Review agreements for common commercial and legal provisions, including:

    • Intellectual Property

    • Confidentiality

    • Indemnification

    • Limitation of Liability

    • Payment Terms

Contract Management & Compliance

  • Manage a high volume of concurrent contract assignments while meeting established timelines.

  • Adjust priorities as directed by the contracting lead.

  • Identify non-standard terms, contractual risks, or issues that fall outside established playbook positions.

  • Escalate identified issues to the contracting lead with a clear summary of the concern and proposed options.

  • Provide regular status updates regarding assigned agreements.

Contract Lifecycle Management

  • Utilize the organization's Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) system for all assigned work.

  • Manage contract activities within the CLM system, including:

    • Intake

    • Drafting

    • Version Control

    • Status Tracking

    • Record Keeping

  • Maintain complete, current, and accurate contract records.

Procurement Support

  • Create purchase requisitions in SAP Ariba for executed agreements as assigned.

Out of Scope

This position will not be responsible for:

  • Engaging directly with internal business partners, scientific teams, or project management teams regarding contracting needs or intake.

  • Escalating matters directly to Legal or other internal subject matter experts. All escalations will be routed through the contracting lead.

  • Procure-to-pay activities beyond purchase requisition creation.

  • Invoice reconciliation.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree.

  • 2+ years of contract drafting and negotiation experience within a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, CRO, or life sciences procurement environment.

  • Working knowledge of common commercial and legal contract provisions, including:

    • Intellectual Property

    • Confidentiality

    • Indemnification

    • Limitation of Liability

    • Payment Terms

  • Demonstrated ability to manage a high volume of concurrent agreements while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.

  • Experience working within established contract templates, playbooks, and approval frameworks.

  • Experience using a Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) system.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Experience negotiating directly with external suppliers.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including:

    • Outlook

    • Word

    • Excel

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience contracting for outsourced research and discovery science services, including:

    • Preclinical CRO services

    • Discovery Biology

    • Chemistry Services

  • Degree or professional background in biology or another related scientific discipline.

  • Scientific literacy sufficient to understand the scope, deliverables, and technical terminology associated with discovery research services, including:

    • In vitro studies

    • In vivo studies

    • Assay development

    • Chemistry services

  • Ability to accurately translate scientific and technical requirements into contract language.

  • Experience negotiating software and SaaS agreements, including data platform agreements within a research environment.

  • Experience with SAP Ariba or a comparable procurement platform.

  • Comfortable using AI tools to support contract drafting and review.

Key Skills

  • Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM)

  • Pharmaceutical / Biotechnology Contracting

  • CRO & Research Services Agreements

  • Supplier Negotiations

  • Confidentiality Agreements (CDAs)

If you're a highly talented Mechanical Engineer who's ready to step into a senior role and provide tutelage and mentoring to your associates, we want to hear from you!

Our Commercial & Industrial Business Unit is looking for a Senior Mechanical Engineer. The Senior Engineer plays a key role in the design, development, and testing of complex mechanical components, systems, and equipment for both new and existing products. This position leads advanced mechanical engineering initiatives, mentors and trains engineering staff, supports continuous improvement, and researches and recommends new design tools, technologies, and engineering processes.

Responsibilities:

  • Complete the product design, analysis, and development of mechanical components and systems, including detailed assembly drawings, part drawings, and engineering documentation from concept through manufacturing release.
  • Conduct FEA (Finite Element Analysis) and FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) and incorporate customer feedback to strengthen product design and development.
  • Develop technical documentation and electronic help files that support new product introductions and engineering workflows.

  • Research emerging mechanical engineering technologies, recommend solutions to management, and oversee implementation of new tools and processes.

  • Ensure system and product quality by designing effective testing methodologies and validation procedures.

job.title: Senior Treasury Analyst
job.description:
Treasury / Corporate Finance Analyst

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Treasury / Corporate Finance Analyst to support cash forecasting, liquidity management, financial analysis, and day-to-day treasury operations.

This is a contract position with the potential to convert to a full-time opportunity in the future based on business needs and individual performance. Conversion is not guaranteed.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Treasury, Corporate Finance, FP&A, Accounting, or a related financial discipline, along with advanced Excel and financial modeling skills.

Work Schedule & Location

  • Work Model: Hybrid

  • Onsite Requirement: Minimum of 4 days per week

  • Remote: Flexibility to work from home 1 day per week

  • Location: Framingham, MA

  • Employment Type: Contract with potential for future full-time conversion based on business need and performance; conversion is not guaranteed

Key Responsibilities

Cash & Liquidity Forecasting

  • Maintain and enhance short-term cash and liquidity forecasting processes.

  • Prepare monthly treasury forecasts and analyze trends, risks, and variances to support financial decision-making.

  • Collaborate with internal business partners to gather inputs, validate assumptions, and improve forecast accuracy.

  • Develop and maintain cash position summaries, liquidity metrics, and other treasury reporting.

  • Identify opportunities to improve cash forecasting processes and overall forecast accuracy.

Treasury Operations

  • Support daily treasury operations, including:

    • Corporate deposits

    • Cash positioning

    • Wire transfers

    • ACH payments

  • Analyze bank fee activity, identify trends, and provide actionable insights to support cost management.

  • Monitor company bond pricing and capital markets activity using Bloomberg.

  • Prepare reporting related to bond pricing and capital markets activity.

  • Identify and implement opportunities to improve treasury operational efficiencies.

Financial Analysis & Modeling

  • Develop and maintain treasury reports and financial models.

  • Perform financial analysis related to:

    • Cash Management

    • Liquidity

    • Debt

    • Working Capital

    • Lease-versus-Buy Decisions

  • Analyze complex financial data to identify trends, risks, variances, and opportunities.

  • Provide actionable insights to support business and financial decision-making.

  • Support working capital initiatives and other treasury-related projects.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with internal and external stakeholders on treasury initiatives, including:

    • Accounts Receivable

    • Accounts Payable

    • Accounting

    • Legal

    • Tax

    • IT

    • External Banking Partners

  • Build productive relationships across teams to support treasury and corporate finance objectives.

  • Clearly communicate financial information and analysis to a variety of stakeholders.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

  • 4+ years of experience in Treasury, Corporate Finance, Financial Planning & Analysis, Accounting, or a related financial discipline.

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

  • Experience developing and maintaining financial models.

  • Demonstrated experience analyzing financial data and supporting business or financial decision-making.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.

  • Ability to independently manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

  • High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

Preferred Qualifications

  • MBA or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field.

  • Corporate Treasury or Corporate Finance experience.

  • Experience with:

    • Cash Forecasting

    • Liquidity Forecasting

    • Debt Analysis

    • Capital Markets

    • Financial Modeling

  • Experience with treasury management systems.

  • Experience using Bloomberg or other financial software platforms.

  • Experience supporting working capital optimization programs.

  • Experience supporting treasury transformation or process improvement initiatives.

job.title: Mechanical Engineer III
job.description:
Leading Long Island electronics manufacturer has an exciting career opportunity for a Mechanical Engineer III. This is an opportunity you won't want to miss out on as it comes with incredible perks that few companies can match. If you're a highly talented Mechanical Engineer with electronics manufacturing experience, we want to hear from you!

Our Commercial & Industrial Business Unit is looking for a Mechanical Engineer III to join their team. This position will independently lead product designs from concept through launch, with an emphasis on performance, reliability, and innovation. Applying strong knowledge of engineering materials and manufacturing processes to develop creative, effective design solutions.

Responsibilities:

  • Independently perform medium- to high-complexity product design for NPI or PLE projects, driving innovation throughout the design process.
  • Analyze existing designs and products to identify improvements, cost-reduction opportunities, and troubleshooting solutions.
  • Collaborate with Electrical Engineers to provide PCB mechanical dimensions, packaging requirements, and keep-out zones, ensuring PCBAs integrate seamlessly with mechanical designs.
  • Research and identify optimal materials, processes, and technologies to meet product performance criteria.
  • Read and interpret regulatory codes and standards with minimal guidance; attend relevant codes and standards activities as needed and report findings.
  • Incorporate internal and external customer input into product design and development.
  • Develop product design specifications, DFMEAs, and DVP&Rs.
  • Perform virtual simulations and design of experiments (DOE) to validate design direction.
  • Perform or oversee prototype testing to verify design performance and robustness.
  • Collaborate with senior engineers and/or the Engineering Manager to maintain tooling budgets and product cost targets.
  • Maintain system databases by entering and updating required data and project status information.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including electrical, manufacturing, and quality engineers, to ensure seamless integration of mechanical designs.
  • Follow established procedures and recommend improvements based on trending data and lessons learned.
  • Make technical decisions, including purchasing prototype components, while managing the established budget.
  • Apply engineering economic analysis to support decision-making for raw material selection and product design.
  • Complete assigned projects and assist in training and guiding technicians.
  • Contribute to team goals and support overall project success.
Qualifications:
  • Effective oral, written, and presentation communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to independently lead product design from concept through launch.
  • Solid understanding of engineering fundamentals and finite element analysis (FEA).
  • Knowledge of engineering materials, including aluminum, copper, brass, and plastics, as well as fabrication techniques such as injection molding, die stamping, casting, sheet metal bending, and various assembly methods.
  • Proficient in advanced 3D CAD, preferably SolidWorks, and basic FEA using simulation tools for stress, force, and motion analysis; knowledgeable in CAD data management and revision control.
  • Knowledge of manufacturing techniques for fabrication, manual, and automated production lines; design for manufacturability; and ability to support manufacturing plants as needed.
  • Basic project management skills; results-driven with the ability to meet deadlines.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and OneNote.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment.
  • Takes initiative and demonstrates a proactive approach.
Education & Experience:
  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering required, Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering a plus.
  • 4+ years of experience in mechanical product design; consumer product or electromechanical product design experience preferred.
  • Experience with printed circuit boards (PCBs) and electronics packaging preferred.
  • Experience with regulatory compliance and validation testing methodologies.
  • Experience with a variety of manufacturing processes and production methods.
  • Experience with design, prototyping, and material selection evaluation.
  • Experience with 3D CAD and drafting; SolidWorks preferred.
Travel:
  • Up to 10%; both domestic and international travel required.

job.title: Technical Editor I
job.description:
Job Description:
Contractor, Nonclinical Document Management & Workflow Support

Role Overview:
The contractor will provide essential support for document lifecycle management, data entry, and workflow coordination for nonclinical documents supporting various regulatory submission types. This role focuses on ensuring document accuracy, maintaining organized digital libraries, and collaborating across functional groups. The contractor will work closely with Submission Managers and serve as a resource to project and submission teams (such as Pharmacology Subteams) to ensure the timely delivery of high-quality, compliant documents that meet global regulatory standards.

Key Responsibilities:
Document Management & Processing:
Build familiarity with internal processes, tools, and document management systems, seeking guidance from experienced submission managers as needed.
Transfer and manage documents across various digital libraries and folder structures.
Accurately capture, identify, and apply metadata to files and system records.
Publish finalized documents and reports within the document management system.
Quality Control & Editing:
Perform quality control (QC) and verification of documents to ensure they meet readiness standards.
Format, edit, and track nonclinical documents (e.g., nonclinical study reports, GLP statements, CRO reports, IND/BLA summaries), applying established editorial standards and templates to ensure accuracy, completeness, and internal consistency.
Retrieve missing information by searching through historical archives and tracking down data.
System Workflow & Coordination:
Initiate document records within the tracking and document management systems.
Enter system data and accurately match documents to broader project plans.
Assess and develop timelines for document deliverables, supporting authors by tracking the completion of documents.
Manage collaborations by coordinating document hand-offs and review cycles between subject matter experts, authors, publishing teams, and stakeholders in Development Sciences, Regulatory Affairs, and other functions.
Identify problems with documents or submissions and collaborate with the team to develop effective solutions.
Internal Communications & Content Management:
Manage and maintain internal team websites or portals.
Create new content and perform routine updates to ensure information remains current.
Serve as an editorial contact and communicate documentation processes to team members and stakeholders.

Qualifications:
Education:
B.A./B.S. degree in English, science, communications, liberal arts, or a health-related field.

Experience:
Minimum of 2 years of scientific editing, writing, or document management experience.

Skills:
Knowledge of the drug development process and regulatory submissions is mandatory.
Strong project management and organizational skills is mandatory .
Ability to anticipate and solve issues impacting timelines.
Ability to work concurrently on multiple projects, meet aggressive deadlines, and contribute effectively in a fast-paced, highly collaborative team environment.
Strong written and verbal communication, solutions-focused mindset.
High attention to detail to prevent inaccurate or substandard documents that could lead to submission corrections or delays.
Experience leveraging AI-augmented tools and automation to streamline documentation workflows and enhance overall efficiency is preferred.
Profiency with MS Word

job.title: Robot Welder Trainee– Day & Night Shifts
job.description:
Robot Welding Trainee – Day & Night Shifts

Claremore, OK | Full-Time | Contract-to-Hire | $20.50 (Days), $23.50/hour (Nights)

Learn a skilled manufacturing trade while getting paid to train!

A Claremore manufacturing team is hiring Robot Welding Trainees for both day and night shifts. This is a great opportunity for someone who wants to build a career in skilled manufacturing, welding, or industrial automation without needing years of previous experience.

You'll receive hands-on, paid training while learning to operate automated welding equipment, inspect finished parts, and work as part of a production team.

No previous welding or robotic welding experience is required. Manufacturing, assembly, welding, machine operation, construction, or other hands-on experience is helpful, but we're also willing to train someone with the right attitude, work ethic, and willingness to learn.

Pay & Schedule

Day Shift

  • $20.50/hour

  • Monday–Friday

  • 6:00 AM–4:30 PM

  • 10-hour shifts

  • Saturday overtime may be available

Night Shift

  • $23.50/hour

  • Monday–Friday

  • 5:00 PM–3:30 AM

  • 10-hour shifts

  • Saturday overtime may be available

Both positions are Full-Time, Contract-to-Hire.
Claremore, OK | Weekly Pay

What You'll Do

  • Learn to operate and monitor automated robotic welding equipment

  • Load and position metal components into welding fixtures

  • Remove completed parts and visually inspect them for quality

  • Follow work instructions, production specifications, and safety procedures

  • Identify obvious weld or part defects and report concerns to the appropriate team member

  • Keep your workstation clean, organized, and safe

  • Assist with other production, assembly, and fabrication tasks as needed

Who We're Looking For

This is a true training opportunity — you do not need to already know robotic welding.

You could be a great fit if you've worked in:

  • Manufacturing or production

  • Welding or fabrication

  • Assembly

  • Machine operation

  • Construction or skilled trades

  • Automotive or mechanical work

  • Warehouse or other industrial environments

No related experience? You can still be considered. We're looking for people who are dependable, comfortable working with their hands, willing to learn, and serious about building a career.

What Will Make You Successful

  • Dependability: You show up on time and consistently

  • Attention to detail: You notice when something doesn't look right

  • Willingness to learn: You're comfortable being trained on new equipment

  • Mechanical mindset: You're interested in how machines and processes work

  • Quality-focused: You take pride in doing the job correctly

  • Teamwork: You communicate well and work safely around others

What to Expect

This is a hands-on manufacturing position in an industrial environment. You'll spend most of your 10-hour shift on your feet and will work around machinery, metal, heat, and noise.

You must be comfortable with repetitive physical work and able to safely lift, move, and position materials as required.

Why Consider This Opportunity?

If you've been looking for a way to break into skilled manufacturing or industrial automation, this is a chance to learn a specialized skill while earning a solid starting wage.

You'll receive paid training and gain hands-on experience with automated welding equipment and production processes — experience that can help you build a longer-term career in manufacturing.

This is a Contract-to-Hire opportunity with the goal of permanent placement for employees who demonstrate strong attendance, performance, safety, and overall reliability.

Ready to Learn a Skilled Trade?

If you're dependable, willing to learn, and looking for an opportunity where you can build skills instead of staying in an entry-level job, apply today!

Basic tools

job.title: Locomotive Mechanic
job.description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Locomotive Mechanic / Electrician for a hands-on role supporting diesel-electric locomotives and railroad equipment throughout the field and shop environment.

This is not a trainee position. We're looking for a journeyman-level mechanic who can independently diagnose and repair complex mechanical, electrical, and air-brake systems, work with limited supervision, and serve as a technical resource to other mechanics.

The position is based in Baytown, TX, with significant travel throughout the country. Candidates who enjoy field work, troubleshooting complex equipment, and working on different locomotive units are encouraged to apply.

What You'll Do

  • Inspect, diagnose, repair, and maintain diesel-electric locomotives and railroad equipment.
  • Troubleshoot complex mechanical, electrical, and air-brake systems.
  • Work on EMD and Client locomotives, including running repairs and major component work.
  • Troubleshoot locomotive control systems, wiring, batteries, charging systems, traction systems, and high-current electrical components.
  • Perform and lead engine, truck, brake, and major-component repairs and overhauls.
  • Inspect and repair safety-critical locomotive systems and document defects and corrective actions.
  • Read and interpret wiring diagrams, schematics, locomotive drawings, work orders, and parts information.
  • Test completed repairs, perform load checks, and assist with locomotive operation prior to return to service.
  • Use electrical meters, hand tools, cutting torches, welders, forklifts, and other shop equipment.
  • Maintain accurate records of inspections, repairs, parts, labor, and required documentation.
  • Help train and mentor less-experienced mechanics and electricians.
  • Coordinate with supervisors, train crews, and customers regarding equipment status, repair timelines, and parts requirements.
  • Identify repeat equipment failures, parts shortages, and other maintenance issues.
  • Follow all company and customer safety requirements.
  • Travel and work away from your home area, including overnight assignments.
  • Work nights, weekends, overtime, and irregular schedules when required.

What We're Looking For

Required

  • 5 years of hands-on experience repairing diesel-electric locomotives or closely related diesel-electric/heavy power-generation equipment.
  • Working knowledge of EMD and/or Client locomotive systems.
  • Strong mechanical and electrical troubleshooting ability.
  • Experience with locomotive electrical systems, diesel prime movers, and air-brake systems.
  • Ability to diagnose equipment problems independently without step-by-step direction.
  • Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, work orders, and locomotive drawings.
  • Valid driver's license and acceptable driving record.
  • Ability to pass a pre-employment background check and drug screen.
  • Ability to complete required safety training.
  • Willingness and ability to travel overnight up to five days per week.
  • Willingness to work irregular hours, nights, weekends, and overtime as required.

Related Experience Considered

Candidates without five years specifically on locomotives may be considered if they have significant experience with comparable diesel-electric, heavy equipment, marine, or industrial power-generation systems, particularly where the work involved high-voltage/high-current electrical systems and diesel prime movers.

Locomotive experience is strongly preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

  • EMD locomotive experience
  • Client locomotive experience
  • Welding experience
  • Cutting-torch experience
  • Forklift experience
  • Prior experience training or mentoring mechanics
  • Previous technical lead experience
  • Railroad or heavy-equipment maintenance background

Important: This Is a Working Technical Role

Although this is a Senior position, it does not automatically include formal supervisory authority.

You will be expected to take technical ownership of assigned work, help set the quality and safety standard for the crew, and provide guidance to less-experienced mechanics.

Physical & Work Environment

This is a hands-on mechanical/electrical position performed in locomotive shops and outdoor field environments.

The job may involve:

  • Standing, walking, climbing, balancing, bending, kneeling, crouching, and crawling.
  • Working around moving railroad equipment.
  • Exposure to weather, vibration, noise, fumes, oils, grease, and airborne particles.
  • Working around live electrical systems and potential electrical-shock hazards.
  • Working at heights.
  • Regularly lifting or moving up to 25 pounds and frequently lifting or moving up to 100 pounds with assistance when required.
  • Use of required PPE and hearing protection.

Color vision is required for electrical work.

Why Consider This Opportunity?

This is an opportunity for an experienced locomotive mechanic/electrician to take on a senior-level technical role with significant field exposure.

If you're currently working as a locomotive mechanic, locomotive electrician, diesel mechanic, railroad mechanic, heavy-equipment mechanic, or industrial power-generation technician and are comfortable traveling for work, we'd like to speak with you.

Apply today to be considered for this opportunity.

Keywords: Locomotive Mechanic, Senior Locomotive Mechanic, Locomotive Electrician, Locomotive Technician, Diesel Mechanic, Diesel-Electric Mechanic, Railroad Mechanic, Railroad Technician, EMD Mechanic, Client Locomotive Mechanic, Heavy Equipment Mechanic, Diesel Technician, Power Generation Technician, Field Service Technician, Railroad Maintenance, Locomotive Maintenance.

job.title: Optical Measurements Engineer
job.description:
Optical Measurements Systems Engineer

Location: Painted Post, NY – Onsite
Schedule: 40+ hours per week
Pay Range: $43.01–$55.62/hour
Work Authorization: US Citizen or US Permanent Resident (Green Card Holder)

Position Summary

We are seeking an Optical Measurements Systems Engineer to join the Corning Environmental Technologies (CET) Engineering Measurements & Controls group. This engineer will be responsible for the development, assembly, testing, integration, and deployment of optical and computer vision-based measurement systems supporting the metrology, inspection, and testing of CET products.

The position will work closely with cross-functional teams and external suppliers to transition measurement technologies from early-stage development into reliable manufacturing systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement optical and computer vision-based measurement and instrumentation systems.
  • Collaborate with Development, Quality, IT, Purchasing, and Operations teams to define system requirements and solutions.
  • Transfer technology from development into manufacturing.
  • Partner with external suppliers and system integrators to implement key technologies.
  • Develop scopes of work, obtain competitive quotes, issue purchase orders, track supplier activities, and approve invoices.
  • Design experiments and analyze data to improve measurement systems and production processes.
  • Create and maintain production documentation, including machine specifications, operating procedures, and drawing packages.
  • Train engineering, maintenance, and operations personnel on the use and maintenance of measurement systems.
  • Provide onsite and remote troubleshooting using system performance data and analysis.
  • Support system checkout, installation, integration, and deployment.

Required Qualifications

  • BS or MS degree in Optics, Physics, Electrical Engineering, or Computer Engineering with 3+ years of hands-on experience with machine vision and metrology equipment; OR
  • PhD in one of the above disciplines.
  • Hands-on experience with vision systems is required.
  • Experience developing optical measurement systems involving cameras, lighting, image acquisition, image analysis, lasers, and/or 3D measurement.
  • Fundamental understanding of physical optics.
  • Knowledge of image-processing techniques such as blob analysis, edge finding, morphology, feature extraction, classification, and metrology.
  • Experience with Microsoft Visual Studio; C# and Python strongly preferred.
  • Experience with systems engineering and integration.
  • Knowledge of digital signal processing.
  • Experience with electrical, optical, and mechanical installations, system checkout, and troubleshooting.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and Microsoft Office skills.
  • Experience retrieving, plotting, and analyzing data, primarily using Microsoft Excel.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Halcon, Matrox Inspector, NI Vision, Cognex, Keyence, or MATLAB Image Processing Toolbox.
  • PLC and control systems experience.
  • Process engineering experience, including DOE, statistical analysis, and process improvement.
  • Experience with manufacturing metrology, inspection, and product quality.
  • Motion-control integration for imaging platforms.
  • Experience with high-performance computing systems.
  • Experience with 3D transformations, topography, point clouds, surface meshes, and 3D registration.
  • Experience developing automated 3D metrology and inspection solutions.
  • Familiarity with machine learning and deep learning theory.
  • Experience designing or deploying machine learning/deep learning models.

What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate is a hands-on engineer with strong experience in machine vision, optical measurement systems, image processing, metrology, and systems integration. The successful candidate will be comfortable working across engineering and manufacturing environments, troubleshooting complex systems, analyzing data, and transitioning new technologies into production.

Strong communication skills, independence, adaptability, problem-solving ability, and the ability to manage multiple priorities are essential.

Work Authorization: Candidates must be a US Citizen or US Permanent Resident (Green Card Holder).

job.title: Quality Engineer
job.description:
Quality Engineer

Key Responsibilities

  • Maintain and continuously improve the Quality Management System (QMS).
  • Manage the internal audit process to ensure QMS compliance.
  • Create, collect, analyze, and maintain company performance metrics, including on-time delivery, non-conformances, and supplier defects; report results to the broader organization.
  • Ensure inspection and quality-control equipment meets required standards and recommend improvements to procedures, processes, standards, and equipment.
  • Compile and maintain inspection reports and quality records.
  • Perform root-cause analysis, collaborate with Engineering, and advise other departments on corrective measures.
  • Develop and implement corrective and preventive action plans to address quality issues and prevent recurrence.
  • Interface with customer and government quality representatives regarding audits, corrective actions, acceptance testing, and other quality-related matters.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure quality standards are met throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Support quality inspections to ensure the efficient processing of parts and maintain manufacturing production lines.
  • Develop, maintain, and deploy quality plans and activities that translate customer requirements into actionable quality requirements.
  • Analyze quality program requirements and prepare quality plans, procedures, and schedules to ensure effective quality support and compliance.
  • Provide training and guidance to team members on quality-control procedures and best practices.
  • Maintain documentation and records related to quality-control activities.
  • Ensure compliance with Quality Management System procedures.
  • Perform other duties as requested, directed, or assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.
  • 3–5 years of experience in Quality Engineering or Quality Management.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Ability to read and interpret complex technical drawings.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Self-starter who can work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Must be a U.S. Person or a non-U.S. Person eligible to obtain any required Export Authorization.

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience with inspection, quality control, and quality assurance methods, techniques, and equipment.
  • Familiarity with AS9100/ISO 9100 requirements.
  • Knowledge of statistical quality-control techniques.

Physical Requirements

job.description:
Accounts Payable Specialist (Part-Time)
Compensation: $21.90 – $25.00 per hour
Schedule: Part-time, 20 hours per week
Location: Albany, NY

Schedule Details
This position requires availability on Thursdays, with the remaining hours scheduled flexibly throughout Monday–Friday, between 8:00 AM and 4:00 PM, based on departmental and business needs.

Position Overview
Our client is seeking a detail-oriented and organized Accounts Payable Specialist to join its Finance Department on a part-time basis. Reporting to the Finance Manager, this individual will be responsible for managing day-to-day accounts payable functions, processing vendor invoices and payments, maintaining accurate financial records, and providing general accounting support.
The ideal candidate will have a background in accounting or bookkeeping, strong attention to detail, and the ability to manage financial transactions accurately and efficiently. job.title: Industrial Maintenance Mechanic
job.description:
Now hiring for a Industrial Maintenance Mechanic please see job details below.

Schedule - 1st shift- Mon thru Fri- 7:30am till 4pm

Job details-

  • Experience in pneumatics, hydraulics and electrical componentry.
  • Looking for three-phase power Experience
  • Maintenance Technician Job Description: Top Duties and Qualifications

Job Description-
A Maintenance Technician, or Maintenance Mechanic, is in charge of performing ongoing facility maintenance and completing repairs on equipment. Their duties include fixing machinery, plumbing, heating and wiring, inspecting buildings to confirm safety standards and scheduling major repairs with the building's inhabitants.

  • Performing routine maintenance around the building such as fixing structural damage, for example, window, door or wall repair
  • Repairing broken or leaking plumbing to avoid water damage and restore full use of water fixtures
  • Working on damaged electrical wiring when a shortage or severed wire occurs
  • Maintaining/repairing facility and various shop equipment (i.e. welders, torches, overhead cranes, press brakes, shears, saws, plate rolls, turning rolls, fiberglass, paint, sandblast eqt.)
  • Maintaining the building HVAC equipment in order to keep climate control in the facility functioning properly
  • Applying preventative measures to the building to reduce the risk of future problems, such as using a sealant on a flat roof
  • Fixing potential safety hazards to avoid injuries
What does a Industrial Maintenance Technician do?
Maintenance Technicians are hired by facility owners to oversee the general upkeep of the building and its infrastructure. Their role is to maintain building operations and ensure that the facilities are safe and functional at all times. They manage routine maintenance and emergency repairs to prevent and resolve safety or comfort issues. Maintenance technicians install new equipment and oversee building upgrades according to owner requests and to preserve the facility.

Maintenance Technician skills and qualifications:
A Maintenance Technician requires a diverse mix of both hard and soft skills, particularly manual labor skills, including:
  • Plumbing knowledge to address leaks, clogs or other drainage problems
  • Electrical wiring capabilities to manage problems with the building's electricity
  • Carpentry ability to handle basic repairs around the building
  • Interpersonal skills to interact with employees or residents of the building in a pleasant manner
  • Attention to detail to ensure that all jobs are completed in an exemplary manner and any potential hazards or warning signs of problems are not overlooked
  • Physical stamina to handle a full shift of being active and working on the building

job.title: Lab Tech - I (Assistant)
job.description:
We are seeking an entry-level Laboratory Technician to support the production of veterinary products in a regulated manufacturing environment. This position will perform laboratory and cell culture-related activities while strictly following Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), aseptic techniques, and safety requirements.

The ideal candidate will have laboratory, biotechnology, pharmaceutical, manufacturing, or scientific experience. Cell culture, vaccine, cleanroom, and SAP experience are highly beneficial.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform laboratory and manufacturing procedures supporting veterinary product production.
  • Perform aseptic techniques, media preparation, antigen inoculation and harvest, tissue/cell culture preparation and harvest, and vaccine filling.
  • Set up and operate laboratory and production equipment.
  • Use equipment such as pH meters, UniFuge, and other laboratory instruments.
  • Prepare, clean, and sterilize glassware, equipment, and work areas.
  • Follow GMP requirements, SOPs, safety procedures, and company policies.
  • Maintain accurate charts, logbooks, production records, and other required documentation.
  • Communicate unusual or non-routine occurrences to department supervision.
  • Support equipment cleaning and preparation throughout the manufacturing process.
  • Work with embryonic eggs used for virus propagation.
  • Handle laboratory chemicals and disinfectants in accordance with established safety procedures.
  • Work collaboratively with production and laboratory personnel to maintain quality and production schedules.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree OR High School Diploma/GED with commensurate experience.
  • GMP experience required.
  • Experience working in an aseptic, cleanroom, laboratory, pharmaceutical, biotech, or regulated manufacturing environment.
  • Ability to accurately read and follow detailed SOPs and work instructions.
  • Prior SAP experience.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills.
  • Ability to successfully complete a physical abilities assessment before starting onsite.
  • Ability to work a 4 10-hour-day schedule.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Cell culture experience.
  • Vaccine or biological product manufacturing experience.
  • Scientific or biotechnology background.
  • Experience using pH meters, UniFuge, and laboratory equipment.
  • Veterinary pharmaceutical or biological manufacturing experience.
  • Previous experience working with aseptic processing or cleanroom procedures.

Work Environment

This position operates in a GMP-regulated laboratory/manufacturing environment and requires strict adherence to aseptic procedures, safety protocols, and SOPs. The role may involve exposure to materials including isopropyl alcohol, hydrogen peroxide, phenolic disinfectants, and oxidizers.

Ideal candidate: A junior-level lab or manufacturing professional with GMP + aseptic/cleanroom experience, strong documentation skills, and the ability to work hands-on in a regulated production environment.

Duration: 12 months with potential for permanent hire

Why Join Our Client:
Working with this organization provides a unique opportunity to contribute to meaningful work that positively impacts communities by addressing social determinants of health. As a mission-driven company focused on improving access to care and supporting underserved populations, they are committed to fostering strong, community-based partnerships and delivering innovative solutions to complex health challenges. You’ll be part of a passionate, collaborative team dedicated to making a difference in people’s lives, all while working in an environment that values personal growth, diversity, and inclusion.

Description:
Our client is seeking a Finance Liaison to join its finance team. This person is responsible for working directly with network partners to ensure successful implementation and execution of billing requirements under New York’s Medicaid Waiver Amendment.  
 
This is a unique opportunity to work mostly remotely—4 days per week from home and 1 day per week in the office. If you have a passion for healthcare billing and want to contribute to meaningful work, this role could be perfect for you!
 
What You’ll Do:

  • Collaborate with internal cross-functional teams to meet partner needs and ensure positive partner experience.  
  • Hold monthly check-in meetings with partners’ finance point of contact. 
  • Identify partner needs and connect to appropriate stakeholders.

  • Track and communicate monthly partner financial performance to internal and external stakeholders. 
  • Exercise discretion and professional judgement to maintain project-specific timelines and communicate project expectations and timelines with internal and external stakeholders. 
  • Maintain current knowledge and understanding of Medicaid and local transformation.

  • 2 years of healthcare claims billing experience
  • Medicaid knowledge preferred.
  • Strong communication skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and solve problems effectively.
  • Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion.

The Senior Advanced Manufacturing Engineer applies technical expertise with responsibility for product and process application to ensure product integrity manufacturing output while leading continuous improvements, working with both labs and factory operations.

Our team develops new or modifies current processes, defines process equipment requirements and specifications, and reviews processing techniques and methods applied in the manufacture, fabrication, and evaluation of Ring Laser Gyroscopes (RLG). The Senior Advanced Manufacturing Engineer influences the planning and designing of manufacturing engineering processes by determining parts and tools needed by the team to achieve manufacturing goals according to product specification, for both existing and new processes/product technologies. This role strives to maximize efficiency by analyzing the layout of equipment, workflow, assembly methods, and work force utilization. Senior Advanced Manufacturing Engineer supports daily production activities and drives producibility improvement projects in a challenging environment. This position will focus on return goods diagnosis, processing, and re-shipment manufacturing.

Key Responsibilities:
Provide manufacturing support for RLGs, specifically glass machining.
Perform yield and performance data analysis to monitor process capability and product health trends.
Utilize CAMP, Lean, and Six-Sigma methodologies to govern engineering standard work practices.
Investigate and resolve technical issues, facilitate issue identification and analysis.
Develop improvements in product design and in the manufacturing and assembly processes for cost and cycle time reductions.
Support knowledge for test equipment and preventative maintenance plans to maintain factory capacity and efficient product flow.
Facilitate a self-driven work force culture to achieve RTY, BIQ, COPQ, and other SQDIC goals.
Test products & software
Complete failure analysis, manufacturing assembly, and test on returned goods

YOU MUST HAVE:
Bachelor's Degree in STEM field
5+ years experience; manufacturing, test, fabrication, or assembly processes
Must be a U.S person

WE VALUE:
Product, process, manufacturing, or test engineering experience.
Ability to balance priorities in daily tasks and strategic projects.
Hands on work ethic. Initiative and ownership of responsibilities and actions.
Ability to partner and collaborate well with team members.
Quickly and accurately identifying subtle interrelationships and patterns among a variety of problems and issues (process and data correlation of cause/effect across value stream).
Conveying information with clarity and directness, ensuring the message is understood across diverse teams.
Knowledge of RCCA, Lean, Six Sigma, and FMEA tools and methodologies.

job.title: Sr. Network Engineer - (IT/OT)
job.description:
Must be US Citizens or Permanent Resident (Green Card holder)

Overview
Client is seeking a Senior Network Engineer to architect, deploy, support, and optimize IT and OT network solutions for a mission-critical semiconductor manufacturing environment in Richardson, Texas. This role partners with cross-functional engineering and operations teams to develop infrastructure that supports manufacturing automation, equipment integration, and business operations.
The position is responsible for operational support of manufacturing and site network infrastructure across physical and virtual environments. The engineer will work primarily with Cisco technologies, support LAN, WLAN, and IoT communications, assist with authentication model migration initiatives, and help deploy secure Special Use Networks (SUN) to protect critical manufacturing systems.

Core Responsibilities
• Provide operational support for on-premises network infrastructure spanning SD-WAN-based enterprise networks through sensor-level communications supporting manufacturing environments.
• Collaborate with process, equipment, and advanced manufacturing engineering teams to enable network-level equipment integration and automation.
• Design, develop, and deploy Special Use Networks (SUN) to segment and isolate mission-critical manufacturing operations from enterprise networks.
• Troubleshoot network performance issues across IT and OT environments to ensure reliable and secure communications.
• Support the implementation and rollout of network technologies including switches, firewalls, wireless infrastructure, and monitoring tools.
• Participate in cross-functional troubleshooting and support activities involving equipment, applications, and infrastructure communications.
• Attend daily operational meetings to provide network support, issue updates, and status reporting.
• Partner with Corporate IT and Global Security teams to maintain compliance with cybersecurity standards and network security requirements.
• Maintain network documentation including topology diagrams, configuration records, and change management logs.
• Ensure network resilience, redundancy, high availability, performance monitoring, and capacity
management through proactive maintenance and operational oversight.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies
• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology or a related field.
• 5+ years of experience supporting enterprise and industrial network infrastructure within manufacturing or site environments.
• Hands-on experience with Cisco networking and routing equipment.
• Strong background supporting factory floor networking (Level 2/3 OT) and integration with IT networks (Level 3.5/4).
• Proficiency with firewall configuration, VPN setup, VLANs, subnetting, IP addressing, DNS, DHCP, NAT, routing, and switching.
• Experience with high availability, redundancy, and Quality of Service (QoS) protocols.
• Experience with network segmentation, resilience strategies, and disaster recovery planning.
• Familiarity with DevOps network operations, including CI/CD integration for network changes, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), monitoring and alerting pipelines, version control, and automated deployment practices.
• 2+ years of experience with PowerShell scripting.
• 1+ years of experience using service management platforms such as ServiceNow.
• Strong documentation skills for network architecture, automation scripts, and system configurations.

Preferred Skills or Experience
• Advanced degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
• Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA) certification or equivalent.
• Experience with multi-vendor networking environments including Cisco, Arista, Dell, and Palo Alto technologies.
• Experience with network patching tools such as Tanium and CHEF, along with security hardening practices for network devices and operating systems.
• Experience supporting data protection and recovery platforms such as Rubrik, Veeam, Commvault, or Zerto.
• Strong understanding of IT/OT convergence, including industrial protocols, SCADA systems, MES platforms, equipment integration, and manufacturing-focused Windows-based PCs and servers.
• Knowledge of industrial network architectures including layered models, DMZs, secure remote access solutions, and redundant topologies.
• Demonstrated ability to drive process improvements, organizational change, and cross-functional collaboration.
• Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills with the ability to engage stakeholders at all levels.
• Strong problem-solving and solution design capabilities.
• Ability to work independently with minimal supervision in a fast-paced environment.

Work Details
• Richardson, Texas.
• Primarily onsite
• Must be a U.S. Citizen or Permanent Resident (Green Card holder).

job.title: Data Analyst/Scientist
job.description:
A major client of ours has a need for a Data Analyst/Scientist. This is a long-term contract (Potentially 2 years) and the position is remote but EST/CST is preferred.

Position Overview

We are seeking a Data Analyst/Scientist to support a Customer Analytics and Digital Products team within a large utility organization. This role will analyze large-scale utility and customer datasets, identify trends and data quality issues, develop dashboards and reporting, and provide actionable insights that support customer-facing digital products and business initiatives.

The ideal candidate has meaningful utility industry and AMI (Advanced Metering Infrastructure) data experience, strong analytical and data validation skills, and the ability to translate complex technical findings into clear business recommendations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze large utility datasets, including AMI usage, Customer Care & Billing (CC&B), and customer engagement data.
  • Review and validate data extracts, vendor dashboards, and multi-source datasets for data quality issues, anomalies, trends, and common themes.
  • Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports, visualizations, and recurring reporting to track key business and customer metrics.
  • Analyze customer engagement, product performance, billing outcomes, and other key performance indicators.
  • Support customer-facing digital products, including rate recommendation and bill comparison tools, using historical usage and billing data.
  • Track and analyze website and digital product engagement, including page views, clicks, and customer interactions.
  • Partner with Product Owners, engineers, business SMEs, and other stakeholders to support data integrations, testing, validation, and product enhancements.
  • Investigate data discrepancies and anomalies and help identify root causes and potential solutions.
  • Translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable insights and recommendations for both technical and business stakeholders.
  • Manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail in a regulated utility environment.

Required Qualifications & Critical Skills

  • 2+ years of professional data analysis experience, including experience analyzing large data extracts or datasets.
  • Hands-on utility industry and AMI data experience is required. Candidates without meaningful utility and AMI experience should not be submitted.
  • Fundamental understanding of utility customer usage data and related business processes.
  • Strong experience identifying trends, anomalies, common themes, and data quality issues within large datasets.
  • Hands-on experience with Power BI for dashboards, reporting, and data visualization.
  • Experience working with large, multi-source datasets, including Databricks or comparable data platforms.
  • Strong data validation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to work effectively in a regulated environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with technical and business stakeholders and translate technical findings into clear business recommendations.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently in a project-focused environment.
  • Bachelor’s degree required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Customer Care & Billing (CC&B) data and tools.
  • Experience with Google Analytics or similar digital engagement analytics platforms.
  • Experience analyzing website and digital product engagement, including page views, clicks, and customer interactions.
  • Experience developing dashboards, recurring reports, data visualizations, and analytics supporting customer-facing digital products.
  • Experience supporting data integrations, testing, validation, and product improvement initiatives within a utility environment.

Technology Requirements

Must Have

  • AMI / Advanced Metering Infrastructure data
  • Utility usage data
  • Power BI
  • Databricks and/or experience working with large, multi-source datasets

Nice to Have

  • Customer Care & Billing (CC&B)
  • Google Analytics
  • Digital engagement analytics
  • Customer-facing digital product analytics
  • Dashboard and visualization development

Success in This Role

Success in this role will be demonstrated by the ability to:

  • Deliver accurate, actionable analysis of complex utility and customer datasets.
  • Identify and communicate meaningful trends, anomalies, and data quality issues.
  • Develop clear dashboards and visualizations that enable stakeholders to understand key metrics.
  • Support reliable data integrations, testing, and validation for customer-facing digital products.
  • Collaborate effectively with Product Owners, engineers, and business stakeholders.
  • Turn complex data findings into practical recommendations that improve products, processes, and customer experiences.

job.title: Full Stack Engineer (Infrastructure & Kubernetes)
job.description:
Overview
Client is seeking a Full Stack Engineer to architect, deploy, and support information technology (IT) and operational technology (OT) solutions for a mission-critical manufacturing site in Richardson, Texas. This role partners with cross-functional teams to design, develop, and deploy infrastructure and software solutions that support semiconductor manufacturing and business operations.
The position focuses on operational support of virtual and physical server infrastructure, VMware environments, Windows and Linux server administration, and Kubernetes-based container platforms. The engineer will help deploy and support advanced automation, equipment integration, fault detection, and process control solutions within a highly available manufacturing environment.

Core Responsibilities
• Provide operational support for on-premises server infrastructure, including both physical and virtualized environments, while maintaining alignment with corporate standards and 24x7 site requirements.
• Support and administer VMware technologies, including vSphere, vSAN, VCF/NSX, and hyper-converged infrastructure platforms such as Dell VxRail.
• Deploy, manage, and support Kubernetes and Docker-based container environments in production.
• Troubleshoot performance issues across physical and virtual server workloads and implement solutions to improve reliability and efficiency.
• Facilitate deployment of new technology stacks and migrate workloads from physical servers to virtualized platforms where appropriate.
• Collaborate with semiconductor process and equipment vendors to optimize infrastructure performance and fault tolerance.
• Participate in site and corporate meetings to resolve application, infrastructure, and operational issues.
• Engage with manufacturing operations and factory systems teams through daily support and coordination activities.
• Partner with corporate IT and security teams to maintain infrastructure in accordance with cybersecurity standards and requirements.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies
• U.S. Citizen or Permanent Resident (Green Card holder).
• Bachelor’s degree.
• 5+ years of experience supporting enterprise server ecosystems in an operational environment.
• 5+ years of experience administering Windows Server operating systems and Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) versions 5 through 9.x.
• 3+ years of experience with ServiceNow or a comparable formal service management platform and/or methodology.
• 3+ years of experience with virtualization technologies including VMware, vSAN, vSphere, and VCF/NSX.
• Demonstrated hands-on experience implementing and managing Kubernetes in production environments. Candidates with only academic, lab, training, or tutorial-based Kubernetes exposure will not be considered sufficient.
• 1+ year of experience with Docker and Kubernetes for container orchestration.
• Experience with server automation and/or infrastructure-as-code technologies such as Tanium, CHEF, JSON, PowerShell, Ruby, or other scripting languages.
• Experience with networking fundamentals, including firewall configuration, VPNs, VLANs, subnetting, IP addressing, DNS, DHCP, NAT, routing, and switching.
• Experience with backup, disaster recovery, and technology resilience strategies and processes.
• Ability to document infrastructure, automation scripts, and system configurations to support maintainability and operational continuity.

Preferred Skills or Experience
• Advanced degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
• Experience with Windows patching tools such as Tanium, Windows security standards, and operating system hardening practices.
• Experience across the software development lifecycle, including requirements gathering, design, development, testing, and production support.
• Experience supporting network infrastructure, including Cisco Nexus and Catalyst switches.
• Experience supporting data recovery platforms such as Rubrik.
• Experience supporting IT/OT systems and applications, including network implementation and segmentation, equipment integration, automation, and manufacturing execution systems (MES).
• Understanding of SCADA environments, manufacturing-focused Windows-based PCs and servers, and industrial network architectures.
• Ability to drive positive organizational change and effectively collaborate with stakeholders at all levels.
• Strong oral, written, and collaborative communication skills.
• Demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

Work Details
• Richardson, Texas. (Onsite)

job.title: CAD Drafter – Industrial / Structural
job.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a CAD Drafter to create and modify detailed technical and engineering drawings for customized industrial equipment and structural systems. This position will work closely with engineering, manufacturing, project management, and field installation teams to develop accurate drawings that support fabrication and installation.

The ideal candidate will have experience with AutoCAD, SolidWorks, or similar CAD software and a background in structural, mechanical, fabrication, material handling, or industrial equipment design.

Responsibilities

  • Create and modify detailed 2D and 3D CAD drawings for industrial equipment and structural systems.
  • Prepare layout, fabrication, assembly, and installation drawings based on engineering concepts and project requirements.
  • Interpret engineering specifications, sketches, field measurements, and design concepts.
  • Develop drawings involving structural components, building interfaces, equipment layouts, and fabrication details.
  • Review drawings for accuracy, dimensions, completeness, and compliance with applicable standards.
  • Revise existing drawings based on engineering changes, field conditions, and project feedback.
  • Collaborate with engineers, project managers, manufacturing personnel, and installation teams to resolve design and drafting issues.
  • Maintain organized drawing files, revisions, and technical documentation.
  • Support project schedules by completing drawings and revisions within established deadlines.
  • Follow applicable company, industry, and safety standards.
  • Assist with continuous improvement of drafting and design processes.

Qualifications

  • Experience producing technical and engineering drawings for industrial equipment, structural systems, fabrication, or related applications.
  • Proficiency with AutoCAD, SolidWorks, or similar CAD/design software.
  • Strong understanding of 2D drafting; experience with 3D modeling is preferred.
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, layouts, specifications, and structural details.
  • Working knowledge of mechanical and/or structural engineering principles.
  • Experience with overhead cranes, material handling equipment, structural steel, fabrication, or industrial machinery is highly desirable.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to produce accurate drawings.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, revisions, and deadlines.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with engineering, manufacturing, and field personnel.
  • Associate degree or technical diploma in Drafting, CAD, Engineering Technology, Mechanical Design, or a related discipline preferred; equivalent relevant experience will also be considered.
  • Familiarity with OSHA requirements or industrial safety standards is a plus.

job.title: IT Project Coordinator (Remote)
job.description:
Overview
The IT Project Coordinator supports the IT Project Management Office and works closely with business stakeholders, developers, data scientists, analysts, and domain experts to deliver IT solutions that meet business needs. This role plays a key part in supporting enterprise digital transformation initiatives through effective project coordination, quality governance, and testing activities.
The successful candidate will support Project Managers while coordinating project quality, SDLC compliance, testing execution, documentation, and stakeholder communication across Agile and traditional project environments. Strong collaboration, organization, facilitation, and attention to detail are critical to success in this role.

Core Responsibilities
• Support Project Managers with project quality plans, schedules, test status reporting, stage-gate presentations, and overall project coordination activities.
• Coordinate project quality and testing activities across business teams, technical teams, vendor partners, and stakeholders.
• Monitor and report project dependencies, risks, issues, impacts, and compliance requirements.
• Maintain project documentation, approvals, quality artifacts, testing evidence, and audit-ready records within designated repositories.
• Serve as the SDLC and QA subject matter expert for assigned projects across Agile and traditional delivery methodologies.
• Develop and maintain quality plans, quality documentation, testing deliverables, quality metrics, and required project approvals.
• Ensure adherence to SDLC, QA, Agile delivery standards, regulatory requirements, and applicable SOX controls.
• Lead quality reviews, inspections, peer review meetings, testing activities, and release-readiness assessments.
• Manage end-to-end testing activities, including system, integration, regression, performance, and user acceptance testing (UAT).
• Develop test approaches, test plans, test schedules, testing strategies, success metrics, and entry and exit criteria.
• Facilitate test scenario and test script development and lead testing kickoff and defect review meetings.
• Manage the complete defect lifecycle, including triage, prioritization, tracking, retesting, reporting, and closure.
• Coordinate performance testing activities, including workload modeling, execution planning, environment readiness, monitoring, analysis, and remediation support.
• Create, maintain, and execute OpenText LoadRunner performance and load-testing scripts and analyze testing results.
• Prepare and communicate quality metrics, testing status, compliance updates, risks, issues, audit readiness, and performance testing outcomes to stakeholders and leadership.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, or an equivalent technical field.
• Minimum of 5–10+ years of experience working as an IT project team member. Quality Analyst experience preferred.
• Strong meeting facilitation skills.
• Experience serving as a test lead and coordinating testing efforts between IT and business teams, including automated performance testing initiatives.
• Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify project risks and support decision-making through risk analysis.
• Proven leadership and collaboration skills.
• Ability to adapt to changing priorities, manage multiple project assignments simultaneously, and succeed in a fast-paced environment.
• Ability to manage workload, establish priorities, and work effectively with minimal supervision.
• Exceptional written, verbal, presentation, and stakeholder communication skills.
• Strong critical thinking, conflict resolution, organizational, and teamwork skills.
• Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Teams.
• Experience developing test approach documentation for Agile and traditional project environments.
• Working knowledge of SDLC governance, quality assurance, testing processes, compliance requirements, and regulatory controls, including SOX.
• Hands-on experience with OpenText LoadRunner, including Virtual User Generator scripting, parameterization, correlation, test scenario configuration, execution, monitoring, and results analysis.

Preferred Skills or Experience
• Project management methodology certification.
• Agile methodology certification.
• Experience with OpenText ALM (Quality Center).
• Experience applying SDLC methodologies such as Waterfall, Agile, and Iterative delivery within enterprise IT environments.
• Experience with OpenText LoadRunner Cloud and Virtual User Generator scripting tools.
• Experience using Planview tools, including AgilePlace, ProjectPlace, and Portfolio.
• Experience creating Power BI reports.
• Knowledge of Planview, GitLab, Confluence, and related Agile tools.
• Experience with automated testing tools and processes.
• Introductory Scrum or Agile certifications or training.
• Knowledge of AI tools and agents.

Work Details
• Remote; open to candidates throughout the United States. Candidates located near Rochester, NY or Charlotte, NC are preferred.
• Full-time schedule, Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern Time. Some flexibility may be required to support collaboration with global teams.
• One-round panel video interview process.
• This position does not support immigration sponsorship.
• Opportunity for extension based on business demand.

job.description:

Andover, MA 01810
Engineering

About the Role

We’re looking for a hands-on Senior Engineering Aide to support advanced power electronics testing in a dynamic lab environment.

  • You’ll work directly with engineers to evaluate DC-DC and AC-DC power supply performance, build and refine test setups, and help drive product validation from concept to qualification.
