job.title: Production Supervisor
job.description:
Lead the Team. Drive Production. Make an Impact.

We are looking for an experienced Production Supervisor to lead a team of approximately 8–15 employees in a fast-paced manufacturing environment producing high-quality consumables.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who enjoys being on the floor, working alongside their team, solving problems, and making sure production stays on track. As the direct link between management and the production team, the Supervisor will set the tone for the department, support employee development, and ensure that safety, quality, and productivity remain top priorities.

The ideal candidate is a dependable, confident leader who knows how to hold people accountable while creating a positive, hardworking team environment.

What You'll Do

  • Lead, motivate, and support a team of 8–15 production employees, creating a positive and productive work environment.
  • Serve as a role model for safety, quality, attendance, teamwork, and work ethic.
  • Assign daily responsibilities and ensure team members have the resources and direction needed to be successful.
  • Oversee employee training and ensure team members understand and follow established processes and procedures.
  • Maintain strong knowledge of department processes and conduct annual reviews of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  • Ensure compliance with company policies and all applicable safety, cGMP, and SOP requirements.
  • Develop weekly production schedules and keep the team focused on meeting production goals and deadlines.
  • Monitor production throughout the day, identify potential issues early, and take action to keep things moving.
  • Identify opportunities to improve processes, efficiency, quality, and productivity, and communicate recommendations to management.
  • Monitor material inventory and submit requests for materials as needed.
  • Provide day-to-day coaching and feedback to employees and assist management with performance evaluations, progress reports, and disciplinary matters.
  • Communicate effectively with both employees and management, keeping everyone informed of important production, staffing, and operational issues.
  • Step in and help solve problems when challenges arise—because successful production takes a team effort.

What We're Looking For

  • A proven leader who can earn the respect of a production team and hold employees accountable.
  • Strong judgment, initiative, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to give clear direction.
  • A dependable, hands-on approach with a strong sense of urgency.
  • High integrity and a commitment to doing things the right way.
  • Ability to balance people, production, safety, and quality in a busy manufacturing environment.
  • Flexibility to work overtime during the week and Saturdays as business needs require.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED required; Associate or Bachelor's degree preferred.
  • Minimum of 4 years of manufacturing supervisory experience.
  • Experience in a regulated manufacturing environment, food/beverage processing, pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, or similar industry is highly desirable.
  • Basic computer skills required.

Why This Role Matters

As Production Supervisor, you'll have a direct impact on the people, processes, and products that keep the operation running. You'll have the opportunity to develop employees, improve production processes, and help ensure that customers receive safe, consistent, high-quality nutritional products.

If you're a hands-on leader who enjoys building strong teams and making things better every day, we'd like to hear from you.

Machine Operator Job Description

Job Title: Machine Operator

Department: Production / Operations

Reports To: Production Supervisor / Operations Manager

Location: Elyria, Ohio

Job Type: Full-Time [Shift: 1st / 2nd / 3rd Shift]

Job Summary

We are seeking a reliable and detail-oriented Machine Operator to join our production team in Elyria, Ohio . In this role, you will be responsible for setting up, operating, and maintaining industrial machinery to manufacture high-quality products according to specifications. The ideal candidate has strong mechanical aptitude, places a high priority on safety, and works well in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Machine Operation: Set up, calibrate, and operate equipment [e.g., CNC machines, press brakes, extruders, stamping presses, packaging machinery] according to production schedules and specifications.

  • Quality Control: Inspect raw materials and finished parts using precision measuring tools [e.g., calipers, micrometers, gauges] to ensure they meet quality standards and engineering drawings.

  • Setup & Adjustments: Adjust machine settings, tooling, feeds, and speeds to optimize efficiency and product accuracy.

  • Routine Maintenance: Perform basic preventive maintenance, cleaning, and lubrication on assigned machines; troubleshoot minor operational issues.

  • Safety & Compliance: Adhere strictly to company safety protocols, OSHA guidelines, Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) requirements, and Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures.

  • Documentation: Maintain accurate production logs, material tracking, scrap counts, and quality control reports.

  • Team Collaboration: Communicate effectively with shift supervisors, quality assurance teams, and maintenance staff to keep operations running smoothly.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Education: High School Diploma, GED, or equivalent vocational training.

  • Experience: [1–3+] years of experience operating machinery in a manufacturing or industrial setting preferred.

  • Technical Skills:

    • Ability to read blueprints, work instructions, and technical documentation.

    • Familiarity with standard measuring devices [calipers, micrometers, tape measures] .

    • Basic shop math and basic computer entry skills.

  • Physical Requirements:

    • Ability to stand, bend, reach, and lift up to [50 lbs] periodically throughout an 8- to 12-hour shift.

    • Good hand-eye coordination, manual dexterity, and close-up visual acuity.

  • Work Ethic: High attention to detail, strong punctuality, safety-first mindset, and ability to work effectively in a team environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in automotive, metal fabrication, plastics, or heavy manufacturing equipment.

  • Valid Forklift / Material Handling Certification.

  • Prior experience with [specific machine brand/controller, e.g., Haas, Fanuc, Allen-Bradley] .

job.title: Windows Endpoint Engineer
job.description:
Overview
Client is seeking a Windows Client Engineer to manage and modernize its Windows endpoint environment through Microsoft Intune and SCCM (Configuration Manager), with a primary focus on reducing vulnerability risk. This hands-on role partners closely with security teams to analyze vulnerability findings, develop remediation solutions, and deploy fixes across the enterprise.
The ideal candidate will have strong experience with Windows endpoint administration, endpoint vulnerability remediation, PowerShell scripting, and enterprise device management technologies. Success in this role requires the ability to investigate vulnerabilities, implement scalable fixes, and ensure compliance without disrupting end users.

Core Responsibilities
• Review vulnerabilities identified through Tenable tools and manage the endpoint remediation process from investigation through closure.
• Build, test, package, and deploy remediation solutions using Microsoft Intune and SCCM, including patches, application updates, configuration changes, registry modifications, and scripted fixes.
• Author and maintain PowerShell scripts for automation, detection, and remediation, including Intune proactive remediations and SCCM configuration items.
• Package and deploy third-party application updates through Intune, SCCM, or patch management tools.
• Manage Windows Update policies and patching processes using Windows Update for Business, WSUS, or SCCM software updates.
• Partner with vulnerability management and security teams to triage findings, validate remediation effectiveness, and identify false positives.
• Track remediation progress and provide reporting on compliance, patch coverage, and outstanding risks against established service levels.
• Maintain Windows configuration baselines and security hardening standards across endpoint devices.
• Support co-management, device onboarding, compliance policies, and conditional access initiatives within the endpoint management environment.
• Document remediation procedures and contribute to standardized, well-tested deployment practices.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies
• Bachelor's degree or higher.
• 3 to 5 years of experience engineering and administering Windows endpoints in an enterprise environment.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Windows Client and Server operating systems.
• Hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune and SCCM/Configuration Manager, including application packaging and deployment.
• Strong PowerShell scripting skills for automation, detection, and remediation.
• Experience with Windows patch management using Windows Update for Business, WSUS, or SCCM software updates.
• Experience performing endpoint and vulnerability remediation, including investigating findings and implementing corrective actions.
• Familiarity with vulnerability management concepts and tools, with Tenable experience strongly preferred and comparable platforms such as Qualys or Rapid7 considered relevant.
• Understanding of CVEs, CVSS scoring, and translating vulnerability findings into remediation activities.
• Knowledge of Windows operating systems, Active Directory, Group Policy, and Entra ID (Azure AD).
• Ability to carefully test, validate, and deploy changes while minimizing impact to end users.
• Demonstrated ability to work independently and proactively drive vulnerability investigation and remediation efforts.

Preferred Skills or Experience
• Experience with application packaging tools such as PSADT, PatchMyPC, MSI, or MSIX.
• Exposure to Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and Threat & Vulnerability Management integration.
• Knowledge of security hardening frameworks, including CIS Benchmarks and DISA STIGs.
• Relevant certifications such as Microsoft MD-102, SC-200, or CompTIA Security+.

Work Details
• Contract position.
• First shift schedule: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM.
• Interview required; an onsite visit is preferred but flexible.

job.title: Internal Communications Interim Program Coordinator
job.description:
Introduction to the Job

Our company brings together the most creative minds in science and technology to develop lithography machines that are key to producing faster, cheaper, more energy-efficient microchips. We design, develop, integrate, market, and service these advanced machines, enabling our customers—the world's leading chipmakers—to reduce the size and increase the functionality of their microchips. This, in turn, leads to smaller, more powerful consumer electronics.

Our headquarters are in Veldhoven, Netherlands, with 18 office locations around the United States, including main offices in Chandler, Arizona, San Jose and San Diego, California, Wilton, Connecticut, and Hillsboro, Oregon. For a company built on technology leadership, attracting and retaining talented people is business-critical. Our US Communications team contributes to achieving this goal by building the company's reputation and employer brand, communicating its strategy and achievements, and fostering employee engagement, pride, and connectedness.

In this role, you will support and execute San Diego site internal communications strategy to help achieve business objectives, ensure employee engagement, and strong alignment to business strategy and culture. You will be asked to support other site-specific or US-wide communications initiatives as needed. You will report to the Head of U.S. Internal Communications and work closely with the San Diego site Internal Communications Business Partner role.

This position requires access to controlled technology, as defined in the Export Administration Regulations (15 C.F.R. § 730, et seq.). Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to access such controlled technology prior to beginning work. Business demands may require us to proceed with candidates who are immediately eligible to access controlled technology.

Role and Responsibilities

You will be responsible for supporting communications programs that affect employees based in San Diego. Our US operations are home to more than 8,000 of our 44,000 global employees who design, manufacture, install, and service sophisticated lithography systems—high-tech equipment the size of a city bus that operates with nanometer accuracy and is used by all of the world's top chipmakers to make the chips in smartphones, laptops, data centers, as well as cars and airplanes.

This will be a hands-on role requiring you to support and execute communications programs and produce and publish content. This is an ideal position for a communications professional who seeks a broad spectrum of challenges. High affinity for technology is a must.

  • Partner with Internal Communications colleagues and others to ensure successful program implementation.
  • Provide hands-on logistics support for specific internal communications programs like All Employee Meetings, local iteration of global events, and campaigns.
  • Produce content for All Employee Meetings, global and local events, campaigns, department initiatives, and messaging.
  • Publish content across multiple channels (e.g., intranet, email, TV screen network, etc.).
  • Execute communication plans and strategies set by the San Diego ICBP for department-specific needs.
  • Provide logistics support for things like video planning and shoots or other big projects and initiatives.
  • Write articles and features that represent US accomplishments on the local and global channels.
  • Own the site-wide newsletter, The San Diego Monthly, for everything from content collection, story writing, distribution, and analytics.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Communications, Business, or other relevant field or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in internal communications in a corporate environment.
  • Experience working in integrated communications teams is a plus.

Skills

Working at the cutting edge of tech, you'll always have new challenges and new problems to solve—and working together is the only way to do that. You won't work in a silo. Instead, you'll be part of a creative, dynamic work environment where you'll collaborate with supportive colleagues. There is always space for creative and unique points of view. You'll have the flexibility and trust to choose how best to tackle tasks and solve problems.

  • Exceptional writing and communication skills; clear, concise, and professional. Secure grasp of spelling, grammar, writing mechanics, and punctuation.
  • Strong storytelling and editing skills. Conveys subtle, technical, or complex messages in writing.
  • Can learn and apply new information or skills quickly and effectively.
  • Self-motivated—demonstrates ownership and accountability and delivers on commitments with a sense of urgency and attention to detail.
  • Identifies bottlenecks (within scope) and drives improvements.
  • Work independently or as part of a team and follow through on assignments with minimal supervision.
  • Demonstrate open, clear, concise, and professional communication.
  • Ability to establish and maintain cooperative working relationships with manager, co-workers, and customers.
  • Hands-on multi-channel experience activated for optimum reach to targeted audiences.
  • Adjusts communication content and style to the audience and a diverse set of stakeholders.
  • Ability to support video projects by organizing shoot outline, storyboard, locations, scripts, and talent management.
  • Expert within PPT. Will be asked frequently to create or contribute to an effective and visually pleasing story.
  • Proficient with SharePoint for building well-organized sites to host local communications/site information.
  • Experience with or aptitude for learning digital tools like Microsoft Forms, Teams TownHall, email campaign system, and digital screen content system.
  • Interpersonal influence: builds trust and rapport with communications colleagues, business partners; pursues goals in a constructive and assertive way.
  • Proficient use of all Microsoft Office suite programs.

Other Information

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer that values and respects the importance of a diverse and inclusive workforce. It is the policy of the company to recruit, hire, train, and promote persons in all job titles without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, or gender identity. We recognize that diversity and inclusion is a driving force in the success of our company.

Position Overview

We are seeking a Quality Lab Technician to support product quality through hands-on inspection, sampling, testing, and quality control activities. This position will work in a manufacturing quality laboratory and will be responsible for performing routine product testing, incoming inspections, sample collection, and other quality-related activities.

The ideal candidate will have at least one year of experience working in a quality lab, manufacturing, inspection, or testing environment and be comfortable operating laboratory and measurement equipment while following established procedures.

  • Ability to accurately follow written procedures and testing protocols.

job.title: NDT Inspector II
job.description:
Job Description Breakdown

Position: NDT Inspector II – Direct Hire
Industry: Aerospace / Engine Components
Pay: $27–$32/hr, depending on experience
Employment: Direct Hire / RPO
Location: Not provided

Openings / Shifts:

  • 1st Shift: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM — 1 opening
  • 2nd Shift: Monday–Friday, 2:00 PM–10:00 PM — 1 opening
  • 3rd Shift: Sunday night–Friday morning, 10:00 PM–6:00 AM — 1 opening

What They're Looking For

The NDT Inspector II will perform Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) on commercial and military aircraft engine accessories, as well as land and marine engine accessories.

The primary inspection methods are:

  • Digital Radiography (RT/X-ray)
  • Fluorescent Penetrant Testing (PT/FPI)

Ideally, candidates will have experience with both RT and PT, but candidates with experience in only one method may still be considered. Candidates with only one method may be considered at the lower end of the pay range, depending on overall experience.

Key Responsibilities

  • Inspect hardware using approved NDT methods to ensure quality requirements are met.
  • Set up and calibrate NDT equipment.
  • Perform inspections and interpret/evaluate results.
  • Document inspection results in accordance with approved procedures.
  • Develop techniques/work instructions for digital RT and PT under Level III approval.
  • Understand applicable codes, standards, specifications and contractual requirements.
  • Provide guidance and/or supervision to Level I personnel and trainees.
  • Perform failure analysis, product development, R&D and production inspections.
  • Perform digital RT and CT inspections.
  • Reconstruct and compile inspection data.
  • Flex between NDT methods based on business needs.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma/GED or higher.
  • Must currently meet NAS-410 qualification requirements.
  • Must be eligible to certify as an NDT Level II in Radiographic Testing and Penetrant Testing.
  • Minimum documented experience/training:
    • Radiographic Testing: 1,600 hours of work experience + 80 hours formal training
    • Penetrant Testing/FPI: 400 hours of work experience + 32 hours formal training
  • Must pass required general, specific and practical examinations.
  • Must achieve required scores for Parker's Level II certification.
  • Must pass 20/25 near-vision examination at 16" ± 1" and color deficiency testing.
  • U.S. Citizen or U.S. Permanent Resident required.
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.

Preferred / Nice-to-Have

  • Welding experience/knowledge
  • Heat treating and brazing knowledge
  • Machining experience
  • Assembly experience
  • FAA Repair Station experience
  • Experience with both RT and PT
  • Digital radiography / CT experience

Key Recruiter Screening Item

Notes about the role: we do both X-ray (radiographic) and PT (penetrant testing) within our NDT department. Ideally, candidates will have some experience in both areas, but we are open to talking to those who maybe only have one or other, they will just be on the low end of the pay rate, maybe a little under depending on years of experience. One thing we do request of all candidates and will need to view before setting up a call will be their OJT records to confirm the number of hours experience they have. Since this is an industry standard, this is something they should hopefully be able to supply.

Candidates should provide their OJT/training records so the team can verify their documented NDT hours, particularly:

  • RT hours
  • PT/FPI hours
  • Formal training hours
  • Certification/qualification history

This is especially important because the experience requirements are tied to NAS-410 qualification standards.


U.S. Citizenship or U.S. Permanent Resident status required.

is dictated by the plant safety guidelines.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently exposed to wet and/or humid conditions, dust, fumes, airborne particles, chemical dust, and risk of electric shock, vibration, non-hazardous chemical agents and outside weather conditions. Regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts and fumes or airborne particles. The employee is frequently exposed to vibration. The employee is occasionally exposed to toxic or caustic chemicals and risk of electrical shock.

Manufacturing Plant
Other

job.title: Mold Operator
job.description:
Nesco Resource is hiring for a Molding Material Handler in Shelbyville, TN,
2nd shift - 3:00pm - 11:00 pm.

POSITION SUMMARY
The Molding Material Handler is responsible for supporting the daily execution of Molding operations by ensuring materials, equipment, and production areas are prepared, maintained, and aligned with operational requirements. This position supports the Molding Working Lead and department leadership in meeting safety, quality, productivity, and housekeeping expectations while helping maintain a consistent and efficient production flow.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Adhere to all company policies, procedures, safety standards, and regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain adequate material flow by filling hoppers and dryers in support of active production schedules.
  • Empty grinders and manage regrind material in accordance with department expectations.
  • Prepare upcoming production materials by pre-drying materials as required to support scheduled mold changes and production needs.
  • Clean material loaders, grinders, and related equipment during color changes, material changes, and mold changeovers.
  • Verify molding machines are clean, prepared, and ready for startup.
  • Confirm auxiliary equipment is properly positioned and available to support efficient startup and production continuity.
  • Maintain organization, cleanliness, and overall appearance of material storage and production areas.
  • Operate a forklift safely and responsibly when required to support material movement and production needs.
  • Move finished product to the appropriate inventory or staging location as directed.
  • Escalate safety, housekeeping, material, or equipment concerns to leadership in a timely manner.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned by the Working Lead, or management team.
  • Provide operational support and assume appropriate department responsibilities when the Working Lead is not present.

QUALIFICATIONS
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below represent the knowledge, skills, abilities, and experience required for the position. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES
  • Demonstrated mechanical aptitude and ability to work with production-related equipment.
  • Ability to understand, interpret, and follow written and verbal instructions.
  • Ability to learn, retain, and apply operational procedures and department expectations.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to respond quickly and effectively to operational needs.
  • Basic math skills required.
  • Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office applications preferred.
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a team-oriented manufacturing environment.
  • Ability to perform effectively in a fast-paced production environment with changing priorities.
  • Ability to lift to 50 pounds as required by the position.
  • Strong attention to detail with a focus on accuracy, consistency, and safety.
  • Willingness and availability to work extended hours and/or overtime as business needs require.
  • Ability to learn forklift operation; forklift certification or prior forklift experience preferred.
  • Minimum of one year of experience in injection molding material handling preferred.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE
Prior experience in injection molding material handling is preferred. Forklift certification or prior forklift experience is preferred; ability to learn forklift operation is required.

WORK ENVIRONMENT
This position operates in a manufacturing environment and requires regular interaction with molding, material handling, and production equipment. The employee is expected to follow all safety practices, wear required personal protective equipment, and maintain awareness of surrounding equipment, material movement, and production activity.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS
The physical requirements outlined below are representative of those necessary to successfully perform the essential functions of this position.
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is required to stand for the duration of the shift and must be able to bend, twist, push, pull, grasp, and lift material weighing up to 50 pounds or more as required. The employee is regularly required to communicate verbally and listen effectively. Specific vision abilities required include close vision and the ability to adjust focus. job.description:
Production Operator - 2nd shift 1:00PM - 11:30PM (Monday through Thursday) - possible Friday OT

Temp to Perm Position

General Summary:
Position is responsible for set up and operation of machinery to combine dry and/or liquid chemicals into customer products. Ensures the highest quality product at the lowest possible cost and meets customer specifications and delivery requirements in accordance with *** policies and procedures.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities
  • Demonstrates and meets qualifications on all Blending or Extrusion operational areas.
  • Demonstrates leadership and team work in all phases of the operation.
  • Sets up and starts all machines, checking all controls for adherence to mixing/blending or extruding procedures.
  • Weighs ingredient to meet recipe specification and inserts into machinery; or ensures the correct ingredients are delivered to the work area and inserts pre-blended materials into machinery.
  • Monitors production and equipment to ensure safe and efficient operation. Troubleshoots equipment and processing issues.
  • Operates machinery to mix or extrude the ingredients according to operating procedures.
  • Examines materials visually or with hands in order to ensure conformance to established standards.
  • May take samples to quality control for testing. Follows lab instruction as to adding raw materials to the batch to bring it into specifications. Labels finished product.
  • Refers issues/problems to lead/supervisor for disposition.
  • Performs all required machine cleaning.
  • Completes and maintains all required SAP transactions. Demonstrates expertise in the use of SAP.
  • Documents work completed. Accurately completes and updates required paperwork such as production logs, data reports, procedures, etc.
  • Participates in training new employees and re-training present departmental employees in processes and methods as required.
  • Completes all necessary documentation at the end of shift.
  • Maintains departmental housekeeping standards.
  • Supports the vision, mission and guiding principles of the company.
  • Follows applicable ISO, EH&S rules and guidelines while performing any procedure.
  • Other duties as assigned.
Physical/Environ. Demands
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand; walk; stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl; use hands to finger, handle or feel objects, tools, or controls; talk and/or hear. Occasionally required to sit. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 55 pounds and occasionally handle up to 250 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job may include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. Requires the use of safety equipment as dictated by the work area such as safety glasses and shoes, dust mask, hard hat, respirator, face shield, hearing protection, chemical suit, gloves, aprons, etc. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate with the exception of high noise areas. Proper personal safety equipment needs to be used while performing this job and that equipment is dictated by the plant safety guidelines. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently exposed to wet and/or humid conditions, dust, fumes, airborne particles, chemical dust, and risk of electric shock, vibration, non-hazardous chemical agents and outside weather conditions. Regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts and fumes or airborne particles. The employee is frequently exposed to vibration. The employee is occasionally exposed to toxic or caustic chemicals and risk of electrical shock.

Scope
Manufacturing Plant

Other

job.title: Warehouse Management Systems Manager
job.description:
Nesco is seeking an experienced WMS Manager to serve as the on-site subject matter expert for the Warehouse Management System at our client's Tifton, GA Distribution Center. This is a permanent position located onsite in Tifton, GA. (Relocation offered)

This position will work closely with Distribution Operations, IT, WMS vendors, and warehouse automation partners to ensure warehouse technology supports efficient receiving, inventory management, replenishment, picking, packing, shipping, and fulfillment operations.

The ideal candidate combines hands-on WMS expertise with a strong understanding of distribution center operations. This individual will troubleshoot system and process issues, support warehouse automation, improve operational efficiency, and help optimize a recently implemented WMS environment.

This is an excellent opportunity for a hands-on WMS professional to take ownership of a critical warehouse technology environment and play a key role in improving system performance, operational efficiency, and fulfillment capabilities at a high-volume Distribution Center.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary on-site owner and subject matter expert for the Distribution Center's WMS.

  • Provide daily WMS support for receiving, inventory, replenishment, allocation, waving, picking, packing, shipping, and fulfillment.

  • Troubleshoot issues involving the WMS, ERP integrations, automation, data, hardware, and warehouse processes.

  • Partner with Distribution Operations, IT, and technology vendors to resolve system and operational issues.

  • Monitor WMS performance and identify issues affecting productivity, inventory accuracy, and order flow.

  • Support warehouse automation technologies, including Exotec goods-to-person automation and Tompkins T-Sort.

  • Monitor interfaces and data flow between the WMS, ERP, automation platforms, and other warehouse technologies.

  • Support RF scanners, printers, mobile devices, and other technology used throughout the Distribution Center.

  • Analyze warehouse data, KPIs, inventory movement, and order flow to identify bottlenecks and improvement opportunities.

  • Recommend and implement WMS configuration changes and process improvements to improve throughput, inventory accuracy, and efficiency.

  • Support WMS enhancements, upgrades, testing, deployments, and post-go-live stabilization.

  • Develop test scenarios and coordinate testing for system changes and integrations.

  • Create and maintain WMS documentation, troubleshooting guides, and standard operating procedures.

  • Train warehouse supervisors, managers, super-users, and associates on WMS functionality and process changes.

  • Serve as the primary liaison between Distribution Center Operations and Corporate IT for WMS-related issues and initiatives.

  • Coordinate with WMS, automation, hardware, and technology vendors through issue resolution.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience supporting Warehouse Management Systems in a high-volume distribution or fulfillment environment.

  • Strong hands-on understanding of distribution center operations and fulfillment processes.

  • Experience supporting enterprise WMS platforms such as Manhattan, Blue Yonder/JDA, Körber/HighJump, Infor, SAP EWM, Intra1, or similar systems.

  • Experience troubleshooting WMS and warehouse process issues in a live production environment.

  • Experience with WMS configuration, testing, upgrades, deployments, implementations, and post-go-live support.

  • Strong knowledge of receiving, inventory control, replenishment, allocation, waving, picking, packing, shipping, and fulfillment.

  • Experience supporting ERP-to-WMS integrations and system interfaces.

  • Experience working with RF scanners, printers, mobile devices, and warehouse technology.

  • Experience with warehouse automation is strongly preferred.

  • Working knowledge of SQL and warehouse reporting tools is a plus.

  • Experience developing operational reports, dashboards, and KPIs.

  • Strong problem-solving, communication, vendor management, and project coordination skills.

Preferred Background

  • Experience in consumer products, apparel, retail, e-commerce, wholesale, or direct-to-consumer distribution.

  • Experience supporting automated picking, goods-to-person, sortation, or other warehouse automation technologies.

  • Experience with Exotec, Tompkins Robotics/T-Sort, or Hy-Tek Intra1 is a plus.

  • Experience supporting a WMS implementation, major upgrade, or post-go-live stabilization.

  • Previous leadership or management experience within Distribution Center Operations or Warehouse Systems is highly desirable.

job.description:

Shift: 2nd Shift: MONDAY - THURSDAY 2:15PM-12:45AM.
THE CANDIDATE WILL TRAIN ON 1ST SHIFT Mon - Fri

The ideal candidate will have experience in set-up, operated Haas, and experienced in adjusting offsets. 5 Axis is a plus!

Roles & Responsibilities:
Setup, layout and operate various CNC lathes and/or mills
Reads blueprint or job order for product specifications such as dimensions and tolerances and tooling instructions such as fixtures, cutting speeds, depth of cut and determines sequence of operations.
Selects, positions, and secures tool in tool holder.
Positions and secures work piece in holding device, machine table, chuck, centers or fixtures.
Moves controls to position tool and work piece in relation to each other, and to set specified feeds, speeds and depth of cut.
Sets up fixture, starts machine.
Requires ability to read precision measuring equipment such as micrometers and calipers.
Observes operation of machine and verifies conformity of machined work piece to specifications.
Keeps work area clean and orderly
Follows all Company rules and safety policies.
Discusses errors in diagrams or production order with supervisor or engineer to clarify assembly problems.
Core Competency Requirements:
Performs any assembly-type functions, using hand or power tools.
Adjusts, trim and fitting parts to close tolerances.
Follows visual aids (standard work) to ensure work is correct.
May perform testing of assembled product.
Make up cartons, print labels, insert protective packing material, seal finishing product.
Meet efficiency rates.
Perform quality checks to ensure quality specifications are met.
Work within all safety guidelines and wear all required PPE (steel toe shoes, hearing protection and
safety glasses).
Reports defective materials or questionable conditions to the department supervisor or team leader.
Maintains the work area and equipment in a clean and orderly condition - 5S.
Must be flexible to rotate job assignments within various work cells.
Performs related duties as assigned by supervision

Required Qualifications:
High School Diploma or equivalent
1+ yrs of previous CNC experience preferred
Physical Needs:
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully
perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with
disabilities to perform the essential functions.
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The
requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required:
Ability to add and subtract/basic math.
Ability to follow written and verbal instructions
Good hand-eye coordination.

job.title: Optical Fabricators
job.description:
Job Title: Optical Assembly Technician
Multiple positions available!
B-Shift/2nd Shift Opening with hours of 2:00pm-10:30pm
$23-26/hr

About the role:
The Optical Assembly Technician performs advanced optical assembly and alignment operations requiring micron- and sub-micron-level accuracy. This role is responsible for actively aligning optical elements to mechanical housings, verifying optical and mechanical performance, and permanently securing optics using high-precision tools and metrology. Work is performed in a controlled clean-room manufacturing environment and requires significant technical skill, judgment, and independence in the execution of high-performance optical products.

Key Responsibilities:
· Perform active alignment of lenses and optical elements into metal housings using precision fixturing.
· Use alignment and metrology tools such as air-bearing spindles, autocollimators, alignment telescopes, precision stages, and indicators to achieve required tolerances.
· Adjust decenter, tip, tilt, and axial position to meet defined optical and mechanical specifications.
· Apply adhesives and permanently secure optics while maintaining alignment during cure.
· Inspect optical elements for defects including scratches, digs, chips, and coating defects.
· Inspect machined metal housings for burrs, surface damage, and dimensional inconsistencies.
· Evaluate cosmetic and functional acceptability using defined optical inspection criteria.
· Determine fitness-for-use of optics and hardware prior to assembly and escalate issues as required.
· Measure critical features using high-precision metrology tools including micrometers, bore gauges, comparators, and dial indicators.



Job Title: Optical Fabricator
Multiple positions available!
B-Shift/2nd Shift Opening with hours of 2:00pm-10:30pm
$25-28/hr

About the Role
In this role, you will manufacture custom lens assemblies and optical systems that meet precise specifications. The ideal candidate has experience in optical systems and glass fabrication, along with strong problem-solving skills using root cause analysis tools.

Key Responsibilities
• Generate precision curves using CNC equipment to meet optical specifications and tolerances.
• Perform CNC centering operations to ensure accurate alignment of optical components.
• Hand bevel and block lenses for grinding and polishing processes.
• Execute hand grinding and CNC/conventional polishing to achieve required surface quality.
• Conduct optical inspection and metrology to verify compliance with specifications.
• Maintain cleanliness of machines, tools, and work areas to ensure quality and safety.
• Plan and schedule work for generation, blocking, grinding, and polishing areas.
• Comply with all health, safety, and PPE requirements.
• Support company values through ethical conduct and integrity in all actions.
• Perform other duties as assigned to support production and continuous improvement.

Equipment Utilized
• CNC and conventional polishing machines
• Optical inspection and metrology equipment
• Personal computer and JDE MRP software
• Personal protective equipment (PPE) and cleanroom attire
• Standard office equipment (calculator, copier, fax, etc.)

Education & Experience
• High school diploma or GED preferred
• Minimum of two years of related optical fabrication experience and/or training
Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities
• Proficiency in operating CNC curve generation machines and CNC centering equipment.
• High degree of accuracy and alertness when using micrometers, interferometers, and high-speed cutting wheels
• Familiarity with optical manufacturing terminology and processes
• Skilled in using conventional polishing machines and performing hand grinding and beveling.
• Ability to perform optical inspection and metrology using precision instruments such as micrometers, interferometers, and other optical measurement tools.
• Familiarity with JDE MRP software and basic computer operations.
• Comfortable using standard office equipment (calculator, copier, fax, etc.).
• Understanding of cleanroom protocols and proper use of personal protective equipment (PPE).
• Knowledge of optical manufacturing terminology and processes.
• Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accuracy under high-speed cutting conditions.

Description:

Position Summary:

Storeroom Attendant is an individual contributor positioned within a customer's location to fulfil daily receiving, stocking, issuing, and cycle counting of customer and/or company inventory. They are responsible for maintaining a professional, clean and organized work environment.

Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities:

•Unloads, receives and puts away incoming product, goods, tools and/or equipment; unpacks bales, crates, and other containers; checks for damage and for discrepancies between goods and invoices.
•Accurately sorts, labels, moves and stores items; places material or items on racks, shelves, or in bins according to predetermined sequence such as size, style, or product codes; arranges storage to optimize crib space.
•Issues product, goods, tools and/or equipment to site employees; documents and maintains accurate records for issued and returned items.
•Enters data into a database or other computerized system to maintain up-to-date stock records; retrieves stored information to respond to inquiries (e.g., inventory levels or delivery schedules.); documents discrepancies on an error log and seeks management advice on appropriate corrective action.
•Requests requisitions to replenish inventory.
•Assists with inventory level maintenance; performs cycle counts and prepares report results.
•Inspects and measures tools/equipment for defects, wear and tear and reports damage or wear to supervisors.
•Prepares periodic inventory or maintains perpetual inventory of supplies and equipment.
•Delivers tools or equipment to associate work locations.
•Investigates and locates lost or misplaced equipment or safety supplies.
•May repair, service and lubricate tools and equipment as required.
•Performs other related duties as requested.

Job Qualifications:

3+ months relevant experience and/or training. High school diploma or equivalent preferred (not required).
Relevant experience and/or aptitude should include:
•Loading, unloading, picking, packing or moving goods in a warehouse environment.
•Demonstrated ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, work orders, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals.
•Basic computer knowledge and proficiency and/or a demonstrated technical aptitude to learn; preferred technical skills to include but not limited to MS-Office products, Vista, Control, SX.e, Prophet 21.
•Demonstration of basic mathematical skills (add, subtract, multiply and divide in all units to measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals); ability to compute rates, ratio, and percent preferred.
•Strong communication and customer service skills.
•Ability to work in a team environment and be self-motivated to accomplish assigned tasks and goals.
•Demonstration of attention to detail and is safety minded.

Work Environment & Physical Demands:

•May be required to wear various forms of protective equipment (shoes, gloves, protective eyewear, etc.)
•May be required to pass warehouse equipment certifications (written and/or driving).
•Assigned work shifts may vary and/or rotate.
•Overtime may be required; extended day, evening and weekend work may be required as job duties demand and may include little to no advanced notice.
•Must be able to handle and work physical inventory; required to lift up to 25 lbs or greater with assistance following standard operating and safety procedures. Other physical requirements including, regularly being required to stand, walk, kneel, bend, crouch, crawl, climb and balance.
•Close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus are required.

Benefits Administration Specialist

Position Overview

The Benefits Administration Specialist supports the administration and day-to-day operation of employee benefit programs. This position works closely with internal departments, employees, managers, benefit vendors, brokers, and consultants to ensure benefit programs are administered accurately, efficiently, and in compliance with established requirements.

Duties are listed based on the estimated percentage of time. Other responsibilities may be assigned.

Key Responsibilities

Benefit Administration – 20%

  • Support the administration of employee healthcare and benefit programs under the direction of the Benefit Administration Manager.

  • Administer programs including:

    • Medical

    • Dental

    • Vision

    • Pharmacy

    • Section 125 plans

    • Qualified Life Events

    • Financial and Retirement plans

  • Ensure accurate and compliant day-to-day administration of employee benefit programs.

  • Provide timely support and guidance to employees and managers.

Benefit Operations – 15%

  • Support operational excellence across benefits administration.

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of benefits operations.

  • Support workflow optimization and system updates.

  • Assist with the maintenance of benefit plan documents.

Annual Enrollment & Integration – 15%

  • Assist with the planning, coordination, and execution of the annual benefits open enrollment process.

  • Support system readiness and employee communications.

  • Coordinate with benefit vendors throughout the enrollment process.

  • Assist with issue identification and resolution.

  • Support special benefits projects designed to improve operational efficiency and the employee experience.

Vendor Management – 15%

  • Manage relationships with benefit providers, brokers, and consultants.

  • Partner with external providers to support the day-to-day administration of employee benefit programs.

Employee Support & Issue Resolution – 15%

  • Respond to employee benefit inquiries and provide excellent customer service.

  • Research and resolve benefit-related issues.

  • Coordinate with internal departments, including Payroll and Legal, as needed.

  • Partner with benefit vendors to ensure employee issues are addressed and resolved.

Benefits Administration & Reporting – 5%

  • Perform daily administrative functions supporting employee benefit programs.

  • Manage file feed transfers and statistical reporting.

  • Process enrollment elections and benefit changes for new hires and employees on leave of absence.

  • Process beneficiary changes.

  • Support Qualified Medical Support Orders (QMSO).

Benefits Invoice Auditing – 5%

  • Audit the preparation and submission of payments and invoices to external vendors.

  • Ensure benefit-related invoices are accurate and processed in a timely manner.

Vendor Meetings & System Enhancements – 5%

  • Participate in vendor status and planning meetings.

  • Assist with the implementation of benefit-related enhancements.

  • Participate in problem resolution activities to maintain effective vendor relationships.

Industry Knowledge & Continuous Improvement – 5%

  • Maintain knowledge of industry trends related to assigned areas of expertise.

  • Evaluate the potential impact of industry developments on benefit plans, programs, policies, and procedures.

  • Communicate findings and recommendations to management.

  • Identify opportunities to improve the employee benefits experience.

Core Values

  • Act with uncompromising integrity.

  • Provide outstanding service and build trusted relationships.

  • Drive innovation in products and services and continually improve processes.

  • Work in partnership and support fellow team members.

  • Be personally accountable and deliver on commitments.

  • Treat others with respect and dignity.

Requirements

  • Relevant education and/or professional experience in benefits administration or a related area.

  • Consideration may be given to candidates with 5+ years of relevant experience in lieu of a degree.

job.title: Trim Engineer
job.description:
Trim Engineer

Position Summary

The Trim Engineer is responsible for the design, development, and implementation of Performance Seats soft trim products and supports engineering trim programs from concept through production. This role works closely with OEM design studios, engineering, manufacturing, suppliers, and customers to ensure trim designs meet styling, performance, quality, cost, and production requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead or support soft trim product and program execution to meet engineering specifications, customer requirements, industry standards, and regulatory requirements.

  • Manage trim product data, including program IDs, sewing components, materials, BOMs, and color matrices.

  • Develop and maintain trim patterns using Optitex PDS or equivalent patterning software, including marker creation.

  • Collaborate with OEM design studios to ensure seating design and styling themes are achieved.

  • Support foam A-surface development, seat styling, comfort, and overall design requirements.

  • Review design inputs, drawings, and specifications to ensure project requirements and deliverables are met.

  • Create and maintain DFMEA, DVP&R, APQP/PAP documentation, and other required engineering documentation.

  • Develop and maintain sewing specifications, appearance standards, and trim construction guidelines.

  • Create and release trim cover drawings and develop paper and digital patterns.

  • Apply automotive cut-and-sew construction techniques, including material selection, lamination, retainers, and attachment strategies.

  • Develop prototype and production BOMs, tooling requirements, material usage, and scrap-rate estimates.

  • Support sewing process development, manufacturing feasibility, production launches, supplier training, and audits.

  • Support prototype builds, seat measurements, fitments, benchmarking, teardowns, and testing.

  • Assist with initial costing, quoting, project timing, and engineering deliverables.

  • Support troubleshooting, complaint resolution, and 8D investigations.

  • Support embroidery and logo development as required.

  • Manage soft trim development materials, inventory, tools, and sample shop requirements.

  • Maintain current technical knowledge and support continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Follow all Health, Safety, Environmental, Quality, ISO/TS 16949, and ISO 14000 requirements.

Key Qualifications

  • Experience in automotive seating soft trim engineering, design, and development.

  • Strong knowledge of automotive cut-and-sew construction techniques.

  • Experience with Optitex PDS or equivalent patterning and marker creation software.

  • Experience with Trim Product Data Management (TPDM) or equivalent systems.

  • Knowledge of trim BOMs, color matrices, sewing specifications, appearance standards, and material selection.

  • Experience creating and maintaining DFMEA, DVP&R, APQP/PAP, and related engineering documentation.

  • Knowledge of foam A-surface development, seat styling, comfort, and fitment requirements.

  • Understanding of manufacturing feasibility, sewing processes, tooling, and supplier requirements.

  • Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, customer requirements, and regulatory standards.

  • Strong problem-solving, communication, organizational, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

  • Ability to support customer and OEM requirements in a fast-paced engineering environment.

  • Commitment to quality, safety, environmental, and continuous improvement standards.

job.title: Legal Operations Specialist
job.description:
Legal Operations Specialist

Position Overview

The Legal Operations Specialist provides comprehensive legal assistance and supports a broad and evolving range of corporate legal functions for the Legal Department and cross-functional business teams.

This position serves as a key liaison between in-house counsel, outside counsel, external organizations, and internal employees. The ideal candidate will be a flexible, solutions-oriented professional capable of supporting commercial transactions, contract administration, corporate records, intellectual property matters, and legal operations and workflows.

Key Responsibilities

Contract & Commercial Support

  • Assist attorneys with drafting, assembling, reviewing, proofreading, and editing contracts, legal agreements, and supporting documentation.
  • Support the full lifecycle of commercial contracts.
  • Track contract execution and maintain executed copies.
  • Coordinate and collect required signatures.
  • Organize and maintain contracts and related documentation within the document management system.
  • Partner with internal commercial teams to ensure stakeholders understand contract terms, requirements, and status.
  • Maintain accurate and organized corporate and legal records.

Legal Operations & Process Improvement

  • Evaluate existing legal processes and identify workflow gaps, redundancies, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Support initiatives designed to streamline processes, improve efficiency, and reduce costs.
  • Assist with evaluating, developing, and scaling legal tools, workflows, templates, and contract playbooks.
  • Support legal technology initiatives and vendor evaluations.
  • Manage legal billing, invoicing, and budget tracking.
  • Assist with cross-functional legal projects and ad-hoc requests.

Legal Intake & Matter Management

  • Serve as the primary intake specialist for new legal requests.
  • Gather and organize required documentation for new matters.
  • Manage multiple legal matters and requests simultaneously.
  • Coordinate schedules and logistics for meetings.
  • Communicate with internal stakeholders, outside counsel, and external organizations as needed.

Intellectual Property & Legal Research

  • Review incoming patent correspondence.
  • Maintain the internal patent docketing database.
  • Track and help ensure critical intellectual property deadlines are met.
  • Conduct project-based legal research at the direction of corporate counsel.
  • Prepare and file legal documentation with appropriate regulatory and government entities.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in a legal or corporate environment.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with stakeholders across areas such as Legal, Finance, Technology, IT, Engineering, and other business functions.
  • Foundational knowledge of contracting principles and legal requirements.
  • Experience supporting contracts, legal documentation, or related corporate legal activities.
  • Strong organizational skills with excellent attention to detail.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • High proficiency in grammar, composition, proofreading, and legal documentation.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgment and appropriately escalate issues when necessary.
  • Demonstrated ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with strict discretion.

Technical Skills

  • Microsoft Office, including Excel
  • Google Workspace
  • Adobe Acrobat
  • Corporate document management systems
  • Legal technology and workflow tools

job.description:
Job Overview
We are seeking a dependable, experienced Production Manager to oversee daily manufacturing operations, coordinate production activities, and ensure that schedules, quality standards, and safety expectations are consistently met. The successful candidate will provide leadership to production employees, resolve operational challenges, and support continuous improvement initiatives that increase productivity and reduce waste.

  • Review production orders and ensure production schedules and department goals are achieved.
  • Plan and coordinate staffing, work schedules, and employee assignments to meet production demands.
  • Supervise, support, and motivate employees in their daily work performance.
  • Assign employees to appropriate positions to improve workflow, efficiency, and productivity.
  • Develop training schedules for new employees and evaluate employee performance.
  • Maintain accurate employee records, including attendance and performance evaluations.
  • Develop, maintain, and adjust job routers as needed.
  • Address employee performance issues and administer disciplinary actions in accordance with company procedures.
  • Prepare and distribute production, safety, and other operational reports for management.
  • Identify and resolve production or personnel issues to minimize disruptions.
  • Establish department objectives and performance goals that support overall business targets.
  • Lead continuous improvement efforts focused on quality, productivity, and scrap reduction.
  • Maintain a clean, organized work environment and enforce safe work practices.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

  • Five to ten years of industry-related experience.

job.title: Administrative Support
job.description:
Administrative / Facilities Coordinator

Position Overview

We are seeking an organized and detail-oriented Administrative / Facilities Coordinator to provide administrative and space planning support to a Facilities organization.

This position will support workplace planning, facilities data management, reporting, scheduling, and day-to-day administrative activities across a large 1.6 million-square-foot campus. The role requires someone who is comfortable working with data and spreadsheets while also conducting daily field checks throughout the facility.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, comfortable managing multiple priorities, and able to work effectively with employees and internal business partners.

Position Details

  • Work Model: 100% On-site
  • Schedule: 4/10 – First Shift
  • Employment Type: Contract
  • Potential for Full-Time Hire: Yes
  • Overtime Status: Non-Exempt
  • Security Clearance: Not required

Key Responsibilities

Facilities & Space Planning Support

  • Provide administrative and space planning support to the Facilities team.
  • Gather, maintain, track, and verify space, occupancy, employee, and facilities-related information from multiple sources.
  • Conduct daily field checks throughout a large corporate campus to verify space and occupancy information.
  • Update space planning records, floor plans, seating assignments, and related databases.
  • Support effective utilization of workplace and facility resources.
  • Coordinate and track space requests, employee moves, seating changes, and other workplace activities.
  • Ensure facilities and space planning information remains accurate and up to date.

Data Management & Reporting

  • Compile, organize, and analyze facilities-related data.
  • Prepare reports, spreadsheets, presentations, timelines, tables, and other materials.
  • Maintain accurate records and databases used for facilities planning and decision-making.
  • Identify inconsistencies or missing information and assist with maintaining data accuracy.
  • Support reporting and analysis related to space utilization, occupancy, and workplace planning.

Administrative Support

  • Manage calendars and schedules for the Facilities team.
  • Coordinate meetings, appointments, site visits, and other team activities.
  • Provide administrative support for Facilities projects and meetings.
  • Assist with internal communications and day-to-day department operations.
  • Coordinate business travel as needed.
  • Prepare and process expense reports.
  • Maintain documentation and assist with other administrative activities as required.

Process & Employee Support

  • Assist with developing and improving administrative and facilities processes.
  • Identify opportunities to improve workflow, data accuracy, and operational efficiency.
  • Provide employees and internal business partners with information regarding Facilities processes and procedures.
  • Assist with questions regarding space assignments, workplace services, and related Facilities activities.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure requests and workplace activities are completed accurately and efficiently.

Required Qualifications

  • Administrative, facilities, workplace coordination, space planning, or related experience.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and data accuracy.
  • Experience maintaining records, databases, spreadsheets, or tracking systems.
  • Ability to compile information and prepare reports, spreadsheets, presentations, and other business materials.
  • Experience coordinating calendars, meetings, appointments, or workplace activities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with internal teams.
  • Comfortable conducting daily field checks and walking throughout a 1.6 million-square-foot campus.
  • Ability to work 100% on-site.

job.title: 3rd Shift Production Operator II - (Biotech/Biomedical)
job.description:
SCHEDULE : Monday - Thursday / 5:30PM - 3:30AM

Experience must include at least two years of Client manufacturing experience and/or field or a technical certification/degree (or substantial progress towards completion). Candidates without actual Client experience should apply for the Operator 1 role.

Description
This position is NonExempt. Hours over 40 will be paid at Time and a Half.

This position is responsible for the production of high quality cardiovascular medical devices on a team within a manufacturing cell. This position includes detailed assembly and operation of various equipment and machinery per documented procedures. This may include electronic assembly, casting/coating functions, mechanical assembly and packaging. Cleans tools and equipment per documented procedures. Disposes hazardous waste material on corresponding hazardous waste areas.

Duties
  • Assembles medical devices and related components.
  • Depending on work area, it may be a controlled cleanroom environment.
  • May include use of microscopes, use of hand tools, razor blades, syringes, soldering, adhesive bonding, and operating various equipment.
  • Performs routine assignments according to specified and/or standardized procedures. Work is closely and continually reviewed.
  • Performs visual inspection and precision measurements on components and assemblies.
  • Performs tests on units using computerized test equipment.
  • Repairs and corrects devices/components using microscopes and applicable tools.
  • Packages devices ensuring all parts are accurate and documentation is complete.
  • Maintains accurate records to ensure travelers, shop floor paperwork and quality documents are accurate, all parts are traceable and quality issues can be addressed to assure the quality of all products.
  • Follows safety guidelines and utilize appropriate safety devices and equipment when performing all operations.
  • Participates in continuous improvement/quality initiatives to enhance production processes to achieve quality and profitability metrics.
  • Notifies supervisor or lead of the need to replenish supplies/materials and of any production difficulties that cannot be readily corrected.
  • Participates with the Manufacturing Supervisor/Manager in setting and monitoring individual goals and cell performance metrics that continuously seek to improve the quality of operations.
  • Cooperates in keeping a clean, sanitary work environment throughout the building.
  • Performs other related duties as directed or assigned.
Requirements:
  • Must be able to read, comprehend and follow English written procedures at a 6th grade level.
  • Must have good basic math skills at a 6th grade level.
  • Must be able to speak, follow verbal instructions and communicate effectively in English.
  • Possesses understanding of and ability to utilize electronic data collection systems and computer software packages.
  • Must have good dexterity to handle and maneuver small components and parts.
  • Ability to prioritize work by determining the sequencing and timing of different jobs based on precedence and importance.
  • Ability to make critical decisions and judgments with minimal supervision. High school diploma required
  • 2+ years of experience

job.title: Radio Frequency Engineer - Secret Clearance
job.description:
Description:
Architects and designs Radio Frequency systems and circuitry. Designs and develops RF circuitry used in high frequency and microwave applications, including receivers, transmitters, antennas, and frequency synthesizers. Responsible for hardware layout, component evaluation, prototype construction, and test. Prepares test methods and specifications; analyzes and tests RF hardware to verify performance characteristics. Develops and allocates RF system and subsystem functional and performance requirements. Identifies and tracks RF technical performance measurements (TPMs). - Bachelor's degree from an accredited college in RF Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related STEM discipline.

- Experience with design, development, and integration of Communication systems
- Proficient in system engineering processes
- Experience with RF analysis; Co-site, Antenna Pattern, and Link budgets

Overview
Client is seeking an experienced Blue Yonder Functional & Technical Engineer to lead the implementation, configuration, integration, and support of Blue Yonder Warehouse Management (WMS) within a complex manufacturing environment. This role serves as the primary subject matter expert responsible for delivering end-to-end warehouse management capabilities across inbound receiving, inventory movement and storage, manufacturing integration, warehouse execution, and outbound fulfillment.
The ideal candidate combines deep manufacturing and warehouse operations knowledge with hands-on Blue Yonder implementation experience. This position focuses on optimizing material flow, inventory accuracy, labor productivity, operational visibility, and warehouse performance through effective use of Blue Yonder WMS capabilities.

Core Responsibilities
• Serve as the primary functional and technical SME for Blue Yonder WMS and lead implementation and optimization activities across inbound, internal warehouse, manufacturing-support, and outbound processes.
• Configure and optimize Blue Yonder WMS capabilities including receiving, directed put-away, inventory control, work order integration, directed work, replenishment, picking, staging, loading, and outbound fulfillment.
• Lead requirements gathering sessions with manufacturing, receiving, warehouse, inventory control, shipping, logistics, and business stakeholders.
• Design future-state business processes, workflows, functional specifications, and business process documentation.

• Lead implementation activities through requirements, design, build, testing, cutover, go-live, and hypercare support.

• Manage testing activities, defect resolution, deployment planning, and production support.
• Provide hands-on support during receiving, warehouse, manufacturing integration, and outbound operational cutovers.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies
• 7+ years of Blue Yonder implementation experience.
• Proven experience implementing and configuring Blue Yonder WMS across both inbound and outbound warehouse operations.
• Experience working in manufacturing, warehouse, and distribution environments.
• Strong understanding of inbound receiving, outbound fulfillment, and transportation processes.
• Strong knowledge of warehouse execution processes including directed put-away, directed work, replenishment, picking, staging, and loading.
• Experience with manufacturing operations, work order integration, inventory management, and supply chain processes.
• Demonstrated experience gathering business requirements and translating them into technical solutions.
• Experience leading full lifecycle implementations including requirements, design, configuration, testing, cutover, and hypercare.
• Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent stakeholder communication and collaboration skills.

Preferred Skills or Experience
• Multiple end-to-end Blue Yonder WMS implementations spanning receiving, inventory, warehouse execution, manufacturing integration, and outbound fulfillment.
• Experience supporting manufacturing facilities operating in a multi-shift environment.
• SAP integration experience.
• Experience integrating Blue Yonder with ERP platforms, MES systems, warehouse automation solutions, and transportation systems.
• Blue Yonder certifications.
• Experience serving as a lead consultant or solution architect.

job.title: Corporate Recruiter
job.description:
Corporate Recruiter Job in Cleveland, OH:

Onsite Position in Cleveland, OH
Full-Time, Direct Hire
 

Are you ready to bridge the gap between talent and opportunity and play a key role in a candidate’s career? You can do just that as a Corporate Recruiter with Nesco Resource.

The Corporate Recruiter will source, interview, select, and place applicants for all internal Nesco Resource roles across both lines of business. Working closely with hiring managers throughout the organization, this person will build sourcing strategies, manage candidates from first contact through offer, and support a wide variety of HR tasks, including compensation, benefits, and contract negotiations.

Key Responsibilities of the Corporate Recruiter Job in Cleveland, OH:

Sourcing and Recruiting

  • Independently source and recruit applicants through job boards, social media, corporate career sites, and other channels.
  • Screen and interview candidates, and select qualified applicants to move forward in the process.
  • Anticipate future openings and build talent pipelines through frequent contact with hiring managers across the organization.
  • Lead campus recruiting and connect with civic, social, and professional groups to share job opportunities.

Hiring Manager Partnership

  • Hold strategy sessions with hiring managers to define job requirements and establish sourcing strategies.
  • Interpret job descriptions and translate them into targeted candidate searches.
  • Recommend candidates for hire and arrange in-person interviews with hiring managers.

Candidate Management and Offers

  • Prepare candidates for interviews, including the nature of the role and who they will be meeting with.
  • Negotiate salary, wages, and benefits between hiring managers and candidates.
  • Compose offer packages, including offer letters, and communicate hiring decisions to candidates.

Recruiting Operations

  • Enter pre-qualified candidates, job postings, and notes into the company’s candidate database.
  • Maintain accurate data and documentation throughout the hiring process.
  • Participate in implementing new recruiting technology, such as applicant tracking systems and screening tools.

Qualifications of the Corporate Recruiter Job in Cleveland, OH:

Required

  • Previous recruiting experience.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong organizational, time management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong customer service skills and business ethics.
  • Strong computer skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks, set priorities, and meet deadlines.
  • Ability to work well in a team environment.

Preferred

  • Bachelor’s or Associate’s degree.
  • Experience in staffing or corporate talent acquisition.
  • Experience with applicant tracking systems and campus recruiting.

Physical and Work Environment

  • Ability to sit at a desk or stand for extended periods of time.
  • Ability to operate standard office equipment, including a computer, keyboard, mouse, calculator, copier, and phones.

job.title: C/C++ Embedded Software Engineer - (Active Secret Clearance Required)
job.description:
Overview
Client is seeking a C/C++ Software Engineer to support the design, development, testing, and maintenance of secure processing applications and embedded software for mission-critical platforms. This role operates in a classified environment and requires an active Full Secret security clearance.
The engineer will work closely with hardware and software teams to develop embedded solutions, support firmware integration, maintain software quality standards, and contribute to automated build and deployment processes.

Core Responsibilities
• Design, develop, debug, and maintain modern C++ applications and legacy software used across multiple projects.
• Develop low-level C/C++ software for bare-metal and RTOS environments, including FreeRTOS and VxWorks.
