job.title: Contracts Administrator
job.description:
Contracts Administrator

Position Overview

We are seeking a Contracts Administrator to support the front-end contract administration process for aftermarket products. This position will administer contracts of moderate scope and complexity, ensuring contractual obligations, customer requirements, pricing, delivery schedules, and terms and conditions are properly managed.

The Contracts Administrator will serve as a key point of contact for customers and internal stakeholders and will support contract review, proposals, RFPs, negotiations, compliance, and contract performance.

The ideal candidate will have 1–2 years of contracts administration experience, preferably supporting military, government, aerospace, or defense contracts, along with strong customer communication skills.

Position Details

  • Employment Type: Temp-to-Hire
  • Shift: 1st Shift
  • Schedule: Monday – Friday
  • Hours: 7:00 AM – 4:00 PM or 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM

Key Responsibilities

Contract Administration

  • Administer contracts of moderate scope and complexity to ensure fulfillment of contractual obligations.
  • Review and analyze customer purchase orders, including orders issued against Basic Contract Agreements and Long-Term Agreements.
  • Evaluate:
    • Performance requirements
    • Delivery schedules
    • Pricing
    • Terms and conditions
    • Other contractual provisions
  • Monitor contract performance and ensure compliance with customer and company requirements.
  • Determine when customer-directed changes fall outside the existing scope of work.
  • Prepare and coordinate contract amendments or extensions as required.

Proposals & RFPs

  • Develop technically and commercially compliant proposal packages in response to customer and contractual requirements.
  • Evaluate performance requirements, delivery schedules, material costs, equipment requirements, and labor-hour estimates.
  • Initiate and coordinate the bid process by gathering requirements and input from cross-functional teams.
  • Develop responses to Requests for Proposal (RFPs).
  • Review material, testing, delivery, pricing, and other requirements associated with customer requests.
  • Prepare and submit proposals in accordance with established procedures.

Contract Negotiations

  • Negotiate contracts within assigned scope and authority while complying with legal requirements and company policies.
  • Negotiate:
    • Pricing
    • Terms and conditions
    • Delivery requirements
    • Other contractual and business matters
  • Ensure contractual provisions are clearly defined and consistent with company policies.
  • Support negotiations for follow-on requirements to obtain favorable pricing, terms, and conditions.

Customer & Stakeholder Management

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for customers regarding assigned contracts.
  • Proactively contact customers to review contract details, obtain required information, and provide status updates.
  • Participate in customer meetings and presentations.
  • Investigate and resolve customer claims, questions, and complaints.
  • Coordinate with internal teams regarding technical issues, quality concerns, data requirements, delivery requirements, and other business matters.

Contract Performance & Compliance

  • Monitor contract financial performance and delivery status.
  • Maintain accurate contract documentation and records.
  • Support export compliance administration and implementation of applicable export compliance requirements.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable federal, state, government procurement, and aerospace industry regulations.
  • Review regulatory requirements and advise management regarding necessary actions.
  • Utilize Lean principles to develop and implement standardized work and process improvements.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration or a related discipline.
  • 1–2+ years of contract administration, contract management, or directly related experience.
  • Experience supporting contracts within military, government, aerospace, defense, or another regulated environment strongly preferred.
  • Knowledge of contract administration principles, practices, policies, and procedures.
  • Understanding of legal and regulatory requirements related to contracts and government procurement, where applicable.
  • Ability to read, analyze, and interpret moderately complex contract terms and conditions.
  • Experience supporting proposals, bids, RFPs, pricing, and contract negotiations.
  • Strong customer service and communication skills, including the ability to proactively contact customers regarding contract requirements and status updates.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to effectively manage multiple contracts, priorities, and deadlines.
  • Proficiency with standard business applications and contract/customer management systems.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Contract Management certification completed or currently in progress.
  • Experience with military or government contracts.
  • Aerospace or defense industry experience.
  • Knowledge of government procurement requirements.
  • Experience with export compliance.
  • Familiarity with Lean principles and continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Membership or familiarity with professional organizations such as the National Contract Management Association (NCMA) or similar contract management organizations.

job.title: Associate Manager, Technical Accounting & SEC Reporting
job.description:
Associate Manager, Technical Accounting & SEC Reporting

Position Overview

The Associate Manager, Technical Accounting & SEC Reporting is responsible for researching and applying U.S. GAAP and SEC reporting requirements to complex business transactions and financial reporting matters.

This position will support quarterly and annual SEC reporting, including the preparation of disclosures and footnotes for Forms 10-K and 10-Q, as well as the development of clear, well-supported, audit-ready technical accounting memoranda and work papers.

The Associate Manager will collaborate with Finance, Legal, Operations, external auditors, and other key stakeholders to evaluate accounting, disclosure, control, and reporting implications. The role will also leverage financial reporting systems, automation tools, and emerging technologies to improve reporting accuracy, efficiency, consistency, and control effectiveness.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Accounting & U.S. GAAP

  • Research and interpret complex U.S. GAAP accounting guidance.
  • Analyze complex business transactions and determine appropriate accounting treatment.
  • Evaluate accounting and reporting implications of business activities and transactions.
  • Prepare clear, comprehensive, and audit-ready technical accounting memoranda.
  • Develop and maintain supporting accounting work papers and documentation.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders and external auditors regarding technical accounting conclusions.

SEC Reporting

  • Support the preparation of quarterly and annual SEC filings.
  • Prepare assigned disclosures and footnotes for:
    • Form 10-K
    • Form 10-Q
  • Support financial statement tie-outs and disclosure reviews.
  • Ensure SEC disclosures are accurate, complete, consistent, and supported by appropriate documentation.
  • Research and apply applicable SEC reporting requirements.

Controls, Compliance & Governance

  • Support SOX and disclosure control requirements related to financial reporting.
  • Assess accounting, disclosure, control, and reporting implications in partnership with Finance, Legal, Operations, and other stakeholders.
  • Maintain strong documentation and governance throughout the reporting process.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen reporting controls and processes.

Reporting Systems & Process Improvement

  • Utilize financial reporting systems and technology to support quarterly and annual reporting activities.
  • Leverage automation tools and emerging technologies to improve:
    • Reporting accuracy
    • Process efficiency
    • Reporting consistency
    • Control effectiveness
  • Identify opportunities to streamline financial reporting processes and strengthen governance.
  • Experience with Workiva, Oracle FCCS, or similar financial reporting platforms is preferred.

Project & Deadline Management

  • Manage multiple time-sensitive deliverables during quarterly and annual reporting cycles.
  • Prioritize competing responsibilities while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Coordinate with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure reporting requirements and deadlines are met.
  • Effectively manage multiple accounting and reporting workstreams simultaneously.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of progressive accounting experience within:
    • Public accounting, and/or
    • SEC reporting
    • Technical accounting
    • Consolidations
    • Fortune 500 corporate accounting environments
  • Demonstrated ability to research and apply complex U.S. GAAP and SEC reporting requirements.
  • Experience preparing or supporting SEC filings, disclosures, footnotes, and financial statement tie-outs.
  • Experience drafting audit-ready technical accounting memoranda and supporting documentation.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across functions and with external auditors.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet tight quarterly and annual reporting deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • U.S. CPA strongly preferred, or active progress toward CPA certification.
  • Experience with SOX and disclosure controls.
  • Experience with financial reporting systems such as:
    • Workiva
    • Oracle FCCS
    • Similar consolidation or financial reporting platforms
  • Experience utilizing automation tools or emerging technologies to improve financial reporting processes.

job.title: Senior Software Engineer – Generative AI Innovation
job.description:
Overview
Client is seeking a Senior Software Engineer – Generative AI Innovation to serve as a hands-on technical leader focused on identifying, evaluating, prototyping, and delivering Generative AI solutions that create business value. This role combines software engineering, applied AI research, solution prototyping, and emerging technology evaluation to accelerate AI adoption across Institutional Banking.
The successful candidate will collaborate with business stakeholders, technology partners, and governance teams to transform ideas into working solutions, guide initiatives through governance processes, and support the transition of validated solutions into production environments. This role requires strong technical curiosity, initiative, and the ability to operate independently while advising on emerging AI technologies and industry developments.

Core Responsibilities
• Design, build, and deploy proof-of-concept and production-ready Generative AI solutions using modern software engineering practices and cloud-native technologies.
• Evaluate, prototype, and validate emerging Generative AI platforms, tools, vendors, and capabilities to determine applicability and value for business use cases.
• Develop AI-enabled applications and workflows utilizing large language models (LLMs), Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), agentic AI frameworks, document intelligence technologies, workflow automation platforms, APIs, and cloud services.
• Rapidly transform business ideas into working software solutions through technical experimentation, prototyping, and solution validation.
• Partner with business stakeholders to identify opportunities where AI can improve productivity, decision-making, client service, operational efficiency, and risk management.
• Provide technical input, documentation, and support for governance, risk, compliance, model review, and technology approval activities related to AI initiatives.
• Research industry trends, emerging technologies, and vendor capabilities, and communicate recommendations to technology and business leadership.
• Design and implement integrations between AI platforms, enterprise systems, and cloud services.
• Establish engineering standards, reusable patterns, and best practices for AI solution development.
• Develop secure, maintainable, testable, and high-quality code while supporting production deployments, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement efforts.
• Create technical documentation, reference architectures, implementation guidance, presentations, and demonstration materials.
• Present prototypes, findings, recommendations, and solution roadmaps to stakeholders and senior management.
• Maintain awareness of evolving AI regulatory, governance, security, and risk management considerations and incorporate appropriate controls into solution designs.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies
• 5+ years of professional software engineering experience developing web-based or distributed applications.
• Demonstrated experience building software solutions using modern programming languages, frameworks, APIs, and cloud services.
• Hands-on experience working with Generative AI technologies, large language models (LLMs), AI-enabled applications, or related emerging technologies.
• Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to independently navigate ambiguity and rapidly learn new technologies.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
• Proven ability to take ownership of complex problems and drive solutions from concept through implementation.
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience preferred.

Preferred Skills or Experience
• Experience with cloud platforms such as Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and/or Microsoft Azure.
• Experience implementing or evaluating Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), agentic AI workflows, document intelligence solutions, or workflow automation platforms.
• Experience operating within regulated industries and partnering with governance, risk, compliance, security, or legal functions.
• Experience evaluating vendor technologies and making technical recommendations to business and technology leadership.
• Experience supporting proof-of-concept development, experimentation, and innovation initiatives.

The Data Center Chief Engineer reports directly to the Facility Manager.

Essential Job Functions

  1. Contribute to creating tracking and maintaining operational budget for facility.

Including determining details/timeline of the incident, all contributing factors, developing and tracking all associated corrective actions and process improvements associated with event.

job.title: IT Project Test Lead
job.description:

Client is seeking an experienced IT Project Test Leader to lead testing, validation, training, and cutover activities supporting a large-scale manufacturing facility startup and legacy site transition. This role is responsible for developing and executing comprehensive testing strategies across enterprise and manufacturing systems while ensuring operational readiness, compliance, and successful business adoption.
The ideal candidate brings experience leading complex testing programs within manufacturing environments, including MES, ERP, WMS, infrastructure, and production floor technologies, while partnering with cross-functional stakeholders to support successful deployment and operational readiness.

Core Responsibilities
• Develop and lead the overall testing and training strategy for a new manufacturing facility startup and legacy site closure.
• Coordinate testing activities across MES, ERP, WMS, infrastructure, production floor technologies, and enterprise applications.

• Partner with business stakeholders, project managers, vendors, quality teams, and manufacturing operations leaders to support successful deployment and user adoption.

• 8+ years of experience leading testing and quality assurance activities for large-scale IT implementations.
• Experience supporting manufacturing, supply chain, or production environments.
• Strong knowledge of testing methodologies, defect management, validation processes, and system integration testing.
• Experience with MES, ERP, WMS, production floor systems, infrastructure deployments, and enterprise applications.

job.title: Digital Process Automation Specialist
job.description:
Digital Process Automation Specialist

Position Overview

Goal is to accelerate the digitization of several of our critical paper-based processes. The MSO automation demonstrated the value of this approach, eliminating approximately 2,000 hours of annual administrative effort while improving visibility, data accuracy, compliance, and auditability. More importantly, that analysis only considered the time savings for two stakeholders involved in the process. Many of the remaining paper-based workflows involve five or more salaried employees routing and approving the same document. As a result, the opportunity to reduce administrative labor and improve cycle times is likely even greater than what we realized with the MSO project. Beyond the direct labor savings, digitizing these workflows will free employees to focus on higher-value work rather than administrative tasks.

As discussed, Sol and Katie would lead the initiative by identifying and prioritizing processes, designing the future-state workflows, developing standardized work instructions, coordinating testing, training users, and measuring the benefits realized. The temporary resource would focus on building the Power Automate workflows and supporting implementation, allowing us to accelerate Hampton's digital transformation without impacting our day-to-day Finance responsibilities. Close We are seeking an Administrative Assistant – Digital Process Automation to support an initiative focused on eliminating paper-based and manual administrative processes through digital workflow automation.

This is a hands-on, project-focused position responsible for supporting the design, development, testing, and implementation of digital solutions primarily using Microsoft Power Automate, Power Apps, SharePoint, and Microsoft 365.

The successful candidate will partner with Finance, Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, and other functional teams to understand existing business processes and convert manual forms, approvals, emails, spreadsheets, and paper-based workflows into efficient and standardized digital solutions.

The goal is not simply to convert paper forms into electronic versions, but to simplify administrative processes, automate workflows, improve visibility and data quality, strengthen controls, and reduce manual effort.

Position Details

  • Employment Type: Contract / Temporary
  • Schedule: Monday – Friday
  • Hours: 7:00 AM – 4:00 PM
  • Lunch: One-hour unpaid lunch
  • Interview Process: Two rounds – phone and in-person

Top Skills

  1. Experience developing solutions using Microsoft Power Automate
  2. Experience building forms or applications using Microsoft Power Apps
  3. Ability to understand a business process and translate requirements into an automated workflow

Key Responsibilities

Process Digitization & Automation

  • Design and build digital workflows using Microsoft Power Apps and Power Automate.
  • Convert paper forms, manual approvals, email-based processes, and spreadsheets into standardized digital workflows.
  • Develop electronic forms and applications using Power Apps.
  • Build automated approval routing, notifications, reminders, escalations, and status tracking using Power Automate.
  • Utilize SharePoint Lists and Microsoft 365 tools to securely capture, organize, and maintain workflow data.
  • Create automated audit trails, timestamps, approval records, and supporting documentation.
  • Identify opportunities to eliminate unnecessary administrative steps rather than simply recreating existing processes digitally.

Process Analysis & Workflow Design

  • Meet with process owners and end users to understand current workflows, pain points, business requirements, and control requirements.
  • Document current-state processes and translate business requirements into practical digital solutions.
  • Partner with project leads and functional stakeholders to develop simplified future-state workflows.
  • Identify high-volume or time-consuming manual processes that are good candidates for automation.
  • Recommend opportunities to improve efficiency, standardization, visibility, and internal controls.

Testing & Implementation

  • Develop and execute User Acceptance Testing (UAT) prior to implementation.
  • Troubleshoot workflow issues and make improvements based on user feedback.
  • Support deployment and transition of new solutions into day-to-day operations.
  • Develop clear work instructions, process documentation, and standardized procedures.
  • Assist with employee training on newly implemented digital processes.
  • Ensure solutions are sustainable and can be maintained following project completion.

Reporting & Continuous Improvement

  • Develop basic dashboards and reporting tools to provide visibility into:
    • Workflow status
    • Cycle times
    • Transaction volumes
    • Outstanding actions
  • Establish baseline metrics and help measure improvements generated by automation projects.
  • Track administrative hours saved and process cycle-time improvements.
  • Maintain a pipeline of digitization opportunities and track projects through implementation.
  • Identify opportunities to reuse successful automation solutions across other business processes.

Initial Project Focus

Initial processes targeted for digitization may include:

  • New item number and job packet processes
  • Material requests and spot buys
  • Internal administrative forms
  • Risk release forms
  • Approval workflows
  • Additional paper-based and manual processes identified across the organization

The position will expand beyond the initial project list as additional automation opportunities are identified and prioritized.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience developing solutions using Microsoft Power Automate.
  • Experience building forms or applications using Microsoft Power Apps.
  • Working knowledge of SharePoint Lists and Microsoft 365.
  • Ability to analyze business processes and translate requirements into automated workflows.
  • Experience converting manual administrative processes into digital solutions.
  • Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
  • Strong organizational and project coordination skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple automation projects and priorities simultaneously.
  • Ability to work effectively with employees across multiple departments and organizational levels.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong documentation and administrative skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Power BI and dashboard development.
  • Experience with Microsoft Forms.
  • Experience with process mapping and continuous improvement.
  • Experience developing automated approval workflows, notifications, and escalations.
  • Experience working within a manufacturing or industrial environment.
  • Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing or continuous improvement principles.
  • Experience documenting business processes and developing standardized work instructions.

job.title: Quality Engineer
job.description:
Exciting career opportunity for an experienced Quality Engineering professional to join an excellent team of hard-working professionals at one of the islands finest defense / aerospace manufacturers. This is a well-established yet rapidly growing company that offers a very generous benefits package, flexible work schedule and awesome work culture!

We are seeking a highly motivated Quality Assurance Engineer to join our team. The successful candidate will provide quality assurance support to customers, suppliers, product development and manufacturing teams, resolving defects and ensuring products meet both customer and regulatory specifications. This role requires collaboration throughout the production lifecycle to ensure compliance with quality standards and continuous improvement of processes.

Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure products meet both customer and regulatory specifications
  • Develop and implement quality control plans and procedures
  • Conduct quality audits and inspections to identify defects and non-conformities
  • Investigate and resolve quality issues, including root cause analysis and corrective actions
  • Monitor and analyze quality performance metrics to identify areas for improvement
  • Participate in design and process reviews to ensure quality requirements are met
  • Provide training and support to production teams on quality standards and procedures
  • Create test procedures and quality plans to ensure product scope, requirements, and product functions are clearly defined, recommending improvements where needed.
  • Ensure products meet organizational, customer, and industry quality standards, including AS9100, AS9102, and other relevant aerospace regulations.
  • Support product development and operations teams by providing analysis and expertise during inspection and quality control stages.
  • Collaborate on root cause and corrective action plans to prevent recurrence of defects or process deviations and ensure timely responses from responsible parties.
  • Generate and Analyze quality data to identify trends, with the goal of reducing defects and improving product reliability.
  • Coordinate and support First Article Inspection (FAI) per AS9102 requirements to ensure products meet both internal and external quality standards.
  • Assist in supplier quality activities including developing inspection plans for purchased products and parts, reviewing supplier first articles and performing on-site audits.
  • Lead quality planning efforts while collaborating with design engineering on new product development, including quality control strategies and ensure timely and compliant project execution.
  • Develop inspection plans for purchased products and parts.
  • Identify and implement opportunities for continuous improvement within the Quality Management System through procedural and product internal audits, supporting customer and 3rd party audits.
  • Support or lead internal, customer and 3rd party audits.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering or related field
  • Strong knowledge of quality control methodologies and tools
  • Experience with root cause analysis and corrective action processes
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills
  • Knowledge of, or the ability to learn, the organization's production processes and quality management systems (QMS).
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively across departments, including developers, project managers, and customer support teams.
  • Proficient in, or the ability to learn, root cause analysis and corrective action methods.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite.

Desired Experience:

  • Experience with root cause – corrective action investigation.
  • Knowledge about First Article Inspection Reports per AS9102.
  • Familiarity with Material Review Board (MRB) processes.
  • Quality certifications such as CQE (Certified Quality Engineer), CQA (Certified Quality Auditor), or similar.
  • Experience with AS9100, ISO 9001, FAA or NADCAP regulations.
  • Experience with quality inspection tools such as Net-Inspect, InspectionXpert, or similar software preferred

This position involves exposure to projects and contracts subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). As a result, only U.S. Citizens or Permanent Residents (Green Card holders) are eligible for employment in this role. Applicants must meet these requirements to be considered.

job.title: Credit Representative
job.description:
Credit Representative

Position Overview

The Credit Representative provides operational, administrative, and reporting support to the Credit Department within an invoice factoring environment. This position works closely with Credit Analysts and Credit leadership to ensure information is accurate, organized, current, and readily available to support effective portfolio monitoring and credit risk management.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, comfortable working with large amounts of data, and proficient in Microsoft Excel. While the primary focus of the position is administrative and reporting support, analytical aptitude and an interest in developing credit and risk management skills are highly valued.

This position is well suited for someone who enjoys working with data, identifying discrepancies, improving processes, and supporting a fast-paced team where accuracy and timely information are critical.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Credit Team & Administrative Support

  • Provide day-to-day administrative and operational support to Credit Analysts and Credit leadership.
  • Assist analysts with gathering, organizing, and maintaining:
    • Client information
    • Debtor information
    • Accounts receivable data
    • Credit-related information
  • Maintain accurate documentation and departmental records.
  • Assist with routine account maintenance and data updates within applicable systems and tracking tools.
  • Coordinate and track requests, follow-ups, and outstanding action items.
  • Prepare information and supporting materials for recurring:
    • Credit reviews
    • Portfolio reviews
    • Debtor reviews
    • Leadership reviews
  • Document meeting discussions, decisions, and action items as requested.
  • Follow up with appropriate team members to help ensure outstanding items are completed.
  • Support Credit leadership with special projects, data requests, research, and departmental initiatives.

Key Skills & Qualifications

  • Strong organizational and administrative skills.
  • High level of accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and ability to work with large amounts of data.
  • Ability to gather, organize, maintain, and track financial and credit-related information.
  • Strong analytical aptitude with the ability to identify discrepancies and data inconsistencies.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, requests, and follow-up items in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with Credit Analysts, Credit leadership, and other internal stakeholders.
  • Interest in developing knowledge of credit analysis, portfolio monitoring, accounts receivable, and credit risk management.
  • Previous experience within credit, accounts receivable, finance, banking, lending, factoring, or financial services is beneficial.

job.title: Mechanical Engineer - Entry Level
job.description:
Mechanical Engineer - Entry Level
$80,000-$95,000

The Mechanical Engineer I is responsible for researching, planning, and designing stations and machines using calculations, mechanical principals, and proven practices to create semi/fully automated assembly and test systems.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  • Researches and analyzes data such as customer request for quote, customer specifications, and PMD's proposal to develop or determine feasibility of design or application.
  • Work within design hour constraints, schedule constraints, and overall machine budget constraints.
  • Work in a collaborative environment to make sure the designs developed are the most cost effective and will meet the customer's requirements.
  • Develop/review concepts to confirm the design will meet required performance metrics including cycle time, yield, uptime, CPK and Gage R&R.
  • Design mechanisms, stations, machines using 3D modeling software (SolidWorks).
  • Works with vendors to obtain competitive quotes for major purchased components.
  • Create detailed fabrication drawings for all custom designed parts.
  • Create detailed assembly drawings identifying each individual component
  • Create a complete Bill of Material for each design/station.
  • Release completed designs to Project Management
  • Supports fabrication, assembly, debug and machine qualification activities to ensure design conforms to customer requirements and specifications
  • Observe safety procedures.

OTHER DUTIES

  • Maintain a clean and orderly work area.
  • Any other task assigned by management within scope of position, federal and state regulations.

Requirements

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE

  • Associates or bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent work experience.
  • General knowledge of manufacturing process preferred.
  • Working knowledge of Solidworks, AutoCAD, Microsoft Word and Excel and internet research.
  • Occasionally required to travel up to 5%.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES

  • Effective verbal and written communication.
  • Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general technical procedures.
  • Ability to calculate engineering formulas including deflection, moment of inertia, stress, along with applying concepts of algebra and geometry.
  • Organized
  • Detail oriented
  • Ability to work independently and to collaborate on a team
  • Creative/Innovative
  • Time management skills
  • Ability to take direction
  • Ability to apply mechanical engineering principals.
  • Ability to interpret instructions which are written, oral or drawn.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS & WORK ENVIRONMENT

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Regularly required to sit, lift; use hands to handle or feel; reach with hands and arms; talk or hear; and smell.
  • Occasionally required to stand and walk.
  • Regularly lift and/or move up to 25 pounds unassisted.
  • Rarely required to push, pull, climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch and crawl.
  • Specific vision abilities include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
  • Work environment is primarily performed indoors around moving mechanical parts at a moderate noise level.
  • Occasionally perform work outdoors in all types of weather.
  • Wear safety equipment, including proper PPE.

Technical Support (70%)

Prepares prototypes and samples of dessert food products (including cakes, cheesecakes, cookies, donuts, and ice cream) in support of new product development and product or process improvements.

Documents laboratory work, tests conducted, and results in lab notebooks or designated computerized systems.

Experiments & Analysis (30%)

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, hands on test kitchen environment.

Exposure to food ingredients, chemicals, cleaning agents, and varying temperatures.

Onsite, regular, and predictable attendance as scheduled is required.

job.title: Test Technician
job.description:
Duties:

Must assess product evaluation against NEC and UL/CSA standards. Review order write-ups, operate components, ensure product quality, work with other areas to ensure quality, and verify units to meet agency approvals.


Performs experience testing and troubleshoots power conversion equipment prior to shipment.


Conducts test following specific test procedures by using measuring instruments and computer test programs


Documents test results with appropriate information in a complete manner


Uses measuring instruments, assorted related tools, and computer test program accurately. Work with Test and Manufacturing Engineers on test equipment development. Coordinate the development and modifications of test work instructions.


Reads and interprets specific test procedures to properly perform and document test results


Performs tests to measure strength, durability and maintainability as required


Collects test data and prepares reports detailing results


Installs, diagnoses, services and repairs electrical equipment prior to shipment of finished product. Configure and connect system equipment (switchgear, SCCT cabinets, and power ties), and perform preliminary inspection and tests.


Applies knowledge and ability to use hand tools and operate test equipment according to established procedures


Reads and understands wiring diagrams to trace electrical circuits and ensure proper operation according to engineered specifications. Makes repairs as needed in circuitry.


Examines electrical equipment during operating cycles to detect excess vibration, overheating, fluid leaks, and loose, noisy or non-functioning parts. Repairs any problems found to be non-conforming to engineered specification


Replaces defective parts


Performs other fixes found to ensure the unit is operational at time of shipment



Skills:

Beginning level of computer skills with knowledge of MS office products such as Word and Excel


Ability to read and comprehend simple instructions, write short correspondence and effectively present information to others in English


Should be knowledgable in the use of the following equipment: hypot tester, multi meters, wave and power analyzer, and oscilloscope.


Must be able to read electrical and mechanical blueprints.

job.title: Warehouse Associate
job.description:
WAREHOUSE ASSOCIATE / DELIVERY DRIVER TRAINEE Located in Leetsdale, PA
Pay: $19.50/hour – Weekly Pay
Schedule: Full-Time – Monday through Friday 7 am – 4 pm (overtime as needed)

BUILD YOUR CAREER FROM THE WAREHOUSE TO THE DRIVER'S SEAT!
This is a dual-role position designed for someone who wants to learn the business from the ground up and grow into a driving position.
You will start as a Warehouse Associate, learning the company's products, processes, and warehouse operations. As you become familiar with the business, you will also learn about the Driver role.
Once fully trained in the warehouse (approximately 3 months), you will transition into a Driver/Warehouse Associate role. These are same day deliveries from the warehouse.
IMPORTANT: This is a warehouse-first position. Even after becoming a driver, you will be expected to work in the warehouse whenever you are not driving. Candidates must be comfortable with both sides of the job.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
Warehouse Responsibilities:

  • Learn the company's warehouse operations from the ground up
  • Receive, organize, stage, load, and unload materials
  • Assist with picking, packing, and preparing orders
  • Operate a forklift after training
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment
  • Assist coworkers and support daily warehouse needs
  • Perform physical warehouse work as needed
Driving Responsibilities (after fully trained)
  • Operate a 26-foot box truck for local deliveries
  • Follow assigned delivery routes and schedules
  • Safely load, secure, transport, and deliver materials
  • Complete required delivery paperwork
  • Represent the company professionally when interacting with customers
  • Return to the facility and assist with warehouse duties when not driving
MUST-HAVES
  • Clean driving record – no driving infractions
  • Must be able to pass a DOT medical/health examination
  • Valid driver's license appropriate for operating a commercial non-CDL vehicle
  • Ability and willingness to learn to operate a forklift
  • Ability to safely operate a 26-foot box truck after training
  • Reliable attendance and dependable work ethic
  • Comfortable performing physical warehouse work
  • Willingness to work in the warehouse when not driving

THE RIGHT FIT
We are looking for someone who wants to learn, grow, and build a long-term career with the company.
The ideal candidate understands that the warehouse is an important part of the role. You will learn the operation from the bottom up, become familiar with the business, and eventually take on driving responsibilities while continuing to support the warehouse team.
Start in the warehouse. Learn the business. Earn the opportunity to drive. Build your career.

job.title: Credit Representative
job.description:
Position Overview

The Credit Representative provides operational, administrative, and reporting support to the Credit Department within an invoice factoring environment. This position works closely with Credit Analysts and Credit leadership to ensure information is accurate, organized, current, and readily available to support effective portfolio monitoring and credit risk management.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, comfortable working with large amounts of data, and proficient in Microsoft Excel. While the primary focus of the position is administrative and reporting support, analytical aptitude and an interest in developing credit and risk management skills are highly valued.

This position is well suited for someone who enjoys working with data, identifying discrepancies, improving processes, and supporting a fast-paced team where accuracy and timely information are critical.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Credit Team & Administrative Support

  • Provide day-to-day administrative and operational support to Credit Analysts and Credit leadership.
  • Assist Credit Analysts with gathering, organizing, and maintaining:
    • Client information
    • Debtor information
    • Accounts receivable data
    • Credit-related information
  • Maintain accurate documentation and departmental records.
  • Assist with routine account maintenance and data updates within applicable systems and tracking tools.
  • Coordinate and track requests, follow-ups, and outstanding action items.
  • Prepare information and supporting materials for recurring:
    • Credit reviews
    • Portfolio reviews
    • Debtor reviews
    • Leadership reviews
  • Document meeting discussions, decisions, and action items as requested.
  • Follow up with appropriate team members to ensure outstanding items are completed in a timely manner.
  • Support Credit leadership with special projects, data requests, research, and departmental initiatives.

Key Skills & Qualifications

  • Strong administrative, organizational, and data-management skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel.
  • Comfortable working with large volumes of data and financial information.
  • Ability to identify discrepancies and maintain accurate records.
  • Strong follow-up and tracking skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Analytical aptitude and interest in developing credit and risk-management skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with Credit Analysts, leadership, and other internal stakeholders.
  • Experience with credit, collections, accounts receivable, invoicing, factoring, banking, finance, or financial services is beneficial.

job.title: Mechanical Engineer - Integrator Support
job.description:
TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS

  • Expected %: 50% Integrators - 30% Hickory
  • Location(s): Integrator sites (Scotland and Canada), Hickory, and occasional remote work

INTERVIEW PROCESS:

  1. 30 minute initial screening with manager via Teams
  2. 90 minute panel interview via Teams (candidate to present on 1 or 2 previous projects, and skills/experience)


EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE

  • Minimum of a BS in Mechanical Engineering. Mechatronics or related Stem Field
  • 7+ years experience supporting fabrication, assembly, installation, or integration activities associated with process manufacturing equipment/automation

DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

The Integrator Support - Mechanical role provides hands-on mechanical oversight and technical support across multiple integrator sites to ensure equipment is built, installed, and commissioned in accordance with design requirements. The position supports fabrication quality, issue resolution, development activities, and vendor coordination while maintaining consistent mechanical standards and execution across the project.

SKILLS REQUIRED

  • Strong mechanical aptitude
  • Ability to evaluate mechanical execution and workmanship
  • Ability to communicate effectively with integrators and engineering teams
  • Familiarity with development systems, testing activities, and equipment builds
  • Ability to travel extensively as project needs require

SKILLED DESIRED:

  • Prior integrator-support experience
  • Experience with machine assembly and mechanical troubleshooting
  • Familiarity with multiple vendor environments
  • Ability to support development test beds and prototype equipment
  • Cross-functional awareness of controls and system integration concept

RESPONSIBILITIES / EXPECTATION

Development & Engineering:

  • Support mechanical design execution and development activities
  • Assist with development systems and test-bed activities
  • Represent mechanical leadership when primary resources are unavailable
  • Support technical communications with integrators

Project Closure:

Miscellaneous:

job.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer – Sustaining
job.description:
Sustaining Engineering Manager Job Description

Location: Edinboro, PA
Position Type: Full-Time

Position Overview

We are seeking a Sustaining Engineering Manager to lead a team responsible for supporting released products throughout their entire lifecycle. This position will provide technical leadership and people management while ensuring products remain reliable, manufacturable, compliant, cost-effective, and aligned with customer and business requirements.

The manager will work closely with Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Product Management, Customer Support, and New Product Development to resolve technical issues, improve existing products, manage engineering changes, and drive continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, mentor, and manage a team of Sustaining Engineers.
  • Provide technical direction for released products throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Lead root cause analysis, failure investigations, corrective actions, and CAPA activities.
  • Partner with Manufacturing, Quality, and Supply Chain to resolve production issues, improve yield, and reduce costs.
  • Oversee engineering changes, deviations, ECOs/ECNs, and technical documentation.
  • Support customer escalations and field issues through engineering analysis and corrective solutions.
  • Ensure products maintain compliance with applicable industry standards, safety requirements, and regulatory certifications.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on quality, reliability, manufacturability, cost reduction, and product performance.
  • Manage engineering priorities, workload, resources, and project assignments.
  • Coach and develop engineers through technical guidance, mentoring, and performance management.
  • Partner with New Product Development and ETO teams to ensure smooth transition of new products into sustaining engineering.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to improve long-term product health and operational performance.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of engineering management or technical leadership experience.
  • Background in sustaining engineering, product engineering, manufacturing engineering, or related engineering disciplines.
  • Experience with root cause analysis, failure investigations, CAPA, and corrective action processes.
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing processes and Design for Manufacturability (DFM).
  • Experience working with Manufacturing, Quality, Operations, Supply Chain, and/or Product Management.
  • Experience with engineering change management, ECO/ECN processes, and technical documentation.
  • Experience with 3D CAD and PLM systems.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, organizational, and leadership skills.
  • Ability to balance hands-on technical problem solving with team leadership and resource management.

Ideal Candidate Background

Look for candidates with titles such as:

  • Sustaining Engineering Manager
  • Engineering Manager
  • Sustaining Engineering Lead
  • Product Engineering Manager
  • Product Development Manager
  • Manufacturing Engineering Manager
  • Engineering Supervisor
  • Senior Manufacturing Engineer
  • Senior Product Engineer
  • Sustaining Engineer
  • Product Engineer

Key differentiators: Candidates who have managed engineers and have hands-on experience with manufacturing issues, RCA/CAPA, engineering changes, product reliability, and lifecycle management.

job.title: SolidWorks Designer
job.description:
Location: Painted Post, NY

Type: 100% On-Site

Schedule: Typically 8AM-5PM, Mon-Fri but anticipate some longer/off-shift hours to support project needs.

Interview Process: 30 minute initial screening via teams, then 60 minute panel interview (presentation not required). Manager will consider nonlocal candidates willing to relocate at their own expense.
 

Required Education/Experience:

Minimum of HS Diploma. Degree not required. 5 years proven hands on experience required. Proven capability in mechanical design, detailing, manufacturing support, and equipment development is valued more than specific credentials.

 

Position Summary

  • We are seeking an experienced Mechanical Design Technician or Mechanical Designer to support the development of custom equipment, fixtures, tooling, prototypes, and manufacturing systems.
  • The successful candidate will transform conceptual designs and engineering direction into complete, manufacturable mechanical designs ready for procurement, fabrication, assembly, and deployment.
  • This role requires strong practical mechanical design experience, expertise with SolidWorks and SolidWorks PDM, and a thorough understanding of manufacturing methods, mechanical components, tolerancing, assembly practices, and mechanical systems.
  • The position is highly hands-on and includes equipment assembly, fitting, troubleshooting, vendor interaction, and supporting procurement activities.
  • Practical experience, sound engineering judgment, and demonstrated design capability are valued more highly than formal educational qualifications.
  • This role is around 50% Design and 50% installation, prototyping, assembly, etc...
 

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop complete mechanical designs from sketches, concepts, engineering direction, and preliminary layouts.
  • Create detailed 3D models, assemblies, manufacturing drawings, fabrication drawings, and assembly documentation using SolidWorks.
  • Generate and maintain bills of material (BOMs), part specifications, and engineering documentation within SolidWorks PDM.
  • Select and specify purchased components, standard hardware, and commercial-off-the-shelf equipment appropriate for project requirements.
  • Work closely with internal supply chain, procurement, and manufacturing personnel to source and procure components and equipment.
  • Interface directly with external suppliers and vendors to identify, specify, quote, and procure mechanical components, assemblies, and fabricated equipment.
  • Apply sound mechanical design principles including appropriate tolerance schemes, constraint methods, fit selection, manufacturability, maintainability, and assembly considerations.
  • Produce manufacturing-ready documentation suitable for internal shops, external fabricators, and equipment vendors.
  • Support prototype construction, assembly, fitting, debugging, troubleshooting, and design refinement activities.
  • Verify design intent through fit-up, inspection, testing, and assembly activities.
  • Participate in design reviews and collaborate with engineers, technicians, manufacturing personnel, and suppliers to resolve technical issues.
  • Maintain accurate documentation, revision control, and drawing standards compliance throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Support installation, startup, and commissioning activities as required.
 

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience creating complete mechanical designs, manufacturing drawings, and assembly documentation for custom equipment, tooling, fixtures, machinery, or automation systems.
  • Proficiency using SolidWorks for part modeling, assembly modeling, drafting, and design detailing.
  • Experience using SolidWorks PDM or a similar engineering document management system.
  • Strong understanding of mechanical design fundamentals including:
    • Tolerancing and fit selection
    • GD&T fundamentals
    • Constraint-based design
    • Assembly methods
    • Material selection
    • Manufacturability and fabrication practices
  • Experience creating and managing BOMs and purchased component specifications.
  • Hands-on mechanical aptitude with the ability to assemble, modify, and troubleshoot mechanical systems.
  • Proficiency using common shop measurement equipment including calipers, micrometers, indicators, height gages, and related inspection tools.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Excellent communication and organizational skills.
 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing equipment used in manufacturing, process development, laboratory environments, or production operations.
  • Familiarity with standard industrial mechanical components including:
    • Linear bearings and guide systems
    • Rotary bearings and bearing supports
    • Lead screws and ball screws
    • Timing belt and pulley systems
    • Gearboxes and power transmission components
    • Pneumatic cylinders, valves, regulators, and controls
    • Hydraulic components and systems
    • Industrial hardware and fastening systems
    • Structural framing systems
    • Sensors, actuators, and motion control components
  • Experience working directly with machine shops, fabrication vendors, and equipment suppliers.
  • Familiarity with common engineering materials and manufacturing processes including machining, welding, sheet metal fabrication, additive manufacturing, and assembly operations.
  • Experience supporting prototype development, equipment installation, and troubleshooting activities.
  • Experience working within multidisciplinary engineering and manufacturing teams

job.title: Mechanical Design Engineer
job.description:
Position Summary

As an ETO Mechanical Design Engineer, you will be responsible for developing customized mechanical designs that meet unique customer, site, and application requirements. This role requires strong technical judgment, customer focus, and the ability to work independently with limited supervision in a fast paced, order driven environment.

You will collaborate closely with sales, applications engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and quality teams to translate customer requirements into manufacturable, compliant, and cost effective engineered solutions.

Responsibilities


  • Develop and release custom mechanical designs in response to customer specific requirements within an Engineer to Order environment.

  • Create detailed 3D models, assemblies, and production drawings using Autodesk Inventor, with secondary support using PTC Creo.

  • Work directly with sales, applications, and customers to clarify requirements and resolve technical questions.

  • Ensure designs comply with applicable standards, regulations, and internal design guidelines.

  • Coordinate with manufacturing engineering, suppliers, and operations to ensure designs are manufacturable and meet delivery commitments.

  • Support quotation, order execution, and change management activities throughout the order lifecycle.

  • Create and maintain BOMs, drawings, and engineering change documentation in ERP and PLM systems.

  • Resolve design and manufacturing issues independently and apply lessons learned to future orders.

  • Balance speed, accuracy, and quality in a high mix, customer driven environment.


Preferred Qualifications:


  • Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent experience.

  • Experience designing sheet metal enclosures and assemblies for customer specific applications.

  • Working knowledge of laser cutting, punch press, press brake, welding, and powder coating processes.

  • Experience working in formal Engineer to Order environments supporting sales and order execution.

  • Experience with ERP systems such as Oracle PD Cloud or Microsoft Dynamics.

job.title: IT Technical Lead - (Banking)
job.description:
Overview
Client is seeking an IT Technical Lead to provide technical leadership for technology platforms supporting Commercial Real Estate (CRE) lending operations. This role is responsible for the architecture, development, integration, implementation, support, and continuous improvement of solutions across the commercial real estate lending lifecycle.
The IT Technical Lead partners with business stakeholders, architects, product owners, engineers, and vendors to design scalable, secure technology solutions aligned with business strategy and enterprise architecture standards. The role also drives engineering excellence, mentors development teams, and ensures system reliability, security, and performance.

Core Responsibilities
• Lead the technical strategy, architecture, and modernization initiatives for Commercial Real Estate originations applications and integrations.
• Design scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions supporting commercial real estate lending processes.
• Define application architecture standards, integration patterns, and engineering best practices.
• Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend solutions that improve operational efficiency and reduce technical debt.
• Lead development, enhancement, implementation, and support activities across the technology ecosystem.
• Collaborate with product owners and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
• Review and approve technical designs, code, deployment plans, and implementation strategies.
• Establish and enforce coding standards, testing strategies, CI/CD practices, and security requirements.
• Participate in design reviews, troubleshooting, performance optimization, and production support activities.
• Serve as the technical subject matter expert for Moody's CreditLens and related lending applications.
• Support integrations between CreditLens and internal lending, workflow, document, and data platforms.
• Drive technical solutions supporting deal intake, underwriting, financial spreading, credit approvals, covenant tracking, and portfolio management processes.
• Partner with business and vendor teams to evaluate platform capabilities and roadmap opportunities.
• Mentor developers and engineers while fostering a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence.
• Conduct code reviews and provide technical guidance to project teams.
• Lead root-cause analysis and resolution of complex technical issues.
• Establish performance, availability, resiliency, and monitoring standards for supported applications.
• Promote Agile delivery practices and continuous improvement across the software development lifecycle.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
• 8+ years of application development, systems integration, or software engineering experience.
• 3+ years of technical leadership experience leading development teams or large-scale technology initiatives.
• Experience designing and supporting enterprise applications in complex environments.
• Strong experience with .NET / C# development.
• Strong experience with REST APIs and service-oriented architectures.
• Strong experience with SQL and relational databases.
• Strong experience with system integrations and middleware technologies.
• Strong experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
• Strong experience with cloud and SaaS application architectures.
• Experience using Git, Azure DevOps, GitLab, or similar toolsets.
• Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), Agile methodologies, and engineering best practices.
• Excellent problem-solving, communication, collaboration, and leadership skills.
• Ability to communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and business audiences.

Preferred Skills or Experience
• Commercial lending or Commercial Real Estate lending technology experience.
• Experience with Moody's CreditLens or other commercial credit underwriting platforms.
• Knowledge of CRE origination, underwriting, credit approval, and portfolio management processes.
• Experience integrating third-party SaaS platforms with enterprise applications.
• Familiarity with enterprise data integration, cloud platforms, and modern API architectures.
• Experience supporting regulatory, risk, and compliance requirements within financial services.
• Architecture certification or advanced technical certifications.

job.title: Dispatcher
job.description:
Position Overview

The Dispatcher provides Call Management System scheduling and coordination support to customers, Service Delivery Team Members, Field Associates, and Business Management Team Members. This position shares responsibility for meeting customer service performance expectations while also providing focused support for special projects involving high-visibility customers.

The ideal candidate is self-directed, organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities simultaneously in a fast-paced service environment. The position requires flexibility to work varied shifts, including evenings and weekends.

Key Responsibilities

Dispatch & Scheduling

  • Review incoming service calls, determine urgency, and schedule calls appropriately.
  • Dispatch service calls to technicians and Flex Labor Partners and monitor assignments through completion.
  • Coordinate with technicians, internal business teams, and customers regarding scheduling and service needs.
  • Contact customers with estimated technician arrival times as necessary.
  • Utilize knowledge of technician coverage and geographic territories to improve scheduling and resource efficiency.
  • Coordinate parts ordering and shipments with technicians and schedule service calls accordingly.
  • Identify duplicate service calls and bundle them when appropriate.

Call Management & SLA Monitoring

  • Monitor the Call Management System in real time to ensure Service Level Agreements (SLAs) are being met.
  • Ensure available technicians are actively assigned to service calls.
  • Monitor scheduling gaps or white space to maximize technician productivity and resource utilization.
  • Monitor incomplete service calls and escalate issues until they are resolved.
  • Document technician unavailability within the Call Management System during emergency situations according to established procedures.
  • Communicate technician availability issues to the appropriate internal teams.

Customer Service & Issue Resolution

  • Proactively identify and resolve scheduling and service-related issues.
  • Escalate urgent customer service needs and technician-related issues or concerns to the appropriate management team.
  • Document customer dissatisfaction and field-related issues and communicate them to the appropriate team for follow-up.
  • Document positive customer feedback and recognize technicians for strong performance.
  • Maintain professional communication with customers, technicians, suppliers, and internal stakeholders.

Reporting & Communication

  • Participate in conference calls regarding service operations and customer needs.
  • Provide analysis and updates related to:
    • Call volumes
    • High-priority customers
    • Known service issues
    • Technician availability
    • Service performance
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • 1–3 years of experience in customer service, call center operations, dispatching, scheduling, or a related environment.
  • Ability to work independently and be self-directed.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to use logic and understand operational and business efficiencies.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to effectively interact with customers, suppliers, technicians, and internal stakeholders at various organizational levels.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft applications and general PC systems.

Education

  • Associate degree preferred, or relevant equivalent experience.

Schedule & Travel

  • Must be available to work varied shifts, including evenings and weekends, as scheduled.
  • Minimal business travel may be required.

job.title: Instrumentation Engineer
job.description:
Nesco Resource is partnering with a global engineering and technology organization seeking an Instrumentation Engineer to join its Houston engineering team.

This position will support large-scale industrial process and capital projects from engineering and design through procurement, construction, commissioning, and startup.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in instrumentation engineering, field instrumentation, and instrument installation. This is not a programming-focused controls/automation position. We are looking for someone who enjoys the hands-on technical side of instrumentation engineering and wants to continue growing within that specialty.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop instrumentation engineering deliverables including instrument indexes, I/O lists, datasheets, loop diagrams, hook-up drawings, cable schedules, and installation layouts
  • Specify and select field instrumentation for pressure, temperature, flow, and level
  • Size and specify control valves and other instrumentation equipment
  • Develop instrument specifications, technical documentation, material requisitions, and bid evaluations
  • Review vendor drawings and technical documentation
  • Provide instrumentation input to P&IDs and project design documentation
  • Support instrument layouts, cable engineering, BOM estimates, and installation requirements
  • Coordinate with process, electrical, mechanical, piping, and controls/automation engineering teams
  • Participate in design and 3D model reviews for accessibility and constructability
  • Interface with clients, vendors, contractors, and project teams
  • Support FATs, SATs, loop checks, field installation, commissioning, startup, and troubleshooting
  • Support projects throughout engineering, procurement, construction, and field execution

Qualifications

  • B.S. in Electrical Engineering or related electrical discipline required
  • 3+ years of instrumentation engineering experience within chemical, petrochemical, refining, energy, industrial process, EPC, or similar environments
  • Strong hands-on experience with field instrumentation design and specification
  • Experience with control valve sizing and specification
  • Experience developing instrumentation engineering deliverables in a project environment
  • EIT/FE certification with a commitment to pursue PE licensure preferred
  • Familiarity with DCS, PLC, SCADA, and/or Safety Instrumented Systems is beneficial; however, this position is not centered around PLC programming or controls programming
  • Knowledge of applicable ISA, IEC, NEC, NFPA, and/or API standards is preferred
  • Experience with engineering software such as COMOS, SmartPlant, or AutoCAD is a plus but not required
  • Must be comfortable traveling approximately 20–30% domestically and internationally

Ideal Background

Exact industry experience is less important than having strong instrumentation fundamentals. Candidates from chemical, petrochemical, refining, oil & gas, energy, EPC, process manufacturing, or other large industrial project environments are encouraged to apply.

This is an excellent opportunity for an engineer who wants to remain a hands-on technical Instrumentation Engineer and contribute to complex, large-scale industrial projects while working with a collaborative engineering team.

job.title: Tactical Buyer
job.description:
Tactical Buyer / Procurement Specialist

Position Summary

We are seeking a Tactical Buyer / Procurement Specialist to support day-to-day procurement, supplier management, sourcing, and operational excellence activities. This role is responsible for independently managing a portfolio of tactical, non-critical suppliers, while partnering closely with Sourcing Leads on more complex or critical supplier activities.

The ideal candidate is a proactive procurement professional who understands the requisition-to-pay process, supplier relationships, contracts, sourcing activities, invoicing, cost analysis, and supplier performance. This position offers the opportunity to take ownership of supplier relationships while contributing to New Product Introduction (NPI) initiatives and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

Procurement

  • Proactively manage the requisition-to-pay process, including identifying and resolving exceptions.
  • Maintain accurate supplier and procurement master data.
  • Support process standardization and ensure procurement activities are completed efficiently and accurately.
  • Review supplier invoices, investigate discrepancies, and identify appropriate resolutions.

Supplier Management

  • Independently manage assigned tactical, non-critical suppliers and maintain strong operational and tactical relationships.
  • Monitor supplier status, performance, and short-term results.
  • Support critical supplier activities under the guidance of Sourcing Leads.
  • Transition commodities from single-sourcing toward appropriate single- and dual-sourcing strategies.
  • Partner with Sourcing Leads to manage supplier activities related to New Product Introduction (NPI).

Contract Management

  • Initiate and negotiate single-event contracts with non-critical suppliers.
  • Work with Sourcing Leads for guidance on contract terms, negotiations, and more complex supplier agreements.
  • Ensure agreements support business requirements and procurement objectives.

Supplier Performance

  • Monitor supplier performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Drive ad hoc corrective and improvement actions to enhance supplier KPIs.
  • Support supplier reporting and performance tracking.

Sourcing

  • Support market investigations and sourcing initiatives.
  • Assist with RFQs, tenders, supplier evaluations, and sourcing events.
  • Execute supplier and category strategies under the supervision of Sourcing Leads.
  • Support sourcing activities for tactical supplier categories.

Cost Accounting & Analysis

  • Analyze supplier costs, pricing, and related financial information.
  • Develop and execute action plans to address cost opportunities for non-critical accounts.
  • Work with Sourcing Leads when additional guidance is required.

Operational Excellence

  • Identify opportunities to improve procurement processes, supplier performance, and departmental efficiency.
  • Independently implement process improvements within the department or with assigned suppliers.
  • Promote standardization, efficiency, and continuous improvement across procurement activities.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Business, Finance, or a related field, preferred.
  • Relevant professional experience in procurement, purchasing, sourcing, supply chain, or supplier management may be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • Previous experience managing suppliers or purchasing activities in a similar role.
  • Understanding of the procure-to-pay / requisition-to-pay process.
  • Experience with supplier management, sourcing, purchasing, or contract administration.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to review invoices, investigate discrepancies, and drive resolutions.
  • Strong communication and relationship-management skills.
  • Ability to work independently while knowing when to escalate complex issues.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Comfortable working under regular supervision while taking ownership of assigned tactical suppliers and projects.

job.title: EHS Specialist
job.description:
Position Summary
The Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) Specialist provides temporary coverage for Design & Engineering (D&E) laboratory operations during an employee maternity leave. The position supports laboratory safety, regulatory compliance, incident management, safety programs, industrial hygiene activities, reporting, and stakeholder communication for the Silicon Valley site.

Key Responsibilities
1. Incident Management and Investigation
Lead investigations of near misses, incidents, injuries, good catches, and safety observations.
Conduct root cause analyses and define corrective and preventive actions.
Coordinate and track corrective actions through closure.
Prepare investigation reports and communicate findings to D&E management.
Manage incident records and workflows in Intelex.
2. Laboratory Safety and Compliance
Conduct monthly D&E laboratory inspections.
Track findings, corrective actions, and closure status.
Support compliance assessments against internal requirements and applicable regulatory standards.
Participate in management assessments and audits.
Arrange annual inspection for lifting equipment
3. Safety Program Administration
Review and approve chemical requests, PPE requests, hazard assessments, and related EHS submissions.
Support work permit review and approval activities.
Update and maintain Level 4 (L4) EHS procedures and supporting documentation.
4. Industrial Hygiene and Exposure Monitoring
Coordinate and perform industrial hygiene sampling for lead, beryllium copper, noise, radiation, and other exposure assessments as required.
Maintain monitoring records and communicate results to relevant stakeholders.
Support follow-up actions arising from sampling activities.
5. Training and Safety Engagement
Coordinate required EHS training activities and track completion and attendance.
Support contractor safety engagement activities.
Deliver or facilitate safety communications and awareness sessions.
6. Reporting and Stakeholder Communication
Prepare monthly EHS performance reports.
Present safety metrics, inspection results, incident trends, and action status at D&E Staff meetings and D&E Lab Owner Safety meetings.
Coordinate with site EHS and D&E leadership on emerging risks and mitigation plans.

Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Occupational Safety, Environmental Health, Industrial Hygiene, Engineering, or a related field.
Minimum 5 years of EHS experience in laboratory, engineering, manufacturing, semiconductor, or technology environments.
Experience conducting incident investigations and root cause analysis.
Knowledge of OSHA requirements and EHS management systems.
Experience with industrial hygiene sampling programs.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience supporting semiconductor or high-tech R&D laboratories.
Familiarity with Intelex or an equivalent EHS management system.
Familiarity with 3E chemical management systems.
Experience supporting radiation, chemical, and electrical safety programs.
CIH, CSP, CHMM, or equivalent certification.
Expected Outcomes
Incident investigations, reports, and corrective-action tracking completed in a timely manner.
Monthly laboratory inspections completed, with findings and actions tracked to closure.
Monthly EHS performance reporting prepared and communicated.
EHS requests, including chemical, PPE, hazard assessment, and work permit requests, reviewed within established service expectations.
Industrial hygiene sampling records, results, and follow-up actions maintained.
L4 procedures and supporting documentation kept current.
EHS training coordination records and attendance tracking maintained.
Other:
4 days per week onsite
