This role will drive a portfolio of automation, AI, and workflow transformation efforts across the Payments & Deposit Services organization, overseeing project governance, financial management, and cross-functional coordination.
The Project Manager will partner with operations, technology, risk, and vendor teams to modernize check processing, wire and RTP, ACH, lockbox, cash vault, virtual item processing, and reconciliation platforms. The role focuses on delivering measurable cost savings, reducing operational risk, and improving the client experience.

Core Responsibilities
• Lead and coordinate multiple concurrent modernization workstreams from intake through delivery, ensuring milestone tracking, risk mitigation, and timely issue resolution.
• Drive project governance and reporting, providing clear status updates, metrics, and escalations to leadership and business partners.
• Manage financial forecasting, budgeting, invoice tracking, and benefit realization, including cost savings and FTE efficiency tracking.
• Coordinate project scope, requirements, dependencies, and resource planning across operations, technology, risk, and vendor teams.
• Monitor cost, schedule, and technical performance across initiative components, identifying and escalating risks and issues as needed.
• Partner with process owners and subject matter experts to prioritize opportunities, develop business cases, and manage initiatives through funding checkpoints.
• Define and manage project scope, objectives, deliverables, and value propositions across stakeholders and lines of business.
• Develop integrated project plans, manage the critical path, and report progress against milestones and target outcomes.
• Ensure client and operational impacts are considered throughout planning, solution design, and change management activities.
• Support vendor engagement and contract management activities, ensuring adherence to obligations and performance expectations.
• Lead communication planning and stakeholder engagement across teams, leadership groups, and delivery partners.
• Follow established organizational processes for work delivery, change control, and project artifact management.
• Champion continuous improvement and operational excellence throughout the initiative lifecycle.
• Perform additional responsibilities as assigned to support organizational priorities.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies
• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
• Demonstrated project or program management experience, preferably within financial services or banking operations.
• Working knowledge of payments and deposit operations, including ACH, wire/RTP, check processing, lockbox, and reconciliation processes, and/or technology modernization programs.
• Strong understanding of agile delivery practices, project financial planning, and benefit tracking.
• Exceptional communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to tailor messaging for executive audiences.
• Strategic thinking with the ability to define and communicate initiative vision, priorities, and outcomes.
• Strong leadership, collaboration, execution, financial management, and risk management capabilities.

Preferred Skills or Experience
• PMP, PgMP, SAFe, or Agile certifications such as CSM or PSM.
• Experience delivering automation, RPA, or AI-enabled transformation initiatives.
• Experience managing initiatives within Commercial Banking, Payments, or related operational domains.
• Familiarity with vendor management, business case development, and cost-benefit or TCO modeling.

Work Details
• General office environment with prolonged sitting, frequent use of a PC or laptop, communication in person and by phone, and occasional lifting of items up to 10 pounds.

job.title: Configuration Analyst - Clearance
job.description:
Description:
You will be the Senior Configuration Analyst for the Configuration Management & Data Integrity Team. Our team safeguards product truth, trust, and traceability (T3) by governing revision control, documentation traceability, and baseline management across engineering and manufacturing – the backbone of every Lockheed Martin breakthrough.

What You Will Be Doing
As the Senior Configuration Analyst you will be responsible for driving configuration baseline control and data management rigor for critical defense programs. Working side by side with world class design engineers, you'll design, develop, and sustain traceability processes, evaluate engineering change proposals, and ensure all CM/DM practices meet contractual and internal standards throughout the product lifecycle.

Your responsibilities will include:
Manage product revision control and maintain the authoritative configuration baseline.
Design and support documentation traceability workflows for manufacturing and engineering teams.
Review, log, categorize, and track engineering changes against approved customer baselines.
Analyze Technical Data Packages and notify impacted stakeholders of configuration impacts.
Ensure CM and DM processes are fully compliant with contract, regulatory, and internal requirements.
Lead change management activities from concept through product sustainment.
Contribute to special projects and cross site initiatives that enhance T3 fidelity.
Produce clear, concise communications and documentation for highly detailed, mission critical work.
Mentor junior analysts and share best practices within the team.
You're a collaborative, detail oriented professional who thrives in fast paced, mission critical environments. At Lockheed Martin you'll be surrounded by a culture that empowers bold thinking, continuous learning, and growth mindset leadership. You'll benefit from world class resources, a flexible work environment, all while making a tangible impact on national security and pioneering technology. If you're ready to turn your passion for configuration management into a career that shapes the future, apply today and help us build a better tomorrow.

job.title: Procurement Buyer II
job.description:
Role Purpose
This position will lead the development and execution of Global Supply Management (GSM) Strategic Sourcing strategies, policies, tactics and objectives for assigned complex global commodities that align and are linked with the business units, commercial, supply chain and manufacturing strategies.

Key Responsibilities
Project Procurement Management – Planning & Strategy Development
Develop and/or assist with Strategic Sourcing plans and objectives (short & long term) based on forecasts of future demand and taking into account economic and currency trends and conditions that affect GSM, the business, and the global commodity sourced.
Apply a thorough understanding of the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) model, including cost of acquisition, use/administration, maintenance, transaction processing, and disposal of a given item or service.
Develop and use Work Breakdown Structures (WBS) by subdividing major project deliverables (from contract documents, scope of work, and historical contract data) into smaller, more manageable work packages.
Ensure well-developed Statements of Work (SOW) to provide clarity and accountability.
Understand and apply funding stage-gate processes to ensure alignment with project objectives.
Identify risks and develop comprehensive risk management plans to mitigate them.

Bid & Tender Process
Develop Requests for Proposals (RFPs) and Requests for Quotations (RFQs) for capital equipment, services, and facilities.
Lead pre-bid and post-award reviews and execute Decision Analysis to facilitate supplier selection and optimal procurement decisions.

Contracts & Contract Administration
Demonstrate a strong understanding of Contract Language, Business Law, and the Uniform Commercial Code.
Manage various contract types, including:
Firm Fixed Price
Lump Sum
Guaranteed Maximum Price (GMP)
Turnkey
Cost-Plus Fixed Fee
Time & Material
Unit Price
Shared Savings Contracts
Define and monitor performance schedules, ensuring sufficient detail to track critical milestones and assess project progress.
Ensure scope is delivered as agreed and meets the required levels of performance and quality.
Ensure both parties adhere to the conditions of the contract.
Ensure relationships between parties remain open, constructive, and collaborative.
Lead the full lifecycle of Contract Management, including contract planning, tendering (RFP/RFQ processes), statements of work, and overall project plans (scope, risk, procurement, quality, schedule, cost, and safety management).

Required Qualifications
  • Preferred Bachelor's degree in engineering, Technology, Supply Chain, Business, Construction Management, or a related field. Will accept no degree with applicable experience 10+ years.
  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in Capital Sourcing, Contract Administration, Procurement, Construction Management, or a related field.
  • Project Procurement Management experience, including planning and project development.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Certifications such as Certified Professional in Supply Management (CPSM), Project Management Professional (PMP), or Certified Supply Chain Professional (CSCP).
  • Experience in capital-intensive industries (e.g., manufacturing, energy, construction, industrial operations).
  • Proficiency with procurement tools such as SAP Ariba, Oracle Procurement, Coupa, or similar platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills and experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau).
  • Demonstrated experience leading sourcing activities for medium to large capital projects.
  • Strong negotiation, stakeholder management, and supplier relationship management skills.

job.title: Production Supervisor
job.description:
POSITION SUMMARY

This position reports to the Production Manager and assists with directing daily activities within the production facility. Responsibilities include overseeing safety, quality, production, EHS, FDA and GMP compliance, as well as hiring and training new and existing employees. The Shift Supervisor will also help improve production processes, equipment reliability, and identify opportunities for capital improvements.

GENERAL DESCRIPTION

The Shift Supervisor is responsible for monitoring and guiding production activities during the assigned shift. This position ensures production stays on schedule and follows Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs), regulatory requirements, and company policies.

The Shift Supervisor works closely with production employees and management, providing coaching, support, and direction while also making decisions to keep operations running safely and efficiently. Strong communication skills and a general understanding of production processes are important for success in this role.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Manage daily shift operations.

  • Ensure production stays on schedule.

  • Determine the most efficient use of employees, equipment, and supplies.

  • Review production reports and address issues as needed.

  • Monitor production operations throughout the shift and take corrective action when needed.

  • Ensure employees follow written SOPs, safety procedures, and company policies.

  • Prepare shift reports and communicate daily activities and concerns to the Production Manager and Plant Manager.

  • Monitor employees for compliance with policies and procedures.

  • Work with the Production Manager, Plant Manager, and Production Scheduler to plan staffing needs.

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date personnel records.

  • Promote good communication and teamwork among employees.

  • Maintain supply inventory and notify Purchasing when supplies are needed.

  • Notify Maintenance when equipment repairs or supplies are needed.

  • Prepare and submit maintenance work orders as needed.

  • Follow up with Maintenance regarding the status of work orders.

  • Participate in team meetings and company training programs.

  • Provide coaching and support to production employees.

  • Set quarterly goals with the Production Manager.

  • Continue developing skills through training, courses, and other educational opportunities.

  • Use time management skills to organize and prioritize daily responsibilities.

  • Communicate regularly with management regarding production performance, concerns, and company goals.

  • Follow all company policies and procedures.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WORK EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

This position may require long days, weekend, and holiday work depending on production needs. When the plant is operating on weekends or holidays, the Shift Supervisor is expected to be available to work the assigned shift.

The ability to handle changes, interruptions, and changing production needs is important for success in this position.

REASONING ABILITY

  • Ability to follow written, verbal, and diagram instructions.

  • Ability to use common sense when making decisions and solving problems.

  • Ability to work independently, organize tasks, and manage workload.

  • Ability to identify and resolve problems involving multiple variables in a standard production environment.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT

This position requires a significant amount of walking throughout the production facility. The work environment may include noisy, wet, slippery, and hot conditions.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.

  • Strong math and computer skills.

  • Good verbal and written communication skills.

  • Some college coursework preferred.

  • Three to five years of supervisory or group leader experience in a food manufacturing or food processing environment required.

  • Ability to plan, organize, direct, and motivate employees.

  • Ability to work effectively as part of a production management team.

  • Strong leadership and problem-solving skills.

job.title: Personal Injury Paralegal
job.description:
Plaintiff Personal Injury Paralegal (5+ Years of Experience)

Position Overview

Our client, a well-established plaintiff personal injury law firm, is seeking an experienced Personal Injury Paralegal with at least 5 years of plaintiff-side litigation experience. The ideal candidate will possess a strong understanding of personal injury case management from intake through settlement or trial and demonstrate exceptional organizational, communication, and multitasking skills.

Responsibilities

  • Manage a high-volume caseload of plaintiff personal injury matters from inception through resolution.

  • Maintain regular communication with clients, providing updates and gathering necessary information and documentation.

  • Draft and prepare legal documents, including pleadings, discovery demands and responses, motions, subpoenas, authorizations, and correspondence.

  • Coordinate and track medical records, medical bills, lien information, and other case-related documentation.

  • Review, summarize, and organize medical records and treatment histories.

  • Assist attorneys with case investigations, liability analysis, and damages assessments.

  • Schedule and coordinate depositions, independent medical examinations (IMEs), court appearances, and mediations.

  • Prepare settlement demand packages and assist with settlement negotiations.

  • Maintain accurate case files and manage deadlines through calendaring systems.

  • Assist attorneys with trial preparation, including exhibit organization, witness coordination, and trial binders.

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 5 years of plaintiff-side personal injury paralegal experience.

  • Strong knowledge of New York personal injury litigation procedures and court rules.

  • Experience handling motor vehicle accidents, premises liability, construction accidents, wrongful death, and other personal injury matters.

  • Proficiency with case management software and Microsoft Office Suite.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to prioritize competing deadlines and manage a busy caseload independently.

  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational and problem-solving abilities.

  • Paralegal certificate or equivalent legal experience preferred.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience preparing settlement demands and negotiating lien reductions.

  • Familiarity with e-filing systems and litigation support software.

  • Trial preparation experience

Compensation & Benefits

Competitive salary commensurate with experience, comprehensive benefits package, paid time off, and opportunities for professional growth within a collaborative and client-focused legal team.

job.title: Warehouse Manager

Develop and maintain transportation, warehousing, and distribution procedures to maximize delivery efficiency and flow of finished goods and raw materials to internal and external customers. job.title: Process Engineer
job.description:
POSITION SUMMARY :
The Process Engineer provides technical expertise for the design standards, process capabilities, scale-ups, hazard analysis, performance monitoring, technical training and continuous improvements for a site or group of locations within the HNH business. This position will plan, support, and where applicable, execute engineering deliverables for the site's production and packaging functions.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Provides technical leadership to enable new product or process development by collaborating with research and development, corporate engineering and/ or technical groups from other locations to develop engineering packages to deliver the capabilities required.
  • Provides technical expertise to generate and track value by implementing improvements to existing processes and to provide guidance for process safety evaluations.
  • Designs experiments with internal and external resources to reduce variation, validate process change, or evaluate a project's cost/ benefit
  • Develops project scopes, justification, P&IDs, drawings, and controls narratives to plan, support, and execute process improvements.
  • Authors and reviews documents including Preventive Maintenance plans, Standard Operating Procedures, Material Masters, and other forms.
  • Leads and provide direction for other operational and engineering resources assigned to projects and processes, including coaching, mentoring and knowledge development.
  • Keeps abreast of emerging manufacturing technology trends and developments and incorporate into design requirements.
  • Works with limited direction, using additional research and interpretation to identify issues/problems.
  • Responsible for technical support and improvement in the areas of material handling, ingredients preparation, receiving, CIP, and liquid & powder processing.
  • Other duties as assigned

QUALIFICATIONS:

REQUIRED:
  • Bachelor's degree in chemical, mechanical or biosystems engineering or equivalent experience.
  • Relevant experience, minimum of 5 years in a manufacturing environment
  • Strong safety orientation
  • Proficient computer skills (Word, Excel, ERP)
  • Specific knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and TPM systems
  • Clear sense of urgency and ability to manage priorities to meet immediate needs and long-term goals
  • Ability to manage time and workload efficiently, and the ability to prioritize and modify priorities accordingly
  • Self-motivation and ability to work independently
  • Demonstrated ability to work and develop others in a team environment
  • Sensitive to other cultures/backgrounds, able to work in a multi-cultural workplace
  • Demonstrated ability to function in a fast-paced environment while moving multiple simultaneous projects forward
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills to discuss, develop, and implement plans
  • High sensitivity to quality and on time delivery of commitments
  • Ability to develop others

PREFERRED:
  • Food or pharmaceutical packaging
  • Working understanding of PLC's
  • Knowledge of Computer- Aided Design Software
  • Knowledge of OSIsoft PI System
  • Past understanding of food GMP's and hygienic design
  • Specific knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and TPM systems
  • Willingness to travel up to 25% of the time

WORKING CONDITIONS:
  • While performing the functions of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, stand, walk, talk, and hear
  • Often required to spend time in plant environments with operating and maintenance personnel requiring one to kneel, crouch, crawl, bend, ascend and descend stairs and/or ladders
  • Vision requirements include close vision, depth perception, color vision, and the ability to adjust focus

job.title: Quality Assurance Specialist
job.description:
POSITION SUMMARY

The Quality Assurance Coordinator supports quality system activities to ensure products meet established specifications and comply with FDA regulations and third-party certification standards. This position works on quality, food safety, compliance, and continuous improvement projects while helping maintain and improve internal quality systems.

The role works closely with Quality, Production, R&D, Supply Chain, and other departments to address quality issues, support new product launches, complete audits, and improve processes.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Supply Chain & Quality Support – 40%

  • Support daily quality activities related to supply chain and product delivery.
  • Assist with product release, testing, reviews, troubleshooting, and required verifications.
  • Complete or coordinate validations and calibrations as needed.
  • Review quality information and ensure requirements are met.

Compliance & Performance – 30%

  • Support food safety and third-party certification requirements.
  • Participate in audits and follow up on corrective actions.
  • Monitor quality performance and KPIs.
  • Identify and communicate non-conformances and issues affecting performance.
  • Assign and track actions needed to contain, correct, and prevent problems.
  • Support root cause analysis and CAPA investigations.
  • Ensure preventive actions are documented and implemented.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and operational efficiency.
  • Assist with quality reviews for new products and specification changes.

Escalated Issue Management – 20%

  • Identify and escalate quality and food safety issues.
  • Work with cross-functional teams to investigate non-conformances.
  • Support investigations involving equipment, internal defects, and customer complaints.
  • Conduct or assist with root cause investigations.
  • Complete CAPA documentation and effectiveness checks.

Optimization & Continuous Improvement – 10%

  • Support continuous improvement and operational excellence activities.
  • Participate in internal audits.
  • Help develop and train cross-functional team members.
  • Support quality improvement initiatives across the facility.

ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Work with site leadership and other departments on goals, decision-making, training, and development.
  • Support commercialization activities and new processes as needed.
  • Coordinate completion of Client, record reviews, verifications, and calibrations.
  • Assist with audits and quality system updates.
  • Provide backup support within the Quality Department.
  • Help implement quality strategies throughout the facility.

PEOPLE & TEAM RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support the development and performance of the quality laboratory team.
  • Build effective working relationships with Production, R&D, Supply Chain, and other departments.
  • Help promote a culture focused on quality and continuous improvement.
  • Maintain and support training programs related to food safety and quality.
  • Communicate and escalate food safety and quality issues in a timely manner.
  • Provide laboratory support when the team is short staffed.

QUALITY SYSTEMS

  • Support the effective use of product safety, product quality, and prerequisite programs.
  • Ensure quality systems work effectively with change control and commercialization processes.
  • Investigate problems and identify solutions that prevent repeat issues.
  • Support internal audit programs and follow up to ensure corrective actions are completed.
  • Work with R&D, Production, and Commercial teams on new products, processes, equipment, and customer launches.
  • Help identify risks and recommend appropriate controls or corrective actions.
  • Support operational excellence programs.
  • Assist with preparation for customer visits and external audits.
  • Become a power user of ERP and LIMS systems.

KNOWLEDGE & EXPERIENCE

  • Experience working in an FDA-regulated environment, preferably food, nutrition, dietary supplement, or a related industry.
  • Understanding of food safety, regulatory, and cost risks.
  • Knowledge of sanitation principles.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills.
  • Ability to prioritize work and meet deadlines.
  • Experience with CAPA and customer complaint investigations.
  • Ability to understand, organize, and communicate technical information.
  • Strong problem-solving and root cause analysis skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with multiple departments and teams.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor's degree in a science-related field or relevant equivalent experience.
  • Team leadership experience.
  • At least 1 year of experience in food, dietary supplement, manufacturing, or a related industry.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 lbs.
  • Ability to stand, walk, sit, reach, and perform other physical activities required in a manufacturing environment.

job.title: Maintenance Technician
job.description:
The Maintenance Technician is responsible for performing all assigned maintenance duties safely, efficiently, and in accordance with company policies and procedures.

This position requires strong mechanical and electrical troubleshooting skills, independent decision-making, flexibility, and the ability to adapt to changing priorities, including working different shifts and overtime as needed.

The technician must manage time effectively while communicating progress and maintenance needs with supervisors.

Essential Functions:

  • Demonstrate the mechanical and electrical skills necessary to maintain efficient plant operations.
  • Analyze, troubleshoot, repair, and rebuild plant equipment and systems to minimize downtime.
  • Repair and rebuild vacuum pumps, gearboxes, valves, steam regulating valves, pneumatic cylinders, and other pumps used throughout the facility.
  • Repair forklifts and other material handling equipment.
  • Perform preventive maintenance and repairs on Clean-in-Place (CIP) systems, conveying systems, mixing and drying equipment, chemical injection systems, air compressors, boiler systems, water systems, ammonia systems, packaging equipment, and material handling systems.
  • Troubleshoot and perform industrial electrical testing on 4–20 mA circuits, 12V, 24V, 48V, 120V, 240V, and 480V electrical systems, including switches, relays, motors, and control components.
  • Repair and maintain packaging systems, pressure systems, boilers, process equipment, and plant fixtures according to manufacturer specifications.
  • Monitor equipment performance and determine appropriate repairs or replacements.
  • Perform scheduled preventive maintenance using maintenance management systems and equipment specifications.
  • Fabricate equipment and piping by interpreting equipment drawings, piping diagrams, and specifications.
  • Read and apply information from equipment manuals, technical documentation, and manufacturer resources.
  • Maintain clean, organized, and safe work areas.
  • Follow all workplace safety procedures and use required personal protective equipment (PPE).
  • Assist with equipment installations, plant improvement projects, and system upgrades.
  • Perform equipment calibrations, including PLCs, valves, sensors, and related instrumentation.
  • Complete additional duties as assigned.
  • Work effectively with minimal supervision.

Requirements:

  • High school diploma, GED, or equivalent.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in industrial maintenance practices.
  • Successfully pass a required written maintenance assessment with a minimum passing score of 75%.
  • Successfully complete required on-the-job qualification requirements within the designated training period.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with engineering, operations, maintenance personnel, and outside vendors.
  • Self-motivated, dependable, and able to respond effectively during emergency situations.
  • Maintain personal cleanliness and follow Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs).
  • Demonstrate initiative and strong problem-solving skills.
  • Experience rebuilding pumps, valves, gearboxes, and other industrial equipment.
  • Ability to troubleshoot and repair boilers, compressed air systems, water systems, ammonia systems, dryers, packaging equipment, and production machinery.
  • Proficient in using electrical testing equipment, multimeters, and diagnostic tools.
  • Advanced knowledge of industrial electrical systems and troubleshooting techniques.
  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints, piping diagrams, electrical schematics, construction drawings, and technical manuals.
  • Welding experience with stainless steel, aluminum, and mild steel.

Working Conditions:

  • Frequent standing, walking, climbing, bending, reaching, lifting, pushing, pulling, and repetitive motion throughout the workday.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds.
  • Routine stair climbing and work at varying heights.
  • Use of computers, measuring instruments, testing devices, and diagnostic equipment.
  • Ability to distinguish colors for electrical and instrumentation work.
  • Work in a manufacturing environment with exposure to elevated temperatures, high noise levels, moving machinery, chemicals, steam, and wet or slippery surfaces.
  • Required use of appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE), including safety glasses, safety shoes, gloves, respirators, and hearing protection as required.
  • May be required to work in confined spaces.
  • Exposure to live steam, heated water, and other industrial process equipment.

job.title: Electrician Technician
job.description:
Position Summary
The Electrician technician is responsible for maintaining, troubleshooting, repairing, and installing electrical systems and equipment throughout the manufacturing facility. This position supports production operations by minimizing equipment downtime, performing preventive maintenance, and ensuring all electrical work is completed safely and in compliance with company policies and electrical codes. The ideal candidate possesses strong industrial electrical knowledge, excellent troubleshooting skills, and experience working in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Troubleshoot, diagnose, and repair electrical issues on manufacturing equipment, machinery, and facility systems.
  • Install, test, repair, and maintain electrical components, wiring, motors, control panels, transformers, lighting systems, and power distribution equipment.
  • Perform preventive and predictive maintenance on production equipment and facility electrical systems.
  • Replace or run new wiring for building enhancements/projects.
  • Respond promptly to equipment breakdowns and electrical emergencies to minimize production downtime.
  • Read and interpret electrical schematics, blueprints, wiring diagrams, and technical manuals.
  • Install and maintain Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs), sensors, relays, motor controls, and instrumentation devices.
  • Conduct root cause analysis of electrical failures and implement corrective actions.
  • Support equipment upgrades, modifications, and capital improvement projects.
  • Maintain accurate maintenance records, work orders, and preventive maintenance documentation.
  • Assist with machine installations, commissioning, and startup activities.
  • Ensure compliance with OSHA regulations and company safety procedures.
  • Collaborate with Maintenance, Production, Engineering, and Quality teams to improve equipment reliability and plant performance.
  • Identify opportunities for continuous improvement, energy savings, and increased equipment efficiency.
Required Qualifications
  • High School Diploma or GED required.
  • Minimum 2 years of industrial or manufacturing electrical maintenance experience.
  • Strong understanding of industrial electrical systems including:
    • Motors and motor controls
    • 120V, 240V, 480V, and three-phase systems
    • Electrical distribution systems
    • PLCs and automation equipment
    • VFDs and drives
    • Hydraulics and pneumatics interface controls
  • Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics and technical drawings.
  • Experience using electrical test equipment including multimeters, megohmmeters, and clamp meters.

Physical Demands – While performing the duties of this job, the employee is required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; talk or hear. The employee must occasionally lift or move parts and supplies, up to 50 lbs. Position Type/Expected Hours of Work – This is a full-time position. Overtime work is required occasionally.
Please note that this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

job.title: 2nd Shift Production Maintenance Technician
job.description:
We are seeking a skilled Maintenance Technician to support our food production facility. This role focuses heavily on electrical troubleshooting and repair, with particular emphasis on Allen-Bradley (AB) Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs). The successful candidate will maintain, diagnose, and repair production equipment to minimize downtime while upholding strict food safety and sanitation standards.

Key Responsibilities
  • Perform electrical troubleshooting, diagnosis, and repair on production equipment, control panels, motors, sensors, and power distribution systems.
  • Install, configure, program, parameterize, and troubleshoot Allen-Bradley VFDs (PowerFlex series and similar); diagnose faults, replace drives, for conveyors, shredders/dicers, Fanuc Robot and Matrix VFFS packaging equipment.
  • Conduct preventive and predictive maintenance on electrical and electromechanical systems.
  • Read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, PLC ladder logic, and technical manuals.
  • Support mechanical maintenance tasks as needed (bearings, belts, chains, gearboxes, pneumatics).
  • Respond to equipment breakdowns in a fast-paced production environment and restore equipment to safe, reliable operation.
  • Follow Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), HACCP, lockout/tagout (LOTO), arc-flash safety, and all food-safety and sanitation protocols.
  • Document work orders, parts usage, and maintenance activities accurately.
  • Collaborate with production, engineering, and sanitation teams to improve equipment reliability.
  • Assist with equipment upgrades, installations, and continuous-improvement projects.
Required Qualifications
  • Hands-on experience troubleshooting and working with Allen-Bradley VFDs (PowerFlex 525 or equivalent).
  • Solid understanding of three-phase power, motor controls, VFDs, PLCs (Allen-Bradley preferred), sensors, and basic industrial controls.
  • Ability to read electrical schematics and use multimeters, clamp meters, and other diagnostic tools.
  • Knowledge of lockout/tagout, electrical safety, and industrial safety practices.
  • High school diploma or equivalent; technical training or trade school preferred.
  • Ability to work in a food production environment (temperature extremes, wet conditions, standing for extended periods, lifting up to 50 lbs).
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience in food or beverage manufacturing.
  • Familiarity with Allen-Bradley PLCs (ControlLogix, CompactLogix, MicroLogix) and related software.
  • Experience with CMMS systems and preventive maintenance programs.

This position is ideal for a hands-on maintenance technician who thrives on diagnosing complex electrical issues especially VFD-related problems and keeping food production lines running reliably.
Hours: 2nd Shift(3pm-11am)

job.title: Transmit Security Engineer (Banking)
job.description:
Overview
Client is seeking a Customer Identity & Authentication Engineer to design, develop, configure, and support customer identity and authentication solutions using the Transmit Security and Mosaic platforms. This role partners with cybersecurity, digital banking, fraud, authentication, and application development teams to deliver secure, frictionless customer onboarding and login experiences.
The position focuses on identity orchestration, passwordless authentication, multi-factor authentication (MFA), risk-based authentication, and integration with banking applications. The engineer will support customer identity journeys while helping maintain security, compliance, and user experience standards.

Core Responsibilities
• Design and implement authentication and identity management solutions using Transmit Security.
• Build and maintain customer identity journeys, including registration, login, MFA enrollment, and account recovery processes.
• Integrate Transmit Security APIs and SDKs with web and mobile banking applications.
• Configure identity orchestration workflows and adaptive authentication policies.
• Support passkey and passwordless authentication initiatives.
• Collaborate with fraud, risk, cybersecurity, and digital banking teams to enhance customer security and user experience.
• Troubleshoot authentication issues, integration defects, and production incidents.
• Participate in architecture reviews and ensure compliance with security and banking standards.
• Create technical documentation, support procedures, and implementation standards.
• Assist with vendor engagement and platform upgrades.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies
• 5+ years of software engineering, IAM, CIAM, or authentication experience.
• 2+ years implementing customer authentication platforms.
• Experience with Transmit Security and the Mosaic Platform.
• Strong knowledge of REST APIs, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and SAML.
• Experience with Java, JavaScript, .NET, or similar enterprise development platforms.
• Experience with Identity and Access Management (IAM) and Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM) solutions.
• Knowledge of MFA, FIDO2, WebAuthn, and passkey technologies.
• Experience with API security, token management, and encryption technologies.
• Experience with cloud technologies, including AWS, Azure, or hybrid environments.
• Familiarity with Agile development and DevSecOps practices.
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related field.

Preferred Skills or Experience
• Banking or financial services experience.
• Experience with customer authentication and fraud prevention solutions.
• Experience integrating customer onboarding and KYC solutions.
• Experience with identity orchestration platforms.
• Experience with vendor platforms such as Okta.
• Security certifications such as CISSP, IAM certifications, or cloud certifications.

Work Details
• Collaborates with Digital Banking, Enterprise Architecture, Information Security, Fraud Prevention, AML/Risk teams, and Mobile and Online Banking development teams.

Description: Job Title: Electronics Technician
Location: Riviera Beach
________________________________________
Position Overview
Lockheed Martin is seeking a skilled Electronics Technician to join our high performance team supporting advanced Underwater mission systems. The ideal candidate will have extensive hands on experience in soldering, crimping, wire harness fabrication, and system troubleshooting working with multimeters and other various troubleshooting tools.
________________________________________
Key Responsibilities
•Perform hand soldering on printed circuit boards (PCBs) cable connectors.
•Assemble, crimp, and terminate wire harnesses to engineering drawings and schematics.
•Conduct visual and electrical inspections (continuity, insulation resistance) to ensure compliance with quality specifications.
•Interpret engineering schematics, wiring diagrams, and bill of materials (BOM) documents.
•Troubleshoot and repair/rework defective assemblies; document corrective actions.
•Maintain clean room and ESD controlled environments; enforce safety and handling protocols.
•Support prototype builds, low rate production, and field service deployments.

Associate's degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering Technology, or related field; or equivalent military/industry training.
Technical Experience3+ years of hands on electronics assembly, with demonstrable expertise in soldering (including surface mount, through hole, and BGA) and wire harness manufacturing.
CertificationsJ STD 001 (Requirements for Soldered Electrical and Electronic Assemblies) and IPC 620 (Requirements for Cable and Wire Harness Assemblies) preferred; OSHA safety certification a plus.
Tools ProficiencyProficient with soldering irons, hot air stations, reflow ovens, crimping tools, wire stripping machines, and test equipment (multimeters, oscilloscopes, continuity testers).

ClearanceEligible for a Secret clearance; ability to obtain Top Secret if required (subject to background investigation).

•Multimeter Proficiency: Ability to use digital multimeters for precise voltage, current, resistance, and continuity measurements while troubleshooting complex electronic systems.
•Fiber Optic Skills: Experience performing fiber terminations (e.g., LC, SC, MPO) and splicing, as well as using fiber power meters and optical time domain reflectometers (OTDR) for link testing and verification.

Schedule & Pay

Why You’ll Want This Opportunity

Great pay, a 4-day workweek, and a strong overall package! This is an opportunity to put your Tool & Die expertise to work on complex tooling projects while having your Fridays off. The company offers a benefits package, PTO, annual profit sharing, and flexibility on compensation for the right candidate—all while giving you the opportunity to work on challenging tooling projects from start to finish.

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Tool & Die Maker to join our team. This position is approximately 80% Tool & Die work, with a strong focus on building, repairing, maintaining, troubleshooting, and reverse-engineering complex tooling and die rings.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience working with complex tooling and be comfortable taking projects from start to finish. Experience with older equipment and troubleshooting challenging tooling issues is highly valued.

Qualifications

  • Strong blueprint reading and interpretation skills.

  • Experience working with complex dies, punches, fixtures, and forming tools.

job.title: Strategic Sourcing Analyst III
job.description:
Location: Richardson, TX
Work Arrangement: 100% Onsite
Strategic Sourcing Analyst III

This role is responsible for independently owning global sourcing activities for after-market parts across our Home Comfort Solutions and Building Climate Solutions segments with a typical aggregate annual dollar buy of $300+ million per year. The position drives procurement cost savings across company expenditures, identifies and implements tariff mitigation and source optimization strategies, and develops both short- and long-term sourcing plans for complex, high-impact, and high-risk categories.

What You Will Be Doing

This strategic sourcing subject matter expert. The role is highly execution-oriented, with responsibility for negotiating complex supplier agreements, managing commercial terms, and driving cost reductions through data-backed analyses and structured sourcing strategies. This person will evaluate and challenge supplier price increases through detailed cost modeling and market benchmarking, while proactively identifying new suppliers, qualifying and onboarding them, and implementing dual-source strategies to improve resilience and competitiveness. Additionally, the role will focus on tariff mitigation, supply base optimization, and long-term category planning, leveraging cross-functional collaboration with category management, supply chain planning, and operations to ensure continuity of supply, quality performance, and alignment with business objectives.

Knowledge & Market Expertise

· Execute a comprehensive understanding of the company's global manufacturing and distribution footprint, product portfolio, served markets, and value proposition of each business unit.

· Build deep category expertise, including all components within category spend, their applications, and their impact on final products.

· Monitor and analyze indexes related to your categories and global market trends to inform sourcing decisions and communicate insights to internal stakeholders and suppliers.

· Continuously research and track developments in the HVAC industry to strengthen decision-making and stakeholder discussions.

Strategic Sourcing

· Develop and execute a global sourcing strategy for assigned categories aligned with organization's business goals.

· Present sourcing strategies and progress during annual roadmap reviews, outlining achievements and forward-looking plans (3–5 year horizon).

· Identify opportunities for cost optimization, supply base improvement, and risk mitigation.

job.title: Senior Design Verification Engineer
job.description:
Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Design Verification Engineer to support the development and verification of high-performance IPs, including compute arrays, DMA engines, Networks-on-Chip (NoCs), crossbars, and memory subsystems.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience developing and maintaining scalable SystemVerilog/UVM testbenches, along with deep knowledge of AXI protocols, performance verification, regression analysis, and coverage closure.

This program is already in execution, so we are looking for someone who can quickly integrate into the team and contribute in a fast-paced environment with evolving processes and limited documentation.

Key Responsibilities

Develop, enhance, and maintain scalable SystemVerilog/UVM verification environments and testbenches for complex, high-performance IP. Perform verification of AXI-based interfaces, NoC/Crossbar architectures, DMA engines, compute arrays, and memory subsystems. Develop verification strategies focused on functional correctness, performance, and system-level behavior. Execute and analyze regression testing, including failure triage, debugging, and root-cause analysis.
  • Drive functional and code coverage closure and support overall verification sign-off.
  • Identify performance bottlenecks and validate performance requirements across complex IP and subsystem designs.
  • Work effectively within established customer tools, flows, and verification methodologies.
  • Adapt quickly in a fast-moving environment where processes and documentation may still be evolving.
  • Collaborate with verification, design, architecture, and other engineering teams to achieve verification milestones.
  • Provide clear daily and/or weekly progress updates to customer and project stakeholders.
  • Support overall verification closure and ensure high-quality project delivery.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline.
  • 5–15 years of relevant experience in ASIC design verification, SoC verification, or a related field.
  • Strong hands-on expertise with SystemVerilog and UVM.
  • Experience developing and maintaining complex, scalable UVM testbench environments.
  • Strong knowledge of AMBA AXI protocols and interface verification.
  • Experience verifying NoC, Crossbar, DMA, compute, and/or memory subsystem architectures.
  • Strong experience with regression execution, failure triage, debugging, and coverage closure.
  • Experience with performance-focused verification and analysis.
  • Working knowledge of scripting and automation using Python, Perl, Make, or similar tools.
  • Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently and contribute effectively within a highly technical engineering team.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical progress and issues effectively to customer stakeholders.
  • Experience working on large-scale ASIC/SoC verification programs.
  • Experience with high-performance compute, networking, or memory-related IP.
  • Experience working in fast-paced or start-up-style engineering environments.
  • Familiarity with customer-specific verification tools, flows, and methodologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive verification activities through coverage and sign-off closure.

job.title: Manufacturing Engineer
job.description:
Manufacturing Engineer

Position Overview

The Manufacturing Engineer will be responsible for developing, implementing, and optimizing manufacturing methods and processes used to produce sophisticated technology products. Working under the direction of the Manufacturing Engineering Manager, this individual will support new process development, equipment installation and validation, facility/layout optimization, process characterization, capital projects, and continuous improvement initiatives.

The engineer will work closely with Design Engineering, Quality, Production, Tool & Die, and Maintenance to ensure manufacturing processes meet cost, quality, productivity, and schedule requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Equipment Installation & Validation

  • Support installation and validation of manufacturing equipment.
  • Develop and execute documentation including:
    • URS – User Requirements Specification
    • FDS – Functional Design Specification
    • IQ – Installation Qualification
    • OQ – Operational Qualification
    • PQ – Performance Qualification
    • VRA – Validation Risk Assessment
  • Support CNC equipment installation and validation.
  • Perform cleaning validation activities, including IQ, OQ, and PQ.

Manufacturing Process Development

  • Develop, implement, and maintain manufacturing methods and processes.
  • Establish operation sequences and manufacturing methods for:
    • Parts
    • Components
    • Subassemblies
    • Final assemblies
  • Determine tooling, equipment, and process requirements for new and existing product lines.
  • Estimate manufacturing costs and establish time standards.
  • Identify opportunities to improve manufacturing efficiency, quality, and cost.

Facility Layout & Equipment Planning

  • Coordinate machine and equipment placement within manufacturing facilities.
  • Optimize plant layouts for productivity, efficiency, material flow, and utilization.
  • Support equipment moves, installations, and manufacturing expansions.

Capital Projects

  • Support capital equipment and facility projects.
  • Prepare financial justifications for capital expenditures.
  • Monitor project spending and budgets.
  • Coordinate with project stakeholders to ensure projects remain on schedule and within expectations.

Quality & Process Improvement

  • Investigate manufacturing issues and identify root causes.
  • Develop and implement corrective and preventative actions.
  • Provide engineering input for material disposition in partnership with Quality.
  • Support process characterization, analysis, control, and validation.
  • Apply statistical tools and Six Sigma methodologies to manufacturing processes.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives.

Risk Analysis

  • Work with cross-functional teams to develop:
    • Process Maps
    • PFMEA
    • MSA
    • Other manufacturing/process risk analysis tools
  • Identify process risks and implement appropriate controls.

Engineering & Cross-Functional Support

  • Interface with:
    • Design Engineering
    • Quality Engineering
    • Production
    • Tool & Die
    • Machine Maintenance
  • Provide engineering support related to manufacturing methods, tooling, equipment, and processes.
  • Support production operations and resolve manufacturing challenges.

Manufacturing Documentation

  • Maintain manufacturing records and reporting systems.
  • Support production routers, BOMs, and engineering/manufacturing change notices.
  • Utilize systems such as SAP and/or Windchill for manufacturing documentation and production setup.

Design & Tooling

  • Support product, fixture, gauge, and tooling design.
  • Apply GD&T principles to manufacturing and engineering activities.
  • Utilize CAD tools such as AutoCAD, DraftSight, NX, or similar platforms.

Communication & Presentations

  • Create and deliver effective PowerPoint presentations.
  • Communicate technical findings, project status, process improvements, and recommendations to engineering and management.
  • Demonstrate initiative and the ability to take new ideas from concept through implementation.

Required Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering required
  • Master's degree in Engineering is a plus.

Experience

The candidate should have approximately 3–4 years of relevant experience with a BS degree.

Strong candidates should have experience with:

  • Equipment installation and validation
  • URS / FDS / IQ / OQ / PQ / VRA
  • CNC machining and validation
  • Cleaning validation
  • Manufacturing process development
  • Process characterization and validation
  • Six Sigma/statistical methodologies
  • Continuous improvement
  • Capital projects
  • Manufacturing layouts
  • SAP and/or Windchill
  • Production routers and BOMs
  • Engineering/manufacturing change notices
  • AutoCAD, DraftSight, NX, or similar CAD software
  • GD&T
  • Metal finishing processes, including bead blasting
  • Manufacturing with materials such as:
    • Titanium
    • Cobalt Chrome
    • Stainless Steel
    • Medical-grade plastics

Preferred

  • Medical device manufacturing experience
  • Experience with sophisticated/high-precision technology products
  • Experience with product, fixture, gauge, and tooling design
  • Six Sigma experience/certification
  • Capital equipment project experience

job.description:
Maintenance Technician

$28–$36/hour + $3,000 Sign-On Bonus | 2nd & 3rd Shifts | Direct Hire | Excellent Benefits

Build your career with a stable, team-oriented food manufacturing company! KanPak is seeking experienced Maintenance Technicians to keep critical processing and packaging equipment running safely and efficiently in a 24/7 manufacturing environment. If you're strong mechanically, enjoy troubleshooting, and can diagnose and repair industrial equipment, this is an opportunity to put your skills to work with a company that offers competitive pay, overtime opportunities, training, and room for growth.

Pay & Schedule

  • Pay: $28–$36 per hour, based on experience
  • Sign-On Bonus: $3,000, paid after 30 days
  • Shift Differential: Currently $0.25/hour for 2nd shift and $0.50/hour for 3rd shift, with plans to increase to approximately $1/hour
  • Schedule: Full-time, permanent
  • Schedule options: Sunday–Thursday or Tuesday–Saturday
  • 2nd Shift: 3:00 PM–11:00 PM
  • 3rd Shift: 11:00 PM–7:00 AM
  • Initial Training: Approximately 90 days on 1st shift, 7:00 AM–3:00 PM
  • Must be available for weekends and overtime as needed
  • Most schedules are 12-hour shifts, depending on plant needs

About the Position

The Maintenance Technician is responsible for maintaining, troubleshooting, and repairing production and facility equipment in a 24/7 food and beverage manufacturing facility. This position works closely with production to minimize downtime, maintain equipment reliability, and ensure machinery operates safely and efficiently.

The ideal candidate has at least two years of industrial maintenance experience and a strong mechanical background. Experience troubleshooting mechanical, pneumatic, and hydraulic systems is highly valued. Food manufacturing experience is a plus, but strong industrial maintenance candidates from other manufacturing environments are encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities

  • Troubleshoot and repair mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and hydraulic equipment.
  • Perform preventive and predictive maintenance on production and packaging equipment.
  • Maintain and troubleshoot conveyors, mixers, fillers, and packaging machinery.
  • Diagnose equipment problems and make necessary repairs and adjustments.
  • Perform machine setup, testing, rebuilds, and emergency repairs.
  • Troubleshoot sensors, photoelectric eyes, and Allen-Bradley controls.
  • Read and interpret schematics, technical drawings, and equipment manuals.
  • Perform basic welding, and facility repairs as needed.
  • Complete maintenance work orders and communicate equipment issues to leadership.

job.title: Quality Inspector - 2nd shift
job.description:
FIRST COUPLE OF WEEKS WILL BE ON AM SHIFT FROM 6am-2:30pm

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential job functions.

Job Summary:
The Quality Inspector will check the quality of all products as well as production procedures. The role will be an advocate for quality in our business. The Quality Inspector will ensure that products are made of flawless materials in compliance with customer specifications.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
• Inspect, test and measure materials or products and accurately record inspection and test data. This includes measuring products using rulers, calipers, gauges, coordinate measuring machines (CMM), thread gauges, gauge pins, optical comparator, surface testers, height gauges or micrometers to monitor operations to ensure they meet quality standards.
• Accept or reject finished products including tagging or identifying all products and material that fail to meet specifications.
• Read, interpret, and follow basic blueprints, diagrams, engineering drawings and other written
instruction. This includes understanding and applying Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerance (GD & T) symbology.
• Recommend adjustments to the assembly or production process to improve quality.
• Calibrate or verify test instruments.
• Adhere to all safety procedures and promote continuous improvement.

Education and Experience (required):
• High School diploma or equivalent.
• 1 year of inspection experience with common hand gages or equivalent.

Education and Experience (preferred):
• 1 year of experience programing and operating a Direct Computer Controlled (DCC) CMM.

Skills, Knowledge and Abilities (required):
• Knowledge of computers and electronics.
• Ability to calibrate or verify test instruments and keep detailed records.
• Excellent communication skills with the ability to interact across multiple departments.
• Proficient computer skills including MS Office.
• Ability to analyze and problem solve with attention to detail.

Skills, Knowledge and Abilities (preferred)
• Working knowledge and comprehension of quality standards.
• American Society for Quality (ASQ) certified.
• Ability to work overtime as needed including weekends.

Additional Information:
Direct Reports: None Travel Requirements: 5%
License and Certification Requirements: None

Physical Requirements:
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met to successfully perform the essential functions of the position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The employee is regularly required to perform physical activities that require significant use of your arms and legs and moving your whole body, such as climbing, lifting, balancing, walking, stooping, standing for extended periods of time and handling of materials. The employee is required to lift up to 50 pounds on a regular basis. The employee is subject to loud noise, dirt, dust, grease, gases and odors and is required to wear personal protective equipment such as safety glasses and ear protection in required area. Typical vision abilities include close up for fine detailed work and
computer work, distance vision and ability to focus. Regular and predictable attendance is required.

job.title: Service Manager
job.description:
SERVICE MANAGER

LOCATION: Amsterdam, NY (Fully onsite)
SCHEDULE: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM
SALARY: $100-130K

Some service departments need a manager.

Others need someone who can see the whole picture, figure out where things are getting stuck, and jump in to fix it.

We’re looking for the second kind.

Our client is a growing manufacturer of specialized industrial equipment looking for a hands-on Service Manager to take ownership of a multifaceted service operation. This person will oversee field service, parts, and installation coordination—and needs to be comfortable stepping into any of those areas when a customer, employee, or job needs help.

This is not a “stay in your lane” kind of role. It’s an opportunity for someone who understands how service, parts, installations, engineering, and operations all connect and enjoys making the entire operation work better.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:
• Lead and develop the service operation, including field service, parts, and installation coordination
• Oversee the Field Service Manager, Parts Coordinator, parts/shipping function, and Installation Coordinator
• Jump in to troubleshoot problems and keep jobs moving when issues cross departmental lines
• Handle escalated customer issues and provide technical guidance when needed
• Identify gaps between service, parts, installation, engineering, and operations and build better processes
• Develop procedures, performance metrics, and accountability measures
• Work alongside engineering and operations to solve technical and workflow issues
• Support installations or parts needs when necessary to stay connected to the operation
• Continually look for practical ways to improve the department and customer experience

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:
• 5+ years of management/leadership experience
• 7+ years in service operations, technical service, industrial equipment, project management, customer support management, or a related environment
• Strong technical aptitude—mechanical, hydraulic, electrical, or industrial equipment experience is valuable
• Someone who can manage people while also understanding the equipment and service issues they’re dealing with
• Experience building or improving processes and workflows
• Comfortable handling customers, including escalated or frustrated customers
• ERP/CRM/service ticketing experience

WHO MIGHT FIT?

Maybe you started as a field technician and worked your way into service or branch management.

Maybe you’ve managed a service operation for an industrial equipment company.

Maybe you’re the person everyone calls when something goes wrong—and you’ve developed the leadership background to go along with the technical knowledge.

The experience can vary. What matters is that you know how to lead people, understand the technical side, and make a complicated operation run better.

BENEFITS:
• Medical, dental and vision
• Company-paid $50K life insurance
• Company-paid long-term disability
• 401(k) with up to 4.5% company match
• Annual performance bonus opportunity
• Referral bonus

job.title: Mechanical Engineer
job.description:
Nesco Resource is in search of a Mechanical Engineer to join our client’s team in Lincoln, RI.
 
Position Summary:
We are seeking an Engineer with a degree in Mechanical Engineering or Structural Engineering to join our client's interdisciplinary design team. This team is responsible for designing location-specific structures for mounting ceiling-suspended operating room equipment such as surgical lights, anesthesia booms, and air circulation systems.
 
Primary Responsibilities:

  • Analyze construction documents and building plans to gather design criteria.
  • Assist in the development of building information models (BIM) to identify clashes with existing and planned construction.
  • Consult and collaborate with in-house and external engineers, architects, project managers, and general contractors to ensure designs meet expectations.
  • Conduct structural analyses through calculations and finite element analysis (FEA).
  • Model structures in 3D CAD programs using multi-component assemblies and parameterization.
  • Create as-designed and as-built technical drawings for fabrication and construction.
  • Support our in-house team of field service technicians before, during, and after installation.
  • Assist with the research and development of design alternatives and modifications to optimize performance and installation.
Required Skills:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Structural Engineering or equivalent with at least 1 year of experience.
  • Experience using 2D and 3D modeling software such as AutoCAD, SolidWorks (or equivalent); Revit desirable.
Preferred Skills:
  • Experience with FEA programs such as ANSYS, Abaqus, Inventor Nastran, or equivalent.
  • Proficient in FEA for structural analysis; relevant software experience includes RISA, SAP2000, Robot Structural, or equivalent (STAAD).
  • Experience using structural engineering standards such as ACI and AISC.
  • Experience with FEA programs such as ANSYS, Abaqus, Inventor Nastran, or equivalent.
Required Interpersonal Skills:
  • Enjoys working in collaborative environments and interdisciplinary teams.
  • Resiliently adapts to change.

Client is seeking an engineer to support ASIC and FPGA development on research and development programs. This role focuses on developing, testing, integrating, and verifying complex digital systems, including digital signal processing, high speed digital designs, high speed communications, and system-on-chip solutions implemented on FPGA platforms.
The engineer will collaborate with systems architects, RF/analog and digital circuit designers, and ASIC/FPGA engineers to contribute to the design, simulation, verification, integration, and testing of advanced products. Core Responsibilities
• Develop, test, integrate, and verify ASIC and FPGA-based solutions for complex digital systems.

• Create and improve automation and scripting solutions to enhance FPGA development efficiency.
• Collaborate across disciplines with systems architects, RF/analog designers, digital circuit designers, and ASIC/FPGA engineers.

job.title: Technology Incident Manager - (Banking)
job.description:
Job Summary
The Incident Manager is responsible for leading the timely restoration of critical business services impacted by technology disruptions. This role manages cross-functional investigative teams and facilitates resolution of enterprise-level incidents through strong leadership, technical insight, and effective communication. The Incident Manager ensures that all incident response activities are executed efficiently, with a focus on minimizing business impact and improving system stability. This position may require overnight work hours and participation in a weekend on-call rotation.

Essential Functions

•Lead the identification, assessment, and resolution of critical technology incidents affecting enterprise operations.
•Facilitate and manage virtual incident response calls with diverse technical and business stakeholders.
•Quickly assess the scope and impact of incidents and determine the appropriate support teams and escalation paths.
•Guide troubleshooting efforts across multiple technology domains, including distributed systems, networks, applications, and mainframes.
•Collaborate with vendors and internal teams to drive resolution and ensure accurate, timely communication.
•Escalate critical issues to senior leadership and provide consistent progress updates.
•Partner with the communications team to ensure incident notifications are timely and accurate.
•Conduct post-incident reviews to identify root causes, process improvements, and documentation updates.
•Maintain and review critical application recovery documentation for accuracy and usability
•Support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance incident detection, response, and recovery processes.
•Participate in production readiness reviews for critical projects to ensure alignment with incident management protocols.
•Adhere to ITIL (Information Technology Infrastructure Library)-based processes and contribute to the development of incident management metrics and reporting.
•Must be able to work overnight shifts.
•Participation in weekend on-call rotation is required.
•Performs other duties as assigned; duties, responsibilities and/or activities may change, or new ones may be assigned at any time with or without notice
•Complies with all policies and procedures, including without limitation, acting professionally at all times, conducting business ethically, avoiding conflicts of interest, and acting in the best interests of clients and company.

Education
•Bachelor's degree in information technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field or equivalent experience. (preferred)

Work Experience
•3+ years of experience leading technical projects, incident response efforts, or cross-functional technology initiatives (required)
•Experience in a high-pressure, 24/7 IT operations or incident management environment (preferred)
•Familiarity with enterprise IT infrastructure and application ecosystems (required)

Licenses and Certifications
•ITIL (Information Technology Infrastructure Library) Foundation certification (preferred)
•Incident management, project management (e.g., PMP), or technical discipline certifications (preferred)

Skills
•The ability to oversee and coordinate the response to unplanned service disruptions, ensuring timely restoration of services and minimizing business impact.
•Executing structured processes to detect, assess, respond to, and recover from incidents, while coordinating across technical and business teams
•Leading the organization's response during high-impact, time-sensitive events by making critical decisions, maintaining control, and ensuring continuity of operations
•The process of identifying the fundamental cause of an incident to prevent recurrence and support long-term stability and improvement.
•The practice of identifying, evaluating, and mitigating risks that could impact business operations, technology systems, or regulatory compliance
•The ability to clearly and effectively convey information across technical and non-technical audiences, especially during high-pressure situations.
•Managing and resolving disagreements or competing priorities among stakeholders to maintain focus and collaboration during incident response.
•Recognizing when an incident requires higher-level attention and ensuring timely communication and involvement of senior leadership or specialized teams.
•Ensuring that IT services can be recovered and maintained during and after a disruption, in alignment with business continuity and recovery objectives.
•Managing cybersecurity-related incidents, including detection, containment, investigation, and recovery, while minimizing impact and ensuring compliance.
•Understanding and applying organizational standards and protocols that govern the secure and effective use of IT systems and infrastructure.
•Guiding cross-functional teams during incident response, making informed decisions, and maintaining composure under pressure to drive resolution.
•Analyzing complex issues, identifying solutions quickly, and making sound decisions based on logic, data, and situational awareness.
•Prioritizing the needs and expectations of internal and external clients during incident response to minimize disruption and maintain trust.
•Accurately recording incident details, timelines, actions taken, and outcomes to support post-incident reviews, compliance, and continuous improvement.

Physical Demands
General Office - Prolonged sitting, ability to communicate face to face in person or on the phone with teammates and clients, frequent use of PC/laptop, occasional lifting/pushing/pulling of backpacks, computer bags up to 10 lbs.

Travel
Occasional travel to include overnights

The ideal candidate will have experience designing structural systems for refineries, petrochemical facilities, chemical plants, oil & gas facilities, or other heavy industrial projects.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and review structural engineering calculations, designs, and technical deliverables.
  • Support structural systems associated with industrial equipment, process units, buildings, platforms, and facilities.
  • Develop design criteria, specifications, calculations, reports, and engineering documentation.
  • Review structural drawings, layouts, 3D models, and engineering documents.
  • Evaluate and incorporate equipment and vendor loads into structural designs.
  • Coordinate structural requirements with Piping, Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, Process, and Civil disciplines.
  • Review vendor drawings, equipment information, and technical documentation.
  • Participate in design reviews, constructability reviews, and technical resolution meetings.
  • Identify and resolve structural engineering issues during design and project execution.
  • Ensure engineering designs comply with applicable codes, standards, specifications, and project requirements.
  • Support project teams with structural engineering expertise throughout the project lifecycle.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or related discipline.
  • Professional experience in structural engineering within industrial facilities.
  • Experience with structural design, engineering calculations, drawings, and technical documentation.
  • Knowledge of applicable structural codes, standards, and engineering practices.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and multidisciplinary coordination skills.
  • Ability to effectively communicate with engineering, project, construction, and vendor teams.
  • Ability to work onsite in Houston, TX.

Preferred Experience

  • Refining
  • Petrochemical
  • Chemical processing
  • Oil & Gas
  • EPC/EPCM projects
  • Heavy industrial facilities
  • Process plants
  • Industrial equipment support structures

job.title: Cash Accountant - Manufacturing
job.description:
Cash Accountant – Manufacturing

Tulsa, OK | Full-Time | Monday–Friday, 7:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m. | On-Site

Pay & Benefits

Compensation: $70,000–$85,000, depending on experience
Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance
Retirement Planning: 401(k) with company match
Time Away: Paid time off, holidays, and personal days
Additional Support: Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Bonus Incentive Program
Coverage: Life and disability insurance
Work Environment: Established manufacturing company with a stable weekday schedule and a collaborative accounting team

About the Role

We’re looking for a detail-oriented Cash Accountant to take ownership of daily cash activity, bank reconciliations, electronic payments, and cash-related accounting processes for an established manufacturing organization.

This is a great opportunity for an accountant who enjoys working with numbers, banking activity, reconciliations, and financial accuracy and wants a role with visibility across the organization. You’ll work closely with Accounting, AP, AR, Purchasing, Sales, and banking partners while helping ensure the company’s cash position and financial records remain accurate and well controlled.

If you’re organized, analytical, comfortable working independently, and have experience with cash accounting, treasury functions, or general ledger accounting, this could be a strong fit.

Key Responsibilities

Cash Management & Banking:

  • Monitor daily cash balances across company bank accounts and maintain accurate cash position reporting

  • Process and monitor ACH payments, wire transfers, positive pay, and other electronic banking transactions

  • Maintain banking records, account documentation, and authorized signer information

Bank Reconciliations & Accounting:

  • Perform daily, weekly, and monthly bank reconciliations, researching and resolving discrepancies

  • Prepare cash-related journal entries and ensure transactions are accurately recorded in the general ledger

  • Support month-end and year-end close through reconciliations, schedules, and supporting documentation

Cash Forecasting & Financial Planning:

  • Prepare short-term cash forecasts and assist with longer-term cash flow planning

  • Monitor upcoming receipts and disbursements to help maintain appropriate cash availability

  • Review bank fees and identify opportunities to improve efficiency and reduce unnecessary costs

AP/AR Coordination:

  • Work with Accounts Receivable on cash application and resolution of unapplied cash

  • Coordinate with Accounts Payable regarding payment timing and cash requirements

  • Partner with internal departments to resolve cash-related questions and discrepancies

Controls, Compliance & Process Improvement:

  • Help maintain effective controls over cash receipts, payments, and banking activity

  • Assist with internal and external audit requests related to cash and treasury accounts

  • Identify opportunities to improve, standardize, or automate cash-management processes

Qualifications

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field

Experience:

  • 3–5 years of accounting experience, preferably with exposure to cash accounting, treasury, or general ledger functions

  • Experience with bank reconciliations and cash management is strongly preferred

Technical Skills:

  • Strong understanding of accounting principles and financial controls

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office

  • Experience with an ERP system and online banking platforms is a plus

Work Style:

  • Highly organized and comfortable managing multiple priorities and deadlines

  • Able to work independently while collaborating effectively with other departments

  • Strong problem-solving skills with a high level of attention to detail

Core Strengths:

  • Accurate and analytical

  • Dependable and organized

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Comfortable handling confidential financial information

Work Environment

This position is primarily office-based within a manufacturing environment and involves regular interaction with accounting and operational teams.
