job.title: Project Manager/Delivery Lead - Kinaxis Maestro Demand Planning
job.description:
Overview
Client is seeking an experienced Project Manager/Delivery Lead to lead the delivery of a Kinaxis Maestro Demand Planning implementation for its Optical Communications business. This role is responsible for driving execution across business, IT, SAP ECC, and vendor teams while enabling Agile ways of working throughout the implementation lifecycle.
The ideal candidate brings strong delivery leadership experience, a servant leadership mindset, and a proven track record leading enterprise implementations in manufacturing environments. This position emphasizes communication, stakeholder alignment, governance, financial tracking, issue resolution, and iterative execution within an Agile product delivery model.

Core Responsibilities
• Lead end-to-end delivery of the Kinaxis Maestro Demand Planning implementation using Agile, Scrum, and iterative product delivery practices.
• Serve as a servant leader by enabling collaboration, removing blockers, supporting decision-making, and driving accountability across cross-functional stakeholders.
• Manage delivery planning, governance reporting, status updates, RAID management, executive communications, and escalation management.
• Coordinate business, IT, SAP ECC, implementation partner, and vendor teams to ensure aligned execution across workstreams.
• Drive backlog and workflow management through Kanban-based delivery practices and support sprint and release planning activities.
• Track project financials, delivery progress, risks, dependencies, and key milestones.
• Support integration planning, data migration readiness, testing coordination, cutover execution, and go-live planning.
• Ensure adherence to SOX, regulatory, and enterprise governance requirements.
• Provide executive-level updates to senior leadership and maintain stakeholder engagement throughout the delivery lifecycle.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies
• 7+ years of experience leading enterprise technology implementations as a Project Manager, Delivery Lead, or similar role.
• Strong project leadership experience in communications, stakeholder management, problem resolution, governance and status reporting, executive communications, financial tracking, and vendor coordination.
• Experience leading teams in Agile/Scrum environments with strong knowledge of iterative and incremental delivery methodologies.
• Demonstrated hands-on experience working from a Kanban board.
• Scrum Master certification or PMI-ACP certification.
• Experience with SAP ECC implementations and SAP ECC platform landscapes.
• Experience delivering solutions involving integration, data migration, and cutover coordination.
• Knowledge of demand planning within a manufacturing environment.
• Knowledge of SOX, regulatory compliance, and structured enterprise governance practices.
• Ability to work during standard Eastern Time business hours.

Preferred Skills or Experience
• PMP certification.
• Product Owner certification such as CSPO or PSPO.
• First-hand experience implementing Kinaxis Maestro Demand Planning.
• Experience implementing complex SAP ECC solutions.
• Hands-on experience with Planview AgilePlace.
• Experience presenting to and influencing senior leadership.

Work Details
• Contract role.
• Charlotte, NC preferred; New York preferred. Qualified remote candidates will also be considered.
• Minimum travel requirement of one trip per month to Charlotte, NC.
• Standard work schedule of 8:00 AM ET to 5:00 PM ET.
• Some weekend and after-hours work will be required during scheduled go-live events.

job.title: Solder
job.description:
Solder/Assembly l
Orlando
7AM-3:30PM

Duties:

  1. Advanced Soldering Techniques: Apply advanced soldering techniques to assemble high-precision frequency control devices, including oscillators, filters, and frequency synthesizers, ensuring optimal performance and reliability.
  2. Component Placement and Calibration: Accurately place and calibrate electronic components, such as quartz crystals, surface acoustic wave (SAW) devices, and specialized frequency control ICs, according to engineering specifications and tight tolerances.

  7. Collaboration with Engineering: Collaborate closely with engineering teams to understand and implement design changes, improvements, and enhancements to the soldering and assembly processes.
  8. Documentation: Maintain detailed documentation of soldering processes, calibration procedures, and quality control records, ensuring compliance with industry regulations and quality management systems.
  9. Continuous Improvement: Actively participate in continuous improvement initiatives, contributing insights and recommendations to enhance soldering processes, efficiency, and overall product quality.
  10. Adherence to Standards: Understands all aspects of Sn63 solder assembly including: Thru-hole components, Recognize J-STD-001 standard regarding materials, methods, and acceptance criteria for producing solder electrical and electronic assemblies.

job.title: Quality Inspector-Direct Hire
job.description:
Quality Inspector – Direct Hire

Pay: $20–$27 per hour, depending on experience
Schedule: Monday–Friday, 7:00 AM–3:30 PM
Overtime: Overtime opportunities are likely based on production needs
Employment Type: Direct Hire

Quality Inspector

We are seeking a detail-oriented Quality Inspector to join a growing manufacturing team. This position is responsible for inspecting incoming materials, in-process components, and finished products to ensure they meet established specifications and quality standards.

The ideal candidate has manufacturing or quality inspection experience, strong attention to detail, and the ability to use precision measuring tools and read technical drawings. This is a great opportunity for someone looking for a long-term career in a quality-focused manufacturing environment supporting aerospace and other highly regulated industries.

Responsibilities

  • Perform inspections of incoming materials, in-process components, and finished products.
  • Use precision measuring tools such as calipers, micrometers, gauges, and other inspection equipment.
  • Read and interpret technical drawings, work instructions, and quality specifications.
  • Document inspection results and identify and report defects or non-conforming products.
  • Review First Article Inspection (FAI) documentation.

job.title: System Integration Lab Engineer
job.description:
Description:
The System Integration Lab Engineer provides hands on technical support and engineering expertise to Sikorsky's Flight Controls Autonomy & Electrical (FCA&E) organization. Reporting to the FCA&E Lab Lead, the incumbent will contribute to the design, development, integration, and verification of high fidelity hardware in the loop (HWIL) and closed loop test facilities and capabilities within the System Integration Laboratories (SILS). This role blends systems engineering, test bed design / operation, and collaborative problem solving in a fast paced, cross functional environment. The engineer will help ensure laboratory activities align with business objectives, program priorities, and Sikorsky technical standards while driving continuous improvement initiatives that increase lab productivity and capability.

looking for candidates with more schematic and experience designing the facilities/labs where tests will be conducted.
Not interested in electrical test engineers
Must have minimum 4+ years with Zuken

Core Responsibilities
•HWIL/Closed Loop Development: Assist the FCA&E Lab Lead in designing, building, integrating, and testing HWIL and closed loop configurations within the SILS, ensuring compliance with design specifications, safety standards, and Sikorsky engineering practices.
•Hardware Integration: Receive, stage, and integrate hardware from subsystem teams; manage interface control documents; and coordinate cross functional wiring, power, and data connections across system, segment, and supporting engineering groups.
•Technical Collaboration: Participate actively in technical interchange meetings, provide clear status updates, and contribute to the preparation of deliverables for internal and external customers.
•Risk & Issue Management: Track laboratory level risks and issues, maintain issue logs, and promptly elevate concerns to the FCA&E Lab Lead or program management while proposing mitigation actions.
•Metrics & Reporting: Capture key performance indicators (KPIs) for SILS activities, generate concise status reports, and assist in metrics dashboards that reflect progress, resource utilization, and test outcomes.
•Equipment & Facility Support: Help manage procurement of capital equipment, support facility modification projects, and assist with laboratory infrastructure planning (e.g., power distribution, network cabling, shielding, cooling).
•Logistics Management: Order, receive, and track parts and consumables required for lab activities; maintain accurate inventory records; and coordinate with vendors and internal supply chains to ensure timely availability of components.
•Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to streamline lab processes, update work instructions, and adopt new tools or methodologies that enhance test efficiency and data quality.
•Documentation: Produce and maintain engineering documentation—including schematics, block diagrams, procedures, results, and lessons learned packages—in accordance with Sikorsky configuration control requirements.
•Design Tools: Develop detailed schematics and system block diagrams using industry standard tools such as Microsoft Visio, Mentor Graphics, Zuken, and Siemens NX/3DX.


Technical Skills:
•Proficiency with real time simulation tools (e.g., MATLAB/Simulink, LabVIEW, NI VeriStand).
•Strong understanding of hardware integration, signal conditioning, power distribution, and data acquisition systems.
•Familiarity with aerospace standards and specifications (e.g., Arinc-429, MIL-STD-1553, DO 160, MIL STD 810, ARP 4754).
•Ability to create schematics and block diagrams using Visio, Mentor Graphics, Zuken, and 3DX.
•Experience managing parts logistics—ordering, receiving, inventory control, and vendor coordination

job.title: PCB Test & Repair Technician
job.description:
PCB Test & Repair Technician

Location: Stratford, CT
Pay: $20–$24 per hour, depending on experience
Schedule: Full-Time
Employment Type: Temp-to-Hire, with Direct Hire consideration for the right candidate

About the Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced PCB Test & Repair Technician to join a growing electronics manufacturing team. This position plays an important role in ensuring the quality and functionality of printed circuit boards used in electronic assemblies.

The ideal candidate has strong hands-on electronics experience and is comfortable troubleshooting and repairing PCBs down to the component level. Troubleshoot failures, support production, and help improve testing and repair processes.

This is a great opportunity for a technically skilled electronics professional looking for a long-term position with the potential to transition directly to the company.

What You'll Do

  • Troubleshoot printed circuit boards (PCBs) down to the component level.
  • Diagnose and repair electronic circuits and identify defective components.
  • Replace surface-mount (SMT) and through-hole components as needed.
  • Perform SMT rework and repair in accordance with IPC standards.
  • Set up and operate automatic and manual test equipment.
  • Perform in-circuit, functional, and bench testing.
  • Use diagnostic equipment including oscilloscopes, multimeters, and other electronic test equipment.
  • Read and interpret PCB schematics, assembly drawings, test procedures, and work instructions.
  • Identify and track PCB failure trends.
  • Support new product introductions and the transition of new products into production.
  • Provide training and guidance to production operators on testing and troubleshooting procedures.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and communicate issues effectively with engineering and production teams.
  • Support continuous improvement efforts and other technical projects as assigned.

What We're Looking For

  • Associate's degree in Electronics (A.S.E.E.) Preferred with a minimum of 2 years of experience troubleshooting microprocessor-controlled circuits to the component level OR 10 years of equivalent hands-on experience in a similar role.
  • PC Certification required.
  • Strong understanding of electronic circuits and component-level troubleshooting.
  • Experience with SMT rework and repair to IPC standards.
  • Ability to confidently use oscilloscopes, multimeters, and other electronic diagnostic equipment.
  • Ability to read and interpret PCB schematics and assembly drawings.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to follow detailed procedures and work instructions.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, and Outlook.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively with engineering and production teams.

Why Consider This Opportunity?

  • $20–$24 per hour, based on experience
  • Temp-to-hire opportunity with Direct Hire potential
  • Opportunity to work with advanced electronics and PCB technology
  • Hands-on component-level troubleshooting and repair
  • Opportunity for long-term growth and development

The ideal candidate will have strong industrial electrical engineering experience with a background supporting EPC, chemical, petrochemical, refining, manufacturing, energy, or other heavy industrial projects.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and review single-line diagrams, power distribution systems, electrical equipment layouts, and electrical design packages.

  • Develop electrical specifications and data sheets for switchgear, MCCs, transformers, motors, VFDs, and related equipment.
  • Perform cable, wire, and conduit sizing and associated electrical calculations.

job.title: Active Directory Administrator/Engineer
job.description:
Overview
Client is seeking an experienced Active Directory Administrator/Engineer to support and maintain enterprise-scale directory services environments. This role is responsible for designing, implementing, securing, and troubleshooting Active Directory infrastructure that supports a large user and device population.

The position requires deep technical expertise across Active Directory, identity and access management, Windows Server environments, and infrastructure security. The successful candidate will collaborate with cross-functional IT teams to ensure reliable, secure, and scalable directory services.

Core Responsibilities
• Design, deploy, and manage Active Directory infrastructure, including domains, forests, and trust relationships.
• Administer user and computer accounts, organizational units, security groups, and Group Policy.
• Implement and maintain Active Directory security best practices and compliance standards.
• Manage identity and access management solutions and directory synchronization tools.
• Monitor Active Directory performance, health, and replication across multiple sites.
• Troubleshoot and resolve complex Active Directory issues and escalations.
• Collaborate with network, security, and application teams to support integrated infrastructure solutions.
• Document configurations, procedures, and technical runbooks.
• Plan and execute Active Directory upgrades and migrations.
• Implement disaster recovery and business continuity procedures for directory services.
• Provide technical support and training to IT staff and end users.
• Stay current with security updates, industry trends, and emerging technologies.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies
• 5+ years of hands-on experience administering Active Directory in enterprise environments.
• Strong knowledge of Active Directory architecture, replication, and Group Policy management.
• Experience with Windows Server 2016, 2019, 2022, or newer versions.
• Proficiency in PowerShell scripting for automation and administration.
• Knowledge of DNS, DHCP, and network protocols.
• Experience with directory synchronization tools such as Azure AD Connect, Okta, or similar solutions.
• Understanding of security principles, least-privilege access, and compliance requirements.
• Excellent troubleshooting, problem-solving, communication, and documentation skills.
• CompTIA Security+ or Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator certification, or equivalent experience.

Preferred Skills or Experience
• Microsoft Certified: Enterprise Administrator Expert or a comparable advanced certification.
• Experience with hybrid cloud identity solutions, including Azure AD/Entra ID.
• Knowledge of LDAP, Kerberos, and SAML protocols.
• Experience with privileged access management (PAM) solutions.
• Familiarity with IT service management tools and ticketing systems.
• Experience working in healthcare, finance, or other regulated industries.

Work Details
• Onsite daily at a Client office in New York City.
• Onsite daily at Bloomberg office required. Work location can be between (3 client sites)
• Limited local travel may be required between Client office locations within New York City.
• Interview process consists of an initial screening followed by a Client interview.

job.title: CCA Design Engineer
job.description:
CCA Design Engineer – Aerospace & Defense

Location: Orlando, FL
Work Arrangement: 100% Onsite
Industry: Aerospace & Defense

Please do not submit any candidates that were submitted to this manager's previous Request #21637.

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced CCA Design Engineer to support the design and development of advanced aerospace and defense products. This position will focus on the design of Circuit Card Assemblies (CCAs), including component and connector selection, layout, engineering documentation, and coordination of testing and integration activities.

The ideal candidate will have at least 3 years of hands-on CCA design experience using Creo Parametric and Zuken, along with experience applying IPC standards within aerospace and defense product development environments.

This is an engineering design position not a CAD/drafting role.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop Circuit Card Assemblies (CCAs) for aerospace and defense applications.
  • Perform connector and component selection and layout on CCAs.
  • Create and release IDX files and associated engineering documentation.
  • Develop detailed layouts, sketches, drawings, and design documentation.
  • Release drawings and documentation through Windchill.
  • Design major components and portions of functional systems and advanced prototypes.
  • Develop and improve products while supporting manufacturing operations.
  • Evaluate designs for manufacturability, material availability, interchangeability, replaceability, strength-to-weight efficiency, cost, and contractual requirements.
  • Coordinate design development with engineering, manufacturing, and other affected organizations.
  • Review completed layouts and drawings for accuracy, completeness, clarity, and compliance with applicable standards and specifications.
  • Identify design errors, omissions, and deficiencies and recommend appropriate design improvements.
  • Produce high-quality engineering documentation.
  • Support and guide test and integration activities.
  • Apply applicable IPC standards throughout the design process.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of hands-on Circuit Card Assembly (CCA) design experience.
  • 3+ years of Creo Parametric experience specifically related to CCA design.
  • 3+ years of hands-on Zuken experience.
  • 3+ years of experience working with IPC standards.
  • 3+ years of experience supporting aerospace and/or defense product development cycles.
  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and project management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to produce high-quality design documentation.
  • Ability to support and guide testing and integration activities.
  • Ability to work 100% onsite in Orlando, FL.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Zuken E3 and electrical harness design.
  • Experience supporting manufacturing and product improvement initiatives.
  • Experience working within structured engineering documentation and release processes.

Important Note

This position is specifically seeking candidates with CCA design engineering experience. Candidates whose backgrounds are primarily CAD, drafting, or general mechanical/electrical design without substantial CCA design experience will not be considered.

If you have hands-on CCA design experience with Creo Parametric and Zuken and have worked within aerospace/defense product development, we encourage you to apply.

High school diploma or equivalent.

Certificate in Automotive Electrical Technology or related.

Experience with automotive powertrain systems or electric battery systems.

Mechanical aptitude with basic understanding of automotive systems and ability to crimp and
solder wires. Proficient with hand and power tools and able to operate vehicle lifts.
Proficient electrical and electronic troubleshooting skills and the ability to understand electronic
schematics and electronic part documentation.
Effective written and verbal communication skills.
Knowledge of MS Office programs including Word, Excel, and Outlook.

Broad knowledge of vehicle systems (powertrain, chassis, electrical, thermal, exteriors, interiors,

job.title: Package Room Operator
job.description:

job.title: Customer Service Representative - (Manufacturing)
job.description:
Storeroom Customer Service Representative – Procurement

Position Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented Storeroom Customer Service Representative to support procurement, purchasing, order tracking, inventory, and vendor activities at an onsite customer location.

This position will be responsible for creating purchase orders, processing procurement requests, tracking orders through delivery, receiving orders in the system, and assisting with invoice reconciliation. The role works closely with onsite Storeroom Attendants, suppliers, vendors, and internal customers to ensure products and materials are purchased and delivered according to established requirements for price, quality, timing, and reliability.

This is a temp-to-hire opportunity, with relevant hands-on experience preferred over education.

Schedule & Work Environment

  • Schedule: Monday – Friday, 8:00 AM – 4:30 PM
  • Work Model: 100% onsite/in person
  • Employment Type: Temp-to-hire
  • Dress Code: Business casual
  • Steel-toe shoes required
  • Primarily an administrative/procurement role with occasional assistance in the storeroom.
  • Position operates within a customer/manufacturing environment.

Key Responsibilities

Procurement & Purchase Order Management

  • Create and process purchase requisitions and vendor purchase orders.
  • Manage procurement requests for stock, non-stock, and spot-buy items.
  • Track orders from initial request through final delivery.
  • Follow up with vendors regarding purchase order status and expected delivery dates.
  • Communicate order status and potential delays to customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Receive completed orders within the appropriate system once delivered.
  • Review inventory forecasts and daily replenishment recommendations generated through ERP or inventory management systems.
  • Review existing orders to determine whether expediting or de-expediting is necessary.
  • Research and evaluate vendors and requested products to ensure specifications, pricing, quality, and delivery requirements are met.

Vendor & Supplier Coordination

  • Maintain effective relationships with suppliers, vendors, and assigned customers.
  • Communicate with vendors to resolve delivery, product quality, and order-related issues.
  • Monitor the quality and timeliness of products and materials supplied.
  • Coordinate returns and replacements for damaged or incorrect goods.
  • Coordinate vendor returns for aging, expired, or excess inventory.
  • Research and resolve supplier and accounts payable discrepancies.
  • Identify and document opportunities for customer cost savings.

Invoice & Inventory Support

  • Assist with invoice reconciliation and resolution of purchasing discrepancies.
  • Support inventory replenishment and purchasing activities.
  • Maintain accurate purchasing, order, and inventory documentation.
  • Produce and maintain customer KPI measurement data.
  • Work closely with onsite Storeroom Attendants to support daily operations.
  • Occasionally assist with storeroom activities as needed.

Customer Service & Operational Support

  • Provide excellent customer service to internal and onsite customers.
  • Follow established Standard Operating Procedures.
  • Adhere to LEAN operating practices.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and professional work environment.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • 1+ years of procurement, purchasing, order management, inventory, or related experience preferred.
  • Relevant experience is preferred over education.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Supply Chain, or a related field is a plus but not required.
  • Experience creating and managing purchase orders and purchase requisitions preferred.
  • Experience with invoice reconciliation and vendor coordination is a plus.
  • Strong computer skills with the ability to quickly learn and navigate new systems.
  • SX.e and SAP experience helpful but not required.
  • Experience with ERP and/or inventory management systems preferred.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.
  • CPM certification is a plus but not required.

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Procurement and purchasing support.
  • Purchase order creation and tracking.
  • Vendor and supplier coordination.
  • Invoice reconciliation.
  • Inventory and replenishment support.
  • Strong customer service skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Strong organizational and follow-through skills.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple priorities.
  • Basic mathematical aptitude.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to quickly learn new ERP and computer systems.

Physical & Environmental Requirements

  • Ability to spend extended periods working on a computer and performing repetitive keyboarding activities.
  • May work within a manufacturing environment with exposure to dirt, smoke, heat, cold, and other industrial conditions.
  • Must follow all customer safety protocols and wear required PPE, including steel-toe footwear.
  • Ability to occasionally stand and walk.
  • Ability to occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.
  • Overtime may occasionally be required with limited advance notice.
  • No driving of vehicles or equipment is required.

job.title: Senior Accountant
job.description:
Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Accountant to manage full-cycle accounting activities, including general ledger maintenance, accounts payable and receivable, payroll processing, tax compliance, reconciliations, month-end close, and financial reporting.

The ideal candidate will have strong QuickBooks experience, a solid understanding of U.S. GAAP, and experience supporting accounting operations within a manufacturing or technology environment. Experience with ERP migrations, Oracle EBS, and M&A/acquired-entity accounting is highly preferred.

Key Responsibilities

Full-Cycle Accounting

  • Manage full-cycle accounting activities in QuickBooks, including general ledger maintenance, journal entries, and account reconciliations.
  • Process vendor invoices/accounts payable (AP) and customer invoices/accounts receivable (AR) accurately and timely.
  • Process vendor payments and manage payment schedules in accordance with contractual terms.
  • Perform regular bank account and general ledger reconciliations.
  • Prepare and post monthly accruals, provisions, and adjusting journal entries.
  • Support an accurate and timely month-end close.
  • Maintain compliance with U.S. GAAP and applicable internal accounting policies.

Payroll & Tax Compliance

  • Calculate and process payroll for approximately 19 employees directly through QuickBooks according to the applicable payroll schedule.
  • Calculate and remit applicable federal, state, and local payroll taxes.
  • Prepare required payroll-related filings and ensure compliance with statutory deadlines.

Financial Reporting

  • Prepare monthly management reports and financial summaries for accounting and finance leadership.
  • Ensure financial information is accurate, complete, and properly documented.

ERP Transition & Systems Support

  • Support high-level coordination and data validation activities associated with the ERP transition from QuickBooks to Oracle EBS.
  • Partner with Financial Systems and Controllership teams on:
    • ERP integration milestones
    • Data validation
    • Process documentation
    • Accounting system transition activities
  • Assist with accounting-related integration activities as needed.

Collaboration

  • Partner effectively with accounting, finance, and financial systems teams.
  • Maintain a positive and professional working environment.
  • Demonstrate strong communication, accountability, and collaboration in all interactions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • Master's degree in Accounting preferred.
  • CPA certification preferred but not required.
  • Strong hands-on experience with QuickBooks.
  • Experience with full-cycle accounting, including:
    • General ledger
    • Accounts payable
    • Accounts receivable
    • Payroll
    • Payroll taxes
    • Journal entries
    • Accruals
    • Bank reconciliations
    • Month-end close
    • Financial reporting
  • Knowledge of U.S. GAAP.
  • Experience supporting ERP migrations or system transitions, such as QuickBooks to Oracle EBS or a similar platform.
  • Familiarity with Oracle EBS preferred.
  • Manufacturing or technology industry experience preferred.
  • Experience within an M&A integration or acquired-entity accounting environment preferred.
  • Bilingual English/Spanish.

job.title: HR Generalist
job.description:
Nesco Resource is seeking an HR Generalist for a newly created position with an insurance firm committed to delivering exceptional client service and operational excellence.

Location: Hybrid –Hybrid work environment with remote-work flexibility. When working onsite, candidates must be able to report to the Huntington, Northport, or Port Jefferson office as business needs require.

The HR Generalist will oversee key human resources functions for approximately 75 employees , including recruitment, onboarding, employee engagement, payroll, benefits, compliance, and performance management. This individual will also play an important role in improving internal processes and operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage recruitment, onboarding, and employee development initiatives.
  • Partner with managers and departments to ensure a smooth and effective onboarding process
  • Administer payroll and employee benefits accurately and confidentially, including 401(k) administration. While payroll processing is managed through an outside payroll service, the HR professional will be responsible for overseeing and coordinating the payroll process, ensuring accurate and timely submission of payroll information, reviewing payroll for accuracy, addressing discrepancies, and serving as the internal point of contact for payroll-related questions and issues.
  • Maintain HR policies and ensure compliance with applicable federal and state regulations.
  • Provide guidance and support throughout the performance management process, including annual employee reviews.
  • Track employee development and assist with organizational development initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to improve internal processes, workflows, and operational efficiency.
  • Manage employee offboarding when necessary, partnering with professional advisors and technology teams to ensure a secure and compliant process.
  • Maintain confidentiality of sensitive employee, payroll, and company information.
 
Qualifications of the HR Generalist
  • 5+ years of progressive HR experience, including payroll and benefits administration.
  • Demonstrates sound judgment and discretion when applying company policies and procedures, understanding when flexibility or exceptions may be appropriate while maintaining consistency, fairness, and appropriate boundaries.
  • Preferred Industry Background: Experience in a professional, white-collar service environment—such as insurance, legal, accounting, financial services, or a similar professional services industry—is strongly preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of multi-state HR laws and regulations a plus
  • Experience with HR operations, process improvement, and administrative functions.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills with a high level of emotional intelligence.
  • Demonstrated integrity, discretion, and sound judgment.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with management and department leaders.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
$90-95k

job.title: Purchasing Buyer
job.description:
Position Summary:
Directs the activities associated with the SCMG managed global spend for a designated commodity category. Responsible for identification and evaluation of North American opportunities within the commodity category for reduction of spend, consolidation of process, function and continuity of supply. Manages the Client contracts within the commodity category and reports the metrics associated with them. Delivers continuous improvement in cost processes and services within the commodity category. Will be responsible for requests for information (RFI) or quotes (RFQ). Generates recommendations based on Total Cost of Ownership comparisons. Monitors and reports on activities associated with named commodity categories. Major Duties and

Responsibilities:
Formulate annual business plans for achievement of cost reductions and year-over-year performance improvement.
Obtains and analyzes quotes to determine best value, then recommends global sourcing solutions based on data and facts collected.
Can layout and explain a commodity strategy. Follows and tracks to the strategy for basic commodities. Understands all aspects of commodity strategy templates. Can create a strategy but may be limited to current state (static) and not completely global. May be limited to more basic commodities. Utilizes capability matrices to develop strategy.
Provides proper documentation for review at sourcing councils, including total landed cost analysis taking into account duty, freight, packaging, surcharge, payment terms, and other financial factors. Includes understanding of SSA status and any financial risk. Consistently utilizes IPOs in quoting new business. Considers global spending for all suppliers.
Ability to maintain control of multiple projects to meet timing and anticipate and resolve 'roadblocks' for successful part PPAP and launch. Monitors technical review progress with cross-functional teams; ensures OISRs are updated and tracks to program milestones.
"Ability to clearly understand the financial and strategic impacts of agreed to 'gives' and 'gets' to optimize the value to Client and negotiate complex supplier issues with little to no supervision. Understands tactics to position Client with the most leverage possible.
Consistently sends out and reviews complete RFQ packages and negotiates the basic terms of a contract to support an agreement. Understand what type of contract is required. Understands key points to leverage beyond price. Understands Client's standard Terms and Conditions.
Monitors supplier(s) performance, audits results and elevates issues within the supplier's organization for resolution. Understands and review the corrective actions for sustained results. Holds regular performance review meetings with key stakeholders and measures compliance to agreements. Tracks Savings projects and reports accurate forecasts and actuals in the Savings Tracker. Understands supplier surcharge mechanisms.
Works proactively with other departments to find ways of reducing the need for inventory.
Manages the supply chain to ensure optimum workflows and takes active steps to remove non-value-added work. Challenges the status quo and engages help and support from other functional groups. Makes specific and comprehensive recommendations for process improvements. Understands DOS and can lead improvement activities with assistance.
Is able to lead Benchmarking, VA/VE, Lean, Resourcing, LPP analysis, Value Stream mapping events with no assistance. Thinks creatively about using what is learned from the savings toolbox to generate a range of improvement options for the business. Promotes cost reduction activities with key suppliers and shares best practices

Minimum Qualifications
Four-year degree in Business (Supply Chain Management or Purchasing is preferred) or four year degree in Engineering (Product or Manufacturing)
Professional Supply chain certification preferred
3-5 years of experience in procurement, preferred
Strong team player, able to work effectively on cross-functional teams.
Excellent communication skills, verbal and written.
Maintains an organized and professional manner when representing Client.
Willing to travel as required (estimate 10%).

Required Skills:
Ability to work on tasks along with prioritizing work and managing deadlines.
Understands interactions that affect outcomes for problem-solving. Uses analytical abilities to distill complex issues into workable parts for themselves. Anticipates consequences of alternative options.
Possesses and uses appropriate levels of intellectual ability to achieve objectives and maximize results. Demonstrates a determined, engaged, thoughtful approach to doing day-to-day work. Applies knowledge of global organizational issues to his/her own work.
Can identify areas of deficiency in processes and employ resources to optimize.
Can support and personalize the needed change within the group/dept./organization.
Develops relationships across the corporation to facilitate inter-divisional cooperation and cross-functional asset utilization
Provides prompt, courteous, and attentive service to both internal and external customers.
Accomplishes tasks and makes effective decisions without guidance, even outside the framework of their direct work responsibility.
Recognizes the talents, skills, and behaviors that the organization needs. Demonstrates self-awareness and takes action to improve individual performance/capabilities.
Inspires others in setting and achieving standards of excellence. Can get others on board, engaged and committed to objectives; can overcome resistance. Effectively get things done through others by delegating, motivating, focusing and leveraging the appropriate resources to meet objectives.
Establishes open, candid and trusting relationships. Treats others fairly and consistently. Effectively handles conflicts and issues impacting working relationships.
Actively supports the implementation and maintenance of lean value and the related value stream.
Demonstrates a high level of cooperation and collaboration with internal and external relationships.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to work with people at all levels within and outside Client in a professional manner.
Familiarity with Procurement and Quality Supplier Metrics with flow-down to supplier contracts and performance reviews.
Must have an understanding of blueprints and technical specifications. Strong personal computer skills required, including experience with MS Office Software

Can create a strategy but may be limited to current state (static) and not completely global. May be limited to more basic commodities. Utilizes capability matrices to develop strategy.
• Provides proper documentation for review at sourcing councils, including total landed cost analysis taking into account duty, freight, packaging, surcharge, payment terms, and other financial factors. Includes understanding of SSA status and any financial risk. Consistently utilizes IPOs in quoting new business. Considers global spending for all suppliers.

Holds regular performance review meetings with key stakeholders and measures compliance to agreements. Tracks Savings projects and reports accurate forecasts and actuals in the Savings Tracker. Understands supplier surcharge mechanisms.

job.title: Measurement Systems Software Engineer
job.description:
Overview
Client is seeking a Measurement Systems Software Engineer to support the design, development, integration, and deployment of software for industrial measurement and inspection systems used in manufacturing environments. This role focuses on C#/.NET software development, hardware integration, and the delivery of reliable, production-ready measurement solutions.
The engineer will work with distributed software applications that coordinate imaging, motion, I/O, sequencing, and data handling for product inspection and quality control. The role also includes evaluating and applying AI-assisted software development practices to improve engineering workflows and productivity.

Core Responsibilities
• Design, develop, test, maintain, and support software for industrial measurement and machine vision systems using C#/.NET.
• Develop and support distributed measurement system applications, including software communication, coordination, configuration, and data handling.
• Support software build, release, deployment, system integration, and technology transfer activities from development into manufacturing.
• Evaluate, adopt, and apply AI-assisted and agentic coding tools to improve software development workflows, code quality, testing, and engineering efficiency.
• Contribute to best practices for incorporating AI development tools into day-to-day software engineering activities.
• Create and maintain technical documentation, including software specifications and support documentation.
• Train engineering, maintenance, and operations personnel on the use, support, and maintenance of deployed systems.
• Provide remote and onsite troubleshooting for software and integrated measurement systems.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies
• BS, MS, or PhD preferred in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Optical Engineering, Physics, or a related field.
• Experience developing software applications in C#/.NET for production use, system integration, or industrial applications.
• Experience designing, developing, and troubleshooting software for distributed, multi-process, or integrated systems.
• Familiarity with software communication and messaging methods such as publish/subscribe architectures, message queues, or similar approaches.
• Experience with source control, software versioning, and build/release workflows using tools such as Git, GitLab, automated build systems, and package management tools.
• Experience supporting software deployment, troubleshooting, and long-term support in development or manufacturing environments.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document technical work and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
• Interest in applying AI-assisted and agentic coding tools to improve software development workflows, code quality, testing, and engineering productivity.

Preferred Skills or Experience
• Experience with WPF user interface development frameworks in .NET.
• Experience with motion control systems, cameras, image acquisition hardware, and integrated imaging platforms.
• Hands-on experience working with imaging hardware, cameras, measurement equipment, or related instrumentation.
• Experience applying machine learning or computer vision methods to inspection, classification, or measurement problems.
• Familiarity with databases, containerization, or high-performance computing environments.
• Experience evaluating, adopting, or helping define best practices for AI-enabled software development workflows.
• Knowledge of machine vision and image processing methods such as feature extraction, edge detection, morphology, classification, inspection, and metrology.
• Experience with machine vision or image processing libraries such as Halcon, OpenCV, LabVIEW, or similar tools.

Work Details
• 40 hours per week with a flexible schedule as needed.
• Up to 10% to 30% domestic and international travel may be required, with trips ranging from one day to several weeks.
• Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

job.description:
Manufacturing / Process / Design Engineer

Position Overview
We are seeking a Manufacturing/Process/Design Engineer to support engineering activities related to manufacturing processes, production systems, and product/design applications. Under direct supervision, this position performs a variety of engineering tasks designed to build experience and familiarity with company engineering methods, practices, standards, and programs.

The ideal candidate will be comfortable working with technical data, engineering documentation, and established procedures to develop practical solutions to routine engineering problems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support manufacturing, process, and design engineering activities.
  • Perform routine engineering assignments under the direction of experienced engineers.
  • Review engineering drawings, specifications, procedures, and other technical references.
  • Use established engineering methods, standards, and readily available references to resolve straightforward technical problems.
  • Collect, organize, and evaluate engineering and manufacturing data to support decision-making.
  • Assist with developing engineering plans, procedures, and recommendations for assigned projects.
  • Support the design and application of engineering solutions to manufacturing and production challenges.
  • Assist with evaluating existing processes and identifying opportunities for improvement.
  • Prepare engineering documentation, reports, calculations, and presentations as required.
  • Collaborate with manufacturing, quality, design, and other engineering teams.
  • Follow company engineering standards, procedures, safety requirements, and quality practices.
  • Gain familiarity with the company's engineering programs, processes, tools, and best practices.

What They're Really Looking For

The strongest candidates will have:

  • A degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Internship, co-op, or early-career experience in manufacturing, process engineering, product design, or production engineering.
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and technical specifications.
  • Experience working with engineering/manufacturing data.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Familiarity with CAD/design software is beneficial.
  • Understanding of manufacturing processes and engineering principles.
  • Ability to work under the guidance of senior engineers while progressively taking on more responsibility.

Seniority Level

Entry-Level / Junior Engineer approximately 0–3 years of engineering experience, although relevant internship/co-op or hands-on manufacturing experience can be highly valuable.

We are seeking a contract CAD Technician to support engineering, maintenance,
and operations teams with the creation, revision, control, and management of
technical drawings and related project documentation.

management/PDM system.

modeled designs into complete drawing packages, update existing drawings based

maintain drawing accuracy throughout the revision process.

This position will also
support project documentation needs, including drawing organization, redline
incorporation, legacy drawing digitization, revision tracking, basic engineering
computations, specification updates, and coordination of supporting technical
information.

In addition to supporting the engineering team, this role will interface with internal
customers, primarily operations and maintenance personnel, to document requests,
retrieve existing drawings, clarify drawing needs, and help ensure accurate
technical information is available to support daily plant activities, troubleshooting,
and project execution.

The ideal candidate will have strong CAD drafting capability, experience working in
a controlled documentation environment, attention to detail, and the ability to
communicate effectively with engineering and plant personnel.

Experience with SolidWorks, AutoCAD, or similar CAD platforms is preferred, along with familiarity with PDM or drawing vault systems, manufacturing environments, mechanical or electrical equipment documentation, and continuous improvement of drawing/documentation workflows.

EDUCATION
• Associate degree or 2-year technical degree in CAD/CAM, Mechanical
Engineering Technology, Electrical Engineering Technology,
Electromechanical Engineering Technology, Manufacturing Technology
• Minimum of 3 years of relevant CAD drafting, design support,
manufacturing documentation, or engineering support experience.

Required Skills:
Candidates must possess the following:
• Proficiency with SolidWorks or comparable 3D CAD software.
• Ability to create, revise, and maintain detailed drawings and drawing
packages.
• Ability to read and interpret mechanical, electrical, and manufacturing
drawings.
• Working knowledge of GD&T and standard drafting practices.
• Experience updating drawings from redlines, field changes,
engineering input, or project documentation.
• Experience converting legacy drawings, sketches, field markups, or
other source documentation into accurate, controlled CAD drawings.
• Ability to support basic engineering calculations and prepare or revise
technical specifications under engineering direction.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and general computer-based
documentation tools.
• Strong attention to detail, organization, and document control
discipline.
• Ability to identify and recommend improvements to standard drawing,
documentation, and workflow processes.
• Able to train new employees or team members on established drawing
management, CAD, and documentation procedures.
• Self-motivated and able to work both independently and as part of a
team, with the ability to follow through on tasks with minimal
supervision while coordinating effectively with engineering,
maintenance, and operations personnel.
• Strong verbal and written communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications:
• Experience with AutoCAD.
• Experience working in a manufacturing, industrial, or plant engineering
environment.
• Familiarity with SolidWorks PDM or similar drawing vault/document
control systems.
• Experience supporting mechanical and/or electrical equipment
documentation.
• Familiarity with revision control, drawing release processes, and
controlled documentation practices.
• Hands-on understanding of manufacturing equipment, maintenance
needs, or field installation details.

This role is responsible for ensuring outbound emails are accurate, fully functional, and rendered correctly across devices and email clients.
The ideal candidate is highly organized, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and can confidently manage both routine and time-sensitive email deployments while maintaining quality and consistency.

Core Responsibilities
• Deploy and review email communications through Adobe Campaign and Journey Optimizer, including urgent and time-sensitive sends.
• Perform thorough pre-send quality assurance to verify content accuracy, functionality, link integrity, and rendering across desktop, mobile, and webmail platforms.
• Ensure brand consistency, formatting accuracy, and content integrity across all outbound email communications.
• Monitor campaign performance, including open rates, click-through rates, bounce rates, and deliverability metrics.
• Generate and distribute performance reports, providing stakeholders with actionable insights and recommendations for optimization.
• Create reusable, standards-compliant Outlook email templates that function consistently across Microsoft Office email environments.
• Maintain and update the email template library to support ongoing communication needs.
• Troubleshoot and resolve email rendering issues, delivery failures, and sending errors in real time.
• Identify root causes of email-related issues and implement corrective and preventive measures.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies

job.title: CNC Operator
job.description:
CNC Operator

We are seeking an experienced CNC Operator/Machinist to join a growing manufacturing team. This position is ideal for someone with strong machining experience who can independently set up and operate CNC equipment while producing high-quality precision components. Candidates should be comfortable working from blueprints, maintaining tight tolerances, and contributing to a safe, team-oriented production environment.

Responsibilities

  • Set up and operate CNC lathes and/or mills to manufacture precision machined parts.

  • Read and interpret blueprints, engineering drawings, and work instructions.

  • Edit machine programs, speeds, and feeds as needed to optimize production.

  • Perform precision measurements using calipers, micrometers, gauges, and other measuring equipment.

  • Maintain close tolerances of ±0.001 " or better while ensuring product quality.

  • Perform machine setup changes for a variety of part configurations and production runs.

  • Operate secondary equipment such as drill presses, saws, tapping machines, and punch presses.

  • Deburr, clean, and inspect finished parts.

  • Troubleshoot machining issues and communicate production concerns to supervision.

  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area.

  • Assist with training less experienced machinists when needed.

  • Follow all company safety policies and quality standards.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • 2-5 years of CNC machining experience in a manufacturing environment.

  • Experience setting up and operating CNC lathes and/or mills.

  • Working knowledge of G-Code and M-Code programming.

  • Ability to read blueprints and accurately interpret dimensions and tolerances.

  • Experience using precision measuring instruments including calipers, micrometers, height gauges, and gauges.

  • Basic computer skills for data entry and machine interface.

  • Ability to make minor program edits at the machine.

  • Experience operating manual machining equipment is a plus.

  • Strong mechanical aptitude and troubleshooting skills.

  • Ability to work independently while meeting production goals.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds.

  • Ability to stand for extended periods throughout the shift.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

  • Willingness to work overtime as needed.

Education

  • High School Diploma or GED required.

  • Technical school or machining certification preferred but not required.

Why Apply?

  • Competitive pay based on experience

  • Stable first-shift opportunity

  • Opportunity to work with precision machining equipment

  • Growth potential within a well-established manufacturing environment

  • Team-focused workplace with an emphasis on quality and safety

job.title: Maintenance Technician (Mechanic)
job.description:
This position is responsible for ensuring equipment integrity and timely repair.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Effectively supporting the Preventative Maintenance (PM) program with a goal of continually reducing unscheduled downtime.
  • Analyzing problems and interpreting technical information necessary to make required repairs, including troubleshooting equipment issues.
  • Performing mechanical and electrical maintenance and repairs on production machinery and facility support equipment.
  • Inspecting, operating, and testing machinery or equipment to diagnose machine malfunction and validate work performed.
  • Ensuring safety by following all company policies, including safety rules, procedures, Lock-out/Tag-out procedures, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP's), personal safety standards, food safety standards, as well as OSHA standards.
  • Troubleshooting PLC controlled equipment and all plant electrical and mechanical systems, including motors, instrumentation, distribution, and feed control systems, and developing sustainable solutions accordingly.
  • Completing all assigned work orders within the time allotted.
  • Maintaining complete records of work performed using software, work orders, and detailed logs, and having good communication skills across all groups/departments.
  • Assisting with equipment changeovers and line startups, troubleshooting issues as needed.
  • Identifying required parts and maintaining current inventories and parts reorder lists.
  • Assuring that all products are manufactured to the highest standard of quality.
  • Participating in Continuous Improvement, providing suggestions to improve processes, and participating in team projects.

Physical Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Ability to lift 50-80 lbs. Performs highly repetitive motions, stand for eight plus hours, talk, and hear.
  • Ability to climb ladders, stairways, use a manlift/scissorlift at ceiling heights or above with proper safety equipment, and work in a non-air conditioned environment.
  • While performing job duties, the associate will frequently walk, use hands to feel or handle, and reach with hands and arms. Frequent exposure to oils and greases or coolants.
  • While performing job duties, the associate will occasionally sit, climb or balance, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, and smell. Occasional exposure to wet and/or humid conditions; high, precarious places; toxic or caustic chemicals; outside weather conditions; extreme heat; and vibration.
  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

job.title: Instrumentation Technician
job.description:
Multiple Levels and Positions! $25-$40/hour Depending on Experience.  
Schedule: 4, 10s; Monday-Thursday 6am to 4:30pm (occasional OT)  
Position Type: 6 Month Contract 

Top Requirements:

  • U.S. Citizenship required – due to work on a Department of Energy (DOE) site 
  • No Green Card holders or Visa candidates – must be a U.S. citizen to access the site.
  • Site Location: Industrial/nuclear environment.

Role Overview:

  • While the role includes calibration duties, it is expanding into instrumentation and controls (I&C)—broader in scope than traditional calibration.
  • Looking for candidates with instrumentation experience beyond just calibration, ideally with electrical troubleshooting skills.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Install, connect & troubleshoot various measurement & control devices (instrumentation).
  • Valve work is a major part of the role — knowledge in this area is essential.
  • Set up and maintain devices such as temperature, pressure, and flow sensors, switches, valves, and control panels.
  • Work with pneumatic and electronic systems.
  • Use tools like Set Route (software program) to verify electrical components & wiring.
  • Troubleshoot malfunctioning devices & assist calibration techs in determining whether the issue is with the device or a calibration issue.
  • Repair or replace equipment depending on diagnostics and cost-benefit analysis (e.g., when to quote vs. replace).
  • Understand the mechanical and electrical aspects of industrial instruments.
  • Collaborate closely with the calibration team — act as the instrumentation expert who can support and mentor calibration staff.

Ideal Background:

  • Experience in industrial environments: petrochemical, pharmaceutical, or nuclear sectors.
  • Solid knowledge of instrumentation and control systems.
  • Basic knowledge of calibration is a plus.
  • Strong electrical troubleshooting ability.
  • Able to interpret technical diagrams (e.g., P&ID) and manufacturer specifications.
  • Hands-on experience with installation, repair, and maintenance of instrumentation equipment.
  • Team-oriented and capable of mentoring less experienced calibration techs.
  • Experience working with multimeters and similar diagnostic tools.
  • P&ID diagrams to verify system setups and processes is a plus.

Additional Notes:

  • Candidates should not expect a typical calibration-only role — this position goes well beyond and is focused on instrumentation, field diagnostics, and system repair.
  • Strong candidates may come from an I&E Technician background, with experience in:
    • Plant lighting systems
    • Thermostat systems
    • Programmable logic controllers (PLCs)
    • Reading and interpreting blueprints
    • Disassembling/reassembling complex instrumentation systems

job.title: Project Engineer – Modular Data Center Infrastructure
job.description:
Position Overview

Our team is seeking an experienced Project Engineer to support the engineering, design, and delivery of modular data center infrastructure projects. This position is ideal for a hands-on Mechanical Engineer or Electrical Engineer with 7+ years of engineering and design experience, particularly within data centers, industrial facilities, large-scale infrastructure, or complex manufacturing environments.

The Project Engineer will take ownership of key technical aspects of projects from initial design through construction, commissioning, and final delivery. The role requires strong mechanical and piping knowledge, the ability to interpret and approve engineering documentation, and the communication skills necessary to work directly with clients and cross-functional project teams.

Key Responsibilities

Project & Engineering Leadership

  • Support the Engineering Manager in delivering complex data center projects.
  • Take ownership of assigned engineering and technical workstreams.
  • Coordinate with Project Management, Sales, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Construction, and other engineering disciplines.
  • Lead technical discussions and provide guidance to engineering team members.
  • Assist with onboarding and mentoring engineers as project demands increase.
  • Manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.

Engineering Design & Technical Oversight

  • Review and approve engineering drawings, specifications, calculations, and technical documentation.
  • Ensure designs meet customer requirements, applicable codes, safety regulations, and engineering best practices.
  • Develop engineering scopes of work, execution plans, schedules, and technical deliverables.
  • Coordinate designs across multiple projects and customers.
  • Identify technical issues and develop practical engineering solutions.

Mechanical & Piping Engineering

Develop and review engineering deliverables including:

  • Equipment lists
  • Valve lists
  • Piping layouts and line lists
  • Mechanical equipment datasheets
  • Pipe sizing calculations
  • Pipe stress analysis
  • Piping load information for structural engineering
  • Mechanical system specifications
  • Technical requisitions for mechanical equipment and systems

Support the engineering and design of:

  • Mechanical systems
  • Industrial piping systems
  • Fire protection and fire suppression systems
  • Equipment mounting and installation systems
  • Modular infrastructure and related mechanical systems

Client & Construction Support

  • Serve as a technical point of contact for customers and project stakeholders.
  • Participate in customer meetings, design reviews, site visits, and commissioning activities.
  • Answer technical questions and provide engineering support during construction.
  • Troubleshoot engineering and installation issues in the field.
  • Review and manage engineering changes and technical documentation.
  • Support projects through construction, startup, and commissioning.

Continuous Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to improve reliability, efficiency, cost, and project execution.
  • Stay current with data center technologies, engineering practices, and industry trends.
  • Evaluate coatings, mounting systems, installation methods, and other technical solutions.
  • Promote engineering best practices and lessons learned across projects.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
  • 7+ years of mechanical engineering and design experience.
  • Experience supporting industrial facilities, large infrastructure projects, data centers, manufacturing facilities, or similar complex environments.
  • Strong understanding of mechanical and piping systems.
  • Experience with fire protection/fire suppression systems.
  • Experience supporting construction and commissioning activities.
  • Ability to review and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and technical documentation.
  • Strong understanding of engineering codes, standards, and regulations.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and changing priorities.

Preferred Technical Experience

Experience with the following software is preferred:

  • SolidWorks
  • Autodesk Revit
  • AutoCAD
  • BIM 360
  • Navisworks

Experience with the following codes and industry standards is highly desirable:

  • AISI – American Iron and Steel Institute
  • ANSI – American National Standards Institute
  • ASME B&PV Section VIII, Section IX, and B31.3
  • ASTM – American Society for Testing and Materials
  • AWS – American Welding Society
  • IBC – International Building Code
  • MFMA – Metal Framing Manufacturers Association
  • Client – Manufacturers Standardization Society
  • OSHA – Occupational Safety and Health Administration
  • NACE – National Association of Corrosion Engineers
  • NFPA – National Fire Protection Association
  • PFI – Pipe Fabrication Institute

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a senior-level, hands-on engineer who can bridge the gap between engineering design, project execution, construction, and the customer. They should be comfortable taking technical ownership, reviewing engineering work, solving field issues, and communicating with both internal teams and external clients.

Candidates with backgrounds in data centers, industrial facilities, process/manufacturing plants, modular construction, piping engineering, mechanical infrastructure, EPC projects, or large-scale capital projects are encouraged to apply.

Additional Requirements

  • Fluent in English, both written and verbal.
  • Must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.
  • Willingness to travel to project sites as required.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, project-driven environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to engineering quality and safety.

job.title: Principal Data Science/AI Product Manager
job.description:
Principal Data Science/AI Product Manager

Overview

Client is seeking a Principal Data Science/AI Product Manager to lead the strategy, development, and delivery of AI/ML product capabilities that support customer engagement and business decision-making across Commercial, Medical, and Government Affairs functions.

This role partners with Data Science, Engineering, IT, and Product leadership teams to define AI product vision, develop roadmaps, and deliver intelligent solutions that enable proactive decision-making, automation, and personalized customer experiences. The position owns the AI product lifecycle from ideation and strategy through deployment, optimization, and governance.

Core Responsibilities

• Drive AI/ML product vision and strategy across classical machine learning and Generative AI capabilities supporting business use cases throughout the customer journey.

• Partner with Data Science, Informatics/IT, Commercial Strategy, and Product leadership to define roadmaps, prioritize initiatives, and maintain a stack-ranked product backlog.

• Develop and manage AI product roadmaps using user research, market trends, business value assessments, and analytics insights.

• Gather and analyze user feedback, usage data, UAT results, and model performance metrics to define requirements and continuously improve AI capabilities.

• Support the ideation, development, and launch of AI/ML-driven features that enable next-best actions, intelligent automation, and personalized recommendations.

• Communicate product value, priorities, and progress to stakeholders while balancing business objectives, user needs, and technical feasibility.

• Build business cases for new and enhanced AI/ML capabilities in partnership with product and technical leadership.

• Identify emerging customer needs and incorporate AI/ML capabilities into digital platforms supporting enterprise transformation initiatives.

• Manage external consulting partners to ensure delivery of scalable, high-quality, and ethical AI solutions integrated with enterprise systems.

• Coordinate across business, IT, and product teams to support responsible AI governance and enterprise-scale outcomes.

• Ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and company policies.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field.

• 8+ years of combined experience in product management, data science, AI, software development, or related disciplines.

• Hands-on experience with modern and classical AI and machine learning techniques, including Deep Learning, Natural Language Processing (NLP), and Generative AI.

• Proficiency in at least one industry-standard programming language such as Python, R, Scala, or SQL.

• Experience creating detailed Product Requirements Documents (PRDs) and utilizing Agile methodologies to deliver AI/ML product capabilities focused on user needs and measurable business outcomes.

• Experience owning the complete AI or Data Science product lifecycle, including strategy, ideation, execution, launch, governance, optimization, and performance measurement.

• Proven experience defining and driving enterprise-level AI/ML product vision and strategy for transformational digital initiatives.

• Experience engaging, influencing, and communicating effectively with senior leadership and executive stakeholders.

• Experience managing complex, multi-team product roadmaps and integrating AI/ML initiatives across multiple business functions.

• Experience leading experimentation efforts and leveraging data-driven insights to drive product innovation.

• Experience researching AI/ML industry trends and incorporating findings into product strategy and roadmap planning.

• Ability to create detailed technical product specifications and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Strong understanding of Agile methodologies, including Scrum and Kanban.

• Knowledge of enterprise technology architectures, including SaaS, PaaS, and IaaS solutions.

• Relevant certifications in product management, machine learning, data science, or related disciplines.

Preferred Skills or Experience

• Advanced degree such as an M.S., MBA, or related field with specialization in AI, Data Science, or Product Management.

• Experience within healthcare, pharmaceutical, or other highly regulated industries.

• Demonstrated experience mentoring and coaching cross-functional teams.

• Deep expertise in product management with a track record of innovating and transforming digital product capabilities.

• Experience with citizen data science platforms, automated analytics tools, and collaborative modeling environments.

• Familiarity with performance monitoring, platform scalability strategies, and cost optimization practices.

• Hands-on experience with user research and design-thinking methodologies to improve product usability and effectiveness.

Work Details

• Onsite position.

• Location: South San Francisco, CA.

• Relocation assistance is not available.

job.title: Maintenance Technician
job.description:
Pay Rate: $35-40/hr based on shift and experience level.

Shift Availability: 1 st and 2 nd shift available. Ten hour shifts Monday through Thursday.

Professional Summary / Core Responsibilities

  • Preventive & Predictive Maintenance: Execute scheduled maintenance routines, inspections, and system checks across plant machinery and facility infrastructure to maximize equipment reliability and minimize operational downtime.
  • Multi-Craft Troubleshooting & Repair: Diagnose, resolve, and repair complex electrical, mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic, and control system issues across production machinery.

  • Electrical & Automation: Industrial Electrical (up to 480 VAC), Control Systems, PLC/Ladder Logic Troubleshooting & Programming.

job.title: Senior Data Scientist
job.description:
Senior Data Scientist

Overview

Client is seeking a Senior Data Scientist to develop, deploy, and industrialize enterprise applications that leverage machine learning to extract value from structured and unstructured data across Commercial and Medical organizations. This role serves as a strategic partner to stakeholders, helping shape business priorities and deliver actionable insights through advanced analytics and AI solutions.

The position requires close collaboration with product owners, data leads, ML engineers, and cross-functional teams to build scalable machine learning applications while maintaining strong standards for data ethics, model validation, governance, and regulatory compliance.

Core Responsibilities

Drive the development, deployment, and industrialization of enterprise machine learning applications using techniques such as classification, regression, and forecasting.

Generate business value from structured and unstructured data across Commercial and Medical domains.

Partner with stakeholders to define impactful business priorities and provide data-driven guidance based on analysis and research.

Collaborate with data science product owners, data leads, ML engineers, and related teams to develop efficient machine learning solutions and deliver actionable business insights.

Ensure adherence to data ethics, model validation standards, regulatory requirements, and data governance practices.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies

Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.

Minimum 5 years of experience in data science or related roles.

Proficiency in Python and/or R.

Knowledge of SQL for database management.

Strong expertise in machine learning and deep learning techniques.

Demonstrated experience developing end-to-end machine learning solutions, from conceptualization and prototyping through production deployment and monitoring.

Experience with cloud computing platforms and data science tools such as AWS, GCP, or similar technologies.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to present complex analyses to non-technical stakeholders.

Proven experience collaborating with cross-functional teams, including data science product owners, ML engineers, and MLOps teams to deploy production-ready machine learning applications.

Proven ability to translate ambiguous business challenges into clear, data-driven analytical initiatives aligned with organizational objectives.

Strong understanding of MLOps best practices, including CI/CD pipelines, model versioning, and performance monitoring for scalable and reliable production environments.

Strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and data analysis skills with exceptional attention to detail.

Preferred Skills or Experience

Experience applying advanced data science and predictive modeling techniques within the healthcare or pharmaceutical industry, including adherence to data governance, regulatory compliance, and model validation standards.

Experience with deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch.

Contributions to open-source projects or publications in data science.

Relevant certifications in data science, machine learning, AI, AWS, or similar technologies.

Experience working with large-scale datasets using Hadoop, Spark, or other big data platforms.

Proficiency applying machine learning techniques for insight generation, ROI calculation, text classification, clustering, and related use cases.

Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau, Qlik, Data Studio, or similar platforms.

Experience translating research and analytical findings into concise, compelling presentations and business narratives that influence decision-making and strategy.

Position is based onsite at the Client campus.

job.title: CNC Programmer- Aerospace
job.description:
The CNC Programmer develops part programs using Catia V5 to control the machining and processing of metal components on automated machine tools and equipment. This role uses Vericut software to validate programs before they are released to production.

Required Education and Experience

  • High school diploma or GED equivalent required.
  • Catia V5 6R2023 certification preferred.
  • Minimum of 3 years of aerospace CNC machine programming experience required.

Essential Functions

  • Analyze job orders, drawings, blueprints, and specifications to determine programming requirements.
  • Calculate dimensions, tool selections, machine speeds, and feed rates.
  • Create geometric layouts from graphic displays.
  • Determine reference points, machine cutting paths, and the sequence of machine operations.
  • Run computer simulations to confirm that programs and machinery function correctly and produce parts that meet customer specifications.
  • Observe trial runs with internal customers to verify program accuracy.
  • Revise programs to eliminate errors and retest to confirm that issues are resolved.
  • Modify existing programs to improve efficiency.
  • Collaborate with internal and external customers to support part programming and design requirements.
  • Perform other job-related duties as assigned.
Other Required Skills and Abilities
  • Ability to read and accurately interpret shop blueprints, sketches, and other technical instructions.
  • Demonstrated basic math skills, including addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and fraction conversions.
  • Experience troubleshooting production issues and editing programs.
  • Demonstrated reliability, with consistent performance and attendance.
  • Proficiency with Catia V5 required; experience with Vericut and iCAM preferred.
