job.title: Critical Facilities Engineer (Datacenter)
job.description:
Nesco Data Center and Infrastructure is seeking a Mission Critical Data Center Engineer in the Greater Ashburn VA area.
 

Mission Critical Data Center Engineer – Night Shift
 

We are seeking an experienced Mission Critical Data Center Engineer to support the safe, reliable, and continuous operation of a mission-critical data center environment on the night shift. This position is responsible for monitoring, operating, troubleshooting, and maintaining critical facility infrastructure and mechanical/electrical systems that support 24x7 data center operations.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience working in a mission-critical environment and understands the importance of preventative maintenance, operational procedures, emergency response, documentation, and strict adherence to safety and change-control processes.

The successful candidate will have a strong facilities background and experience with the infrastructure systems that provide power, cooling, environmental control, fire/life safety, and building management for a high-availability data center.

Pay range is $42-56/hr + 10% ND

 

Mission Critical Facilities Operations

  • Monitor and operate critical data center infrastructure and building systems during the overnight shift.

  • Perform routine inspections of electrical, mechanical, HVAC, and life-safety systems.

  • Monitor facility conditions, alarms, temperatures, humidity, power utilization, and equipment status.

  • Respond promptly to alarms, abnormal operating conditions, equipment failures, and facility emergencies.

  • Perform equipment rounds and document operating conditions, readings, deficiencies, and corrective actions.

  • Maintain situational awareness of facility load, capacity, redundancy, and equipment operating status.

  • Follow established operating procedures, emergency operating procedures, and standard operating procedures.

  • Participate in 24x7 on-call and/or emergency response activities as required.

Electrical Systems

Experience operating and/or maintaining critical electrical infrastructure such as:

  • Utility service and electrical distribution systems

  • Switchgear and switchboards

  • Automatic Transfer Switches (ATS)

  • UPS systems and battery systems

  • Power Distribution Units (PDUs)

  • Remote Power Panels (RPPs)

  • Transformers

  • Generators and emergency power systems

  • Automatic transfer and emergency power systems

  • Electrical panels and distribution equipment

  • 3-phase electrical systems

  • Power monitoring and metering systems

The engineer should understand electrical distribution, redundancy concepts, load balancing, power flow, and the risks associated with working around energized equipment.


Mechanical / Cooling Systems

Experience with mission-critical cooling infrastructure, including:

  • Chillers and chilled-water systems

  • Cooling towers and condenser-water systems

  • CRAH/CRAC units

  • Pumps and pumping systems

  • Computer Room Air Handling systems

  • Air-handling and ventilation systems

  • Humidification/dehumidification systems

  • Heat exchangers

  • Cooling Distribution Units (CDUs)

  • Direct-to-chip and/or liquid cooling systems is a plus

  • Building HVAC systems

  • Temperature and humidity control systems

Building Management & Monitoring Systems

  • Monitor and respond to alarms through Client/EPMS/DCIM platforms.

  • Review trends and operating data to identify abnormal conditions before they become failures.

  • Understand critical alarm priorities and escalation procedures.

  • Document alarm events, equipment status, and corrective actions.

  • Work with remote monitoring and control systems to verify equipment operation.

  • Experience with systems such as Client, EPMS, DCIM, or similar monitoring platforms is strongly preferred.

Preventative & Corrective Maintenance

  • Perform or coordinate preventative maintenance on critical infrastructure.

  • Assist vendors and contractors during scheduled maintenance activities.

  • Troubleshoot equipment and determine appropriate corrective actions.

  • Verify completed maintenance activities and return equipment to normal operating configuration.

  • Maintain accurate maintenance records and equipment documentation.

  • Identify recurring equipment issues and recommend improvements.

  • Support reliability and continuous-improvement initiatives.

Emergency Response

  • Respond immediately to critical alarms and facility emergencies.

  • Execute emergency operating procedures and established escalation protocols.

  • Troubleshoot power, cooling, environmental, and mechanical failures.

  • Communicate effectively with management, security, vendors, customers, and other technical personnel during incidents.

  • Participate in incident investigations and root-cause analysis.

  • Maintain composure and sound judgment during high-pressure situations.

Change Management & Documentation

  • Follow formal change-management procedures for all critical facility work.

  • Review Method of Procedures (MOPs), Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and Emergency Operating Procedures (EOPs).

  • Participate in MOP/EOP reviews and execution.

  • Maintain shift logs, equipment logs, work orders, incident reports, and operational documentation.

  • Provide detailed shift turnover to incoming engineering personnel.

  • Ensure all work is performed in accordance with site procedures and established safety requirements.

Required Qualifications

  • 3–7+ years of experience in data center facilities, mission-critical facilities, critical infrastructure, industrial facilities, semiconductor facilities, hospitals, power plants, or a similarly complex operating environment.

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.

  • Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Facilities Management, Engineering Technology, HVAC, or a related technical discipline preferred.

  • Equivalent military, technical-school, apprenticeship, or hands-on mission-critical experience may be considered in lieu of a formal degree.

  • Demonstrated experience operating and troubleshooting critical electrical and/or mechanical systems.

  • Ability to read and understand electrical one-line diagrams, mechanical drawings, equipment manuals, and technical documentation.

  • Strong understanding of electrical and mechanical safety practices.

  • Experience working in a 24x7 mission-critical environment preferred.

  • Ability to work independently during an overnight shift while maintaining strong communication with day-shift personnel and management.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Strong attention to detail and documentation skills.

  • Ability to prioritize multiple alarms, work orders, and operational issues based on criticality.

Preferred Qualifications & Certifications

Preferred candidates may possess one or more of the following:

  • Data Center Certified Associate (DCCA) or equivalent data center certification

  • Certified Data Center Professional (CDCP)

  • Certified Data Centre Specialist (CDCS)

  • BICSI credentials

  • OSHA 10 or OSHA 30

  • EPA 608 certification

  • Electrical or HVAC certifications

  • NFPA training

  • Generator or UPS manufacturer training

  • Client/Client/EPMS/DCIM training

  • Electrical safety / NFPA 70E training

  • Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) training

  • CPR/AED/First Aid certification

  • Facilities or stationary engineering certification

  • Journeyman electrical, HVAC, or mechanical license is a plus

Safety & Compliance

  • Strictly follow OSHA, NFPA, site-specific safety requirements, and company policies.

  • Follow Lockout/Tagout and electrical safe-work practices.

  • Utilize appropriate PPE when performing inspections, maintenance, and troubleshooting.

  • Maintain a safety-first mindset when working around energized electrical equipment, rotating machinery, high-voltage systems, pressurized systems, refrigerants, and other hazards.

  • Report unsafe conditions immediately.

  • Participate in safety meetings, training, audits, and emergency drills.

Night Shift Requirements

  • Night shift availability is required.

  • Ability to remain alert, attentive, and responsive throughout an overnight shift.

  • Comfortable working independently with limited onsite management supervision.

  • Ability to respond to critical alarms and emergencies at any time during the shift.

  • Willingness to work weekends, holidays, overtime, and emergency call-ins when required by site operations.

  • Reliable attendance and punctuality are critical to maintaining continuous data center coverage.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a hands-on mission-critical facilities professional, not simply a general building engineer. They understand that uptime, redundancy, safety, documentation, and procedural discipline are paramount in a data center environment.

The strongest candidates will have experience operating a data center or similarly critical facility, understand UPS, generators, switchgear, PDUs, chillers, CRAH/CRAC systems, Client/EPMS/DCIM, emergency procedures, preventative maintenance, and electrical/mechanical systems, and can independently manage the facility during an overnight shift.

The successful candidate will manage software, hardware, ERP, security, and other IT-focused initiatives while driving communication, risk management, financial oversight, project planning, and stakeholder alignment. Core Responsibilities

job.title: Quality Technican
job.description:
We are seeking a Quality/Supplier Quality professional to support manufacturing operations by monitoring incoming supplier products and in-process materials to ensure parts are available for production and meet established quality requirements. This position will identify and resolve issues involving nonconforming parts, documentation discrepancies, shipping problems, and supplier-related quality concerns.

The ideal candidate will have 2–3 years of experience in quality inspection, supplier quality, quality assurance, or aerospace/manufacturing, with the ability to read complex engineering drawings and use inspection equipment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor incoming supplier products and in-process materials for quality, documentation, and availability issues.
  • Identify, investigate, and resolve day-to-day product discrepancies and nonconformances.
  • Review parts and associated paperwork to determine whether materials can be released for manufacturing.
  • Communicate directly with suppliers to resolve quality, documentation, delivery, and product issues.
  • Support nonconforming material processes and assist with product containment activities.
  • Help validate supplier and internal corrective actions and follow up on resolution effectiveness.
  • Coordinate with Quality, Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and other internal teams to resolve production-impacting issues.
  • Review First Article Inspection (FAI/FAIR), PPAP, and other supplier quality documentation.
  • Assist with customer-returned material and coordinate related internal and external activities.
  • Read and interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, route sheets, specifications, and manufacturing documentation.
  • Perform or support visual and dimensional inspections using appropriate inspection tools.
  • Apply GD&T principles and applicable quality standards when evaluating parts.
  • Participate in root-cause/problem-solving activities, Kaizen events, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Maintain 5S standards and contribute to a safe, organized, and efficient work environment.
  • Provide support, training, and knowledge sharing to other team members as needed.

Required Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or equivalent required; additional technical education preferred.
  • 2–3 years of related experience in:
    • Quality Inspection
    • Supplier Quality
    • Quality Assurance
    • Manufacturing Quality
    • Aerospace Manufacturing
  • Experience working in a manufacturing, aerospace, engineering, or quality environment.
  • Experience using inspection tools and methods to evaluate manufactured parts.
  • Ability to read and understand complex blueprints, engineering drawings, specifications, route sheets, and work instructions.
  • Working knowledge of shop mathematics, including basic trigonometry.
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with suppliers and cross-functional internal teams.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Aerospace manufacturing experience.
  • Supplier Quality experience.
  • Experience with FAI/FAIR, PPAP, Client/nonconformance, corrective actions, and containment.
  • Knowledge of GD&T / ASME Y14.5.
  • Experience with calipers, micrometers, gauges, CMMs, or other inspection equipment.
  • Knowledge of military/aerospace specifications and standards.
  • Experience with continuous improvement, Kaizen, or 5S.

Compensation

  • Pay Rate: $28–$32/hour
  • $30–$32/hour: Candidates should have directly related inspection or supplier experience, particularly Supplier Quality, Quality Assurance, aerospace, or manufacturing experience.
  • RPO Hire

Important Eligibility Requirement

This position is subject to meeting applicable U.S. Export Compliance and/or U.S. Government Contracting citizenship eligibility requirements.

job.title: Machinist Weekend/Swing Shift
job.description:
Machinist Technician – CNC Machinist

Direct Hire | 60 Openings | Ogden, UT

Company: Parker Hannifin – Commercial Flight Controls Division
Location: Ogden, Utah
Employment Type: Direct Hire / Full-Time
Openings: 60
Pay Range: $20–$40/hour, depending on skills and experience
Relocation Assistance: Up to $7,500 gross relocation assistance; approximately $5,000 after taxes
Experience Level: Experienced CNC Machinists Only

Position Overview

Parker Hannifin's Commercial Flight Controls Division is seeking highly skilled and experienced CNC Machinists to join its manufacturing operation in Ogden, Utah. These are direct-hire opportunities supporting the production of precision components for the aerospace industry.

This opportunity is designed for experienced machinists who can do more than simply operate a machine. Successful candidates should be comfortable with machine setup, tooling, offsets, process adjustments, blueprint interpretation, precision inspection, troubleshooting, and machining close-tolerance components with limited supervision.

The ideal candidates will have a strong background in CNC machining, with particular interest in individuals experienced with Swiss lathes, grinding, CNC mills, and/or manual machining. Candidates should be able to independently evaluate machining conditions, troubleshoot production issues, make adjustments, and maintain the quality and efficiency of their work.

This is NOT an Entry-Level Machine Operator Position

We are specifically seeking experienced CNC Machinists who can independently perform complex setups and machining operations.

Strong candidates may have experience with:

  • CNC Swiss lathes
  • CNC turning
  • CNC milling
  • Precision grinding
  • Manual machining
  • Complex machine setups
  • Tight-tolerance aerospace components
  • Tooling and fixture setup
  • CNC offsets and adjustments
  • Process troubleshooting
  • Precision inspection and measurement

Compensation

Desired Pay Range: $20–$40/hour DOE

Compensation will be determined based on the candidate's skills, machining experience, technical capabilities, and overall qualifications.

Important Recruiting Note: Share the $20–$40/hour range with candidates. Do not tell a candidate they are guaranteed a specific hourly rate.

Available Shifts

Weekend Shift

Friday–Sunday | 5:00 AM–5:00 PM

  • 36 hours per week
  • $6/hour shift differential
  • Three-day work schedule

Swing Shift

Monday–Thursday | 3:00 PM–1:30 AM

  • Four-day work schedule
  • Shift differential applies

Candidates should be clearly informed of the schedule and applicable shift differential during the initial conversation.

Relocation Assistance

Relocation assistance is available for qualified candidates relocating to the Ogden, Utah area.

Relocation Assistance: Up to $7,500 gross
Approximate after-tax amount: $5,000

Target Relocation Markets

Prioritize experienced CNC machinists currently located in:

  • Idaho
  • Utah
  • Nevada
  • Arizona
  • Wyoming
  • New Mexico
  • Colorado
  • Montana

Utah candidates: Relocation assistance may be available for candidates living more than 50 miles from Ogden.

Key Benefits

Parker Hannifin offers a comprehensive benefits package, including:

  • Benefits beginning Day 1
  • Up to $10,000 per year in tuition reimbursement
  • Shift differentials for applicable shifts
  • 401(k) vested Day 1
  • 5% company 401(k) match
  • Onsite cafeteria
  • Opportunities for professional development and advancement

Position Responsibilities

The Machinist Technician will set up and operate a variety of conventional and numerically controlled machining centers while working on complex, close-tolerance production components.

CNC Machine Setup & Operation

  • Set up, adjust, and operate CNC and conventional machining equipment.
  • Perform complex setups involving multiple workpiece stations and standard or custom workholding devices.
  • Run multiple machines efficiently, including simultaneous operations when required.
  • Select and install appropriate tooling, fixtures, and workholding.
  • Make necessary machine adjustments and offsets within established procedures.
  • Monitor machining operations and make process adjustments to maintain quality and productivity.
  • Adapt or modify tooling when necessary to achieve required machining results.

Precision Machining

  • Machine components requiring tight dimensional tolerances, complex contours, dimensional relationships, and specific surface-finish requirements.
  • Apply strong knowledge of production machining techniques, tooling, materials, and shop practices.
  • Work with a variety of production machines, materials, tooling, and machining processes.
  • Develop or refine machining processes when documentation is limited.
  • Troubleshoot machining problems and determine appropriate corrective actions.

Blueprint & Engineering Interpretation

  • Read and interpret:
    • Blueprints
    • Complex engineering drawings
    • Engineering specifications
    • Planning sheets
    • Quality requirements
    • Charts and tables
    • Sketches
    • Verbal instructions
  • Understand dimensional requirements, tolerances, surface finishes, and other manufacturing specifications.
  • Identify potential drawing or process issues and communicate them appropriately.

Engineering & Process Support

  • Interface directly with Engineering to resolve drawing discrepancies and manufacturing issues.
  • Recommend potential design or process improvements.
  • Assist Engineering with developing effective manufacturing processes.
  • Provide input regarding tooling requirements and may assist with tooling design.
  • Help identify opportunities to improve production efficiency, quality, and cost.

Quality & Inspection

  • Machine and inspect parts to ensure they meet customer and engineering specifications.
  • Perform in-process and final inspection using precision measuring equipment, including:
    • Calipers
    • Micrometers
    • Precision gauges
    • Comparators
    • Surface plates
    • Other inspection equipment
  • May operate or utilize CMM equipment.
  • Monitor dimensions and tolerances throughout the machining process.
  • Ensure inspection equipment is properly calibrated and used according to requirements.
  • Perform statistical process control (SPC) activities as required.

Equipment Maintenance

  • Routinely maintain machining equipment to support cleanliness, accuracy, reliability, and production performance.
  • Identify equipment issues and troubleshoot problems when appropriate.
  • Maintain tools, fixtures, machines, and work areas in proper operating condition.

Lean Manufacturing & Continuous Improvement

  • Actively participate in Lean manufacturing initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to improve:
    • Productivity
    • Quality
    • Efficiency
    • Cost
    • Safety
    • Workflow
  • Recommend and implement process improvements within the work area.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives and operational goals.

Team Support & Leadership

  • Work independently with minimal supervision while contributing effectively within a team environment.
  • Help coordinate workload priorities based on business demand.
  • Provide guidance and technical assistance to less-experienced machinists.
  • Train and mentor other team members as needed.
  • Serve as a technical resource within the machining area.

Required Qualifications

Experience

  • 5+ years of directly related machining experience in a high-technology manufacturing environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Strong CNC machining experience is required.
  • Experience with complex machining setups strongly preferred.
  • Aerospace, defense, medical device, or other precision manufacturing experience is highly desirable.

Technical Skills

Candidates should be proficient in several of the following:

  • CNC machining
  • CNC setup
  • CNC turning
  • CNC milling
  • Swiss machining
  • Grinding
  • Manual machining
  • Tooling
  • Fixtures and workholding
  • Machine offsets
  • Process troubleshooting
  • Precision inspection
  • GD&T/tolerancing
  • Blueprint interpretation
  • Shop mathematics
  • Trigonometry
  • SPC
  • Lean manufacturing

Blueprint & Mathematics

  • Ability to read and interpret complex blueprints and engineering drawings.
  • Ability to understand engineering specifications and manufacturing documentation.
  • Working knowledge of advanced shop mathematics.
  • Ability to apply trigonometry when required.
  • Strong understanding of dimensions, tolerances, and precision machining requirements.

Communication & Teamwork

  • Effective verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, and other team members.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a production environment.
  • Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting capabilities.
  • Demonstrated ability to train and mentor less-experienced employees.

Physical & Work Environment

The position requires the ability to:

  • Stand, walk, and sit for extended periods.
  • Use hands and demonstrate strong manual dexterity when operating machinery and handling components.
  • Maintain close visual attention to machining operations and precision measurements.
  • Work safely around CNC machinery, tooling, materials, and production equipment.
  • Lift up to 50 pounds when required.
  • Maintain regular attendance and reliable work performance.
  • Work cooperatively and professionally with other team members.

Reasonable accommodations may be available for qualified individuals to perform the essential functions of the position.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for a career-level machinist, not someone whose experience is limited to loading and unloading CNC machines.

The strongest candidates will be able to explain:

  • How they perform a CNC setup from start to finish
  • How they select and change tooling
  • How they establish or adjust offsets
  • How they troubleshoot dimensional or machining problems
  • How they read complex blueprints
  • How they inspect precision components
  • How they determine whether a part is within tolerance
  • How they work with Engineering to resolve manufacturing issues
  • What types of CNC equipment they have personally operated
  • Their experience with Swiss lathes, mills, grinders, and manual machines
  • The tightest tolerances and most complex components they have machined

Recruiter Prescreen Questions

Before submitting a candidate, confirm:

  1. How many years of hands-on CNC machining experience do you have?
  2. How much of your experience is as a CNC Machinist versus Machine Operator?
  3. What CNC machines have you personally set up and operated?
  4. Do you have experience with Swiss lathes?
  5. Do you have experience with CNC mills?
  6. Do you have experience with grinding or manual machining?
  7. Can you independently perform a complete CNC setup, including tooling, fixtures, offsets, and adjustments?
  8. What types of materials and components have you machined?
  9. Have you worked with tight-tolerance or precision components? Please provide examples.
  10. Are you comfortable reading complex blueprints and engineering drawings?
  11. What precision measuring equipment have you used?
  12. Do you have experience with CMM, SPC, or other quality-control processes?
  13. Have you worked directly with Engineering to troubleshoot machining or drawing issues?
  14. Are you comfortable working with minimal supervision?
  15. Which shift are you interested in?
  16. Are you open to relocating to Ogden, UT?
  17. If relocating, where are you currently located and approximately how far are you from Ogden?

Sourcing Direction

Please prioritize highly skilled, experienced CNC Machinists over general machine operators.

Do not limit searches to candidates with the exact title "CNC Machinist." Strong candidates may have titles such as:

  • CNC Machinist
  • Senior CNC Machinist
  • CNC Technician
  • Machinist Technician
  • Precision Machinist
  • CNC Setup Machinist
  • Swiss Machinist
  • CNC Mill Machinist
  • CNC Lathe Machinist
  • Manufacturing Machinist
  • Aerospace Machinist
  • Tool & Die Machinist
  • Journeyman Machinist

job.title: Learning Architect
job.description:
Learning Architect (LA)

Position Overview

The Learning Architect (LA) is responsible for platform-specific curriculum design, development, and ongoing maintenance within the GMQLD operating model. This role partners closely with site Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), Platform Leads, and the Center of Excellence (COE) to ensure learning content remains current, compliant, and aligned with manufacturing processes and business needs.

The ideal candidate brings a strong combination of Learning & Development/instructional design expertise and experience within a GxP-regulated manufacturing environment.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Curriculum Design & Development

  • Design and develop platform-specific training content within COE governance frameworks and global standards.
  • Address approximately 90% platform-level content and 10% site-specific content, as assigned by the M2/P4 Platform Lead.
  • Partner with site SMEs to develop curricula that accurately reflect current manufacturing processes.
  • Apply process-based curriculum principles, organizing learning content by manufacturing process with task-level qualifications.
  • Ensure curricula align with the three-layer content model: Global, Platform, and Site.
  • Leverage global COE content as the foundation for platform-specific curriculum development.

Content Governance & Quality

  • Develop and maintain training content in accordance with COE standards, governance frameworks, quality requirements, and regulatory expectations.
  • Identify content gaps and site-specific needs and escalate them to the Platform Lead and COE for resolution.
  • Support learning equivalency, exception, and substitution decisions in alignment with the Quality system.
  • Ensure learning materials remain current, accurate, compliant, and aligned with manufacturing requirements.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Partnership

  • Partner with the Platform Lead (M2/P4) on Learning & Development strategy and business priorities across platform sites.
  • Interface with the COE to ensure alignment with global standards, governance requirements, and cross-platform initiatives.
  • Collaborate with Learning Execution Partners (LEPs) to understand site-specific execution needs and incorporate feedback into curriculum updates.
  • Work cross-functionally with teams including Quality, Operations, Engineering, and Manufacturing.
  • Represent the platform in cross-functional forums, audits, and governance reviews.
  • Collaborate effectively across multiple sites and time zones.

Continuous Improvement

  • Support Time to Qualification optimization initiatives by identifying training burden, content redundancies, and qualification bottlenecks.
  • Contribute to On-the-Job Training (OJT) standardization across platform sites.
  • Use data and qualification outcomes to identify opportunities to improve curriculum effectiveness.
  • Recommend enhancements to learning content, processes, and qualification programs.

Basic Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree required; OR
  • Minimum of 10 years of equivalent relevant experience in lieu of a degree.

Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in a GxP-regulated environment.
  • Experience in one or more of the following areas:
    • Learning & Development
    • Instructional Design
    • Manufacturing Operations
    • Quality Operations
  • Experience with curriculum design, Learning Management Systems (LMS), and GMP training requirements.
  • Strong understanding of:
    • GxP requirements
    • Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP)
    • Regulatory requirements
    • Compliance training
  • English proficiency, both written and verbal.

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Deep knowledge of manufacturing processes such as:
    • Prefilled Syringes (PFS)
    • Cartridge manufacturing
    • DAP/EM
    • Chemical manufacturing
    • Biologics
  • Experience developing process-based or competency-based curriculum architectures.
  • Experience supporting learning programs across multiple manufacturing sites.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, particularly with Quality, Operations, Engineering, and Manufacturing teams.
  • Experience with digital learning tools and methodologies.
  • Experience with Digital OJT (DOJT), OJT programs, or OJT standardization.
  • Familiarity with Workday, SuccessFactors, or similar HR/Learning Management Systems.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to use data to evaluate training effectiveness and qualification

The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced manufacturing environment, is detail-oriented, and can effectively coordinate with freight carriers, vendors, suppliers, and internal departments while maintaining accurate inventory records and ensuring on-time shipments. This is a hands-on role requiring extensive standing, walking, lifting, and forklift operation throughout the workday.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the shipping and receiving of all products, materials, and supplies.

  • Verify incoming shipments against bills of lading, packing slips, and purchase orders.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Previous shipping, receiving, warehouse, inventory, or logistics experience preferred.
  • Strong computer skills, including experience with QuickBooks, Microsoft Outlook, Excel, and data entry.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple responsibilities simultaneously.
  • Forklift experience preferred or willingness to become certified.
  • Valid driver's license with a clean driving record.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

Physical Requirements

  • This is a physically demanding, hands-on position.
  • Must be able to lift and move materials and equipment weighing up to 80 pounds.

  • Ability to work on your feet for extended periods of time.

job.title: Head of Product - Commercial Lending
job.description:
Head of Product – Commercial Lending Technology

Location: Remote – United States
Employment Type: Full-Tim

The Opportunity

We are seeking a senior Product leader with deep commercial lending and LOS experience to help shape and build the next generation of a commercial lending platform. This person will own product strategy and roadmap priorities, bring strong knowledge of the full commercial lending lifecycle, and work closely with Engineering to turn market and business needs into scalable product capabilities. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can set direction, understand the competitive landscape, and stay close to the details as the product is built.

 

What You'll Do

  • Own the product strategy, roadmap, and prioritization for a commercial lending technology platform.
  • Bring deep commercial lending expertise across origination, underwriting, credit approval, monitoring, and portfolio management.
  • Use market trends, competitive intelligence, customer needs, and business priorities to guide product decisions.
  • Translate lending workflows and business requirements into clear product requirements, acceptance criteria, and development priorities.
  • Partner closely with Engineering throughout planning, development, testing, and release.
  • Lead and develop a small Product team while remaining hands-on in the day-to-day work.
  • Help establish practical Product processes around requirements, roadmap management, prioritization, and product validation.
  • Identify opportunities to improve workflows, reduce manual effort, and create stronger differentiation in the commercial lending market.
  • Participate in customer or prospect conversations when Product expertise is needed.

What We're Looking For

Required Experience

  • Significant Product Management experience within commercial lending technology, commercial loan origination systems, banking technology, or a closely related fintech environment.
  • Deep knowledge of the end-to-end commercial lending lifecycle.
  • Experience owning a commercial lending product, product line, or significant product portfolio.
  • Previous leadership responsibility for Product professionals or a Product function.
  • Demonstrated experience owning product strategy, roadmaps, and prioritization.
  • Ability to understand market dynamics and competitive positioning within lending technology.
  • Experience translating business requirements and complex financial workflows into scalable software capabilities.
  • Strong history of partnering directly with Software Engineering teams.
  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with detailed, hands-on Product work.
  • Strong written, verbal, and executive communication skills.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience working directly for a commercial LOS, lending software, banking technology, or fintech provider.
  • Product experience involving commercial credit underwriting, financial spreading, credit decisioning, portfolio management, or loan workflow technology.
  • Experience building or launching a new product or substantial new platform capability.
  • Familiarity with APIs, integrations, bank cores, and third-party financial technology.
  • Experience introducing stronger Product processes within a smaller or growing software organization.
  • Experience working in an entrepreneurial environment where priorities can change quickly and leaders wear multiple hats.

Work Environment

  • Remote position within the United States
  • Candidates should be comfortable maintaining meaningful overlap with Pacific Time business hours
  • Limited travel expected, primarily for occasional company meetings or strategic in-person sessions
  • Small, distributed Product and Engineering organization
  • Highly collaborative environment with direct access to company leadership

Why This Opportunity

This is an opportunity to have a meaningful influence on the development of a commercial lending product rather than simply inherit and maintain an established roadmap.
The person selected will bring commercial lending knowledge that is critical to the next phase of the platform, helping determine what gets built, how the product should compete, and how technology can improve the commercial lending process.
For someone who understands commercial lending deeply and enjoys building products in a smaller, hands-on environment, this role offers significant ownership and visibility.

job.title: Project Controls Specialist - (Oil/Gas)
job.description:
BASIC FUNCTION:
Supports project team by providing financial controls and tracking for regional capital projects, and project manager with management tools, controls, and analysis, allowing manager to make informed decisions with accurate and timely data.

ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES: (functions considered essential as defined by ADA)
Leads in the overall project cost and schedule control efforts during capital efforts
Initiates correct structuring setups to facilitate data collection and control monitoring during the execution process
Tracks contractor performance, processes payments and logistics
Tracks and forecasts costs throughout life of the project
Tracks progress against budget throughout year
Sets safety example by keeping current on LRST and other safety initiatives within the plans

Special assignments or tasks assigned to the employee by their superior, as determined from time to time in their sole and complete discretion.

EXPERIENCE:
A minimum of 5 years in planning, estimating, and construction/maintenance management in a process plant environment is required.

EDUCATIONAL LEVEL:
A minimum of a High School Diploma or equivalent is required.

PREFERRED EDUCATIONAL LEVEL:
A Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or other technical discipline is preferred.

REQUIRED SKILLS:
Broad understanding of engineering, construction, logistics and financial processes. Advanced knowledge of accounting, contracting, and procurement software systems and processes. Spreadsheet software skills. Ability to work in a fast paced work environment and deliver to required deadlines. Ability to work additional hours as required to support project control efforts. Prioritization skills are required. Ability to see how all the pieces affect the overall refinery, i.e., big picture perspective. Ability to effectively communicate with others, both written and verbal communication. Advanced reading and writing skills, with the ability to perform intermediate mathematical calculations.

PREFERRED SKILLS:
General proficiency in Microsoft packages Word, Outlook, Excel, Project, Access as well as Primavera (P6) etc. General knowledge of procedures and practices for contracting field construction activities are preferred.

SUPERVISORY/MANAGERIAL RESPONSIBILITIES:
None.

WORK CONDITIONS:
Office based with up to 5% travel by land and air required. Petroleum refinery, warehouse/plant environment including but not limited to chemicals, pressure vessels tanks, rotating equipment, loud noise and vibrations. Subject to all temperatures, weather and varying road conditions.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:
Job conditions require sitting, talking or hearing, making precise hand and finger movements, reaching or grasping, perceiving color difference, and wearing personal protective equipment (beards not permitted). Job conditions may require standing, walking, making visual inspections, lifting and/or carrying up to 10lbs, and ability to operate and drive all assigned company vehicles at company standard insurance rates is essential, valid state drivers license and proof of insurance required.

ENVIRONMENTAL, HEALTH, & SAFETY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Our primary values are: We put health and safety first; We care about the environment.
All employees are expected to work safely every day and be safety & environmental leaders. This includes active participation in the following:
Stops and/or reports any unsafe work or conditions
Follows safety & environmental policies and procedures
Supports safety & environmental goals and initiatives
Participates in safety & environmental meetings, training, emergency drills and hazard recognition programs
Reports all accidents, injuries and near misses, and participates in associated investigations
Participates in industrial hygiene, medical surveillance and behavior based safety programs

job.title: Product Manager/Product Owner – Customer Communications
job.description:
Product Manager / Product Owner – Customer Experience & Communications

Location: New York, NY
Work Arrangement: Hybrid – 3 days per week in the office during training; after training, in-office as needed
Schedule: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM EST
Employment Type: 6-Month Contract with Potential for FTE Conversion
Openings: 2
Compensation: $65–$85/hour
Start Date: ASAP

Position Overview

We are seeking two Product Managers / Product Owners to support customer experience, digital transformation, and customer communications initiatives for a complex, customer-facing organization.

This role combines Product Ownership, Project Management, and Business Analysis responsibilities. The ideal candidate will be comfortable working in an Agile environment, managing product backlogs, gathering and translating business requirements, coordinating development activities, and working closely with business stakeholders, technology teams, and third-party vendors.

The team supports digital customer experiences and multi-channel communications across platforms such as websites, mobile applications, SMS, email, voice, and other customer-facing channels. The position will also support transformational initiatives and time-sensitive customer communications, including emergency and weather-related notifications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and prioritize product and program backlogs, enhancements, features, epics, and user stories.

  • Partner with business stakeholders to understand customer and business needs and translate them into actionable requirements.

  • Develop clear, concise user stories, acceptance criteria, business requirements, and functional specifications.

  • Support product and feature development across digital customer channels, including websites, mobile applications, and other customer-facing platforms.

  • Lead or support Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, stand-ups, backlog refinement/grooming, reviews, retrospectives, and release planning.

  • Coordinate Agile teams or pods from a business and product perspective.

  • Track sprint and release progress, team velocity, deliverables, risks, issues, and dependencies.

  • Manage project plans, schedules, action items, status reporting, documentation, and other program materials.

  • Coordinate with technology teams, vendors, and internal stakeholders to ensure requirements and deliverables remain on track.

  • Conduct requirements analysis, process analysis, testing, UAT, and issue resolution.

  • Develop test plans and test cases and coordinate testing activities with business and technical teams.

  • Support customer communications across multiple channels, including SMS, email, voice, web, and mobile.

  • Support customer communications during emergency or time-sensitive situations.

  • Identify opportunities to improve product processes, governance, intake, and overall customer experience.

  • Conduct research and analysis related to digital customer experience, industry trends, customer behavior, and emerging technologies.

  • Prepare presentations, status reports, and documentation for management and other stakeholders.

  • Manage multiple priorities and workstreams in a fast-paced, sometimes ambiguous environment.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree required.

  • 3+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, Project Management, Business Analysis, Customer Experience, or a related discipline.

  • Demonstrated experience working in an Agile product development environment.

  • Experience managing or supporting product backlogs, requirements, user stories, and feature prioritization.

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

  • Ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical teams.

  • Experience coordinating projects, deliverables, risks, issues, and competing priorities.

  • Strong analytical, organizational, documentation, and problem-solving skills.

  • Experience with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel.

  • Technical aptitude and ability to quickly understand business processes, technology platforms, and systems.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to work independently and effectively within a small, complex team.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience as a Product Owner for an Agile development team.

  • Experience with SAFe Agile, Agile transformation, or large-scale Agile programs.

  • Experience with digital customer experience, websites, mobile applications, or digital products.

  • Experience with customer communications or multi-channel communication platforms.

  • Experience with SMS, email, voice, web, mobile, or other customer communication technologies.

  • Vendor management or third-party technology partner experience.

  • Experience with Azure DevOps, Monday.com, Jira, or similar Agile/product management tools.

  • Experience with web accessibility guidelines and compliance.

  • Experience in the utility industry or another regulated/highly complex environment.

  • Knowledge of customer operations, customer assistance programs, or customer-facing regulations.

  • Experience supporting emergency communications or other time-sensitive customer initiatives.

  • Experience preparing executive, regulatory, or formal stakeholder presentations and documentation.

Additional Information

This is a 6-month contract opportunity with potential for conversion to a full-time position based on performance and business needs.

Candidates should be comfortable working in a hybrid environment in New York City. A valid driver's license may be required for potential FTE conversion; driving is not required as part of the day-to-day responsibilities of this position.

Title: Facility/Site Supervisor (Coyanosa Thermal Treatment Facility)

The Facility/Site Supervisor at the Coyanosa Facility is a critical and dynamic role. Coyanosa TTF is one of the most regulated facilities in SLB. The Facility/Site Supervisor is responsible for working with management to ensure the execution of SLB standards and policies for the facility as they pertain to the regulatory Compliance program, facility sustainment and maintenance, facility administration, and personnel. The Coyanosa Facility Supervisor function is critical in establishing, monitoring, and continuously improving environmental performance and environmental programs at the highly regulated Coyanosa Thermal Treatment Center.

General Duties Include but are not limited to:
• Work with Regulatory Compliance to maintain up-to-date knowledge of laws and regulations affecting local operations.
• Coordinate with Regulatory Compliance for the gathering and submission processes for regulatory licenses and permits.
• Maintain regulatory compliance documentation.
• Support the preparation of reports to management and to regulatory bodies within set time targets.
• Coordinate with Management to Implement procedural modifications based on changes in local laws and regulations.
• Report regulatory compliance incidents to Management and in QUEST.
• Participate in external and internal regulatory audits and inspections and ensure all remedial actions are documented and closed in a timely manner.
• Advise management on corrective actions required.
• Help develop and provide awareness training to employees on processes for internal and external regulatory compliance requirements.

Specific Environmental Duties
• Liaise with local contractors and agencies regarding environmental programs.
• Assess local environmental risks and develop risk controls.
• Coordinate with Management and HSE to recommend changes to environmental procedures, work instructions and checklists as required.
Monitor plans defining how the environmental aspects of the HSE Management System are implemented at the location level. Monitor and recommended improvements.
• Ensure compliance to Environmental policies, standards and procedures.
• Plan and assist in compliance audits and self-audits. Advise management on corrective action required.
• Coordinate environmental training of personnel, including contractors.
• Keep abreast of new documentation and training material related to environmental management and inform management accordingly.

• Advise management on the compliance of the local environmental program with ***, local and national requirements, and regulations.
• Support line management in investigations of environmental incidents.

Specific Business/Operational Duties
• Implement best practices in facility operations to ensure a consistent professional image for the facility.

job.title: Sr. DevOps/Deployment Engineer
job.description:
Position Overview

We are looking for a hands-on Senior DevOps Engineer with strong experience building and improving software deployment and release processes in Linux environments. This role is best suited for someone who understands the full software delivery lifecycle — not just how to maintain an existing pipeline. You should be comfortable designing deployment solutions, working through complex technical problems independently, and understanding how decisions made within a pipeline or deployment process impact the broader application environment.

The immediate focus will be on Linux virtual machine deployments, release automation, application packaging, and CI/CD. Longer term, the environment is expected to continue evolving toward greater use of containerization.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and YAML.
  • Develop reusable pipeline templates and deployment processes that can support multiple applications and environments.
  • Create and maintain Ansible playbooks, roles, inventories, and automation workflows.
  • Build and support automated application deployments into Linux virtual machine environments.
  • Package and deploy applications using Debian-based deployment methods.
  • Support the build, packaging, versioning, release, and deployment of .NET applications and services.
  • Develop deployment solutions appropriate to different .NET frameworks and application architectures.
  • Help establish consistent release, versioning, and deployment practices across technical teams.
  • Support deployments across environments with varying levels of connectivity, including restricted or disconnected environments.
  • Troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines, Linux systems, application builds, package deployments, configuration issues, and release failures.
  • Work closely with software engineering, infrastructure, QA, database, and other technical teams to improve the overall deployment process.
  • Research technical issues through product documentation and other authoritative resources and independently develop solutions.
  • Contribute to the organization's longer-term transition toward containerized and orchestrated application deployments.

Required Experience

  • 5+ years of DevOps, Release Engineering, Deployment Engineering, Infrastructure Automation, or comparable experience.
  • Advanced hands-on experience with Ansible, including creating and maintaining playbooks and roles.
  • Strong experience working within Linux environments.
  • Direct experience building and/or deploying Debian packages to Linux virtual machines.
  • Strong experience designing and developing Azure DevOps YAML pipelines.
  • Experience creating reusable YAML templates and structured CI/CD pipeline frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of software versioning, packaging, build processes, release management, and deployment patterns.
  • Experience supporting the build and deployment lifecycle of .NET applications.
  • Ability to independently troubleshoot complex deployment and pipeline problems.
  • Strong understanding of how application builds, infrastructure, configuration, pipelines, and deployment processes work together as a complete system.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to document technical designs and explain technical decisions.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience with Docker or other container technologies.
  • Kubernetes, orchestration, or container platform experience.
  • Experience supporting both traditional VM-based and containerized application environments.
  • Infrastructure as Code experience using tools such as Terraform or similar technologies.
  • Experience deploying applications into cloud, on-premises, hybrid, or restricted-connectivity environments.
  • Scripting experience using Bash, PowerShell, Python, or similar languages.
  • Experience with SQL Server deployment automation.

The Mechanical Technician is responsible for ensuring on-time delivery of equipment as per operational demands. job.title: Maintenance Manager
job.description:
Maintenance Manager

Reports to: Plant Manager
Location: Farmingdale and Amityville, New York (On-Site)
Pay: From $100,000 per year

POSITION SUMMARY

We are seeking an experienced, hands-on Maintenance Manager to lead maintenance and reliability across two Long Island manufacturing facilities. This position is responsible for leading the maintenance team, improving equipment reliability, managing preventive maintenance programs, overseeing repairs and projects, maintaining regulatory compliance, and controlling maintenance-related spending.

This is not strictly an administrative position. The Maintenance Manager must be comfortable working directly with equipment, leading complex troubleshooting, reading prints and manuals, identifying and sourcing components, and ensuring critical issues are resolved effectively.

A key initial priority will be establishing and driving consistent use of a newly implemented Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS), including equipment and parts data, preventive maintenance programs, work-order standards, and maintenance reporting.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Maintenance Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead, schedule, coach, and develop maintenance technicians and mechanics supporting multiple shifts and two facilities.
  • Establish daily and weekly priorities based on safety, production needs, equipment criticality, labor, and parts availability.
  • Set clear expectations for workmanship, attendance, documentation, housekeeping, shift handoffs, and communication.
  • Evaluate team performance, identify skill gaps, provide technical coaching and cross-training, and address performance concerns in coordination with HR.
  • Maintain appropriate shift and emergency coverage and ensure open repairs and production risks are communicated effectively.

CMMS & Maintenance Planning

  • Lead the implementation and ongoing administration of the maintenance department's CMMS.
  • Maintain accurate equipment records, asset hierarchy, preventive maintenance schedules, parts information, manuals, drawings, and equipment history.
  • Establish effective work-order standards, priorities, scheduling, downtime reporting, and closeout procedures.
  • Develop and continuously improve preventive and predictive maintenance programs for production equipment, utilities, buildings, and safety systems.
  • Use CMMS reporting to manage PM completion, maintenance backlog, recurring failures, equipment history, parts usage, and maintenance performance.

Troubleshooting & Equipment Reliability

  • Provide hands-on technical leadership during complex or high-impact equipment failures involving mechanical, electrical, controls, pneumatic, hydraulic, refrigeration, boiler, steam, and facility systems.
  • Troubleshoot automated production and packaging equipment, including batching and cooking systems, pumps, mixers, fillers, cappers, conveyors, coding and labeling equipment, and related utilities.
  • Lead root-cause analysis for significant breakdowns and recurring problems and ensure corrective actions are completed and effective.
  • Maintain accurate electrical and mechanical drawings, equipment documentation, control-system backups, and records of equipment changes.
  • Partner with Production and Quality during equipment startup and turnover to ensure repairs meet safety, quality, and performance expectations.

Parts, Vendors & Contractors

  • Identify, research, cross-reference, and source mechanical, electrical, controls, and facility components, including obsolete and long-lead parts.
  • Develop and maintain a critical spare-parts program based on equipment risk, failure history, lead time, and cost.
  • Maintain accurate parts inventory and storeroom records.
  • Build strong relationships with manufacturers, distributors, repair services, and technical contractors.
  • Obtain and compare quotations, coordinate contractor work, and ensure outside work meets established expectations.

Safety, Food Safety & Compliance

  • Ensure maintenance activities comply with OSHA requirements, safety policies, LOTO, machine guarding, electrical safety, and other applicable requirements.
  • Ensure repairs meet cGMP, sanitary design, food safety, allergen control, foreign-material, and sanitation standards.
  • Maintain accurate, audit-ready maintenance, inspection, calibration, contractor, and corrective-action records.
  • Support customer, regulatory, GFSI, and internal audits.

Projects, Budgeting & Continuous Improvement

  • Lead or support equipment installations, upgrades, capital projects, commissioning, and startup activities.
  • Develop project scopes, cost estimates, schedules, and risk assessments and monitor project costs and progress.
  • Manage maintenance labor, parts, repair, service contract, and capital spending.
  • Use downtime, maintenance, quality, safety, and cost data to identify reliability and continuous-improvement opportunities.
  • Provide plant leadership with clear updates on equipment condition, major breakdowns, staffing, PM status, projects, risks, and recommended actions.
  • Work closely with Production, Quality, Safety, Sanitation, HR, and plant leadership to coordinate priorities and support uninterrupted operations.

QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS

Required Experience

  • Minimum of 8 years of progressive industrial maintenance experience, including at least 4 years supervising or managing maintenance employees in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
  • Experience in food, beverage, pharmaceutical, or another regulated, sanitation-sensitive manufacturing environment; food manufacturing strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated success leading a multi-shift maintenance team and improving maintenance execution and equipment reliability.
  • Hands-on experience implementing, building out, or significantly improving a CMMS, including asset data, PMs, work orders, equipment history, parts, backlog management, and reporting.
  • Strong experience leading complex troubleshooting and root-cause analysis on automated production and packaging equipment.
  • Proven ability to identify, research, cross-reference, and source mechanical, electrical, controls, and facility components.

Education & Technical Knowledge

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or Manufacturing Engineering preferred. Technical education, recognized trade training, or an equivalent combination of education and substantial hands-on experience will be considered.
  • Strong knowledge of industrial mechanical and electrical systems, motors, pumps, gearboxes, pneumatics, hydraulics, sensors, instrumentation, VFDs, PLC diagnostics, and HMI fault information.
  • Ability to read electrical schematics, mechanical drawings, manuals, specifications, and parts diagrams.
  • Working knowledge of plant utilities, preventive and predictive maintenance, root-cause analysis, OSHA requirements, cGMPs, and food manufacturing safety standards.
  • Strong computer skills, including CMMS administration, Microsoft Excel, data analysis, and written reporting.

Leadership & Work Style

  • Calm and decisive under production pressure with strong organizational and follow-through skills.
  • Fair, direct, and professional when setting expectations and addressing performance concerns.
  • Able to earn the respect of experienced tradespeople through technical credibility, consistency, and hands-on leadership.
  • Strong communicator who can explain technical issues and business risks to employees, leadership, vendors, and nontechnical personnel.

SCHEDULE & WORK REQUIREMENTS

  • Full-time, on-site position with regular work at both the Farmingdale and Amityville facilities.
  • Must be available to support multiple shifts and respond to urgent plant issues outside normal working hours when required.
  • Must be able to work safely in an active manufacturing environment and comply with all required PPE, hygiene, safety, and food safety requirements.

BENEFITS

  • 401(k)
  • 401(k) matching
  • Health insurance
  • Dental insurance
  • Vision insurance
  • Paid time off

job.title: Manufacturing Engineer II (NPI)
job.description:
Nesco Resource is in search of a Manufacturing Engineer II (NPI) to work for one of our clients based in Bethel, CT.
 
SUMMARY:
The Manufacturing Engineer II will serve as the New Product Introduction (NPI) Design Transfer Engineer provides support for documenting medical device component manufacturing processes for handoff from development to full scale production. This position is the bridge between R&D and manufacturing engineering. Will utilize the company’s phased design transfer process to ensure that all production release requirements are being met on schedule, including utilizing transfer checklists or project plans, and conducting phase gate reviews with functional department managers.
 
RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Coordinate closely with Development and Manufacturing Engineering to define and document component manufacturing requirements and processes as devices move through the development lifecycle
  • Work with cross-functional departments to confirm manufacturing line readiness and ensure appropriate equipment, space and staff are prepared
  • Finalize inspection procedures including defining inspection sample size and inspection techniques/gages for each lot of parts
  • Write work instructions and train production staff on procedures
  • Draft process risk assessment (PFMEA), process flow charts, and control plans
  • Perform process validation (IQ/OQ/PQ/MVP/TMV) and gage R&R activities, as required
  • Ensure bill of materials and job router accuracy
  • Solidify tooling documentation for production release using SolidWorks, including tool design updates for manufacturability and tool drawing creation/modification
  • Review process metrics to identify areas of improvement during the transfer process
  • Ensure that accurate and complete QMS/DMR records are generated through the change order process, including documentation of both finished components and raw materials
  • Monitor transfers post-release for lessons learned or process improvements
  • Provide constructive feedback to the production transfer process, and participate in continuous improvement initiatives such as creating templates for similar processes
  • Assist in driving manufacturing engineering projects to completion, including making sure the work is done satisfactorily and timely.
  • Other duties as assigned
QUALIFICATIONS:
  • BS in relevant Engineering discipline
  • 3 years’ experience in a manufacturing environment
  • Familiarity creating and modifying drawings and models using SolidWorks
  • Strong communication skills, comfortable with providing project status updates at the team level or holding phase gate meetings with functional department managers
  • Demonstrated work ethic and understanding of deadline management
  • Effective interpersonal skills and adeptness in working with a culturally diverse employee population
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:
  • Experience working in a medical device or regulated environment
  • Prior experience transferring projects from development to manufacturing

job.title: CNC Machinist
job.description:
Position Summary
The Machinist III is responsible for programming, setting up, operating, and troubleshooting CNC and manual machining equipment to manufacture precision parts that meet engineering specifications and quality standards. This role requires advanced machining knowledge, the ability to work independently with minimal supervision, and strong communication skills to collaborate with internal teams and external vendors.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities
Program CNC machines using CamWorks and SolidWorks software.
Utilize knowledge of Mastercam or GibbsCAM software, with training provided for CamWorks as needed.
Perform light G-code editing at the machine to optimize programs and correct machining issues.
Set up and operate CNC mills, CNC lathes, manual lathes, and other machining equipment.
Create and modify simple machine programs directly at the machine when required.
Select tooling, establish work and tool offsets, and optimize machining processes.
Read and interpret:
Blueprints
GD&T (Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing)
CAD drawings
Engineering sketches and specifications
Conduct in-process and final inspections using precision measuring instruments, including:
Micrometers
Calipers
Pin gauges
Indicators
Other precision gauges
Troubleshoot machining, tooling, and quality issues to ensure efficient production.
Perform routine machine maintenance and basic equipment repairs.
Understand material characteristics and machining requirements for various metals and other materials.
Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on safety, quality, productivity, and cost reduction.
Communicate effectively with supervisors, engineers, coworkers, and vendors.
Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.

Required Qualifications
High school diploma or equivalent; technical or vocational training preferred.
Minimum of 5 years of machining experience in a manufacturing environment.
Experience programming CNC equipment using CAM software.
Proficiency with CamWorks and SolidWorks preferred.
Experience with Mastercam or GibbsCAM is acceptable; training on CamWorks will be provided.
Ability to read and interpret blueprints, CAD drawings, and GD&T requirements.
Working knowledge of G-code programming and machine-side editing.
Experience setting up and operating CNC and manual lathes.
Strong understanding of machining processes, tooling selection, feeds, speeds, and material properties.
Ability to use precision measuring and inspection equipment accurately.
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications
Advanced CNC programming experience.
Experience with multi-axis machining operations.
Lean manufacturing or continuous improvement experience.
Experience communicating directly with suppliers and outside vendors.
Physical Requirements
Ability to stand, walk, bend, and lift throughout the workday.
Ability to lift up to 50 pounds occasionally.
Ability to safely operate machine tools and inspection equipment.
Must be able to work in a manufacturing environment with exposure to noise, moving machinery, and metalworking fluids.

Key Competencies
CNC Programming
CNC and Manual Machining
Blueprint Reading
GD&T Interpretation
Precision Measurement & Inspection
Troubleshooting & Problem Solving
Material Knowledge
Process Improvement
Communication & Teamwork
Independent Work Execution
This position is ideal for a highly skilled machinist who can independently program, set up, machine, inspect, and troubleshoot precision components while supporting quality and continuous improvement objectives.

job.title: Supply Chain Customer Service Representative
job.description:
Nesco Resource is partnering with a global leader in the petrochemical and manufacturing industry to hire a Supply Chain Customer Service Representative for its Houston team.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys being the main point of contact for customers while also working closely with supply chain, logistics, sales, and operations. This is not a traditional call-center position. The role is focused on managing B2B customer accounts, coordinating orders from start to finish, proactively communicating with customers, analyzing demand and buying trends, and resolving issues throughout the order fulfillment process.

The ideal candidate will have experience in customer service, supply chain, order management, logistics, or customer account management within a corporate, manufacturing, industrial, chemical, petrochemical, or oil & gas environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for assigned B2B customer accounts
  • Build and maintain strong customer relationships through proactive communication and follow-up
  • Manage customer orders and support the order-to-fulfillment process
  • Coordinate closely with supply chain, logistics, operations, sales, and other internal teams
  • Proactively contact customers regarding orders, product needs, demand changes, and service-related issues
  • Monitor customer buying patterns and identify increases or decreases in demand
  • Analyze customer and order data to anticipate needs and identify potential issues
  • Resolve order, shipment, inventory, and customer service issues while ensuring timely follow-through
  • Help identify opportunities to retain existing business and increase customer satisfaction
  • Balance customer needs with operational and business requirements
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and increased efficiency
  • Maintain accurate customer and order information within ERP and internal systems

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in a corporate B2B environment
  • Experience in customer service, supply chain, order management, logistics, customer operations, inside sales support, or a related field
  • Strong customer-facing experience via phone and email
  • Ability to manage customer relationships rather than solely process transactions
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Excellent organization, multitasking, and follow-through
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and basic math skills
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Word
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience

Highly Preferred

  • SAP or other ERP experience
  • Manufacturing, industrial, chemical, petrochemical, plastics, or oil & gas experience
  • Supply chain and order fulfillment experience
  • Experience analyzing customer demand, buying patterns, KPIs, or order trends
  • Experience working with logistics, inventory, warehouses, or transportation
  • Lean/Six Sigma or process improvement exposure
  • Bilingual or multilingual communication skills are a plus

What We're Looking For

The strongest candidate will be someone who can say, "I own the customer relationship and make sure their orders and needs are handled from beginning to end.”

We're looking for someone who is proactive, comfortable picking up the phone and contacting customers, understands how customer service connects with supply chain and operations, and can use data to anticipate customer needs—not someone whose experience is limited to simply entering orders.

This contract-to-hire opportunity offers the chance to join an established global organization with exposure to multiple areas of the business and long-term opportunities for professional growth.

job.title: Process Designer - Aveva P&ID
job.description:
We are seeking an experienced Process Designer with advanced AVEVA P&ID experience to support industrial process engineering and design projects. This position will focus on creating, updating, and maintaining Process and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs) while working closely with Process Engineers and multidisciplinary project teams.

The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of process design principles, industrial facility operations, and experience developing engineering deliverables within a fast-paced project environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, revise, and maintain Process and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs) using AVEVA P&ID.
  • Support Process Engineering teams with process design documentation and project deliverables.
  • Create and update process flow diagrams (PFDs), line lists, equipment information, and associated process documentation.
  • Incorporate engineering markups and field changes into existing process drawings.
  • Ensure design deliverables comply with project standards, client requirements, and industry best practices.
  • Coordinate with Process Engineers, Instrumentation Designers, Piping Designers, and other project stakeholders.
  • Participate in design reviews and interdisciplinary coordination meetings.
  • Maintain drawing accuracy, consistency, and document control throughout project execution.
  • Assist with as-built documentation updates and Management of Change (MOC) activities.
  • Support both capital projects and facility modification efforts.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Process Design within industrial, chemical, refining, petrochemical, manufacturing, energy, or related industries.
  • Advanced proficiency with AVEVA P&ID software.
  • Demonstrated experience creating and revising P&IDs in an engineering environment.
  • Strong understanding of process engineering concepts, equipment, instrumentation, piping systems, and control systems.
  • Ability to interpret engineering specifications, process flow diagrams, and technical documentation.
  • Experience working in multidisciplinary engineering and design teams.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while meeting project deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting EPC, consulting engineering, or owner-operator projects.
  • Familiarity with AVEVA Engineering, AVEVA E3D, AutoCAD, SmartPlant P&ID, or similar design platforms.
  • Experience with Management of Change (MOC) processes.
  • Knowledge of chemical processing, refining, manufacturing, specialty chemicals, pulp & paper, or industrial facilities.
  • Associate Degree in Design Technology, Engineering Technology, Drafting, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent industry experience.

job.title: Senior Embedded Firmware Engineer
job.description:
Overview

Client is seeking a Senior Embedded Firmware Engineer to design, develop, and support firmware for IoT and video-streaming products. This role will own major firmware components throughout the product lifecycle and collaborate with hardware, cloud, mobile, QA, and manufacturing partners to deliver reliable, production-ready devices.

Core Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, debug, and maintain embedded firmware for IoT and video-streaming products.
  • Own major firmware components and features from initial design through production.
  • Develop and integrate device drivers, communication protocols, RTOS components, and platform firmware.
  • Collaborate with hardware, cloud, mobile, QA, and original design manufacturer partners on system integration and product delivery.
  • Troubleshoot complex firmware, hardware, and system-level issues.
  • Optimize firmware for performance, memory usage, power consumption, resource utilization, and reliability.
  • Review board schematics, component datasheets, and hardware documentation to support development and debugging.
  • Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and root-cause analysis.
  • Evaluate SoCs, image sensors, wireless modules, and other components for future products.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to engineering standards and process improvements.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience.
  • 7+ years of embedded firmware development experience.
  • Strong Embedded C and C++ programming skills.
  • Software development experience across RTOS and Embedded Linux platforms.
  • Understanding of real-time multimedia applications, including video and audio processing, compression, and streaming technologies such as H.264 and H.265.
  • Multithreaded and multitasking embedded software development experience.
  • Experience developing and debugging embedded device drivers.
  • Strong embedded-system debugging, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis skills.
  • Experience optimizing embedded software for performance and resource utilization.
  • Working knowledge of TCP, UDP, HTTP/HTTPS, RTP, RTSP, SIP, and WebRTC.
  • Experience with Wi-Fi, BLE, and LTE wireless technologies.
  • Familiarity with IoT communication architectures and cloud-connected devices.
  • Hands-on experience with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and protocol analyzers.
  • Experience using Git or a comparable source-control system.

Preferred Skills or Experience

  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Firmware development experience involving consumer IoT, smart-home, networking, or video-streaming products.
  • Experience with Zigbee, Z-Wave, Thread, or Matter.
  • Knowledge of Linux memory management, file systems, and bootloaders such as U-Boot.
  • Python, Perl, or Lua scripting experience.
  • Experience supporting products through manufacturing and production.

Work Details

  • Remote role within California, USA

job.title: Instrumentation Technician II
job.description:
***No Tools Needed, All tools will be provided***

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential job functions.

Job Summary:
The Instrumentation Technician II will install test equipment in development vehicles such as thermocouples, transducers, sensors, fiberoptics, accelerometers, strain gages and data acquisition systems. The role will build, modify, adjust and calibrate installed devices. This role will build and install low voltage wire harnesses to drawings and schematics. The Instrumentation Technician II will perform independent project tasks and collaborate with customers and team members.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
• Build and install low voltage automotive and instrumentation wiring harnesses, auxiliary battery and electrical systems.
• Install, adjust and calibrate sensors, shunts, fiber optics, accelerometers, strain gages and data acquisition systems.
• Collaborate with Customers, Fabricators, and Mechanics to identify required locations for sensor installation according to Instrumentation Requirement List (IRL).
• Perform complete functional inspection and prove-out of instrumentation according to Instrumentation Quality Assurance (IQA).
• Diagnose faulty low voltage automotive and instrumentation wiring systems and repair.
